title: Performance Marketing Associate
description:
**Role title: Performance Marketing Associate**

**Function home:**
Performance Marketing

**Seniority band:**
3-5 years total experience, with at least 2 years owning live paid-media spend in B2B SaaS

**Reporting line:**
Reports to the Head of Marketing, CallBotics

**Location:**
Pune (Onsite)

**Work model:**
5 days per week from the office. No remote or hybrid option.
**Shift timing:**
4:00 PM to 1:00 AM IST (aligned to US business hours for live campaign management and same-day collaboration with US-based stakeholders).

**Responsibilities**

Own day-to-day execution across the paid-media mix: LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, ABM display, intent-based platforms, YouTube, and retargeting channels. Translate channel-mix strategy from the Head of Marketing into live campaigns, audience builds, creative briefs, and daily optimisation

Build and operate a multi-stage retargeting funnel covering website visitors, product-page visitors, gated-content downloaders, demo-no-shows, and stalled-deal nurture cohorts. Audience segmentation, creative assignment per stage, and exit-criteria logic sit with this seat.

Run named-campaign-level execution: LinkedIn ABM-tier campaigns paired to target account lists, Google Ads BoFu campaigns paired to competitor-comparison and use-case landing pages, ABM display retargeting paired to in-market account signals, intent-data campaigns once review-platform baselines support them.

Own daily cost-per-qualified-pipeline (CPQP) discipline against the monthly benchmark. Weekly campaign reviews. Monthly creative rotation. Quarterly channel-budget reallocation proposals based on trailing 30-day CPQP performance.

Coordinate with the in-house design team on creative production: paid-creative variants per funnel stage, A/B-test designs, video creative for YouTube and LinkedIn video ads. Maintain the asset library with campaign-tagged assets.

Build and maintain the performance-marketing dashboard in Looker Studio: spend, impressions, click-through rate, demo-booking volume, MQA volume, pipeline-sourced and pipeline-influenced dollars, sliced by channel and audience segment. Daily refresh; weekly review with the Head of Marketing.

Support agency-or-in-house decisions on external performance partners: SLA enforcement, weekly performance review, and transition execution when scope changes.

**Must-have qualifications**

* Two or more years hands-on owning live paid-media spend in B2B SaaS with six-figure ACV and multi-quarter sales cycles. Concrete example: shipped a LinkedIn campaign at meaningful monthly spend with CPQP discipline and trailing 90-day pipeline-sourced contribution reported.
* Hands-on LinkedIn Campaign Manager administrator-level fluency: matched-audience builds, lookalike configuration, conversion API integration, Insight Tag setup, audience layering, video-ads creative space.
* Hands-on Google Ads administrator-level fluency: BoFu search campaigns, branded-search defence, competitor-keyword targeting, negative-keyword discipline, B2B-appropriate Performance Max judgement.
* Named tool fluency: LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, HubSpot Marketing Hub, GA4, Looker Studio. Working comfort with one or more of: 6sense, Demand base, Mutiny, Default.
* Track record of CPQP-or-equivalent pipeline-anchored measurement (not impression-or-click-anchored measurement). The candidate must be able to explain how they back-calculate paid spend to pipeline contribution without hand-waving the attribution layer.

**Nice-to-have qualifications**

* Conversational AI, contact-centre AI, or BPO-adjacent SaaS experience.
* ABM-platform administrator-level experience (versus user-level).
* Meta Ads B2B retargeting experience.
* Video-ads production fluency (LinkedIn video, YouTube TrueView for B2B).
* Prior US-buyer-side paid-media experience.

💡 Discover Callbotics.ai - https://callbotics.ai/

🎥 Explore Life at AMI - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T1UKFelepCk

title: Senior SEO Executive
description:
**Company Description**
DigiBirds360 is a performance-focused digital marketing agency that helps large enterprises and small businesses strengthen their online presence. Founded in 2020, the agency provides end-to-end solutions including SEO, SMO, PPC, application development, and website development, with a mission to deliver measurable results. DigiBirds360 also offers SEO reseller services that support high profit margins and empower e-businesses through advanced digital strategies. As a pioneer in professional SEO services in India, the agency serves clients across Australia, the US, the UK, the UAE, and other global markets with tailored SEO packages. DigiBirds360 focuses on maximizing ROI and building strong digital brands for its clients.

**Role Description**
The Senior SEO Executive will lead and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, search rankings, and qualified traffic for a diverse portfolio of clients. This full-time, on-site role based in the Pune Division includes planning and performing keyword research, implementing on-page optimization, managing link-building campaigns, and conducting comprehensive SEO audits. The role involves analyzing performance data, preparing reports, and presenting insights and recommendations to internal teams and clients. The Senior SEO Executive will collaborate closely with content, design, and paid media teams to ensure cohesive digital marketing campaigns and alignment with client goals. The position also requires staying current with search engine algorithm updates, industry trends, and best practices to continuously refine strategies.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in BFSI, Keyword Research and SEO Audits to identify opportunities and diagnose performance issues.
* Candidates should possess advanced On-Page SEO skills, including meta tags, schema markup, site architecture, and content optimization.
* Candidates should possess proven Link Building expertise, with experience in ethical outreach, backlink analysis, and off-page optimization.
* Candidates should possess working knowledge of Social Media Marketing to support integrated digital campaigns and brand visibility.
* Hands-on experience with
  **BFSI-SEO tools**
  such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar platforms.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to interpret data and communicate clear, actionable insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and clients.
* Typically requires a bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, IT, or a related field, and prior experience in a senior or lead SEO role.
* Knowledge of technical SEO fundamentals (crawlability, indexation, site speed, mobile optimization) is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment.

title: EY - GDS Consulting -AI Strategy & Go-To-Market
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**JOB DESCRIPTION | AI & DATA TECH CONSULTING**
**AI Strategy & Go-To-Market**
Career Family: AIA – AI Strategy & GTM
  
  

* Pursuits, RFPs & Offering Development

**LEVEL**
**Senior/Manager**
**Experience**
**8–12 years**
**LOCATION**
EY GDS
  
  

* Hybrid

**ORIENTATION**
**Strategy-led**
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
We are seeking a strategic Manager to join our AI & Data Tech Consulting team, focused on shaping how clients adopt Agentic AI and GenAI — and how the firm takes its AI offerings to market. The ideal candidate brings a blend of AI product strategy, solution positioning, and pursuit leadership, with enough technical fluency to credibly translate AI capabilities into business value, without being a hands-on builder.
  
  
You will work closely with account leaders, solution architects, C-suite stakeholders, and alliance partners to win and shape AI programs — owning the narrative from opportunity qualification and RFP response through solution storyboarding, commercial framing, and client orals.
  
  
**WHERE YOUR TIME GOES**
**40%**
**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**
Win themes, solution storyline, client orals
  
  
**30%**
**Go-To-Market & Offerings**
Positioning, enablement collateral, alliances
  
  
**30%**
**AI Strategy & Advisory**
Roadmaps, business cases, operating models
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
AI Strategy & Value Advisory
  
  
■ Partner with client leadership and Operating Partners to define AI / Agentic AI vision, use-case portfolios, and adoption roadmaps.
  
  
■ Build use-case prioritization frameworks (value vs. feasibility vs. risk) and translate them into phased roadmaps (discovery → MVP → scale).
  
  
■ Develop business cases with ROI, cost-to-serve, and value-realization metrics that leadership can fund against.
  
  
■ Frame AI operating models — CoE design, governance, Responsible AI guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
■ Knowledge of business process transformation and industry value chains (Health, FS, Consumer, Industrials) would be an added advantage.
  
  
Go-To-Market & Offering Development
  
  
■ Shape and package AI offerings, accelerators, and assets into market-ready propositions — positioning, messaging, pricing logic, and differentiation.
  
  
■ Build sales enablement collateral: pitch decks, solution one-pagers, executive pagers, demo storylines, case studies, and battle cards.
  
  
■ Conduct market, competitive, and analyst research (vendors, hyperscalers, AI-native startups) to inform build / buy / partner decisions and offering roadmaps.
  
  
■ Work with alliance partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.) on joint GTM motions, co-sell plays, and partner-funded programs.
  
  
■ Track adoption and pipeline KPIs for offerings and feed market signals back into the offering roadmap.
  
  
RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits
  
  
■ Lead end-to-end RFP / RFI / RFQ responses for AI and data programs — bid / no-bid qualification, win themes, solution storyline, and response orchestration.
  
  
■ Translate client requirements into a crisp solution narrative, scope, delivery approach, staffing model, and commercial construct, in collaboration with architects and delivery leads.
  
  
■ Own proposal quality — compliance matrices, executive summaries, value articulation, risk and assumption logs.
  
  
■ Prepare and lead client orals, executive workshops, and proof-of-value storyboards; coach pursuit teams on messaging.
  
  
■ Maintain a reusable pursuit library of proposal content, case studies, and credentials.
  
  
AI Fluency (Conversational, Not Hands-On)
  
  
■ Working understanding of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI frameworks, AI evaluation & observability, and LLMOps — enough to engage architects and challenge solutions credibly.
  
  
■ Awareness of AI risk, regulation, and governance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and how they shape client buying decisions.
  
  
■ Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and enterprise data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) at a solution level.
  
  
■ Comfort with AI productivity tools to accelerate research, content, and proposal creation.
  
  
Business Development & Client Management
  
  
■ Work closely with account leaders to identify, qualify, and shape opportunities and build tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.
  
  
■ Build trusted relationships with client CXOs, product owners, and transformation leaders.
  
  
■ Represent the firm at analyst briefings, industry forums, webinars, and thought-leadership platforms; author POVs, whitepapers, and blogs.
  
  
Team Leadership & Collaboration
  
  
■ Lead and mentor a small team of strategy consultants and pursuit analysts.
  
  
■ Orchestrate collaboration across solution architects, delivery, sector specialists, alliances, legal, and pricing teams.
  
  
■ Drive knowledge sharing, offering playbooks, and capability-building across the practice.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes**
Educational Background
  
  
■ MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
■ 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.
  
  
■ Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.
  
  
■ Experience building offerings, roadmaps, business cases, and executive-facing collateral for enterprise clients.
  
  
■ Exposure to market research, competitive benchmarking, startup / vendor evaluation, or innovation programs is a strong plus.
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
■ Exceptional storytelling and executive presence — able to turn complex AI concepts into a compelling, simple business narrative.
  
  
■ Strong structured thinking and problem-solving; comfortable working under pursuit deadlines.
  
  
■ Excellent written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, especially with C-suite executives.
  
  
■ Influencing without authority across large, matrixed pursuit teams.
  
  
**Preferred Certifications**
■ GenAI / AI strategy certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Coursera, ISB / IIM executive programs, etc.)
  
  
■ Product management or agile certifications (SAFe POPM / PM, Pragmatic, CSPO), Design Thinking.
  
  
■ APMP (proposal management) certification is a plus.
  
  
IDEAL PROFILE
  
  
**You will thrive here if you…**
■ Have taken AI / data products from 0 → 1 and know what drives adoption
  
  
■ Love building the story, the business case, and the winning proposal
  
  
■ Can hold your own with architects — and simplify for the CXO
  
  
■ Have run market scans, vendor evaluations, or innovation programs
  
  
**This role is not…**
■ A hands-on engineering or model-building role
  
  
■ Writing production code, data pipelines, or agent frameworks
  
  
■ Pure delivery / project management
  
  
■ A back-office bid-desk formatting role
  
  
WHY JOIN US
  
  
■ Shape how leading global enterprises adopt AI — and how the firm wins in the AI market.
  
  
■ Work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and growth, with direct visibility to account and practice leadership.
  
  
■ Collaborate with a team of AI experts, solution architects, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
■
**Continuous learning**
— You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
  
  
■
**Success as defined by you**
— We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
  
  
■
**Transformative leadership**
— We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
  
  
■
**Diverse and inclusive culture**
— You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Market Performance Manager
description:
At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.
  
  
**What We Do...**
Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.
  
  
That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.
  
  
**About The Market Performance Manager Role…**
The Market Performance Team Manager leads a high-performing team of Market Performance Team Leads and Specialists who optimise distribution and revenue strategy for our hotel customers. This role is accountable for building and scaling a centre of excellence in market performance — ensuring hotels maximise bookings and profitable revenue through the intelligent use of SiteMinder’s platform, channel mix, and pricing strategies.
  
  
Combining strategic leadership, deep commercial acumen and strong people management, the Market Performance Team Manager oversees pipeline and performance across all optimisation initiatives, drives capability development in revenue and distribution management, and partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver measurable uplift in customer value, retention and revenue outcomes.
  
  
**What You’ll Do…**

* Strategic Leadership: Develop and implement comprehensive market management strategies that maximise product value and drive customer ROI, with a strong focus on revenue and distribution optimisation.
* Team Development & Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop Market Performance Team Leads and Specialists. Provide coaching, training and feedback to build deep revenue and distribution optimisation capability across the team.
* Pipeline Management: Own and manage the optimisation and revenue pipeline (initiatives, cases and opportunities), including forecasting, prioritisation and resourcing. Monitor pipeline health, conversion and velocity, and drive continuous improvements in team productivity.
* Performance Reporting: Build and maintain clear performance reporting on optimisation pipeline, revenue impact and team productivity, providing visibility to internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, to customers.
* Distribution Optimisation: Design and oversee strategies that optimise distribution mix (OTAs, direct, GDS and other channels) to drive profitable bookings for hotels. Ensure the team can diagnose channel performance issues and execute corrective actions.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing and Sales to ensure market performance and optimisation needs inform product development and go-to-market strategies.
* Optimisation Program Design: Create and implement scalable optimisation programs that systematically improve customer outcomes and revenue performance across different tiers and segments.
* Performance Management: Consistently meet or exceed team KPIs. Monitor pipeline, revenue and productivity metrics, and coach Team Leads and Specialists to improve conversion, quality and impact.
* Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across the business. Represent the market performance function in executive forums and champion customer and revenue outcomes.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance optimisation processes, tools and methodologies. Drive innovation in market performance and revenue optimisation delivery to maintain competitive advantage.

**What You Have…**

* Extensive experience in market management at an OTA, customer success, upgrade sales, account management, BPO or similar customer-facing roles, with good experience in a leadership position managing teams (Team Operations).
* Experience leading and developing managers (particularly Team Leads) and frontline specialists, including training and coaching on revenue and distribution optimisation best practices.
* Available to flex schedule across global hours
* Proven track record of designing and implementing successful market performance and/or optimisation programs that drive measurable revenue and customer outcomes.
* Strong analytical skills with experience using data to inform strategic decision-making, manage a pipeline and demonstrate ROI (e.g. RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, channel mix, conversion, productivity).
* Solid grounding in hotel revenue management concepts, including demand forecasting, pricing, inventory and channel management, and competitive set analysis.
* Preferable experience optimising distribution strategy and channel mix (OTAs, direct, GDS and other channels) to improve profitability and share.
* Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at all levels of an organisation. Fluent English required; additional languages (Spanish, German, French, Italian, Thai, Vietnamese, Bahasa, Portuguese or Mandarin) are a plus.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to translate business objectives into actionable market performance and revenue optimisation plans.
* Experience in the hotel industry or travel technology sector is highly desirable; background in Market Performance Management from an OTA is highly beneficial.
* Advanced negotiation skills with the ability to train teams in contract negotiation and value-based selling.
* Proficient in Salesforce and G-Suite with ability to analyse data across Salesforce reporting, Tableau (as a reader) and Google Sheets.

**Our Perks & Benefits…**

* Mental health and well-being initiatives
* Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy
* Flexibility to work in a Hybrid model (3 days in-office)
* Paid birthday, study and volunteering leave every year
* Sponsored social clubs, team events, and celebrations
* Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved
* Investment in your personal growth offering training for your advancement

Think this role sounds like you? If so, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.
  
  
When you apply, feel free to share your pronouns and let us know if you need any adjustments during the interview process, we’re here to support you. We also warmly encourage applications from people from underrepresented backgrounds.

Iliana Beauty & Co. is a modern luxury beauty brand that brings high-performance cosmetics and skincare-led formulations together, grounded in intentional design. Founded by sisters Niharika Singh and Nupoor Singh, the brand is built on ethics, inclusivity, and refined elegance. Every product is created to care for the skin while enhancing individual beauty across a wide range of skin tones.

The leadership team brings expertise across commercial finance, strategy, brand building, technology, and product innovation, with a shared focus on sustainable growth and a consumer-centric vision. Our products are cruelty-free and built to globally compliant standards. We are launching direct-to-consumer in India with a curated range of cosmetics, and we are looking for someone who wants to shape how a new luxury brand finds and grows its audience from day one.

**The Role**

We are hiring a Senior Marketing Specialist to own performance marketing, digital marketing, and go-to-market strategy for Iliana. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable building a launch plan, running paid campaigns, and reading the numbers to decide what to do next. You will work closely with our Marketing and content team and the founders, and you will have real ownership over how the brand grows in its first year and beyond.

**What You Will Do**

**Go-to-market strategy**

* Build and execute go-to-market plans for the brand launch and every new product or shade release that follows
* Define target audiences, customer segments, and positioning for each channel, informed by market research and competitor analysis
* Own the promotional and campaign calendar, including launches, seasonal moments, festive periods, and sale events
* Partner with product and sales to plan pricing, bundles, offers, and launch sequencing

**Performance marketing**

* Plan, launch, and optimise paid campaigns across Meta (Instagram and Facebook), Google (Search, Shopping, YouTube, Performance Max), and emerging channels
* Manage budgets and pacing against clear targets for ROAS, CAC, conversion rate, and contribution margin
* Run structured creative and audience testing, and turn results into clear next steps for the content team
* Set up and maintain tracking, pixels, conversion events, and attribution across the Shopify storefront and ad platforms

**Digital marketing and retention**

* Grow owned channels including email, WhatsApp, and SMS, with lifecycle journeys such as welcome, browse and cart recovery, post-purchase, and replenishment
* Improve storefront conversion through landing page tests, offer testing, and onsite experience improvements
* Work with the content and social team to keep messaging, storytelling, and brand voice consistent across every touchpoint
* Support influencer and creator programs with tracking, performance analysis, and amplification of top-performing content through paid media

**Measurement and reporting**

* Build weekly and monthly dashboards covering acquisition, retention, and revenue performance
* Translate data into recommendations that the founders and team can act on quickly
* Track market trends, competitor activity, and consumer behaviour in the Indian beauty space, and bring those insights into planning.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 4 to 7 years of marketing experience, with at least 3 years running performance marketing for a direct-to-consumer or e-commerce brand.
* Proven experience managing meaningful paid media budgets on Meta and Google, with results you can speak to in numbers
* Experience planning and executing a product or brand launch from strategy through to measurement
* Strong working knowledge of Shopify, Google Analytics 4, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and at least one email or CRM platform such as Zoho, Klaviyo, WebEngage, or MoEngage
* Comfort with data: building reports in spreadsheets or dashboard tools, reading attribution, and running clean tests
* A good eye for creative and an understanding of what makes beauty content perform, especially on Instagram and short-form video
* Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work across creative, product, and sales teams
* Strong organisational skills and comfort managing several priorities in a fast-moving, early-stage environment
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with luxury, premium, beauty, skincare, or wellness brands
* Familiarity with marketplace marketing on Nykaa, Amazon, or Myntra
* Experience working with influencers and creators at scale
* Understanding of the Indian D2C landscape and regional audience nuances

title: Marketing Lead
description:
**Job Description: Marketing Lead**

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic, strategic, and results-driven Marketing Leader to head our marketing division from our corporate office in Okhla, New Delhi. In this leadership role, you will design and execute the comprehensive marketing strategy for our IT System Integration business, specifically targeting the growth of our Hardware and Cloud Solutions portfolios.

The ideal candidate is a hybrid marketer who pairs deep data-driven analytics with creative storytelling. You will own the entire marketing funnel—from brand awareness and thought leadership to predictable lead generation—while leading cross-functional teams to achieve aggressive business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

Lead & Demand Generation

• Design and execute end-to-end B2B demand generation campaigns to build a high-quality pipeline for our enterprise and mid-market sales teams.

• Implement account-based marketing (ABM) strategies targeting key industry verticals across India to secure net-new logos for our cloud and hardware integration business.

• Optimize the lead lifecycle from initial capture to sales handoff, establishing clear MQL (Marketing Qualified Lead) .

**Digital Marketing & Performance Analytics**

• Oversee all digital marketing channels, including SEO/SEM, paid search, display advertising, and targeted LinkedIn campaigns.

• Establish a data-driven marketing culture by tracking, analyzing, and reporting on key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), conversion rates, and pipeline contribution.

• Utilize marketing automation and CRM tools to continuously measure campaign effectiveness and optimize budgets.

**Use Cases, & Thought Leadership**

• Develop compelling thought leadership content (whitepapers, eBooks, and executive insights) that positions our company as a premier IT system integrator.

• Translate complex technical capabilities into business value, creating structured Use Cases and case studies that highlight our success in hardware deployments and public/hybrid cloud migrations.

• Manage the corporate website and social media channels to maintain a consistent, highly professional brand voice.

**Event Management & Field Marketing**

• Plan and orchestrate targeted B2B events, including executive roundtables, tech webinars, vendor partner joint events, and large-scale industry exhibitions.

• Manage vendor co-op marketing funds (MDF) from major hardware OEMs and public cloud hyperscalers to drive joint marketing initiatives.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

• Experience: 8+ years of B2B marketing experience, with a minimum of 3–5 years in a leadership role within an IT System Integration, Managed Services, or Cloud Technology company.

• Domain Expertise: Proven track record marketing a combined portfolio of Enterprise IT Hardware (servers, storage, networking) and Cloud Solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP, or Hybrid Cloud).

• Core Strengths: Deep hands-on experience in Digital Marketing, Lead/Demand Gen, Content Strategy, Event Management, and ROI-based Performance Analytics.

• Communication Mastery: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Ability to seamlessly interact with internal C-suite executives, external OEM vendor partners, and enterprise clients.

• Location: Ability to work full-time from our office in Okhla, New Delhi.

title: Social Media Marketing Specialist
description:
Job Description: Manager / Assistant Manager – Social Media Marketing

**Company:**
Ferns N Petals (FNP)

**Department:**
Marketing

**Location:**
Gurugram, Haryana

**Experience:**
3–6 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

About FNP

Ferns N Petals (FNP) is a leading gifting and celebration brand, offering flowers, cakes, personalised gifts, and curated products for every occasion. With a strong digital presence and a diverse consumer base, FNP focuses on creating memorable gifting experiences through innovative products, engaging content, and impactful brand campaigns.

Role Overview

We are looking for a creative, strategic, and execution-oriented Social Media Marketing professional to strengthen FNP's social media presence and drive audience engagement through compelling content and innovative campaigns.

The candidate will be responsible for planning and executing social media campaigns, developing content strategies, identifying emerging trends, and creating engaging brand narratives across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and other relevant digital channels.

The ideal candidate should combine creativity with a data-driven approach and understand how to translate social media engagement into brand awareness, audience growth, and business impact.

Key Responsibilities

1. Social Media Strategy & Campaign Management

* Develop and execute social media strategies aligned with FNP's brand objectives, marketing priorities, and business goals.
* Plan and manage social media campaigns for key occasions, including Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Raksha Bandhan, Diwali, Christmas, birthdays, anniversaries, and other gifting-led events.
* Drive campaigns around flowers, cakes, personalised gifts, celebrations, and seasonal product launches.
* Develop monthly content calendars covering campaigns, brand storytelling, product promotions, trends, and engagement initiatives.
* Manage end-to-end campaign execution, from ideation and briefing to publishing, performance tracking, and optimisation.
* Ensure consistency in brand voice, visual identity, and messaging across social media platforms.

2. Content Creation & Creative Development

* Conceptualise engaging content formats, including Instagram Reels, short-form videos, carousels, stories, static posts, and interactive content.
* Develop creative ideas and content narratives that resonate with target audiences and reflect FNP's brand personality.
* Write engaging captions, social media copy, hooks, calls to action, and campaign messaging.
* Collaborate with designers, video editors, photographers, copywriters, and internal marketing teams to produce high-quality content.
* Create compelling product-led content that showcases gifting experiences, product benefits, and occasion-based solutions.
* Identify opportunities to leverage user-generated content, influencer content, and customer stories.

3. Trends, Community & Audience Engagement

* Stay updated on social media trends, viral formats, platform updates, and evolving consumer behaviour.
* Identify relevant trends and translate them into timely, brand-appropriate content opportunities.
* Monitor comments, messages, mentions, and audience conversations to strengthen community engagement.
* Develop interactive initiatives such as polls, contests, giveaways, and engagement-led campaigns.
* Explore opportunities to increase organic reach, followers, engagement rates, and brand visibility.
* Monitor competitor activity and social media best practices to identify opportunities for differentiation.

4. Influencer & Integrated Campaign Collaboration

* Collaborate with influencer marketing teams on creator-led content, campaign briefs, and social media amplification.
* Coordinate with brand, performance marketing, category, and e-commerce teams to ensure integrated campaign execution.
* Support product launches, festive campaigns, promotional activities, and brand partnerships.
* Ensure social media campaigns align with broader marketing initiatives and commercial priorities.

5. Performance Tracking & Optimisation

* Track and analyse key performance indicators, including reach, impressions, engagement rate, video views, shares, saves, follower growth, and website traffic.
* Prepare regular social media performance reports and provide actionable insights.
* Identify high-performing content formats and recommend improvements to content strategy.
* Conduct experiments with creative formats, content hooks, posting schedules, and messaging to improve performance.
* Use platform analytics and social media management tools to measure campaign effectiveness.
* Evaluate campaign performance against defined objectives and recommend data-backed improvements.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Advertising, Journalism, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in social media marketing, content creation, and digital campaign management.
* Demonstrated experience managing social media accounts for consumer brands, lifestyle brands, D2C businesses, e-commerce companies, or agencies.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and emerging social media platforms.
* Experience in developing content calendars, managing campaigns, and coordinating creative production.
* Excellent copywriting, storytelling, and creative ideation skills.
* Strong understanding of social media analytics, engagement metrics, and campaign performance measurement.
* Familiarity with social media management and analytics tools such as Meta Business Suite, Sprout Social, Hootsuite, or equivalent platforms.
* Working knowledge of Canva and/or creative collaboration tools is an advantage.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and deliver within tight timelines.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience working with gifting, lifestyle, fashion, beauty, food, retail, or other consumer-focused brands.
* Strong understanding of occasion-led marketing, consumer behaviour, and cultural trends.
* A creative thinker who can turn everyday trends and consumer insights into engaging brand content.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with multiple campaigns and seasonal priorities.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder-management skills.
* A portfolio showcasing social media campaigns, content concepts, and measurable results is preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Growth in organic reach, followers, and audience engagement.
* Quality, consistency, and timeliness of social media content.
* Performance of social media campaigns against defined objectives.
* Growth in video views, shares, saves, and meaningful audience interactions.
* Effectiveness of occasion-led campaigns and creative initiatives.
* Improvement in content performance through testing and analytics.
* Contribution to brand awareness, website traffic, and business objectives where measurable.

Why Join FNP?

* Work with an established consumer brand across gifting, celebrations, flowers, and cakes.
* Create campaigns around high-engagement occasions and seasonal marketing moments.
* Opportunity to experiment with new content formats, digital trends, and creative storytelling.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams across brand marketing, design, content, and e-commerce.
* Contribute directly to strengthening the brand's digital presence and consumer engagement.

**If you are passionate about social media, creative storytelling, and building campaigns that connect with consumers, we would love to hear from you.**

**About us:**

Founded in 2017, ON PURPOSE exists to use the power of communications to drive social change in India. It works with clients and organizations in 5 broad areas: Climate Action, Public Health, Education, Gender and Tech4Good.

**The Culture We Proudly Offer**

More than words. ON PURPOSE has been at the forefront of defining what a progressive workplace looks like. Our focus on building a safe and welcoming workplace for all has led us to innovate with policies like ‘6 days of paid leave for all menstruating employees’; 12 weeks of parental leave for all non-birthing people and a fixed lunch hour that is mentioned in our signatures. We also have a team of ‘D&I Ke Gunde’ who are trained to help us challenge our biases and create a more inclusive workplace.

Don’t just take our word for it- In 2025, ON PURPOSE was recognised among the ‘12 Best Agencies in India and South Asia’ by Provoke Media and featured in the exchange4media's PR and Corp Comms Watchlist 2026 (Agencies)’. We've also received multiple honours, including ‘Best Organisation for Women Empowerment’ at the Women Achievers Summit and Awards 2025, as well as ‘Best Culture of the Year’, ‘Best Diversity & Inclusion of the Year’, and ‘PR Team of the Year’ at the Campaign India Awards.

**About the profile**

We’re looking for an Assistant Account Manager who’s excited to go beyond execution and bring real thinking to the table.   .

* Understanding of Instagram Reels, Stories, social media formats and current content trends.
* Familiarity with influencer identification, outreach, collaborations and campaign coordination.
* Strong written communication skills, particularly for captions, content briefs and creator communication.
* Good visual sense, attention to detail and an understanding of digital-first brand communication.
* Ability to manage multiple creative tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
* Willingness to learn, experiment and execute ideas in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Skills**

* A portfolio of edited videos, social media creatives, content projects or influencer campaigns.
* Familiarity with Instagram Insights and basic social media performance indicators.
* Exposure to influencer marketing platforms, creator databases or campaign tracking tools.
* Ability to write engaging captions and develop content hooks that capture attention.
* Experience working with lifestyle, consumer, hospitality, fashion, beauty, premium or D2C brands will be an advantage.
* Initiative to bring new ideas rather than simply execute assigned briefs.
* A balance of creativity, speed, ownership and attention to detail.

**Why Join HULP?**

* Get exposure to creative campaigns, influencer partnerships and end-to-end marketing execution.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for a
**highly creative and hands-on Social Media Manager/Specialist**
to own the social media strategy and execution.

This is a
**strategy + execution role**
.

You will be responsible for building our social presence across
**LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, X, and other relevant platforms**
, while developing distinct content strategies for the company, founders, leadership, and employees.

A major part of this role will be building
**founder-led and employee-led social media**
. You should be comfortable turning ideas, conversations, industry developments, customer insights, data, opinions, and everyday company moments into content people actually want to consume and share.

We are not looking for someone who simply creates a content calendar and posts pre-designed creatives.

We are looking for someone who can
**spot stories, develop ideas, create content, experiment with formats, understand internet culture, build distribution, and continuously improve what works.**

If you are highly curious, creatively obsessed, comfortable with ambiguity, and enjoy turning complex topics into compelling content, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Social Media Strategy**

* Own the overall social media strategy.
* Develop platform-specific strategies for LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, Facebook, and emerging platforms.

**Founder Led & Employee Led Socials**

* Turn founder insights, opinions, experiences, customer conversations, company milestones, and industry perspectives into high-quality content.
* Identify employees and subject matter experts who can become authentic voices for us.

**Content Creation & Execution**

* Ideate, write, produce, publish, and distribute content across platforms.
* Create content across formats including: Short-form videos, Reels, YouTube videos, LinkedIn posts, Carousels, Memes, Threads etc.
* Work with internal teams where required.
* Be comfortable creating content yourself rather than relying entirely on external teams.

**Brand Awareness**

* Make complex topics across legal intelligence, litigation, risk, compliance, due diligence, AI, and legal technology understandable and interesting.
* Develop content that establishes us as credible voices in the legal, risk, compliance, financial services, and technology ecosystem.
* Turn company milestones, customer stories, data, research, reports, and product developments into compelling social narratives.

**Creative Campaigns**

* Experiment with unconventional formats, storytelling techniques, collaborations, and distribution strategies.
* Think beyond “posting content” and find creative ways to make people talk about our company.

**Content Distribution & Growth**

* Understand how content distribution works differently across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and other platforms.
* Collaborate with relevant creators, industry experts, employees, customers, and communities.
* Continuously test hooks, formats, topics, posting strategies, and distribution mechanisms.

**Analytics & Experimentation**

* Monitor metrics such as reach, engagement, impressions, video views, follower growth, shares, saves, profile visits, and website traffic.
* Identify patterns in high-performing content.
* Run structured experiments to improve content performance.

**What we are looking for?**

* **3–6 years of experience**
  in Social Media, Content, Brand, Digital Marketing, or a similar role.
* Proven experience building social media presence for a
  **company, founder, executive, or personal brand**
  .
* Strong experience with
  **LinkedIn and at least 2–3 other major platforms**
  , especially Instagram, YouTube, X, or Facebook.
* Strong understanding of founder-led and employee-led social media.
* Comfortable working directly with founders, leadership, and senior stakeholders.
* Ability to move quickly from
  **idea → execution → distribution → measurement → iteration**
  .
* High ownership and ability to operate independently in a fast-growing startup.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with
  **B2B SaaS, FinTech, LegalTech, RegTech, AI, enterprise technology, or other complex products**
  .
* Experience building a founder's LinkedIn or social media presence from scratch.
* Experience building employee advocacy programs.
* Experience growing a YouTube channel or short-form video presence.
* Experience working with creators or influencers.
* Experience working in an early-stage startup where you had to build the social function from scratch.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**Your Impact**
As a Marketing Manager for India, you will lead the development and execution of joint marketing strategies and programs with Cisco’s channel partners. Your role will focus on driving partner engagement, demand generation, and co-marketing initiatives that accelerate pipeline growth and revenue. You will collaborate closely with sales, partner teams, and global marketing to align partner marketing efforts with Cisco’s business priorities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner Strategy & Joint Planning: Build annual and quarterly co-marketing plans with tier-1 channel partners to drive shared pipeline and revenue goals.
* Demand Generation Campaigns: Design, launch, and optimize through-channel marketing automation campaigns, digital programs, and localized events.
* Enablement & Collateral: Create high-impact partner toolkits, co-branded collateral, email templates, and product launch playbooks.
* Partner Portal Management: Oversee and optimize the company’s partner portal as a central hub for marketing resources, DGI (Demand Gen Incentive) requests, and asset distribution.
* Budget & MDF Administration: Manage and track co-op and Market Development Funds (MDF), ensuring efficient allocation and high ROI on partner investments.
* Performance Analytics: Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) including partner-sourced pipeline, program engagement, conversion rates, and ROI.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align closely with Channel Sales / Partner Account Managers (PAMs), product marketing, and field marketing teams.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 10–12 years of experience in B2B technology marketing, with at least 8 years focused on channel marketing, partner ecosystems, or alliances.
* Strong familiarity with B2B technology ecosystems, including SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, or enterprise IT solutions.
* Proficient in CRM systems such as Salesforce and marketing automation platforms.
* Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills, with proven ability to manage external partner relationships and align cross-functional teams.
* Skilled in project management to drive marketing initiatives and meet business goals.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

title: SEO Specialist – Marketing
description:
SEO Specialist – Marketing SEO Specialist – MarketingFull-timePosted Jul 24, 2026

**ABOUT PROEFFICO**

Proeffico Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is an AI-first digital transformation company headquartered in Noida, India, serving customers across India and the GCC. We are ISO 27001:2022 certified and GDPR compliant, with a 55+ member team building and deploying enterprise-grade AI and SaaS products.

Our product portfolio includes VIZO361° (AI video analytics and VMS), MAFLO (manufacturing ERP), ZivuX.ai (WhatsApp-native CRM), MaximPro (cloud POS) and OPS360.LIVE. We are looking for an SEO Specialist to own organic growth across our product and corporate web properties.

**ROLE SUMMARY**

You will own end-to-end SEO for Proeffico's corporate site and product websites — technical SEO, on-page optimisation, content strategy and off-page authority building. The goal is simple: rank for high-intent commercial keywords in India and the GCC, and convert that traffic into qualified inbound pipeline for our sales team.

**POSITION SNAPSHOT**

**Job Title**
SEO Specialist – Marketing
**Department**
Marketing
**Location**
Sector 67, Noida, Uttar Pradesh (Work from Office)
**Reports To**
Head of Marketing
**Experience**
0-2 years in SEO (B2B SaaS / IT services preferred)
**Employment Type**
Full-time, Permanent
**Markets Covered**
India and GCC (UAE, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Qatar)

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. **Search Strategy —**
   Own keyword research, search intent mapping and content gap analysis across all Proeffico web properties, with separate strategies for Indian and GCC search markets.
2. **Technical SEO —**
   Audit and fix crawlability, indexation, site architecture, schema markup, Core Web Vitals, page speed, canonicalisation, redirects and mobile usability. Coordinate fixes with the engineering team.
3. **On-Page SEO —**
   Optimise titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking, URL structures, image alt text and landing page copy for target keywords and conversion.
4. **Content & Editorial —**
   Build the content calendar with the marketing and product teams. Brief and edit blogs, case studies, comparison pages, landing pages and product content for search visibility.
5. **Off-Page & Authority —**
   Execute white-hat link building, digital PR, directory and marketplace listings, guest posting and partner backlinks. Improve domain authority sustainably.
6. **Local & Geo SEO —**
   Manage Google Business Profile, local citations and geo-targeted landing pages for Noida/Delhi NCR and GCC city-level searches.
7. **Analytics & Reporting —**
   Track rankings, organic sessions, impressions, CTR, conversions and assisted pipeline. Build monthly dashboards and report insights, not just numbers.
8. **Competitive Intelligence —**
   Benchmark competitors in AI video analytics, ERP, CRM and POS categories. Identify keywords and content assets we can win.
9. **Cross-Functional —**
   Work with the paid, social and sales teams so SEO content supports campaigns, and use search data to inform positioning and messaging.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

1. 2–4 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, IT services or technology products.
2. Strong command of Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and at least one SEO suite (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz or Screaming Frog).
3. Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and structured data (JSON-LD schema); comfortable reading a page's source and briefing developers precisely.
4. Proven track record of improving organic rankings and traffic — able to show before/after data from previous roles.
5. Solid content sense: can write or edit a technical blog, product page or case study that reads well and ranks.
6. Understanding of B2B buyer journeys and how organic traffic converts into MQLs and SQLs.
7. Excellent written English and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

1. Experience marketing to GCC / Middle East audiences, including multilingual or Arabic-language SEO.
2. Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow or headless CMS platforms.
3. Exposure to AI-assisted content workflows, programmatic SEO or GEO/AEO (optimising for AI search and answer engines).
4. Basic experience with paid search, LinkedIn campaigns or marketing automation tools.
5. Google Analytics or HubSpot certifications.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

1. Direct ownership of the organic channel for a fast-growing AI product company — your work is visible to leadership from day one.
2. Exposure to multiple product categories (AI video analytics, ERP, CRM, POS) and two geographies (India and GCC).
3. A collaborative, low-bureaucracy team with real budget for tools and experiments.
4. Competitive compensation aligned to experience and demonstrated impact.

title: eCommerce Growth Manager
description:
**Company:**
Transverse Solutions

**Location:**
Noida

**Work Mode:**
Full-time | On-site / Hybrid

**Experience:**
2-4 years

**Compensation:**
₹25,000–₹35,000 per month + performance incentives

**About Transverse Solutions**

Transverse Solutions is an eCommerce consultancy helping brands build, launch and grow their businesses online.

We work with D2C brands across Shopify, Amazon, Flipkart and other digital commerce platforms - bringing together eCommerce strategy, technology, performance marketing and conversion optimisation.

We are looking for a hands-on Performance Marketing & Marketplace Manager who can take ownership of the digital growth of our clients and, most importantly, help turn marketing activity into measurable sales.

**The Role**

This is not a social media management role.

And it is not a role where success is measured by how many campaigns were launched or how many reports were prepared. You will be responsible for growing sales for assigned eCommerce brands across: Shopify + Meta Ads + Google Ads + Amazon + Flipkart + Other Marketplaces.

You will independently plan, execute, monitor and optimise campaigns and marketplace operations for your assigned clients.

You will typically own 4 major client accounts at a time, with the possibility of supporting a few additional accounts on smaller requirements.

Your core question every day should be:
*“What can we do today to sell more profitably than yesterday?”*

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Performance Marketing - Meta Ads

* Independently plan and execute Meta advertising campaigns for D2C brands.
* Develop acquisition, retargeting and remarketing strategies.
* Manage campaign structures, audiences, budgets and bidding strategies.
* Analyse campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Test different audiences, creatives, offers and campaign approaches.
* Scale campaigns that demonstrate sustainable performance.
* Identify and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns.
* Monitor key metrics including ROAS, CAC, CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR and revenue.
* Manage and optimise campaigns based on agreed client objectives.

2. Google Ads

* Plan, launch and manage Google Ads campaigns.
* Work across Search, Shopping and Performance Max as relevant.
* Manage keyword strategy, search terms, budgets and bidding.
* Monitor product/feed-related issues in coordination with the relevant team.
* Optimise campaigns based on conversion and revenue data.
* Identify opportunities for profitable scaling.
* Track and analyse Google Ads performance alongside Shopify sales data.

3. Shopify eCommerce Growth

While you will not be responsible for Shopify development, you will be responsible for understanding the sales funnel and identifying where marketing performance is being affected. You should be comfortable analysing: Ad → Landing Page → Product Page → Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase

You will:

* Monitor Shopify sales and conversion metrics.
* Identify funnel drop-offs.
* Analyse product-level performance.
* Identify products that should be promoted or deprioritised.
* Recommend improvements to offers, promotions and campaigns.
* Work closely with our eCommerce/Shopify team when website or CRO issues are identified.
* Connect advertising performance with actual business revenue.

4. Amazon & Flipkart Management

Take end-to-end ownership of assigned marketplace accounts. Responsibilities include:

Marketplace account management.

Product catalogue management.

Listing optimisation.

Keyword optimisation.

Search visibility improvement.

Sponsored Ads / marketplace advertising.

Product-level sales analysis.

Campaign optimisation.

Promotions and deal planning.

Pricing and offer recommendations.

Identifying high-potential SKUs.

Identifying underperforming products.

Monitoring account health and operational issues.

Monitoring inventory-related issues and coordinating with clients.

Regularly analysing marketplace reports and identifying growth opportunities.

**Data, Analytics & Reporting**

You should be comfortable working with numbers.

You will be expected to:

\* Monitor daily/weekly/monthly performance.

\* Analyse advertising and sales data.

\* Track ROAS, CAC, conversion rate and revenue.

\* Identify trends and anomalies.

\* Prepare concise performance reports.

\* Translate data into actionable recommendations.

\* Explain why performance changed, not simply report what changed.

We don’t want dashboards full of numbers.

We want someone who can look at the numbers and say:

*“Here’s the problem. Here’s why it’s happening. Here’s what I’m going to do about it.”*

**Working With Our Internal Team**

You will work closely with:

Head – Digital Marketing

For digital strategy, SEO, marketplace expertise and overall marketing direction.

eCommerce / Shopify Team

For website, CRO, tracking and technical requirements.

Creative & Content Team

For ad creatives, content and campaign briefs.

Founder / Leadership

For client strategy, commercial priorities and growth planning.

You will be responsible for translating strategy into execution and measurable performance.

**What We’re Looking For**

*Must Have*

\* 2-4 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing/eCommerce.

\* Proven experience managing client brands, preferably D2C/eCommerce.

\* Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads.

\* Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads.

\* Experience managing Amazon and/or Flipkart accounts.

\* Good understanding of Shopify and the D2C sales funnel.

\* Strong understanding of ROAS, CAC, CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR and other performance metrics.

\* Ability to independently launch and optimise campaigns.

\* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.

\* Comfortable taking ownership of client performance.

\* Ability to work with multiple stakeholders and manage deadlines.

*Strong Advantage*

\* Experience scaling D2C brands.

\* Experience managing meaningful monthly ad budgets.

\* Experience with Amazon Sponsored Ads.

\* Experience with Flipkart Ads.

\* Experience with Google Shopping / Performance Max.

\* Experience with GA4, Google Merchant Center and Meta Pixel/CAPI.

\* Experience with quick-commerce platforms.

\* Experience working with fashion, beauty, food, toys, lifestyle or other consumer brands.

**The Person We’re Looking For**

*You could be a great fit if you:*

\* Think about sales, not just campaigns.

\* Enjoy looking at data and figuring out what’s wrong.

\* Don’t need to be told what to optimise.

\* Can independently manage an account from strategy to execution.

\* Are comfortable experimenting and testing.

\* Know that a campaign being “live” doesn’t mean it is successful.

\* Can explain performance in simple business terms.

\* Take ownership when numbers aren’t working.

\* Are curious about why customers buy - and why they don’t.

*You may NOT be the right fit if:*

\* Your primary experience is social media posting/community management.

\* You have only executed campaigns based on someone else’s instructions.

\* You primarily create reports without taking action on them.

\* You have never independently managed ad accounts.

\* You consider “campaign launched” to be the end of the job.

\* You are uncomfortable being accountable for measurable performance.

**How We Measure Success**

Your performance will ultimately be evaluated on the growth and efficiency of the accounts you manage. Key metrics may include:

* Revenue Growth
* ROAS / CAC
* Conversion Rate
* Paid Traffic Quality
* Marketplace Sales Growth
* Marketplace Advertising Efficiency
* Account Health

Execution Quality & Timeliness

The exact targets will vary by client depending on their category, product, pricing, margins, inventory, website and stage of growth.

**Compensation**

₹25,000-₹35,000 per month, depending on experience and demonstrated capability.

Additional performance incentives may be offered based on account-level performance and achievement of agreed targets.

**Why Join Transverse Solutions?**

You’ll get the opportunity to work on real eCommerce businesses, not just isolated advertising campaigns.

You’ll work across:

Shopify → Meta → Google → Amazon → Flipkart → Quick Commerce

and understand how all these channels come together to build an actual eCommerce business.

If you’re someone who gets excited when a client’s numbers move from:

₹5L → ₹8L → ₹12L

rather than simply getting excited about a campaign going live… we’d like to meet you.

**Apply**

Please share your CV along with a brief note highlighting:

1. The eCommerce/D2C brands you’ve worked with.

2. The platforms you’ve managed.

3. Approximate monthly ad budgets you’ve independently handled.

4. One brand/account where you were directly involved in improving sales.

5. Your current/expected compensation.

Only candidates with genuine hands-on performance marketing experience will be considered.

**On-Page SEO, Technical SEO, Off-Page SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation), AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation), AIO (AI Optimisation), and E-E-A-T principles**
.

You will be responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, and improving organic search strategies across multiple client websites, with a strong focus on Google rankings, organic traffic, qualified leads, and visibility across AI-powered search platforms.

Key Responsibilities1. SEO Strategy & Execution

* Develop and execute comprehensive SEO strategies for multiple client projects.
* Perform keyword research, search intent analysis, competitor analysis, and keyword mapping.
* Manage complete On-Page SEO, including metadata, headings, URLs, internal linking, image optimisation, and content structure.
* Conduct technical SEO audits and coordinate with developers to resolve issues.
* Optimise website architecture, crawlability, indexability, canonical tags, redirects, XML sitemaps, and robots.txt.
* Monitor Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile usability, and structured data implementation.
* Identify ranking opportunities, traffic gaps, and SEO growth potential.

2. GEO, AEO & AI Search Optimisation

* Develop strategies to improve website visibility across Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Bing Copilot, and other AI-powered discovery platforms.
* Optimise content for conversational queries, question-based searches, entity relevance, and direct-answer formats.
* Implement GEO and AEO best practices, including structured content, semantic relevance, and accurate schema markup.
* Understand AI-driven search behaviour, zero-click searches, and evolving search engine algorithms.
* Improve brand discoverability, topical authority, and content credibility across traditional and AI search experiences.
* Analyse AI-generated search visibility and recommend practical improvements.

3. Content Planning, Assignment & Optimisation

* Prepare SEO content strategies, topic clusters, content calendars, and keyword-based content plans.
* Create detailed content briefs and assign articles, landing pages, blogs, and service-page content to content writers.
* Define primary and secondary keywords, search intent, content outlines, internal links, and SEO requirements.
* Review submitted content for quality, originality, accuracy, keyword relevance, and SEO effectiveness.
* Ensure content aligns with
  **E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness)**
  principles.
* Coordinate with writers, designers, and developers for timely content publication.
* Identify content gaps and opportunities to refresh existing pages.

4. Off-Page SEO & Authority Building

* Plan and execute ethical, white-hat link-building campaigns.
* Perform backlink analysis, competitor backlink research, and link prospecting.
* Manage relevant outreach, digital PR opportunities, and quality link acquisition.
* Conduct backlink audits and identify potentially harmful or spammy links.
* Work on brand mentions, citations, local SEO, Google Business Profile optimisation, and business listings where applicable.
* Track referring domains, backlink quality, and organic authority growth.
* Avoid spammy link-building practices and manipulative SEO techniques.

5. SEO Tools, Analytics & Reporting

**Strong hands-on experience with the following tools is expected:**

* Google Search Console
* Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
* Google Tag Manager (basic understanding)
* Ahrefs / SEMrush
* Screaming Frog SEO Spider
* Google Keyword Planner
* Google PageSpeed Insights / Lighthouse
* Google Trends
* Rich Results Test / Schema Markup Validator
* Google Looker Studio
* ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and other AI research or SEO productivity tools

**Additional tool knowledge:**
Surfer SEO, Frase, SE Ranking, Moz, Microsoft Clarity, and Rank Math / Yoast SEO will be an advantage.

6. Performance Monitoring & Client Reporting

* Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, impressions, CTR, conversions, and leads.
* Prepare weekly and monthly SEO performance reports.
* Track SEO deliverables, content assignments, published pages, backlinks, and technical improvements.
* Analyse performance trends and recommend data-driven improvements.
* Maintain project trackers and ensure deadlines are met.
* Coordinate with internal teams and communicate SEO progress professionally.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Minimum
  **2 years of practical SEO experience**
  , preferably in a digital marketing agency.
* Proven experience handling multiple SEO projects independently.
* Strong technical, on-page, and off-page SEO knowledge.
* Working understanding of GEO, AEO, AIO, and AI-driven search trends.
* Experience in keyword clustering, topic planning, content briefing, and assigning tasks to writers.
* Strong understanding of E-E-A-T, Google Search Essentials, and search intent.
* Ability to perform comprehensive SEO audits and prepare actionable recommendations.
* Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript SEO fundamentals, and CMS platforms such as WordPress and Shopify.
* Good analytical skills, attention to detail, and written English communication.
* Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks, and consistently meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with international SEO projects targeting the USA, Canada, UK, or other global markets.
* Knowledge of Local SEO, e-commerce SEO, and programmatic SEO.
* Familiarity with Laravel, Next.js, or other JavaScript-based websites from a technical SEO perspective.
* Experience implementing and validating structured data.
* Basic knowledge of SEO automation and AI-assisted workflows.
* Demonstrable improvements in organic visibility, relevant traffic, or conversions.

What We Expect

We are looking for someone who goes beyond routine keyword placement and backlink creation.

The candidate should be capable of
**thinking strategically, identifying growth opportunities, managing content execution, solving SEO challenges, and adapting to the changing search landscape driven by AI.**

**A proactive attitude, ownership of assigned projects, and a results-oriented mindset are essential.**

Why Join SAM Web Studio?

* Work on diverse Indian and international client projects.
* Gain hands-on exposure to SEO, GEO, AEO, and AI-powered search strategies.
* Collaborate with web developers, designers, and content teams.
* Opportunity to take ownership of SEO campaigns and contribute to measurable business growth.
* Professional working environment with opportunities for career advancement.

title: Search Engine Optimization Executive
description:

8020 is a brand-led digital marketing agency built on four pillars:
**strategy, creativity, data analytics and technology**

.

We help brands start meaningful conversations, deliver better customer experiences, build immersive digital journeys and drive measurable ROI. If you want to make a difference and change the game, 8020 is the place to be.

www.eightytwenty.co.in

**The Role**

Search has changed. Customers now find brands through Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Copilot as much as through the traditional ten blue links. We are looking for an SEO & Analytics Specialist who understands both worlds: someone with solid technical SEO fundamentals who is also building expertise in
**Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO)**

and uses AI tools intelligently to work faster and smarter.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Search & GEO Strategy**

•   Build integrated SEO and GEO strategies that improve visibility across traditional search results and AI-generated answers.

•   Optimise content for AI citation and answer inclusion: clear question-led structure, concise answer blocks, FAQs, comparison content and verifiable facts.

•   Strengthen brand entity signals through structured data, consistent brand information across the web, Knowledge Panel optimisation and E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trust).

•   Track and report brand visibility, mentions and citations across AI platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews / AI Mode) alongside traditional rankings.

•   Stay current with Google algorithm and core updates, AI search developments and emerging standards in AI discoverability.

**Technical SEO**

•   Conduct in-depth technical audits covering crawling and indexing (robots.txt, XML sitemaps), canonicalisation, duplicate content, redirects, URL structure, internal linking and site architecture.

•   Improve Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), mobile usability and page performance in partnership with development teams.

•   Implement and validate schema markup (Organization, Product, FAQ, Article, LocalBusiness, etc.).

•   Ensure sites are accessible to both search engine crawlers and AI crawlers, including JavaScript rendering checks.

•   Support eCommerce SEO: category and product page optimisation, faceted navigation, product feeds and structured data.

**Content & Authority**

•   Conduct keyword and topic research, search-intent mapping, content gap and competitor analysis.

•   Build topic clusters and content roadmaps that establish topical authority.

•   Brief and coordinate with content teams to produce high-quality, people-first content that is also optimised for search and AI answers.

•   Optimise blogs, articles, images and video (including YouTube) for discoverability.

•   Earn high-quality backlinks and brand mentions through ethical link building and digital PR.

**AI-Assisted SEO Workflows**

•   Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and AI features within SEO platforms) to speed up keyword clustering, content briefs, meta data, schema generation, audit analysis and reporting, always with human review for accuracy and brand fit.

•   Identify opportunities to automate repetitive SEO tasks using AI, Google Sheets / Apps Script or basic Python.

**Analytics, Measurement & Reporting**

•   Set up and manage measurement using Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and Google Search Console, including event tracking, conversions and Consent Mode.

•   Build clear dashboards in Looker Studio that connect search performance to business outcomes such as leads, sales and brand demand.

•   Measure performance in a zero-click world: impressions, brand search growth, AI referral traffic and share of voice, not just clicks.

•   Analyse data to identify growth opportunities and translate insights into clear recommendations.

•   Present SEO and GEO performance, insights and strategy to clients and internal teams with confidence.

**﻿
What We're Looking For**

**Experience & Education**

•   Bachelor's or Master's degree with around
**3 years of hands-on SEO and analytics experience**

.

•   Experience in a digital agency environment, managing multiple clients and categories, is strongly preferred.

**Core Skills**

•   Strong command of technical, on-page and off-page SEO.

•   Working knowledge of GEO / AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) principles and how AI search platforms select and cite sources.

•   Proficiency in GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console and Looker Studio.

•   Hands-on experience with SEO tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs and Screaming Frog; familiarity with AI visibility tracking tools is a plus.

•   Practical, responsible use of AI tools in day-to-day SEO work.

•   Understanding of structured data, entity SEO and E-E-A-T.

•   Strong SEO writing skills: titles, meta descriptions, headers, FAQs and content briefs.

•   Advanced MS Excel / Google Sheets (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data cleaning and MIS reporting).

•   Strong PowerPoint skills and the ability to tell a clear story with data.

**How to Apply**

Send your CV and a short note on how you are approaching SEO in the age of AI search to:

**glen.ireland@eightytwenty.co.in**
