title: Paid Search Manager
description:
**Position Overview**
Vida is looking for an experienced and highly analytical Paid Search Manager to join our growing performance marketing team.
  
  
This role will help manage and grow paid search programs across multiple D2C brands within the Vida portfolio. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience managing significant Google Ads budgets across multiple e-commerce accounts and has a proven track record of driving revenue growth and ROAS improvement.
  
  
The Paid Search Manager will work closely with the Senior Manager, Paid Search and Director of Paid Media while independently owning day-to-day strategy, execution, optimization, testing, reporting, and performance management across assigned brands.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong technical Google Ads knowledge with commercial thinking and can identify opportunities to scale revenue while maintaining efficiency.
  
  
**Compensation:**
Indian Rupee $116,667 - $166,667 montly
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Paid Search & Shopping Management**

* Independently manage and optimize paid search programs across multiple D2C/e-commerce brands.
* Build, manage, and optimize campaigns across:

+ Google Search
+ Google Shopping
+ Performance Max
+ Demand Gen
+ Microsoft Ads

* Own campaign performance against revenue, ROAS, conversion, and profitability goals.
* Develop campaign structures and segmentation strategies based on product performance, category, brand, margin, seasonality, and business priorities.
* Conduct product-level performance analysis to identify top-performing products, underperformers, wasted spend, and opportunities to scale.
* Identify opportunities to increase profitable spend while maintaining efficiency targets.
* Monitor competitive activity, search demand, seasonality, promotions, and other factors impacting performance.

**Google Merchant Center & Product Feeds**

* Manage and troubleshoot Google Merchant Center, including product disapprovals, warnings, feed errors, account issues, and product eligibility.
* Work closely with product feeds and feed management platforms to improve Shopping and Performance Max performance.
* Analyze and optimize key feed attributes including product titles, descriptions, product types, Google product categories, custom labels, pricing, availability, images, and promotional information.
* Develop product segmentation strategies using custom labels and other feed attributes.
* Partner with internal teams and feed management partners to continuously improve product data quality and feed health.
* Identify feed optimization opportunities that can improve visibility, traffic quality, revenue, and ROAS.

**Campaign Strategy, Optimization & Performance Analysis**

* Develop keyword and search strategies across brand, non-brand, category, product, competitor, and seasonal campaigns.
* Conduct keyword research, search-term analysis, and negative keyword management to improve traffic quality and efficiency.
* Evaluate and optimize match types, campaign structures, audiences, and account segmentation.
* Develop and manage bidding strategies including Target ROAS, Maximize Conversion Value, Target CPA, Maximize Conversions, and other automated bidding approaches.
* Understand when bidding targets, budgets, campaign structure, or conversion signals may be restricting growth.
* Manage budgets and pacing across assigned accounts while ensuring alignment with monthly and annual revenue goals.
* Recommend budget reallocations across campaigns, products, brands, and tactics based on performance and incremental growth opportunities.
* Develop structured testing roadmaps across bidding, campaign structure, Performance Max, Broad Match, landing pages, ad copy, audiences, feeds, promotions, and emerging Google Ads products.
* Analyze performance across revenue, ROAS, spend, conversion rate, CPA, CPC, average order value, impression share, and other key e-commerce KPIs.
* Diagnose performance changes and clearly communicate what changed, why it changed, and what actions should be taken next.
* Prepare weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reporting with actionable insights and recommendations.
* Proactively identify performance risks, account issues, testing opportunities, and areas for incremental growth.
* Stay current on Google Ads product updates, automation, AI-driven campaign capabilities, and changes within the paid search landscape.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5-6+ years of hands-on paid search / Google Ads experience, preferably within an agency, multi-brand organization, or D2C/e-commerce business.
* Strong experience independently managing multiple paid search accounts simultaneously.
* Demonstrated experience managing significant paid media budgets and being accountable for revenue and ROAS goals.
* Strong D2C/e-commerce experience with an understanding of how paid search contributes to overall business growth.
* Advanced hands-on knowledge of:

+ Google Search
+ Google Shopping
+ Performance Max
+ Demand Gen
+ Google Merchant Center
+ Microsoft Advertising

* Advanced understanding of Google Smart Bidding, including Target ROAS and value-based bidding strategies.
* Strong experience with Shopping campaign structures, product segmentation, and product-level performance analysis.
* Hands-on experience working with Google Merchant Center and product feeds.
* Strong understanding of campaign structures, match types, keyword strategy, search-term analysis, and negative keyword management.
* Ability to determine when performance issues are driven by bidding, budget, feed quality, campaign structure, conversion rate, tracking, competition, seasonality, or other factors.
* Strong understanding of e-commerce KPIs including revenue, ROAS, conversion rate, CPA, AOV, CPC, impression share, and profitability.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn complex performance data into actionable recommendations.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to QA campaign setups, budgets, conversion tracking, feeds, URLs, promotions, and account changes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple brands, projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to proactively bring recommendations and growth opportunities rather than relying solely on direction from senior leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with D2C retail, footwear, fashion, apparel, accessories, or consumer brands.
* Experience managing large e-commerce product catalogs and Shopping-heavy accounts.
* Experience managing high-spend Google Ads accounts.
* Experience with third-party feed management platforms such as Feedonomics, Productsup, DataFeedWatch, Channable, or similar platforms.
* Experience developing custom-label and product segmentation strategies.
* Understanding of GA4, conversion tracking, attribution, enhanced conversions, and e-commerce measurement.
* Experience managing Microsoft Ads alongside Google Ads.
* Experience with Performance Max channel analysis and understanding the interaction between Search, Shopping, YouTube, Display, and other inventory within PMax.
* Experience evaluating new customer acquisition, brand vs. non-brand performance, and incremental growth opportunities.
* Familiarity with Looker Studio or other reporting and visualization platforms.

**What Success Looks Like**
The successful Paid Search Manager will be able to independently own assigned accounts while consistently identifying opportunities to improve performance and grow the business.
  
  
Success in this role means:
  
  

* Growing profitable revenue across assigned brands.
* Meeting or exceeding ROAS and business performance targets.
* Identifying opportunities to scale high-performing campaigns, categories, and products.
* Quickly diagnosing and addressing performance declines.
* Effectively managing significant budgets and maintaining accurate pacing.
* Continuously improving Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and product feed strategies.
* Developing thoughtful testing roadmaps with clear hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
* Turning account and product data into clear strategic recommendations.
* Maintaining strong Merchant Center and feed health.
* Proactively identifying new opportunities rather than waiting for direction.
* Clearly communicating account performance, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions to the Senior Manager, Paid Search.
* Taking strong ownership of assigned brands while collaborating effectively across the broader performance marketing team.

title: EY - GDS Consulting -AI Strategy & Go-To-Market
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**JOB DESCRIPTION | AI & DATA TECH CONSULTING**
**AI Strategy & Go-To-Market**
Career Family: AIA – AI Strategy & GTM
  
  

* Pursuits, RFPs & Offering Development

**LEVEL**
**Senior/Manager**
**Experience**
**8–12 years**
**LOCATION**
EY GDS
  
  

* Hybrid

**ORIENTATION**
**Strategy-led**
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
We are seeking a strategic Manager to join our AI & Data Tech Consulting team, focused on shaping how clients adopt Agentic AI and GenAI — and how the firm takes its AI offerings to market. The ideal candidate brings a blend of AI product strategy, solution positioning, and pursuit leadership, with enough technical fluency to credibly translate AI capabilities into business value, without being a hands-on builder.
  
  
You will work closely with account leaders, solution architects, C-suite stakeholders, and alliance partners to win and shape AI programs — owning the narrative from opportunity qualification and RFP response through solution storyboarding, commercial framing, and client orals.
  
  
**WHERE YOUR TIME GOES**
**40%**
**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**
Win themes, solution storyline, client orals
  
  
**30%**
**Go-To-Market & Offerings**
Positioning, enablement collateral, alliances
  
  
**30%**
**AI Strategy & Advisory**
Roadmaps, business cases, operating models
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
AI Strategy & Value Advisory
  
  
■ Partner with client leadership and Operating Partners to define AI / Agentic AI vision, use-case portfolios, and adoption roadmaps.
  
  
■ Build use-case prioritization frameworks (value vs. feasibility vs. risk) and translate them into phased roadmaps (discovery → MVP → scale).
  
  
■ Develop business cases with ROI, cost-to-serve, and value-realization metrics that leadership can fund against.
  
  
■ Frame AI operating models — CoE design, governance, Responsible AI guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
■ Knowledge of business process transformation and industry value chains (Health, FS, Consumer, Industrials) would be an added advantage.
  
  
Go-To-Market & Offering Development
  
  
■ Shape and package AI offerings, accelerators, and assets into market-ready propositions — positioning, messaging, pricing logic, and differentiation.
  
  
■ Build sales enablement collateral: pitch decks, solution one-pagers, executive pagers, demo storylines, case studies, and battle cards.
  
  
■ Conduct market, competitive, and analyst research (vendors, hyperscalers, AI-native startups) to inform build / buy / partner decisions and offering roadmaps.
  
  
■ Work with alliance partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.) on joint GTM motions, co-sell plays, and partner-funded programs.
  
  
■ Track adoption and pipeline KPIs for offerings and feed market signals back into the offering roadmap.
  
  
RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits
  
  
■ Lead end-to-end RFP / RFI / RFQ responses for AI and data programs — bid / no-bid qualification, win themes, solution storyline, and response orchestration.
  
  
■ Translate client requirements into a crisp solution narrative, scope, delivery approach, staffing model, and commercial construct, in collaboration with architects and delivery leads.
  
  
■ Own proposal quality — compliance matrices, executive summaries, value articulation, risk and assumption logs.
  
  
■ Prepare and lead client orals, executive workshops, and proof-of-value storyboards; coach pursuit teams on messaging.
  
  
■ Maintain a reusable pursuit library of proposal content, case studies, and credentials.
  
  
AI Fluency (Conversational, Not Hands-On)
  
  
■ Working understanding of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI frameworks, AI evaluation & observability, and LLMOps — enough to engage architects and challenge solutions credibly.
  
  
■ Awareness of AI risk, regulation, and governance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and how they shape client buying decisions.
  
  
■ Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and enterprise data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) at a solution level.
  
  
■ Comfort with AI productivity tools to accelerate research, content, and proposal creation.
  
  
Business Development & Client Management
  
  
■ Work closely with account leaders to identify, qualify, and shape opportunities and build tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.
  
  
■ Build trusted relationships with client CXOs, product owners, and transformation leaders.
  
  
■ Represent the firm at analyst briefings, industry forums, webinars, and thought-leadership platforms; author POVs, whitepapers, and blogs.
  
  
Team Leadership & Collaboration
  
  
■ Lead and mentor a small team of strategy consultants and pursuit analysts.
  
  
■ Orchestrate collaboration across solution architects, delivery, sector specialists, alliances, legal, and pricing teams.
  
  
■ Drive knowledge sharing, offering playbooks, and capability-building across the practice.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes**
Educational Background
  
  
■ MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
■ 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.
  
  
■ Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.
  
  
■ Experience building offerings, roadmaps, business cases, and executive-facing collateral for enterprise clients.
  
  
■ Exposure to market research, competitive benchmarking, startup / vendor evaluation, or innovation programs is a strong plus.
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
■ Exceptional storytelling and executive presence — able to turn complex AI concepts into a compelling, simple business narrative.
  
  
■ Strong structured thinking and problem-solving; comfortable working under pursuit deadlines.
  
  
■ Excellent written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, especially with C-suite executives.
  
  
■ Influencing without authority across large, matrixed pursuit teams.
  
  
**Preferred Certifications**
■ GenAI / AI strategy certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Coursera, ISB / IIM executive programs, etc.)
  
  
■ Product management or agile certifications (SAFe POPM / PM, Pragmatic, CSPO), Design Thinking.
  
  
■ APMP (proposal management) certification is a plus.
  
  
IDEAL PROFILE
  
  
**You will thrive here if you…**
■ Have taken AI / data products from 0 → 1 and know what drives adoption
  
  
■ Love building the story, the business case, and the winning proposal
  
  
■ Can hold your own with architects — and simplify for the CXO
  
  
■ Have run market scans, vendor evaluations, or innovation programs
  
  
**This role is not…**
■ A hands-on engineering or model-building role
  
  
■ Writing production code, data pipelines, or agent frameworks
  
  
■ Pure delivery / project management
  
  
■ A back-office bid-desk formatting role
  
  
WHY JOIN US
  
  
■ Shape how leading global enterprises adopt AI — and how the firm wins in the AI market.
  
  
■ Work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and growth, with direct visibility to account and practice leadership.

title: Outbound Lead Development Representative - International
description:
**About Duratuf**

We're an industrial safety company in Kolkata, with our own office and warehouse in Dubai

Our equipment keeps workers safe at 4,142+ customers across 65+ countries — when it works, someone gets to go home to their family.

We're on our way to 10,000 protected workplaces by 2035

**About the Role**

* Demand generation engine of our international outbound motion, covering UAE, India, APAC, Europe, GCC and the Americas
* Research target companies in our focus industries and develop interest into sales-ready opportunities
* Move each contact from Prospect (MQL) to a sales-qualified lead (SQL) that Sales accepts, with a meeting on the calendar
* Full-cycle prospecting seat: you own the bridge into Sales, you do not negotiate or close, and you carry no pricing authority
* Fully digital and desk-based, with no field visits

**Research and Target**

* Identify and research target companies across all markets against the defined ideal customer profile (ICP)
* Build and maintain target account lists by market
* Map the decision-makers and buying committee in each account

**Enrich and Maintain Data**

* Source and validate contact information using approved tools
* Keep every prospect record in CRM accurate, complete and up to date, tagged by market

**Pitch and Develop**

* Reach out by email, LinkedIn, phone and WhatsApp (where applicable)
* Personalise every message to the account and its market, and follow the defined sequences and cadences
* Open real conversations with plant, EHS, safety and procurement buyers

**Qualify MQL to SQL**

* Run a structured qualification against the criteria set by management and Sales for each market
* Capture buying signals and make an honest qualify or reject call on every lead
* Understand each account's scope and potential

**Fix the Meeting**

* Secure a genuine meeting or next step with Sales across time zones and hand over cleanly
* Move real opportunities forward, not just pricing requests

**Build Qualified Pipeline**

* Develop and maintain a qualified pipeline for Sales, with clear opportunity value by market

**Keep the CRM Honest**

* Log every contact, activity, disposition and stage in CRM in real time

**Feed the Loop**

* Track outreach and conversion metrics by market and join the weekly performance review
* Share learnings back to demand generation and Sales so targeting and criteria keep getting sharper

**How Success Is Measured**

* MQL to SQL qualification against the agreed criteria for each market
* SQL acceptance by Sales: a meeting fixed and taken forward, not just a request for pricing
* Pipeline value handed to Sales (for example, USD pipeline developed)
* GP contribution from qualified opportunities that convert into orders

**Requirements**

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 2-4 years in B2B lead generation, inside sales, presales, SDR / LDR or outbound business development
* Comfortable owning a daily qualification and calling number
* Hands-on outbound experience (required): reached out to business prospects, run discovery and qualified them
* Strong internet research skills; ideally has researched accounts on LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo or similar

**Technical Skills**

* CRM familiarity (required), ideally Zoho CRM, with clean dispositions and stages
* Qualifies with a method (BANT / CHAMP / SPIN or similar), not gut feel
* Can read an account's scope and potential
* Plus: tools such as Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot or Lusha

**Functional Skills**

* Strong communicator with international buyers: clear, confident written and spoken English
* Comfortable with plant, EHS, safety and procurement contacts across cultures and time zones
* Gets the meeting: moves a conversation to a fixed next step, not a soft maybe

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to international markets
* Experience in industrial, manufacturing, engineering, SaaS or B2B services
* Exposure to technical / industrial products or PPE

**Application**

* Include a link to your 90-second video introduction (questions are in the application form)

**Benefits**

* Own the gate: the call on what is a real opportunity and what is noise is yours
* Learn B2B selling properly: real discovery with real buyers and a real method
* A mission that matters: every account you qualify moves a real plant closer to safe
* Fully remote within India, or office-based at Kolkata HQ (South City Business Park, Anandapur)
* Working hours aligned to the time zones of your assigned markets, agreed at offer stage
* Everything runs on Zoho One

**Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) and Google Ads**
. The candidate will be responsible for planning, executing, optimizing, and monitoring paid advertising campaigns to generate qualified leads for our interior design and turnkey projects.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of performance marketing, audience targeting, lead generation strategies, campaign analytics, and conversion optimization.Key Responsibilities

**1. Meta Ads Management**

* Plan, execute, and manage paid advertising campaigns on Facebook and Instagram.
* Develop effective audience targeting strategies based on demographics, interests, locations, and buyer intent.
* Run lead generation, website conversion, remarketing, and retargeting campaigns.

* Optimize bidding strategies, ad copies, audience targeting, and campaign structure.
* Monitor search terms, negative keywords, conversion tracking, and landing page performance.

* Develop and implement digital strategies to generate consistent, high-quality leads.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING MANGER

**Location:** Edappally  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** Minimum 2 or 3 Years  
**Department:** Digital Marketing  
**Reports To:** CEO / Management  
**Team Size:** 2–3 Digital Marketers

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Digital Marketing Team Lead** to lead our digital marketing team and take ownership of strategy, campaign execution, performance, client communication, and team delivery.

The ideal candidate should have **strong hands-on expertise in Meta Ads and Google Ads**, combined with excellent strategic thinking, analytical ability, problem-solving skills, client communication, and people-management capabilities.

The Team Lead will be responsible for managing a team of **2–3 Digital Marketers**, assigning work, reviewing campaign performance, solving execution challenges, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring that the team consistently delivers measurable results for clients.

This is a **hands-on leadership role**. We are looking for someone who can **think strategically, execute practically, lead people, solve problems, communicate with clients, and take ownership of results.**

Key Responsibilities1. Team Leadership & Management

* Manage and lead a team of **2–3 Digital Marketers**.
* Allocate clients, campaigns, and responsibilities among team members.
* Set clear priorities, deadlines, and performance expectations for the team.
* Monitor daily and weekly execution of assigned work.
* Review the team's campaign strategies and execution before implementation when required.
* Conduct regular team reviews and performance discussions.
* Identify skill gaps within the team and provide guidance, coaching, and training.
* Ensure team members follow standard processes, reporting formats, and campaign management practices.
* Build a culture of **ownership, accountability, learning, and performance**.
* Support team members in solving complex campaign and client problems.
* Escalate major issues to management with a proposed solution rather than simply reporting the problem.

2. Digital Marketing Strategy

* Develop comprehensive digital marketing strategies based on client objectives, target audience, industry, and business goals.
* Guide team members in developing client-specific marketing strategies.
* Create channel-wise marketing plans covering paid advertising, content, social media, lead generation, and conversion.
* Translate business objectives into measurable digital marketing KPIs.
* Plan monthly and quarterly campaign strategies and execution roadmaps.
* Identify opportunities to improve lead quality, conversion rates, customer acquisition, and overall campaign performance.
* Ensure that campaign strategy is aligned with the client's overall business objectives.

3. Meta Ads Management

* Plan, launch, manage, and optimize **Meta Ads campaigns** across Facebook and Instagram.
* Develop campaign structures based on objectives such as lead generation, conversions, traffic, engagement, and remarketing.
* Manage audience targeting, retargeting, lookalike audiences, creatives, budgets, and bidding strategies.
* Analyze campaign performance and optimize for **CPL, CPA, ROAS, CTR, conversion rate, and lead quality**.
* Review and guide the Meta Ads work executed by team members.
* Troubleshoot tracking, campaign delivery, audience, creative, and performance-related issues.
* Stay updated with changes in Meta Ads, targeting, attribution, automation, and campaign optimization practices.

4. Google Ads Management

* Plan, execute, and optimize **Google Ads campaigns**.
* Maintain hands-on knowledge of Search, Display, Performance Max, YouTube, and remarketing campaigns.
* Conduct keyword research, audience research, competitor analysis, ad copy planning, and campaign structuring.
* Monitor budgets, search terms, conversion data, bidding strategies, and campaign performance.
* Review Google Ads campaigns managed by team members and provide strategic direction.
* Identify and resolve performance issues to improve acquisition efficiency and ROI.
* Ensure proper conversion tracking and campaign measurement.

5. Campaign Performance & Optimization

* Monitor campaign performance across all assigned accounts.
* Review campaign performance reports prepared by team members.
* Analyze data and identify the reasons behind performance changes.
* Develop actionable optimization plans based on campaign data.
* Conduct and guide A/B testing of creatives, audiences, landing pages, messaging, and campaign structures.
* Identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective action.
* Focus not only on lead generation but on **lead quality, conversion, customer acquisition cost, and business results**.
* Ensure that every campaign has clear KPIs and measurable objectives.

6. Client Communication & Account Management

* Act as a senior digital marketing point of contact for assigned clients.
* Understand client requirements, business challenges, objectives, and expectations.
* Participate in client meetings and strategy discussions.
* Present marketing strategies, campaign plans, reports, and performance insights clearly.
* Explain campaign performance and recommendations in a simple, business-oriented manner.
* Handle client questions, concerns, and performance-related discussions professionally.
* Build strong, long-term relationships with clients through proactive communication.
* Communicate both positive and negative campaign developments honestly and professionally.
* Ensure that team members maintain professional and timely client communication.

7. Team Performance & Quality Control

The Team Lead will be responsible for ensuring that the **2–3 member digital marketing team delivers work on time and at the expected quality level.**

Responsibilities include:

* Review campaign plans before execution where necessary.
* Review monthly marketing strategies and reports.
* Monitor task completion and deadlines.
* Check campaign setup and optimization quality.
* Ensure proper tracking and reporting.
* Review client deliverables.
* Identify recurring mistakes and implement corrective processes.
* Ensure team members continuously improve their technical and strategic capabilities.

8. Problem Solving

* Identify problems before they become major issues.
* Analyze campaign, client, creative, technical, tracking, and conversion-related problems systematically.
* Develop practical solutions rather than simply reporting problems.
* Support team members in solving difficult campaign problems.
* Take ownership of major campaign challenges.
* Remain calm and solution-oriented under pressure.
* Escalate critical issues to management along with possible solutions.

We are specifically looking for someone who thinks:“Here is the problem. Why is it happening? What are our options? What should we do next?”

—not someone who simply says:

“There is a problem.”9. Cross-Team Collaboration

Work closely with:

* Content team
* Video production team
* Designers
* Developers
* Sales team
* Management

Responsibilities include:

* Provide clear campaign and content briefs.
* Coordinate requirements between teams.
* Ensure marketing strategy is properly translated into execution.
* Review marketing creatives and assets when required.
* Coordinate landing page and tracking requirements.
* Work with sales teams to understand lead quality and conversion.
* Ensure marketing and sales teams are aligned on campaign objectives.

Required SkillsMust-Have Skills

* **Minimum 3 years of professional experience in Digital Marketing**
* Strong hands-on expertise in **Meta Ads**
* Strong hands-on expertise in **Google Ads**
* Strong understanding of digital marketing strategy and campaign planning
* Proven ability to manage and guide a small team
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent client communication and presentation skills
* Strong understanding of lead generation and conversion funnels
* Experience with campaign performance analysis and optimization
* Ability to manage multiple clients and campaigns simultaneously
* Strong ownership and accountability
* Strong teamwork and leadership skills

Technical Knowledge

Candidates should have a strong understanding of:

* Meta Ads Manager

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience leading a small marketing team is an advantage.
* Experience in both B2B and B2C marketing is an advantage.

What We Are Looking ForSTRATEGIST

PERFORMANCE MARKETER

title: EY - GDS Consulting -AI Strategy & Go-To-Market
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**JOB DESCRIPTION | AI & DATA TECH CONSULTING**
**AI Strategy & Go-To-Market**
Career Family: AIA – AI Strategy & GTM
  
  

* Pursuits, RFPs & Offering Development

**LEVEL**
**Senior/Manager**
**Experience**
**8–12 years**
**LOCATION**
EY GDS
  
  

* Hybrid

**ORIENTATION**
**Strategy-led**
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
We are seeking a strategic Manager to join our AI & Data Tech Consulting team, focused on shaping how clients adopt Agentic AI and GenAI — and how the firm takes its AI offerings to market. The ideal candidate brings a blend of AI product strategy, solution positioning, and pursuit leadership, with enough technical fluency to credibly translate AI capabilities into business value, without being a hands-on builder.
  
  
You will work closely with account leaders, solution architects, C-suite stakeholders, and alliance partners to win and shape AI programs — owning the narrative from opportunity qualification and RFP response through solution storyboarding, commercial framing, and client orals.
  
  
**WHERE YOUR TIME GOES**
**40%**
**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**
Win themes, solution storyline, client orals
  
  
**30%**
**Go-To-Market & Offerings**
Positioning, enablement collateral, alliances
  
  
**30%**
**AI Strategy & Advisory**
Roadmaps, business cases, operating models
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
AI Strategy & Value Advisory
  
  
■ Partner with client leadership and Operating Partners to define AI / Agentic AI vision, use-case portfolios, and adoption roadmaps.
  
  
■ Build use-case prioritization frameworks (value vs. feasibility vs. risk) and translate them into phased roadmaps (discovery → MVP → scale).
  
  
■ Develop business cases with ROI, cost-to-serve, and value-realization metrics that leadership can fund against.
  
  
■ Frame AI operating models — CoE design, governance, Responsible AI guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
■ Knowledge of business process transformation and industry value chains (Health, FS, Consumer, Industrials) would be an added advantage.
  
  
Go-To-Market & Offering Development
  
  
■ Shape and package AI offerings, accelerators, and assets into market-ready propositions — positioning, messaging, pricing logic, and differentiation.
  
  
■ Build sales enablement collateral: pitch decks, solution one-pagers, executive pagers, demo storylines, case studies, and battle cards.
  
  
■ Conduct market, competitive, and analyst research (vendors, hyperscalers, AI-native startups) to inform build / buy / partner decisions and offering roadmaps.
  
  
■ Work with alliance partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.) on joint GTM motions, co-sell plays, and partner-funded programs.
  
  
■ Track adoption and pipeline KPIs for offerings and feed market signals back into the offering roadmap.
  
  
RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits
  
  
■ Lead end-to-end RFP / RFI / RFQ responses for AI and data programs — bid / no-bid qualification, win themes, solution storyline, and response orchestration.
  
  
■ Translate client requirements into a crisp solution narrative, scope, delivery approach, staffing model, and commercial construct, in collaboration with architects and delivery leads.
  
  
■ Own proposal quality — compliance matrices, executive summaries, value articulation, risk and assumption logs.
  
  
■ Prepare and lead client orals, executive workshops, and proof-of-value storyboards; coach pursuit teams on messaging.
  
  
■ Maintain a reusable pursuit library of proposal content, case studies, and credentials.
  
  
AI Fluency (Conversational, Not Hands-On)
  
  
■ Working understanding of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI frameworks, AI evaluation & observability, and LLMOps — enough to engage architects and challenge solutions credibly.
  
  
■ Awareness of AI risk, regulation, and governance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and how they shape client buying decisions.
  
  
■ Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and enterprise data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) at a solution level.
  
  
■ Comfort with AI productivity tools to accelerate research, content, and proposal creation.
  
  
Business Development & Client Management
  
  
■ Work closely with account leaders to identify, qualify, and shape opportunities and build tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.
  
  
■ Build trusted relationships with client CXOs, product owners, and transformation leaders.
  
  
■ Represent the firm at analyst briefings, industry forums, webinars, and thought-leadership platforms; author POVs, whitepapers, and blogs.
  
  
Team Leadership & Collaboration
  
  
■ Lead and mentor a small team of strategy consultants and pursuit analysts.
  
  
■ Orchestrate collaboration across solution architects, delivery, sector specialists, alliances, legal, and pricing teams.
  
  
■ Drive knowledge sharing, offering playbooks, and capability-building across the practice.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes**
Educational Background
  
  
■ MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
■ 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.
  
  
■ Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.
  
  
■ Experience building offerings, roadmaps, business cases, and executive-facing collateral for enterprise clients.
  
  
■ Exposure to market research, competitive benchmarking, startup / vendor evaluation, or innovation programs is a strong plus.
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
■ Exceptional storytelling and executive presence — able to turn complex AI concepts into a compelling, simple business narrative.
  
  
■ Strong structured thinking and problem-solving; comfortable working under pursuit deadlines.
  
  
■ Excellent written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, especially with C-suite executives.
  
  
■ Influencing without authority across large, matrixed pursuit teams.
  
  
**Preferred Certifications**
■ GenAI / AI strategy certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Coursera, ISB / IIM executive programs, etc.)
  
  
■ Product management or agile certifications (SAFe POPM / PM, Pragmatic, CSPO), Design Thinking.
  
  
■ APMP (proposal management) certification is a plus.
  
  
IDEAL PROFILE
  
  
**You will thrive here if you…**
■ Have taken AI / data products from 0 → 1 and know what drives adoption
  
  
■ Love building the story, the business case, and the winning proposal
  
  
■ Can hold your own with architects — and simplify for the CXO
  
  
■ Have run market scans, vendor evaluations, or innovation programs
  
  
**This role is not…**
■ A hands-on engineering or model-building role
  
  
■ Writing production code, data pipelines, or agent frameworks
  
  
■ Pure delivery / project management
  
  
■ A back-office bid-desk formatting role
  
  
WHY JOIN US
  
  
■ Shape how leading global enterprises adopt AI — and how the firm wins in the AI market.
  
  
■ Work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and growth, with direct visibility to account and practice leadership.
  
  
■ Collaborate with a team of AI experts, solution architects, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
■

■

■

■
**Diverse and inclusive culture**

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Regional Strategy Manager
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
In this role, every single day brings exciting topics and opportunities for growth. You will delve into several strategic topics and initiatives, work closely with regional leadership peers to discuss business plans, go-to-market topics that create lasting impact. You work collaboratively with cross-cultural teams in a dynamic and encouraging environment that emphasizes partnership and open communication. Your work will not only strengthen our business growth but also contribute to our shared mission of decarbonizing the planet, giving you a profound sense of purpose.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**
In this role as the Regional Strategy Manager, you’ll functionally report into the global Head of Business Strategy and work closely with the Regional Leadership
  
  
team to implement the strategy and transform the business towards profitable growth specifically, you will:
  
  

* Develop the regional strategy together with the Regional Leadership team, and define clear, actionable measures & initiatives towards profitable growth
* Lead regional strategic growth plans and transformation initiatives to ensure strategy implementation; occasionally drive global strategic projects with cross-functional workstreams
* Work closely with the Regional Leadership and SE Hub teams to develop business plans, support go-to-market and sales excellence activities
* Support the global market & competitive intelligence team with regional competitive insights and regional market evaluation, together with the local countries
* Drive the preparation for recurring regional business reviews and provide executive support to the Regional Head for ad-hoc strategically important topics
* Provide executive support to Business leadership, with ad-hoc topics and presentations to various stakeholders, for e.g., SE Executive Board, etc.

**What You Bring**

* Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Engineering, and / or economics or MBA required
* Necessarily multiple years of prior working experience in strategy consulting and / or in-house strategy teams with a focus on strategy implementation and business transformation
* Prior experience in the Oil & Gas / Chemicals / Maritime / Process Industries with understanding of the market mechanics and future developments, especially around energy transition and sustainability
* Understands AI and has experience in using AI agents
* Strong analytical skills as well as proficiency in MS Office, incl. constructing and delivering executive presentations with multi-layered content; Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI is an advantage
* Self-driven, with hands-on experience in interacting with and leading international teams in complex interdisciplinary projects
* Effective English language and communication skills to position ideas and deliver key messages to all leadership levels

**About The Team**
Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.
  
  
Check this video to learn more about our Transformation of Industry business https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/offerings/industrial-applications.html
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

title: Director Content Operations-Company Data
description:
Role Summary
  
  
The Director of Broker Models will lead the strategy, build-out, and scaling of LSEG's business. This leader will be responsible for redefining an emerging capability into a differentiated, high-growth product by driving business expansion, operational excellence, technology innovation and customer value creation.
  
  
The role requires an entrepreneurial leader with a consistent record of building and growing new businesses, leading large-scale transformation programs, and delivering commercial outcomes through a combination of domain expertise, technology, AI and operational excellence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Business Growth & Strategy**

* Define and implement the long-term vision, strategy, and growth roadmap for the Broker Models business.
* Drive expansion of company coverage, broker participation, data depth, and product adoption.
* Identify new revenue opportunities and unlock market differentiation through innovative content and insights.
* Partner with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering to drive commercial success.

**Business Transformation**

* Lead end-to-end transformation of data collection, extraction, enrichment, and delivery processes.
* Leverage AI, automation, and modern technologies to scale operations and improve efficiency.
* Build scalable operating models capable of supporting rapid business growth.
* Drive continuous improvement across quality, timeliness, customer experience, and cost efficiency.

**Product & Customer Leadership**

* Translate customer needs into differentiated product capabilities.
* Ensure the Broker Models business delivers high-quality, trusted, and scalable content.
* Supervise competitive landscape and market trends to identify growth opportunities.
* Act as an inspiring leader and advocate for customers and business collaborators.
* Organization Building
* Build, lead, and develop high-performing global teams.
* Develop a culture of innovation, ownership, accountability, and experimentation.
* Attract and develop talent capable of operating in a high-growth environment.
* Lead cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations, and Commercial organizations.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 15+ years of leadership experience in financial data, market intelligence, research, analytics, information services, or related industries.
* Shown success in building, launching, and scaling new businesses, products, or data franchises.
* Proven experience leading large-scale business transformation and modernization programs.
* Experience driving growth through data, technology, AI and automation.
* Strong commercial competence with ability to connect strategy to revenue and customer outcomes.
* Outstanding stakeholder management and executive interpersonal skills preferred.
* Experience with broker research, estimates, financial models, investment research, or capital markets data.
* Experience leading global, cross-functional organizations.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML-enabled data extraction and content operations.
* Experience leading P&L, business cases, investment decisions, and growth roadmaps.

**Leadership Profile:**

* A builder who can build and scale a business from an emerging opportunity.
* An ambitious leader who challenges traditional ways of working and drives innovation.
* A growth mindset leader passionate about market expansion and customer value.
* A strategic problem solver who can translate vision into execution.
* A collaborative influencer capable of aligning Product, Engineering, Commercial, and Operations teams around a common goal.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and accelerating growth in a constantly evolving business.
* Success Measures
* Growth in company and broker coverage.
* Revenue growth and business expansion.
* Product adoption and customer satisfaction.
* AI and automation-driven productivity improvements.
* Scalability of the operating model.
* Quality, timeliness, and trustworthiness of content delivered to customers.

**Career Stage:**
Director
  
  
**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
  
  
Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of
**Integrity, Partnership**
,
**Excellence**
and
**Change**
underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
  
  
Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
  
  
We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
  
  
LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.
  
  
Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject.

title: Associate Manager, Market Development
description:
Reporting to the Head of Sales, South Asia, the Associate Manager, Market Development, will be a key member of the Global Sales organization responsible for driving market growth, demand generation, and revenue execution across the South Asia region.
  
  
The role will focus on expanding Shure's presence within the Collaboration and Conferencing ecosystem by developing strategic relationships with end users, consultants, system integrators, distribution partners, and alliance partners. Leveraging market intelligence, competitive insights, and customer engagement, this individual will help build pipeline, accelerate specifications, and drive adoption of Shure's collaboration, conferencing, networked audio, and enterprise solutions portfolio.
  
  
This position can be based in Bangalore or Hyderabad.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Revenue Growth & Pipeline Development**

* Drive business development, pipeline creation, and revenue growth within the Collaboration and Conferencing market to support regional sales objectives and long-term business growth.
* Identify, prioritize, and develop strategic opportunities, key accounts, and emerging market segments to expand Shure's customer base and specification influence.
* Work closely with sales leadership, distribution partners, and system integrators to accelerate opportunity conversion and improve win rates.

**End-User & Ecosystem Engagement**

* Develop strong relationships with end users, consultants, technology influencers, and channel partners to position Shure as the preferred audio and collaboration solutions provider.
* Promote Shure's complete ecosystem, including conferencing, collaboration, networked audio, wireless, and software offerings, to drive cross-portfolio adoption and attachment opportunities.
* Influence project specifications and technology recommendations through proactive customer engagement and solution-based selling.

**Partner Enablement & Capability Development**

* Plan and deliver training, workshops, demonstrations, and enablement programs for distribution partners, consultants, and integration partners.
* Strengthen partner capabilities around Shure solutions, value proposition, competitive positioning, and sales motions.
* Measure the effectiveness of enablement activities and recommend actions to improve partner engagement and conversion.

**Market Activation & Demand Generation**

* Collaborate with Marketing and Market Activation teams to execute customer events, roadshows, industry conferences, webinars, and thought leadership initiatives.
* Support local demand-generation campaigns that increase market awareness, create qualified opportunities, and strengthen customer engagement.
* Represent Shure at key industry events and customer-facing activities throughout the region.

**Business Intelligence & Strategic Planning**

* Provide market insights, customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and regional trends to support sales strategy, portfolio planning, and go-to-market decisions.
* Support forecasting, pipeline reviews, account planning, and business reviews through data-driven insights and opportunity analysis.
* Monitor competitive developments and recommend actions to strengthen Shure's market position and accelerate growth.

**Travel**

* Ability to travel minimum 50% of the time, including occasional weekends, as business needs require.

**Qualifications**

* Proven success driving business development, revenue growth, and strategic account expansion within the Integrated Systems, Unified Communications, or professional AV industry.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience with 8-10 years of relevant experience in professional audio, collaboration technologies, or audiovisual solutions.
* Strong understanding of Integrated Systems markets, including Audio Visual Integration, Unified Communications, Collaboration Solutions, Networked Audio, Video Conferencing, and Multi-Language Discussion Systems.
* Demonstrated ability to influence complex buying decisions and build relationships across end users, consultants, integrators, distributors, and alliance partners.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to analyze market trends, identify growth opportunities, and develop actionable sales strategies.
* Excellent presentation, communication, and customer engagement skills, with the ability to articulate business value to both technical and executive audiences.
* Experience with audio system design, DSP platforms, conferencing technologies, and enterprise collaboration solutions is highly desirable.
* Self-motivated, highly organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, CRM platforms, and pipeline management processes.
* Native language fluency appropriate for the region with excellent spoken and written English.

**Who We Are**
Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.
  
  
Shure is headquartered in United States. We have more than 35 regional sales offices, engineering hubs, distribution centers and manufacturing facilities throughout the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.
  
  
Join Shure and
**Amplify Your Impact.**
Explore our unique culture and learn the key pillars that define our legacy of excellence.
  
  
**THE MIX MATTERS**
Don’t check off every box in the job requirements? No problem! We recognize that every professional journey is unique and are committed to providing an equitable candidate experience for all prospective Shure Associates. If you’re excited about this role, believe you’ve got the skills to be successful, and share our passion for creating an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible work environment, then apply!

title: AVP - Partnership & Marketing
description:
**Factspan Overview:**

Factspan is a pure play data and analytics services organization. We partner with fortune 500 enterprises to build an analytics center of excellence, generating insights and solutions from raw data to solve business challenges, make strategic recommendations and implement new processes that help them succeed. With offices in USA, Canada, UK, Europe & India; we use a global delivery model to service our customers. Our customers include industry leaders from Retail, Media & Entertainment, Hospitality, and Logistic & Supply Chain.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a high-caliber, net-new pipeline-driven AVP / VP of Partnership & Marketing to architect, execute, and scale our B2B demand generation engine. In this strategic leadership role, you will be entirely focused on accelerating qualified lead generation and pipeline velocity through two primary levers: deep strategic alliances with major technology ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, Databricks) and highly targeted Account-Based Marketing (ABM) campaigns.

You will own the bridge between our cutting-edge Data & AI service offerings and enterprise clients looking to modernise their tech stacks. The ideal candidate brings a data-driven approach to marketing automation and AI-driven workflows, combined with a proven track record of monetizing partner networks within the professional services or IT consulting landscape.

**What You’ll Do**

**1. Strategic Partnerships & Co-Selling**

* Ecosystem Pipeline Generation: Identify, build, and scale commercial relationships with premier cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) and data/AI platform partners (Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft, OpenAI) to secure inbound service leads.
* Joint Go-To-Market (GTM): Architect and execute co-marketing plans with tier-1 partners, driving high-impact webinars, roundtables, and co-authored thought leadership that capture enterprise buyer intent.
* Partner Tier Optimization: Drive our standing within partner tier frameworks (e.g., achieving Premier/Elite competencies), unlocking internal referral mechanisms, partner-led funding programs (MDF), and co-sell opportunities.
* Alliance Enablement: Equipping cloud partner account managers (PAMs) and enterprise sellers with clear sales plays, case studies, and distinct value propositions regarding our AI implementation capabilities.

**2. Growth Marketing & Enterprise Lead Generation**

* Pipeline Acceleration: Own the quarterly and annual lead generation quotas, converting marketing and partner investments into highly qualified opportunities (MQLs/SQLs).
* Account-Based Marketing (ABM): Design multi-channel hyper-targeted ABM campaigns tailored to Fortune 500 / Global 2000 logos, positioning our custom AI framework, MLops, and data engineering solutions.
* Modern Growth Stack Execution: Direct data-driven campaigns spanning content marketing, SEO/SEM, organic search, paid media, and industry-specific events.
* AI-Enhanced Operations: Inject AI-driven personalization, advanced marketing automation tools, and predictive intent data platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, HubSpot, Salesforce) into the everyday lead routing workflow.

**3. Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and evaluate a lean, high-performing team of Inside Sales, Marketing, and demand generation specialists.
* Sales-Marketing Interlock: Maintain strict SLA alignment with the enterprise sales team on lead definitions, lead scoring thresholds, and quick-response follow-up timelines.
* ROI Data Governance: Track, analyze, and present key performance metrics (CAC, LTV, MQL-to-SQL conversion, Partner-Influenced Revenue) to executive stakeholders, shifting budgets rapidly to top-performing channels.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Partner-Sourced Pipeline: Total dollar value of qualified sales opportunities originated directly via cloud and technology partners.
* Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) / Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs): Volume and conversion rate of enterprise leads into active pipeline opportunities.
* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) Efficiency: Cost optimization per channel, maximizing return on marketing spend (ROAS).
* Partner-Influenced Revenue: Percentage of total closed-won annual contract value (ACV) touched by marketing or alliance programs.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Experience & Expertise**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field (MBA preferred).
* Experience: 15+ years of B2B marketing and/or channel management experience, with a minimum of 4+ years in a senior leadership role inside an IT consulting, professional services, or Data & AI services firm.
* Industry Fluency: Profound understanding of cloud infrastructure ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern data/AI concepts (Generative AI, LLMs, data warehousing, business intelligence).
* MarTech Proficiency: Hands-on experience scaling CRM platforms (Salesforce) and marketing automation ecosystems with a clear understanding of intent-data frameworks.
* Commercial Acumen: Exceptional negotiation, relationship-building, and public presentation skills, with a history of converting abstract tech alliances into structured revenue streams.

title: Dir, Product Management
description:
**The group you’ll be a part of**
In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam’s etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.
  
  
**The impact you’ll make**

* In this role, you will directly contribute to shaping the strategy, growth, and profitability of Lam Research's Customer Support Business Group by leading a portfolio of lifecycle products, services, and solutions that help customers maximize equipment performance and productivity. You will influence product investments, drive innovation, and lead a team of Product Managers to deliver business outcomes that create long-term value for both Lam and its customers.

**What You’ll Do**

* Define and execute the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for a portfolio of CSBG products, upgrades, services, and lifecycle solutions.
* Partner with Engineering, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Global Product Groups, and Customer Support teams to translate customer and market requirements into differentiated product offerings.
* Drive product lifecycle management, including product planning, prioritization, launch readiness, adoption, and end-of-life decisions.
* Lead portfolio investment decisions by evaluating market opportunities, competitive landscapes, customer needs, and business case economics.
* Develop and monitor key business metrics including revenue growth, profitability, customer adoption, and product performance.
* Build strong relationships with strategic customers to understand technology roadmaps, operational challenges, and emerging opportunities.
* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Product Managers while fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and operational excellence.
* Collaborate globally to influence executive decisions, align stakeholders, and drive successful execution of strategic business initiatives.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* Master's or Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Semiconductor Technology, Business, or a related discipline.
* 15+ years of relevant experience in Product Management, Product Strategy, Business Management, Engineering, Product Marketing, or Program Management in semiconductor or similar hardware products..
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders across a global organization.
* Experience developing product roadmaps, portfolio strategies, and investment prioritization frameworks.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to analyze market opportunities, customer requirements, and commercial outcomes.
* Proven people leadership experience, including leading product management teams and developing future leaders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting semiconductor manufacturing customers and engaging directly with wafer fabs.
* Knowledge of semiconductor process technologies such as Etch, Deposition, Clean, CMP, or related process domains.
* Experience managing aftermarket services, upgrades, installed-base solutions, or lifecycle management businesses.
* MBA or advanced technical degree.
* Demonstrated ability to drive growth initiatives, portfolio transformation, and organizational change.
* Experience presenting business strategy, portfolio reviews, and investment recommendations to executive leadership.
* Familiarity with customer support business models and service-based product offerings in semiconductor equipment companies.

**Our commitment**
We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.
  
  
Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.
  
  
*Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.*

**Requirements**

* 8 -10+ years of proven multi-channel B2B marketing experience within enterprise software/SaaS
* Bachelor's Degree in, Marketing, Business Administration, or related field
* Experience in the Developer & Startup ecosystem would be beneficial
* Ability to understand and communicate to diverse technical and non-technical audiences
* Penchant for technology creativity to “think outside the box” and leadership to execute effectively
* Experience building and delivering of field marketing covering campaigns, events and digital
* Demonstrated success in highly collaborative partnerships with other marketing and cross-functional leaders both inside and outside the company
* Strong influencing skills with the ability to sell ideas and get buy-in with various stakeholders
* Hands-on execution ability with effective project and time management
* Project management, prioritization, organizational skills, accuracy in performance and details driven
* Experience in Salesforce, Marketo, Wordpress
* Highly metrics driven
* Good understanding of cloud infrastructure, cloud applications, data science, analytics platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Dataiku, H2O, Salesforce)

* Global mindset and ability to think across discipline, industries, cultures and scenarios.

How do you want to make your impact?
