title: CRM Manager
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
  
  
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
**About The Role**
We are looking for a CRM Lead who can write high-converting copy and design automated user journeys across app and web. Your primary focus will be crafting the push notifications, in-app messages, emails, and WhatsApp sequences that guide users through key financial flows. You bring past experience in fintech or digital banking, knowing how to write clear, simple copy for complex steps like KYC, onboarding, and loan applications. You are a high-agency strategist who uses writing to improve retention and solve funnel drop-offs.
  
  
**Focus Area 1: Copywriting & Journey Architecture**

* Core Copywriting: Write all copy for push notifications, in-app banners, SMS, WhatsApp messages, and email sequences.
* Journey Mapping: Structure communication flows across the user lifecycle, adapting message angles based on user behavior and drop-off points.
* Funnel Drop-Off Recovery: Identify friction points in registration and product funnels, writing targeted recovery messaging to bring users back.
* Voice & Clarity: Keep messaging simple, direct, and transparent across all dynamic templates and automated sequences.

**Focus Area 2: Narrative Experimentation & Analytics**

* A/B Copy Testing: Run continuous experiments testing subject lines, hooks, message length, call-to-action buttons, and value propositions.
* Performance Analysis: Track open rates, click-through rates, and conversion metrics to see which messaging variations drive actual transactions.
* Dynamic Messaging: Set up modular content rules so message copy automatically adjusts based on user profiles and past activity.

**Focus Area 3: Product Alignment & Setup**

* Tech Coordination: Work with Product Managers and Tech Leads to trigger the right messages based on specific user events and backend actions.
* Frequency Control: Manage notification schedules to keep messages helpful without annoying users or causing uninstalls.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Fintech / Banking Writing Experience: Direct experience writing product copy and lifecycle campaigns for digital banking, lending, payments, or investment apps.
* CRM Stack Fluency: Hands-on experience working with tools like MoEngage, CleverTap, WebEngage, or Braze to set up and send written campaigns.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to read funnel drop-off charts and figure out what copy change will fix the leak.

**Mindset To Succeed**

* Clear Communication: You know how to distill complex financial products into one or two clear sentences.
* High Agency: You take full ownership of retention metrics, rewriting underperforming campaigns without waiting for a nudge.
* Audience Understanding: You understand user hesitation around financial decisions and write a copy that builds trust and prompts action.

**Additional Information**
PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)
  
  
Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

title: Deloitte USI - Cost Transformation - Specialist Assistant Manager | Bengaluru
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Deloitte USI - Growth - Specialist Assistant Manager**
**| Bengaluru**
**About The Team**
The Consulting Services works globally across practices and borders to support Deloitte’s Consulting Services business. The team is focused on offering our clients and people the global experience that’s essential in today’s world. Through Consulting Services, we provide innovative solutions for cross-cultural cross-border challenges our teams may encounter around the world. Leveraging leading-edge tools, methods, and resources, we deliver top-notch service that is applied locally while staying true to our global brand and core values.
  
  
Within the Consulting Services Growth – Cost Transformation team, professionals work collaboratively with Global and Member Firms (MFs) leaders to drive MDM and AIO growth, creating a significant impact across Deloitte's businesses by shaping markets, driving innovation, and expanding market presence.
  
  
**Overview of the role**
The professional will play a key role within the Cost Transformation team, helping to activate the Global Pillar focused on defining and executing GTM strategy across Deloitte’s businesses and offerings. The professional will help accelerate the execution of Growth strategic agenda by delivering high impact strategic projects, simplifying, and streamlining operations (reporting, PMO activities etc.), creating compelling and transparent leadership communications to solve the most complex challenges in exponentially powerful ways. This position is critical to advancing Cost Transformation initiatives, with a particular focus on Strategic Support and Go-To-Market priorities.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
The professional will work with the India colleagues and senior leaders across Consulting Services practice. They will need to develop a knowledge of the firm’s Consulting Services business, strategic priorities to enable sharing of insights, trends, and escalation of issues/variances as appropriate. The professional will analyse quantitative and qualitative data, synthesize findings, and demonstrate solid analytical and writing skills. The professional will also be responsible to develop compelling narrative with clear recommendations based on the research, analysis, and findings. The team’s projects are typically high-impact and high-visibility aligned to the global firm and Consulting Services leadership’s strategic priorities. Projects often involve collaboration across workstreams to ensure coordination and alignment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the Cost Transformation team in activating the Pillar dedicated to defining and executing GTM strategy across Deloitte businesses and offerings
* Collaborate with , Cost Transformation, and senior leaders to shape and align on a unified global strategy that advances strategic priorities and strengthens the competitive position of Member Firms and Geos
* Collaborate with diverse stakeholders to develop the GTM approach for priority focus areas
* Support pipeline and reporting analysis, providing Global leaders with insights to evaluate firm performance
* Conduct thorough quantitative and qualitative analyses using advanced tech-enabled tools to uncover insights and deliver actionable recommendations
* Demonstrate strong project management skills, taking ownership of a core project from start to finish, and seamlessly support and switch to different workstreams as required
* Support global communication of the Cost Transformation story across teams and the Cost Transformation specialist community
* Apply a strategic mindset and structured problem-solving approach, driven by intellectual curiosity
* Present ideas confidently to stakeholders through effective written and oral communication
* Lead/Co-Lead meeting planning and execution, including drafting agenda, organizing online and offline meetings and document MoM to support follow-up and accountability

Requisite core skills
  
  

* Ability to prepare leadership ready materials that “tell-the-story” succinctly and logically; ability to flex the communication and messaging to the audience and context
* Excellent project and time management skills; able to independently manage multiple high-quality deliverables under pressure and adapt to diverse cultures, communication styles, and working environments
* Capable of building effective working relationships with internal stakeholders across multiple business areas, functions, and geographies in a virtual environment
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint with strong attention to detail and best in class deliverables
* Must possess the ability to manage highest level of confidential information
* Experience creating dashboards in Tableau and Power BI, and familiarity with SharePoint

**Qualifications, experience, work location, and timing**
We seek an enthusiastic, energetic, and self-motivated individual who thrives both independently and collaboratively, and is comfortable working on projects of varying sizes within a close-knit team environment.
  
  

* Academic qualification: Master’s Degree like MBA
* Work experience: 6+ years of relevant experience
* Strong track record with previous employment, preferably with consulting firms or corporate strategy
* Location: Bengaluru
* Work hours: 11:30 AM – 8:30 PM OR 12:30 PM – 9:30 PM (expected to be flexible with time zones)
* Working from office: The individual is expected to come to office at least 2 days a week as per the ‘work from office’ schedule

**About Deloitte**
“Deloitte” is the brand under which independent firms throughout the world collaborate to provide services in a geographic area. These firms are members of Deloitte Touché Tohmatsu Limited DTTL, a UK private company limited by guarantee. With 260,000+ people in over 150 countries, Deloitte member firms serve more than 80 percent of the world's largest companies as well as large national enterprises, public institutions, and successful fast-growing companies
  
  
**Deloitte Support Services India Pvt Ltd**
Enabling Areas (EA) at the U.S. India offices are the support arm of the organization and comprise several groups including Talent, Technology, Finance, Communications, Field Operations, etc. EA gives every client-service business unit access to the best and brightest resources when it comes to support services. More specifically, EA enables the business units to solely focus on satisfying clients and developing new products and services to sustain competitive advantage, while they consolidate and standardize a diverse collection of systems, processes, and functions. The team provides a wide array of services to the U.S and India professionals, and is continually evaluating and expanding its portfolio
  
  
**How You Will Grow**
At Deloitte, we have invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team-based learning, and eLearning. Deloitte University (DU): The Leadership Center in India, our state-of-the- art, world-class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the DU in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development.
  
  
**Benefits**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits.
  
  
**Deloitte’s Culture**
Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives.
  
  
**Corporate Citizenship**
Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people, and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. title: Brand Manager
description:
Job Role: Manager / Senior Manager– Branded Content & Media Partnerships

Reporting: Branded Content Head.

**Role Purpose**

We are looking for an experienced Branded Content professional with strong relationships across the Indian media and entertainment ecosystem and a practical understanding of how branded content is developed and executed across multiple platforms. The candidate should have working relationships with Broadcast Television networks, OTT platforms, production houses, radio networks, publishers and digital content partners, and should understand how brand integrations work within each of these environments. The role is highly execution-oriented. The candidate should be able to take an opportunity from an initial conversation with a media partner through commercials, ideation, integration planning, production, approvals and final delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

● Manage branded content and media partnership projects end-to-end across:

o Broadcast Television

o OTT Platforms

o Digital Publishers

o Radio

o Print

o Films and entertainment content

o On-ground and experiential extensions where relevant

● Understand client briefs and identify relevant media properties, content franchises, shows, films, formats and partnership opportunities.

● Work directly with broadcasters, OTT platforms, production houses, publishers, radio networks and other media partners to develop executable branded content opportunities.

● Understand different branded content formats, including:

o In-show integrations

o Fiction integrations

o Non-fiction integrations

o Vignettes

o Sponsorships

o Branded IPs

o Film integrations

o Radio integrations

o Print-led branded content

o Publisher-led custom content

o Digital extensions

o Long-term content partnerships

● Assess opportunities from both a creative and execution perspective.

● Work closely with partners to convert broad opportunities into clearly defined and executable branded content solutions.

● Lead discussions around commercials, deliverables, inventory, production requirements and timelines.

● Negotiate with media partners and production houses to optimise costs and extract maximum value.

● Understand production processes and independently coordinate: Scripts, Integrations, Pre-production, Shoot planning, Production, Brand visibility, Post-production, Edit feedback, Final approvals

● Attend shoots where required and ensure that agreed brand integrations are executed correctly.

● Work closely with production partners and platform teams to troubleshoot execution issues.

● Manage brand and partner feedback during scripting, production and post-production stages.

● Proactively identify relevant upcoming shows, series, films, content franchises, events and cultural opportunities for brands.

● Build longer-term partnerships with broadcasters and platforms instead of relying only on one-off integrations.

● Work closely with internal strategy, media, client servicing and implementation teams.

● Manage multiple projects and partner conversations simultaneously.

**Experience**

Preferred Experience: 6–10 years

Candidates may come from:

● Broadcaster branded content teams

● Network brand solutions teams

● Media agencies – content teams

● OTT partnership teams / solutions teams

● Integrated content agencies

**Ideal Candidate**

We are specifically looking for someone who understands how branded content actually gets made.

The ideal candidate should know who to call at a broadcaster or platform, understand what is realistically possible within a show or content environment, negotiate the opportunity, structure the execution and ensure that what was promised to the client is actually delivered.

They should be equally comfortable:

Sitting across the table from a broadcaster negotiating an integration, and standing on a shoot floor ensuring that the integration has been executed correctly. Candidates whose experience has primarily been limited to strategy, ideation or presentation development without hands-on execution experience may not be suitable for this role.

If interested, please share your resume at kaushik.kujur@verse.in

description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.
  
  
Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).
  
  
This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The
**Senior Specialist – Consumer Make in India Category Management**
will primarily be responsible for driving Lenovo India's
**Consumer Make in India (MII) strategy and execution**
, while also managing key category, alliance, and consumer-insights responsibilities.
  
  
The role will work closely with
**Lenovo AP teams, manufacturing partners, supply chain, product teams, finance, strategic technology partners, and global stakeholders**
to identify and execute opportunities for local manufacturing, ensure supply readiness, and support the growth and profitability of the Consumer business.
  
  
In addition, the role will own the
**Consumer Chromebook category**
, manage strategic technology alliances, and provide actionable consumer and market insights to support business decisions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Make in India – Primary Responsibility
* Own and manage the end-to-end Consumer Make in India process, from product identification and feasibility assessment through manufacturing readiness and execution.
* Assess the Consumer product portfolio and identify products/categories suitable for local manufacturing in India.
* Evaluate business, operational, supply-chain and commercial considerations for bringing products into local manufacturing.
* Coordinate closely with AP teams to align product roadmaps, manufacturing plans, supply requirements and MII priorities.
* Work with manufacturing teams and partners to drive execution, readiness and successful ramp-up of MII products.
* Manage forecast, supply and demand planning for locally manufactured products and proactively identify supply risks and gaps.
* Work cross-functionally with Product, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance and Operations teams to ensure smooth execution of MII initiatives.
* Track key MII milestones, issues, dependencies and business impact, and provide regular updates to leadership.
* Identify opportunities to improve localization, cost competitiveness, supply resilience and operational efficiency.
* Support Lenovo's broader India manufacturing and localization strategy, including relevant government initiatives and programs.
* Consumer Chromebook Category Management
* Own the Consumer Chromebook category and manage the overall category business performance.
* Drive PL management, including revenue, margin, cost and profitability objectives.
* Manage end-to-end supply, demand, forecasting and inventory for the Chromebook portfolio.
* Identify opportunities to improve portfolio performance, inventory health and overall category profitability.
* Work closely with internal stakeholders to manage product lifecycle, supply constraints, launches and business priorities.
* Strategic Alliance Management
* Coordinate with alliance partners on business initiatives, product programs, joint activities and relevant Consumer priorities.
* Ensure effective internal alignment and execution of partner-led programs.
* Consumer Category Insights Market Intelligence
* Own the GfK relationship and end-to-end consumer market intelligence process for the Consumer business.
* Manage and utilize GfK, IDC and other relevant consumer/market reports to generate actionable business insights.
* Analyze market trends, category performance, competitive movements, pricing and consumer dynamics.
* Translate market data into clear recommendations for product, category, pricing and business strategy.
* Own the AP BMS deck end-to-end, ensuring accurate, timely and insightful reporting of Consumer business performance.
* Develop regular management insights and presentations to support decision-making by senior leadership.

**Key Deliverables / Success Measures**

* Successful execution of the Consumer Make in India roadmap and localization targets.
* Identification and successful transition of appropriate Consumer products to local manufacturing.
* Improved supply availability, forecast accuracy and inventory health for MII products.
* Strong financial and operational performance of the Consumer Chromebook category.
* Effective management of strategic technology alliances and partner programs.
* Generation of actionable insights that contribute to Consumer business growth, profitability and market competitiveness.

**Required Experience Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Marketing or a related discipline; MBA is preferred.
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in consumer electronics, technology, PC, manufacturing, supply chain, category management, business management or a related field.
* Strong understanding of Make in India, local manufacturing and supply-chain processes.
* Experience managing cross-functional projects involving regional/global teams.
* Strong business acumen with experience in PL, forecasting, supply-demand planning and business performance management.
* Experience working with technology partners, OEM/ODM partners or ecosystem stakeholders is preferred.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to translate market/business data into actionable insights.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, fast-paced and globally connected organization.

title: AVP - Category
description:

We operate across diverse industries and geographies, tackling complex challenges that require leaders who can navigate ambiguity and drive impact. * Track record of productive teamwork starts with “why” rather than “what,” enjoys getting hands dirty, and possesses a drive for continuous learning
* A deep understanding of user needs, preferably gained in consumer-first companies
* Comfort working with AI automation tools and exposure to LLM-based workflows to drive scalable growth initiatives
* Action bias: solves problems, executes, and iterates as needed

title: Director, Product Management
description:
**Opentext - The Information Company**
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  
**AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.**
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As the Director of Product Management – Messaging, you will lead the vision, strategy, and modernization of OpenText’s enterprise messaging portfolio, shaping the evolution of our current messaging capabilities toward a next-generation, SaaS-native Messaging Channels platform.
  
  
This is a strategic growth and transformation role with end-to-end responsibility for product vision, business strategy, roadmap, product boundaries, and transition planning across existing and future messaging capabilities. You will help build an email-first platform, with SMS and additional digital messaging channels, designed to support OpenText Communications, Experience Cloud applications, and API-driven customer use cases.
  
  
You will lead and develop the Product Management team responsible for messaging services, APIs, channels, and related platform capabilities. Working closely with Engineering, Architecture, Cloud Operations, Security, Support, and other Product organizations, you will translate customer needs and market opportunities into a focused, scalable product strategy.
  
  
A key part of your impact will be balancing innovation with the needs of our existing customers. You will guide the development and commercialization of the new messaging platform while managing customer commitments, operational dependencies, product economics, channel strategy, and migration from legacy messaging services.
  
  
You will also bring strong commercial and customer perspective to the portfolio, defining investment priorities, pricing and packaging strategies, channel economics, partner relationships, and business cases that support sustainable growth.
  
  
**What The Role Offers**

* Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and business plan for OpenText Messaging.
* Lead and develop a Product Management team responsible for messaging services, APIs, channels, and platform capabilities.
* Define a compelling long-term messaging vision and translate it into a focused, phased product roadmap.
* Lead the development and commercialization of the OCP-native Messaging Channels platform.
* Shape product boundaries across message delivery, channel selection, orchestration, campaign logic, consent, preferences, suppression, compliance, retry behavior, and reporting.
* Drive evidence-based investment decisions across email, SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, push, and future messaging channels.
* Define API-first messaging capabilities supporting OpenText applications, partners, developers, and direct customer integrations.
* Drive a product strategy that supports both multi-tenant OpenText applications and single-tenant or off-cloud OpenText Communications deployments.
* Partner across Communications, Journey, Experience Cloud, OCP, Engineering, Architecture, Cloud Operations, Support, and Security organizations.
* Establish measurable product success criteria across functionality, adoption, financial performance, scalability, security, reliability, and operational performance.
* Drive product requirements, project charters, architecture alignment, release planning, and dependency management.
* Own the commercial and customer transition strategy from legacy messaging services to the next-generation platform.
* Balance investments in the existing platform across customer commitments, security, regulatory requirements, technical currency, and business-critical priorities.
* Define pricing, packaging, aggregation, volume, margin, and monetization strategies for messaging services.
* Evaluate aggregator and channel-provider relationships, including geographic coverage, channel economics, and operational dependencies.
* Guide product ownership and service-boundary decisions across shared messaging infrastructure and software assets.
* Engage directly with customers and field teams on strategic opportunities, roadmap priorities, escalations, and evolving channel requirements.
* Develop business cases supporting investment, modernization, migration, partnership, and portfolio retirement decisions.
* Strengthen the integration between Messaging and OpenText Communications to deliver a coherent customer experience across content design, orchestration, delivery, compliance, and reporting.

**What You Need To Succeed**

* 14+ years of product management experience across enterprise software, SaaS, cloud services, communications, messaging, or platform products.
* Demonstrated experience leading Product Managers and complex, cross-functional product initiatives.
* Proven success defining and launching new platforms or materially modernizing established enterprise products.
* Strong understanding of enterprise messaging, email infrastructure, SMS, messaging APIs, CPaaS, aggregators, delivery status, and channel economics.
* Knowledge of messaging compliance requirements, including consent, opt-out and suppression management, data retention, auditability, sender identity, and geographic considerations.
* Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture, multi-tenancy, APIs, identity, security, observability, resilience, scalability, and service operations.
* Demonstrated ability to establish clear product boundaries within complex ecosystems spanning applications, platforms, infrastructure, and third-party providers.
* Experience developing product visions, project charters, PRDs, measurable success criteria, and phased MVP strategies.
* Strong commercial judgment with experience across pricing, packaging, margins, partner economics, revenue planning, investment decisions, and business cases.
* Ability to balance net-new product innovation with existing customer commitments, platform modernization, and migration requirements.
* Proven ability to partner effectively with Engineering and Architecture while maintaining clear ownership of product vision, priorities, and requirements.
* Strong customer-facing, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to operate effectively across global teams and navigate ambiguity, complex dependencies, and competing priorities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field.

OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
  
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us at hr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

title: Senior Director, Product Management
description:
ThoughtSpot is a Data & AI platform that helps companies turn data into enterprise advantage. We're Gartner MQ leaders with more than 1,000 customers globally and offices in Mountain View, Chicago, London, Bangalore, Sydney, and Tokyo.
  
  
**About Spotter**
Spotter is ThoughtSpot’s agentic analytics product. It reasons over governed enterprise data and shows its work, so its answers hold up in a board meeting. It covers:
  
  

* Data connectors that bring structured and unstructured data into Spotter.
* Spotter Analyst, the AI analyst inside ThoughtSpot.
* Slack and Microsoft Teams connectors that deliver answers where teams already work.
* The MCP Server, which brings Spotter into Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants.
* Embedded Spotter, for customers building it into their own applications.

**What You'll Do**
You’ll own a product for all of Spotter and lead the Spotter PM team, with the full backing of ThoughtSpot’s R&D organization.
  
  

* Set the strategy. Decide where Spotter goes across data, surfaces and embedding, and what to cut.
* Make trust in the product. Partner with Engineering so accuracy, reasoning and governance hold up whatever the data source and wherever the answer is delivered.
* Win every surface. Make Spotter the analytics layer people reach for in ThoughtSpot, in Slack and Teams, in AI assistants and in customers’ own applications.
* Ship in days, not quarters. Get things in front of customers early and iterate in the open.

**What You Bring**

* You’re a builder. You stay hands-on: you prototype, try the product yourself and get into the details, rather than leading from a distance.
* You’ve run a product for an AI or data platform at scale.
* You understand both end-user and developer/platform products: data integration, MCP, APIs and embedding.
* You have a strong point of view on where agentic analytics is going, and you change course fast when you’re wrong.
* You build PM teams that own their decisions.

****In-Office at ThoughtSpot****
Spotters are expected in-office 3+ days per week to be part of the energy of their local team. Momentum compounds when we're in the room together with faster decisions, sharper problem-solving, and the kind of peer learning that doesn't happen over a screen. Being in-office is our default way of working, with flexibility available where it's genuinely needed.
  
  
**About ThoughtSpot**
The world’s most innovative companies turn to ThoughtSpot’s AI-Powered Analytics to put data in the hands of everyone, from the C-suite to the frontline. With simple, natural language search and AI, anyone can ask questions, discover insights, and act with confidence. Unlike legacy tools that sacrifice performance for complexity, ThoughtSpot is intuitively designed for every business user while being built to handle the most complex, large-scale data, wherever it resides. This unique combination of speed and simplicity is why enterprise leaders trust ThoughtSpot to transform decision-making into a truly data-driven culture.
  
  
At ThoughtSpot, we’re a curious, data-driven bunch. We believe the world works better when everyone has access to facts. That’s why we build products that make asking and answering data questions as natural as having a conversation.
  
  
**Mandatory And Required Skills For All ThoughtSpot Roles**
Spotters are expected to demonstrate AI literacy and workflow integration to include to ability to:
  
  

* Comfortably and confidently integrate artificial intelligence into their daily workflow to increase productivity and quality.
* Hands-on experience to leverage AI tools (industry-leading LLMs) to increase productivity, automate routine tasks, and improve work quality.
* Speak to the experience of using AI for research, content creation, and document summarization while maintaining ownership of judgment and final decisions.
* Write effective prompts to get the most accurate and creative results from AI tools.

Spotters are expected to exemplify these key traits and AI Mindset:
  
  

* Curiosity in exploring new AI tools
* Adaptability to quickly learn and implement new, emerging AI technologies
* Critical thinking to know when to identify when AI should be used versus when human judgement is necessary

This combination of curiosity, adaptability, and discernment defines the AI mindset, and it’s required for every role at ThoughtSpot.
  
  
****AI Mindset for All Spotters****
At ThoughtSpot, we believe AI is a necessary and essential part of how we work. Every role, across every team, is expected to be fluent and comfortable with using AI to do their best work.
  
  
All Spotters are expected to experiment with ThoughtSpot’s AI tools (like Spotter and SpotterViz) and leading industry LLMs to streamline workflows, enhance output, and uncover new insights. Whether drafting content, analyzing data, or summarizing documents, AI is a daily partner. We value curiosity, openness to learning, and thoughtful application of AI to create real value. Training and resources are provided so every Spotter can confidently create with AI.
  
  
****ThoughtSpot for All****
At ThoughtSpot, diverse teams build better products. Complex data problems need many perspectives, not just one. We welcome different backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and we work to create a place where everyone can be themselves and do their best work. If this role excites you and you believe you’re a strong match, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
****What Makes ThoughtSpot a Great Place to Work?****
ThoughtSpot is the Agentic Analytics Platform that empowers every enterprise to transform insights into action, on a mission to make the world more fact driven. We hire people with unique identities, backgrounds, and perspectives - this balance-for-the-better philosophy is key to our success. When paired with our culture of Trust, Customer Obsession, Innovation and Intensity, ThoughtSpot cultivates a respectful culture that pushes norms to create world-class products. If you’re excited by the opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds in the business and make your mark on a truly innovative company, we invite you to read more about our mission, and apply to the role that’s right for you.

title: Product Lead, Analytics
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
Rippling recently launched Data Cloud, opening up a new opportunity to help customers understand and act on data across their business. By bringing together first-party, third-party, and customer-created data across HR, IT, finance, and external systems, Rippling can answer business questions that traditional analytics tools struggle to connect.
  
  
As Product Lead for Analytics, you will turn this extraordinary technical depth into simple, powerful products for enterprise and mid-market customers. You will own customer-facing analytics experiences and the shared capabilities that power analytics across Rippling—from intuitive reporting for business users to sophisticated analysis for advanced users.
  
  
This is a rare opportunity to define new AI-centric experiences beyond classic dashboards. You will build agentic experiences that help customers investigate questions, uncover insights, and proactively learn when meaningful events in their data need attention. AI will be the backbone of the features you ship—and a core part of how you build them.
  
  
Your core engineering team is based in India. You will work closely with engineering, design, AI, Data Catalog, and stakeholder teams across India and the USA to shape the product direction for a foundational part of Rippling’s Data Cloud and AI strategy.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for Analytics within Rippling’s Data Cloud.
* Define and build new experiences for how customers analyze data in the AI era, extending beyond classic reports and dashboards.
* Make sophisticated analysis intuitive for admins and business users while giving advanced users the depth and flexibility they need.
* Build agentic experiences that help customers investigate questions, explain trends, and proactively discover meaningful events in their data.
* Partner with your India-based engineering team and engineering, design, AI, Data Catalog, and product stakeholders across India and the USA to deliver trusted analytics across Rippling and external data.
* Work directly with enterprise and mid-market customers to understand their needs, win adoption, and measure customer value.
* Use AI extensively to accelerate discovery, prototyping, delivery, and product iteration.

**What You’ll Need**

* 8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping complex B2B products.
* Experience building analytics, BI, data platforms, or adjacent products; experience with shared platform capabilities is valuable.
* Strong customer and UX judgment, with the ability to make sophisticated analysis intuitive without sacrificing power.
* Technical fluency in data modeling, querying, metrics, and permissions, and the ability to work closely with engineering on product trade-offs.
* AI fluency: an understanding of how to build reliable AI and agentic experiences, evaluate their quality, and use AI effectively in your own work.
* Strong systems thinking, clear communication, and the ability to drive execution across teams and geographies with high ownership.
* Alignment with Rippling’s leadership principles: We push the limits of possible, We challenge each other directly, and We go and see.

If you don’t necessarily meet all of the requirements listed here, we still encourage you to apply because skills can be used in lots of different ways, your life experience is equally important sometimes.

title: Senior Product Manager - Core Risk
description:

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**About the team and the role:**

The Core Risk Product team’s vision is to ensure eBay remains a trusted marketplace for our customers by building advanced risk management capabilities and intuitive experiences that enable legitimate sellers and buyers to transact with confidence, while proactively preventing fraudulent and abusive behavior by sellers & buyers.

  
  

You would be part of a world class product organization with a strong product management culture. You would be the leader of the product that you own to shape the strategy going forward.

We are seeking a seasoned Product Manager to help define and execute the product strategy for Core Risk management. You will drive initiatives end-to-end, from customer discovery to launch, working cross-functionally with engineering, analytics, design, marketing, research, communications, policy, legal, finance, and other partner teams.

**What you will accomplish:**

* Create Product Strategy & Vision - You will be responsible for the holistic vision and end-to-end execution of key product solutions for our customers; develop and effectively champion a data-driven and market-informed product strategy that aligns to our eBay corporate strategy and delivers tangible outcomes for our Sellers and the eBay business
* Obsess the Customer & Overall Quality of Experiences - Demonstrate a steadfast focus on listening to our end-users and feed their voice into the customer-centric design process. Leverage design and research partnerships to get insights and feedback throughout the entire product lifecycle. Build processes for continuous improvement.
* Break Down Silos & Enable Tight-knit Collaboration - Create connections and processes across teams that will drive efficient cross-team collaboration and clear alignment. Primary teams this role partners with outside of the risk product team include risk policy, decision science, analytics, design, and marketing.
* Empower Teams To Rapidly Prioritize & Implement - Build in processes to ensure execution with speed and transparency. Inspire a “decide and go” mentality across your team to prioritize and propel the development process forward to hit our outcomes. Partner closely with Program Management to manage through blockers and communicate dates and milestones
* Build risk capabilities needed across eBay, eBay Live and its subsidiaries

**What you will bring:**

* 5+ years of proven experience building products, deep expertise in customer focused product management and product development lifecycle. Experience with risk or trust management on online marketplaces and eCommerce platforms preferred.
* Technical depth and proven experience with building engaging, customer-focused end-to-end UX experiences; designing elegant solutions to complex problems that require integrations with multiple platforms, domains and services; and driving analysis of qualitative and quantitative data and metrics to derive opportunities, gaps, and solutions
* Experience managing multiple complex, multi-phase strategic products in parallel with the ability to manage matrixed teams in a global context to successful delivery and excellence. title: HR Generalist
description:
**HR Generalist**
=================

**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka

**Work Mode:** On-site

**Experience:** 3–5 years

**About Habuild**
-----------------

Habuild is a fast-growing HealthTech company on a mission to help people build sustainable, healthy habits through yoga and technology. With a community of over 1.8 crore users, we are building technology-driven solutions that make wellness accessible to millions.

We are looking for an **HR Generalist** who can own the complete employee lifecycle, from hiring and onboarding to people operations, compliance, and employee engagement. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment, takes ownership, and uses AI tools to make HR processes smarter and more efficient.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**1. People Operations & Employee Lifecycle**

* Own the end-to-end employee lifecycle, including offer letters, onboarding, employee records, attendance, leave management, and exit formalities.
* Maintain accurate employee documentation, HR databases, and personnel records.
* Coordinate payroll inputs, employee data, and monthly attendance and leave reconciliation.
* Build and improve HR processes, policies, and workflows to ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

**2. Talent Acquisition**

* Own end-to-end hiring for business and technical roles, from understanding requirements and sourcing candidates to screening, interview coordination, offer management, and joining.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements and build effective hiring pipelines.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience and drive timely hiring closures.
* Use AI tools and technology to improve sourcing, screening, communication, and recruitment efficiency.

**3. HR Compliance & Policies**

* Ensure adherence to applicable Indian HR and employment compliance requirements, including PF, ESI, gratuity, and POSH.
* Maintain statutory records, employee documentation, and compliance-related trackers.
* Support the implementation and regular review of HR policies and processes.
* Coordinate with external consultants or vendors wherever required for payroll and statutory compliance.

**4. Performance Management & Employee Engagement**

* Coordinate performance review cycles, feedback collection, and appraisal processes.
* Support employee engagement initiatives, internal communication, and workplace culture-building activities.
* Assist in employer branding initiatives and strengthen Habuild’s positioning as an employer of choice.
* Act as a reliable point of contact for employees on HR-related queries and workplace matters.

**5. AI-Driven HR Operations**

* Use AI tools regularly to streamline HR workflows, improve productivity, and reduce manual effort.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks across recruitment, documentation, employee communication, and reporting.
* Demonstrate practical examples of how AI tools have improved the quality, speed, or efficiency of your HR work.

**Must-Have Requirements**
--------------------------

* **3–5 years of HR experience** in a startup or product-based company, with hands-on exposure to both people operations and talent acquisition.
* Experience owning the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee records, leave and attendance, payroll inputs, and exits.
* Working knowledge of Indian HR compliance requirements, including PF, ESI, gratuity, and POSH.
* Proven experience managing end-to-end hiring for actual business or technical roles.
* **Strong AI proficiency:** Regularly uses AI tools in day-to-day HR work and can demonstrate practical use cases or workflows.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, communication skills, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.

**Good-to-Have Requirements**
-----------------------------

* Experience as the first HR hire or in building HR processes from scratch at a startup.
* Experience hiring for engineering, product, or other technical roles.
* Exposure to employer branding and recruitment marketing.
* Experience running performance review and appraisal cycles.
* Proficiency in both Hindi and English.

**Who Should Apply?**
---------------------

We are looking for a well-rounded HR professional who combines **people operations, hiring, compliance, and technology-enabled problem-solving**.

This role is not suited to candidates whose experience is limited exclusively to recruitment, payroll, administration, or agency/RPO hiring. We value candidates who have worked across multiple HR functions and can demonstrate genuine ownership of processes from start to finish.

If you enjoy building systems, solving people-related challenges, and using AI to make HR more effective, we’d love to hear from you.

title: City Lead
description:
We operate through two key sales channels — Spinny Retail and Spinny Partners (B2B Auction platform).

●
**Retail:**
We purchase used cars on our inventory, refurbish them at our owned workshops, and sell them through our retail outlets in Hub and Park formats

●
**Auction:**
We enable digital auctions for used car dealers based on in-house inspection reports. Prices are offered to sellers only after a confirmed dealer bid, ensuring minimal inventory risk.

The Supply vertical (car procurement) is common to both channels. Every incoming car runs through the Auction platform for the best price discovery, leveraging our network of 10,000+ channel partners, including Spinny Retail.

**SUPPLY CHANNELS**

We operate two primary procurement channels:

● G1 (Online C2B): Direct sellers who connect with Spinny digitally

● G3 (Offline B2B): Partnerships with new car dealerships, OEMs, leasing companies and corporate sellers

**G1 SUPPLY FUNNEL**

1. Lead Generation: Through Spinny’s digital platforms (website and app)

2. Inside Supply: A telecalling team that qualifies leads and schedules car evaluations at the customer’s preferred time and location

3. Inspection Ops: A fleet of technical evaluators who work in defined slots, moving from one scheduled evaluation to another. Each evaluator starts and ends their day from their home location 4. Closure: A tele-sales team responsible for price negotiation with sellers. They attempt to bridge price gaps by collaborating with sales teams, and schedule delivery once the price is agreed

5. Delivery Ops: A team of drivers and documentation agents who manage the final pickup, verify documentation, and trigger payment upon approval.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Lead Ground Operations (G1 Supply):**

● Oversee evaluation, delivery, documentation, and logistics for the G1 channel

● Drive key operational KPIs including fulfilment of scheduled evaluations and deliveries, operational SOP adherence, and quality metrics

● Manage hiring, training, daily operational planning and performance monitoring for the on-ground fleet

**2. Scale G3 Channel (B2B Supply):**

● Own the end-to-end funnel for the G3 channel — from lead generation to final delivery and price negotiations

● Lead growth and P&L for the G3 vertical in the respective geography

● Develop and execute strategies to expand partnerships with new car dealerships to maximise procurements from the exchange enquiries

● Manage a team of Business Development Managers (BDMs) responsible for relationship management and lead generation

**REQUIREMENTS**

● 3-6 yrs. of professional work experience, preferably have worked at a high growth startup/FMCG/FMCD in an execution driven role.

● Graduate from Tier 1/2 College/University.

● Good stakeholder management skills.

● Excellent written, communication, research, and analytical skills.

● Ability to think creatively about business problems and come up with solutions.

● Previous team management/leadership ability to lead teams of at least 15-20 members.

title: Senior Regional Sales Enablement Manager– APAC
description:
**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**
At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
  
  
Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.
  
  
The Regional Sales Enablement Partner - APAC (RSEP) is a sales practitioner and enablement leader responsible for the readiness, coaching, and performance of Genesys' APAC field and partner sales organization. Bringing firsthand sales experience to the role, the RSEP builds trusted relationships with regional sales leaders and cross-functional partners to diagnose performance gaps, then designs and facilitates the coaching, training, and readiness programs that close them.
  
  
The RSEP is as comfortable in a live coaching conversation with a seller or manager as they are advising senior leadership on regional go-to-market priorities. They apply sales methodology expertise, data, and AI-enabled tools to sharpen judgment and scale impact — and they show up in the field, role-playing, shadowing calls, reviewing deals, and reinforcing skills in the flow of work. Ultimately, the RSEP is a trusted advisor and an adjunct member of the regional sales leadership team, measured on tangible improvements in seller performance and pipeline outcomes.
  
  
The RSEP is part of a global enablement team: some programs are built centrally at the global level, and the RSEP is responsible for tailoring and localizing them for APAC's markets, languages, and selling motions, while also feeding regional field insight back into how those global programs are designed. The RSEP is expected to operate fluently in both directions — shaping what gets built globally and making sure it lands regionally.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements:**

* 5+ years of experience working with Sales team (technology/SaaS strongly preferred), plus 5+ years in sales enablement, coaching, or sales performance roles, including experience leading enablement for a region or business unit; bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* Proven track record coaching and developing sellers and front-line sales managers — through call/deal reviews, live shadowing, and structured 1:1 coaching — with measurable improvement in skills and results.
* Strong facilitation skills, with confidence leading in-person and virtual sessions for sellers, managers, and partners across diverse APAC audiences, languages, and time zones.
* Deep fluency in enterprise sales methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, Value Selling, or similar), with the ability to embed it into everyday selling behavior rather than simply introduce it.
* Demonstrated credibility as a trusted advisor to sales leadership and cross-functional partners (Marketing, RevOps, Product, Partner/Channel), with the executive presence and influence-without-authority to shape decisions at senior levels.
* Data-driven approach — comfortable analyzing pipeline, conversion, and performance data (CRM, Clari, conversation-intelligence tools) to diagnose gaps and demonstrate enablement impact.
* Experience in a cloud/SaaS company, ideally supporting complex, multi-persona sales motions across direct and partner/channel teams.
* Experience operating as part of a global, matrixed enablement team — tailoring centrally-built global programs for regional nuance while feeding field insight back into global program design.
* Comfort leveraging AI-enabled tools to support coaching preparation, content development, and performance analysis, with a growth mindset toward new AI-supported approaches to enablement.
* Proficiency with the sales and enablement tech stack (CRM, Seismic, LMS/Lessonly or similar) and standard business tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Self-motivated, organized, and effective at managing multiple priorities in a fast-changing, matrixed environment.
* Fluency in languages outside of English a plus, particularly APAC regional languages.

**Key Responsibilities:**
The Regional Sales Enablement Partner spends the majority of their time directly engaged with sellers, managers, and leaders in the field — coaching, facilitating, and diagnosing performance gaps — while also shaping the regional enablement strategy that those activities feed into. Success in this role is measured by improvement in seller skill, pipeline quality, and win rate.
  
  
**Sales Coaching & Skill Development**

* Deliver 1:1 and team-level coaching to sellers and front-line sales managers to reinforce methodology and close specific skill gaps.
* Facilitate engaging, high-impact enablement sessions — in person and virtual — including role-play, negotiation practice, discovery and objection-handling drills, and certification workshops.
* Support new hire ramp to accelerate time-to-productivity and build early confidence.
* Design and deliver skills-based training aligned to the moments that matter most in a seller's day-to-day motion.

**Strategic Advisory & Stakeholder Partnership**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to APAC sales leadership and cross-functional partners (Marketing, RevOps, Product, Partner/Channel), proactively surfacing performance gaps and enablement opportunities grounded in data and field insight.
* Build strong relationships with regional stakeholders to pinpoint knowledge and skills gaps, validating findings with data before recommending action.
* Bring firsthand field credibility into planning conversations, informing GTM and enablement priorities with real signal from coaching conversations, deal reviews, and seller feedback.
* Represent APAC's needs and constraints to the global enablement team, providing field-tested input that shapes how global programs are designed and where regional tailoring will be needed.
* Partner with global enablement peers and instructional designers to localize and adapt global programs for APAC's sellers, partners, and languages.

**Global Program Contribution & Regional Readiness**

* Tailor and localize globally-built enablement programs — content, methodology, and delivery format — for APAC's markets, languages, buyer dynamics, and selling motions, ensuring global programs actually change seller behavior in region.
* Own the quarterly readiness plan that brings global programs to APAC field and partner sales, translating global priorities and regional performance data into a prioritized, localized coaching and training calendar.
* Feed regional field insight — from coaching conversations, deal reviews, and seller feedback — back into the global team to inform how future global programs are designed and where global consistency vs. regional flexibility is needed.
* Apply AI-enabled tools to accelerate content localization, personalize coaching plans, and synthesize field feedback at scale.
* Maintain a consistent through-line between global enablement strategy and regional execution — flagging where global programs need adaptation and closing that loop with the global team.

**Performance Insights & Optimization**

* Partner with Sales Ops/RevOps to track how coaching and enablement activity moves pipeline creation, conversion rates, and seller productivity.
* Partner with first line managers to identify skill and performance trends, then convert them into targeted coaching interventions.
* Report enablement and coaching impact to leadership in clear, data-backed, executive-ready terms.

**Professionalism & Team Contribution**

* Exercise sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism in relationships with sellers, partners, and executive stakeholders.
* Contribute to broader Enablement Team initiatives and continuously develop personal coaching and facilitation craft.
* Travel: ~20% (key meetings/events + Annual Sales Kickoff).
* Remote, or based near a Genesys office, as required.
* Some early or late meetings required to accommodate our broader global team and varying time zones.

**Working at Genesys**

* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
* Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
* Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
* Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.

title: EY - GDS Consulting -AI Strategy & Go-To-Market
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**JOB DESCRIPTION | AI & DATA TECH CONSULTING**
**AI Strategy & Go-To-Market**
Career Family: AIA – AI Strategy & GTM
  
  

* Pursuits, RFPs & Offering Development

**LEVEL**
**Senior/Manager**
**Experience**
**8–12 years**
**LOCATION**
EY GDS
  
  

* Hybrid

**ORIENTATION**
**Strategy-led**
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
We are seeking a strategic Manager to join our AI & Data Tech Consulting team, focused on shaping how clients adopt Agentic AI and GenAI — and how the firm takes its AI offerings to market. The ideal candidate brings a blend of AI product strategy, solution positioning, and pursuit leadership, with enough technical fluency to credibly translate AI capabilities into business value, without being a hands-on builder.
  
  
You will work closely with account leaders, solution architects, C-suite stakeholders, and alliance partners to win and shape AI programs — owning the narrative from opportunity qualification and RFP response through solution storyboarding, commercial framing, and client orals.
  
  
**WHERE YOUR TIME GOES**
**40%**
**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**
Win themes, solution storyline, client orals
  
  
**30%**
**Go-To-Market & Offerings**
Positioning, enablement collateral, alliances
  
  
**30%**
**AI Strategy & Advisory**
Roadmaps, business cases, operating models
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
AI Strategy & Value Advisory
  
  
■ Partner with client leadership and Operating Partners to define AI / Agentic AI vision, use-case portfolios, and adoption roadmaps.
  
  
■ Build use-case prioritization frameworks (value vs. feasibility vs. risk) and translate them into phased roadmaps (discovery → MVP → scale).
  
  
■ Develop business cases with ROI, cost-to-serve, and value-realization metrics that leadership can fund against.
  
  
■ Frame AI operating models — CoE design, governance, Responsible AI guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
■ Knowledge of business process transformation and industry value chains (Health, FS, Consumer, Industrials) would be an added advantage.
  
  
Go-To-Market & Offering Development
  
  
■ Shape and package AI offerings, accelerators, and assets into market-ready propositions — positioning, messaging, pricing logic, and differentiation.
  
  
■ Build sales enablement collateral: pitch decks, solution one-pagers, executive pagers, demo storylines, case studies, and battle cards.
  
  
■ Conduct market, competitive, and analyst research (vendors, hyperscalers, AI-native startups) to inform build / buy / partner decisions and offering roadmaps.
  
  
■ Work with alliance partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.) on joint GTM motions, co-sell plays, and partner-funded programs.
  
  
■ Track adoption and pipeline KPIs for offerings and feed market signals back into the offering roadmap.
  
  
RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits
  
  
■ Lead end-to-end RFP / RFI / RFQ responses for AI and data programs — bid / no-bid qualification, win themes, solution storyline, and response orchestration.
  
  
■ Translate client requirements into a crisp solution narrative, scope, delivery approach, staffing model, and commercial construct, in collaboration with architects and delivery leads.
  
  
■ Own proposal quality — compliance matrices, executive summaries, value articulation, risk and assumption logs.
  
  
■ Prepare and lead client orals, executive workshops, and proof-of-value storyboards; coach pursuit teams on messaging.
  
  
■ Maintain a reusable pursuit library of proposal content, case studies, and credentials.
  
  
AI Fluency (Conversational, Not Hands-On)
  
  
■ Working understanding of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI frameworks, AI evaluation & observability, and LLMOps — enough to engage architects and challenge solutions credibly.
  
  
■ Awareness of AI risk, regulation, and governance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and how they shape client buying decisions.
  
  
■ Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and enterprise data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) at a solution level.
  
  
■ Comfort with AI productivity tools to accelerate research, content, and proposal creation.
  
  
Business Development & Client Management
  
  
■ Work closely with account leaders to identify, qualify, and shape opportunities and build tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.
  
  
■ Build trusted relationships with client CXOs, product owners, and transformation leaders.
  
  
■ Represent the firm at analyst briefings, industry forums, webinars, and thought-leadership platforms; author POVs, whitepapers, and blogs.
  
  
Team Leadership & Collaboration
  
  
■ Lead and mentor a small team of strategy consultants and pursuit analysts.
  
  
■ Orchestrate collaboration across solution architects, delivery, sector specialists, alliances, legal, and pricing teams.
  
  
■ Drive knowledge sharing, offering playbooks, and capability-building across the practice.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes**
Educational Background
  
  
■ MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
■ 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.
  
  
■ Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.
  
  
■ Experience building offerings, roadmaps, business cases, and executive-facing collateral for enterprise clients.
  
  
■ Exposure to market research, competitive benchmarking, startup / vendor evaluation, or innovation programs is a strong plus.
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
■ Exceptional storytelling and executive presence — able to turn complex AI concepts into a compelling, simple business narrative.
  
  
■ Strong structured thinking and problem-solving; comfortable working under pursuit deadlines.
  
  
■ Excellent written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, especially with C-suite executives.
  
  
■ Influencing without authority across large, matrixed pursuit teams.
  
  
**Preferred Certifications**
■ GenAI / AI strategy certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Coursera, ISB / IIM executive programs, etc.)
  
  
■ Product management or agile certifications (SAFe POPM / PM, Pragmatic, CSPO), Design Thinking.
  
  
■ APMP (proposal management) certification is a plus.
  
  
IDEAL PROFILE
  
  
**You will thrive here if you…**
■ Have taken AI / data products from 0 → 1 and know what drives adoption
  
  
■ Love building the story, the business case, and the winning proposal
  
  
■ Can hold your own with architects — and simplify for the CXO
  
  
■ Have run market scans, vendor evaluations, or innovation programs
  
  
**This role is not…**
■ A hands-on engineering or model-building role
  
  
■ Writing production code, data pipelines, or agent frameworks
  
  
■ Pure delivery / project management
  
  
■ A back-office bid-desk formatting role
  
  
WHY JOIN US
  
  
■ Shape how leading global enterprises adopt AI — and how the firm wins in the AI market.
  
  
■ Work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and growth, with direct visibility to account and practice leadership.
  
  
■ Collaborate with a team of AI experts, solution architects, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
■

■
**Success as defined by you**
— We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
  
  
■
**Transformative leadership**
— We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
  
  
■
**Diverse and inclusive culture**
— You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
