title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description – Digital Marketing Manager

**Company:** TELAWNE POWER EQUIPMENTS PVT. LTD.  
**Position Title:** Digital Marketing Manager  
**Location:** Thane, Maharashtra, India  
**Experience:** 9–13 Years  
**Working Days**- Monday to Saturday  
**Reporting To:** Head – Corporate Communications

**Company Profile**

TELAWNE POWER EQUIPMENTS PVT. LTD. is engaged in the manufacturing and repair of Power and Distribution Transformers and Substations. The company manufactures Oil Immersed Power and Distribution Transformers up to 50 MVA, 132 kV Class; Resin Impregnated Dry Type Transformers up to 5 MVA, 22 kV Class; Cast Resin Dry Type Transformers up to 5 MVA, 33 kV Class; and Unitised and Pad Mounted Substations up to 2 MVA, 33 kV Class.

With an installed capacity of 1,000 MVA per annum, Telawne caters to Government and Semi-Government undertakings, utilities, real estate, refineries, chemical, automobile, power, pharmaceutical, paper, steel, and other industrial sectors.

Job Summary

The Digital Marketing Manager will be responsible for developing and executing the company's digital marketing strategy to strengthen online brand visibility, enhance digital presence, generate qualified business leads, and support business growth across domestic and international markets. The role involves managing digital campaigns, website performance, SEO, paid advertising, social media marketing, marketing analytics, and digital content initiatives in coordination with the Head – Corporate Communications and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

* **Digital Marketing Strategy:** Develop and implement integrated digital marketing strategies aligned with the company's business objectives, brand positioning, and marketing priorities.
* **Website Management:** Oversee corporate website management, content updates, landing pages, user experience, website performance, and conversion optimisation.
* **SEO & SEM:** Lead search engine optimisation (SEO), search engine marketing (SEM), keyword research, technical SEO, on-page and off-page optimisation, and organic traffic growth.
* **Performance Marketing:** Plan, execute, and optimise paid digital campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other relevant platforms to improve brand reach, lead generation, and campaign ROI.
* **Social Media Marketing:** Manage digital marketing activities across LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant platforms to strengthen brand visibility, audience engagement, and industry positioning.
* **B2B Lead Generation:** Develop digital campaigns and lead-generation initiatives targeting industrial customers, OEMs, consultants, EPC contractors, utilities, and other relevant business segments.
* **Content Marketing:** Coordinate the development of website content, blogs, technical articles, product-focused content, case studies, email campaigns, and digital marketing collaterals in collaboration with the Head – Corporate Communications and technical teams.
* **Marketing Automation & Email Campaigns:** Manage email marketing, lead nurturing, marketing automation, and campaign workflows to improve prospect engagement and lead conversion.
* **Analytics & Reporting:** Monitor website traffic, search rankings, campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, cost per lead, and marketing ROI using tools such as Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, and relevant advertising dashboards.
* **Digital Branding:** Ensure consistency in brand identity, messaging, and visual communication across digital platforms in coordination with the Head – Corporate Communications.
* **International Digital Marketing:** Plan and execute digital initiatives to improve online visibility and generate business enquiries from relevant export markets.
* **Marketing Technology:** Identify and implement suitable digital marketing tools, tracking systems, and optimisation techniques to improve campaign effectiveness and operational efficiency.
* **Cross-functional Coordination:** Work closely with Sales, Business Development, Product/Technical, and Corporate Communications teams to align digital campaigns with business priorities and lead follow-up requirements.
* **Budget Management:** Plan and monitor digital marketing budgets, evaluate campaign effectiveness, and optimise spending to achieve measurable business outcomes.
* **Team & Agency Management:** Lead the digital marketing team, coordinate with external agencies and service providers, and ensure timely execution of campaigns and marketing initiatives.
* **Performance Reviews:** Prepare periodic digital marketing performance reports and present insights, campaign outcomes, and improvement plans to the Head – Corporate Communications.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication, or a related field.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in Marketing/Digital Marketing preferred.

**Experience**

* 9–13 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, SEO/SEM, online brand management, and lead generation.
* Experience in manufacturing, engineering, electrical equipment, power, industrial products, or other technical B2B environments will be an advantage.
* Proven experience in managing digital marketing campaigns, website performance, lead-generation initiatives, and marketing budgets.
* Experience in team handling and managing external digital marketing agencies preferred.

**Required Skills**

* Strong expertise in digital marketing strategy, SEO, SEM, and performance marketing.
* Hands-on knowledge of Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
* Experience in website management, content marketing, email marketing, and marketing automation.
* Strong understanding of lead generation, conversion optimisation, campaign analytics, and ROI measurement.
* Ability to interpret marketing data and translate insights into actionable strategies.
* Strong project management, team leadership, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Understanding of industrial marketing and long B2B sales cycles preferred.

**Working Conditions**

* Full-time position based in Thane, Maharashtra.
* May require coordination with internal departments, external agencies, and business stakeholders.
* Occasional travel for business meetings, exhibitions, and marketing-related activities may be required.

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

* Do you have manufacturing company experience?

description:

**Role:** Copywriter

**Location:** Mumbai, India

  

**About the role:**

  

Working in true collaboration with our client we have one goal in mind: 'to be the leading agency partner for the development of stunning and effective needs based content and digital media campaigns'.

The brands are at the forefront of contemporary thinking, utilising in depth insight for digital strategy and content advertising. They are also dedicated to sustainability and foregrounding a brand purpose, which means the work we do with them requires working creative thinking into every brief, regardless of scale.

As a Copywriter you will be an integral part of the team. You will need to combine deep understanding of the trends and concerns inherent to the beauty industry with a varied skill set that will include copywriting, investigative research, script writing, conceptual thinking and content project planning. The role will primarily involve writing for digital/web: you'll help brands fit their tone of voice to this landscape and advise on content that'll powerfully connect with consumers. To do this you'll need to be an expert storyteller able to find interesting and engaging ways of dramatizing subject matters, extremely digitally savvy.

You'll also occasionally be asked to team up with other creatives to help conceptualise larger projects (I.E. videos, key visuals, social media campaigns). And due to the nature of OLIVER's in-house agency model you'll also need to be confident interacting directly with clients.

The role will support one of India's leading beauty and cosmetics brands, working across its diverse product portfolio.

  

**What you will be doing:**

* Develop engaging, platform-first copy across social media, digital content, CRM, e-commerce, influencer initiatives, and integrated campaigns.
* Translate brand objectives and briefs into fresh, impactful creative concepts and narratives.
* Craft everything from social captions, scripts, and video content to campaign ideas, taglines, and long-form storytelling.
* Stay on top of beauty, lifestyle, fashion, social, and internet culture trends to bring relevant and contemporary thinking to the brand.
* Collaborate closely with designers, content creators, community managers, and marketing stakeholders throughout the creative process.
* Adapt content and messaging for different audiences, platforms, and stages of the consumer journey.
* Ensure all communication aligns with Lakmé's brand voice, tone, and positioning.
* Participate actively in brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas that can drive engagement, conversations, and brand love.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

* 2+years of strong experience in copywriting, content creation, advertising and digital marketing
* A thorough understanding of the language and needs inherent to writing for beauty brands
* You can write with equal ease across short-form, long-form, social, digital, and campaign formats.
* Understanding the nuances of beauty, skincare, makeup, lifestyle, and culture-driven communication.
* A powerful grasp of how content can play out across multiple mediums
* Able to use data and insight to inform creative

We’re reshaping how modern, premium jewelry is discovered and experienced. As we gear up for our next phase of growth—including offline expansion and a stronger omnichannel presence—we’re looking for a Store Manager for our Kala Ghoda store to join our our team into its most exciting chapter yet.

This is a high-visibility retail space, and we want someone who blends operational excellence with great customer experience and a deep love for jewelry and fashion. You will play a crucial role in shaping a positive shopping experience for customers, motivating and leading the team, and driving the store’s success.

Customer Service, Sales, and Staff Management:

* Drives sales through engagement of customers, cross-selling, upselling, and sharing product knowledge.
* Act as a personal jewlery stylist to the customers and provide recommendations accordingly.
* Maximize results and achievement of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), by driving own performance as well as the performance and engagement of the team.

title: Finance Intern
description:
#### **At a Glance: The Story Behind AMINA**

Founded in April 2018 and headquartered in Zug, AMINA Bank is a pioneer in the financial industry. In August 2019, AMINA received a Swiss banking and securities dealer license from FINMA. The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique.

AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.

CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognised for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.

AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading & liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back-office, product management, technology & engineering, IT support, finance and human resources.

#### **Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It)**

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Finance Intern to join our Finance team and gain hands-on experience across Accounts Payable (AP), Finance Operations, and Management Reporting.

This internship offers a unique opportunity to learn how a modern banking finance function operates. You will support day-to-day finance activities, assist with management reporting, budgeting, and forecasting processes, and work closely with experienced finance professionals. We are looking for someone who is eager to learn, curious about financial data, and excited to develop practical skills in a fast-paced environment.

#### **Your AMINA To-Do List**

**Accounts Payable & Finance Operations:**

* Process supplier invoices and employee expenses accurately and on time in our finance systems.
* Ensure invoices are correctly coded, approved, and aligned with internal policies.
* Support payment runs across multiple payment systems and coordinate with relevant internal teams.
* Investigate and resolve invoice, payment, expense, and vendor queries in a timely and professional manner.
* Maintain accurate records and documentation in line with audit and compliance requirements.
* Support AP-related month-end close activities.

**Management Reporting & Budgeting:**

* Support the preparation of the Bank’s key management reports, including revenue and KPI reporting.
* Develop an understanding of how key metrics are calculated, where the underlying data comes from and how it flows into Finance reporting.
* Support data mapping and validation to help ensure reporting remains accurate, consistent, and reliable.
* Look at our reports with a curious mindset: understand whether the numbers make sense and help identify gaps or areas that could be improved
* Work with the Finance team and internal stakeholders to understand what information is useful to them and how our reporting can continue to evolve
* Support the budgeting and forecasting process, building an understanding of the Bank’s key revenue streams, cost areas, and business drivers

**Ownership & Growth:**

* Bring a proactive, hands-on attitude, take ownership of your work and be comfortable asking questions and learning as you go.
* Work closely with the wider Finance team and business stakeholders, with plenty of opportunity to build your knowledge and gradually take on broader responsibilities.

#### **Your golden ticket to the AMINA team:**

**Essential:**

* Basic understanding of accounting or finance principles (through education, self‑study, or practical exposure)
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work accurately with high volumes of data
* Good communication skills, both written and verbal
* Ability to concentrate for extended periods and take pride in delivering high‑quality, reliable work
* Proactive, positive attitude with a willingness to learn and take feedback onboard
* Comfortable working with systems and technology (prior experience with expense or invoice tools is a plus, but not required)
* Bachelor’s degree in finance or related fields.

**Desirable:**

* Previous experience in an operational, administrative, or finance‑related role
* Pursuing advanced qualifications in Finance, especially the CFA Program.
* Exposure to Accounts Payable, Expense Processing or Budgeting.

#### **Why We’re Awesome**

We owe our exponential growth to our innovative and collaborate team spirit and talented workforce. Every voice counts as we are always committed to learning from diverse perspectives and backgrounds because our people make the difference at AMINA Bank. **Regardless of your age, gender, belief, and background, at AMINA EVERYONE is welcome!**

Join our skilled team and together redefine finance.

title: EY - GDS Consulting -AI Strategy & Go-To-Market
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**JOB DESCRIPTION | AI & DATA TECH CONSULTING**
**AI Strategy & Go-To-Market**
Career Family: AIA – AI Strategy & GTM
  
  

* Pursuits, RFPs & Offering Development

**LEVEL**
**Senior/Manager**
**Experience**
**8–12 years**
**LOCATION**
EY GDS
  
  

* Hybrid

**ORIENTATION**
**Strategy-led**
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
We are seeking a strategic Manager to join our AI & Data Tech Consulting team, focused on shaping how clients adopt Agentic AI and GenAI — and how the firm takes its AI offerings to market. The ideal candidate brings a blend of AI product strategy, solution positioning, and pursuit leadership, with enough technical fluency to credibly translate AI capabilities into business value, without being a hands-on builder.
  
  
You will work closely with account leaders, solution architects, C-suite stakeholders, and alliance partners to win and shape AI programs — owning the narrative from opportunity qualification and RFP response through solution storyboarding, commercial framing, and client orals.
  
  
**WHERE YOUR TIME GOES**
**40%**
**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**
Win themes, solution storyline, client orals
  
  
**30%**
**Go-To-Market & Offerings**
Positioning, enablement collateral, alliances
  
  
**30%**
**AI Strategy & Advisory**
Roadmaps, business cases, operating models
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
AI Strategy & Value Advisory
  
  
■ Partner with client leadership and Operating Partners to define AI / Agentic AI vision, use-case portfolios, and adoption roadmaps.
  
  
■ Build use-case prioritization frameworks (value vs. feasibility vs. risk) and translate them into phased roadmaps (discovery → MVP → scale).
  
  
■ Develop business cases with ROI, cost-to-serve, and value-realization metrics that leadership can fund against.
  
  
■ Frame AI operating models — CoE design, governance, Responsible AI guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
■ Knowledge of business process transformation and industry value chains (Health, FS, Consumer, Industrials) would be an added advantage.
  
  
Go-To-Market & Offering Development
  
  
■ Shape and package AI offerings, accelerators, and assets into market-ready propositions — positioning, messaging, pricing logic, and differentiation.
  
  
■ Build sales enablement collateral: pitch decks, solution one-pagers, executive pagers, demo storylines, case studies, and battle cards.
  
  
■ Conduct market, competitive, and analyst research (vendors, hyperscalers, AI-native startups) to inform build / buy / partner decisions and offering roadmaps.
  
  
■ Work with alliance partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.) on joint GTM motions, co-sell plays, and partner-funded programs.
  
  
■ Track adoption and pipeline KPIs for offerings and feed market signals back into the offering roadmap.
  
  
RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits
  
  
■ Lead end-to-end RFP / RFI / RFQ responses for AI and data programs — bid / no-bid qualification, win themes, solution storyline, and response orchestration.
  
  
■ Translate client requirements into a crisp solution narrative, scope, delivery approach, staffing model, and commercial construct, in collaboration with architects and delivery leads.
  
  
■ Own proposal quality — compliance matrices, executive summaries, value articulation, risk and assumption logs.
  
  
■ Prepare and lead client orals, executive workshops, and proof-of-value storyboards; coach pursuit teams on messaging.
  
  
■ Maintain a reusable pursuit library of proposal content, case studies, and credentials.
  
  
AI Fluency (Conversational, Not Hands-On)
  
  
■ Working understanding of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI frameworks, AI evaluation & observability, and LLMOps — enough to engage architects and challenge solutions credibly.
  
  
■ Awareness of AI risk, regulation, and governance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and how they shape client buying decisions.
  
  
■ Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and enterprise data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) at a solution level.
  
  
■ Comfort with AI productivity tools to accelerate research, content, and proposal creation.
  
  
Business Development & Client Management
  
  
■ Work closely with account leaders to identify, qualify, and shape opportunities and build tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.
  
  
■ Build trusted relationships with client CXOs, product owners, and transformation leaders.
  
  
■ Represent the firm at analyst briefings, industry forums, webinars, and thought-leadership platforms; author POVs, whitepapers, and blogs.
  
  
Team Leadership & Collaboration
  
  
■ Lead and mentor a small team of strategy consultants and pursuit analysts.
  
  
■ Orchestrate collaboration across solution architects, delivery, sector specialists, alliances, legal, and pricing teams.
  
  
■ Drive knowledge sharing, offering playbooks, and capability-building across the practice.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes**
Educational Background
  
  
■ MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
■ 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.
  
  
■ Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.
  
  
■ Experience building offerings, roadmaps, business cases, and executive-facing collateral for enterprise clients.
  
  
■ Exposure to market research, competitive benchmarking, startup / vendor evaluation, or innovation programs is a strong plus.
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
■ Exceptional storytelling and executive presence — able to turn complex AI concepts into a compelling, simple business narrative.
  
  
■ Strong structured thinking and problem-solving; comfortable working under pursuit deadlines.
  
  
■ Excellent written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, especially with C-suite executives.
  
  
■ Influencing without authority across large, matrixed pursuit teams.
  
  
**Preferred Certifications**
■ GenAI / AI strategy certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Coursera, ISB / IIM executive programs, etc.)
  
  
■ Product management or agile certifications (SAFe POPM / PM, Pragmatic, CSPO), Design Thinking.
  
  
■ APMP (proposal management) certification is a plus.
  
  
IDEAL PROFILE
  
  
**You will thrive here if you…**
■ Have taken AI / data products from 0 → 1 and know what drives adoption
  
  
■ Love building the story, the business case, and the winning proposal
  
  
■ Can hold your own with architects — and simplify for the CXO
  
  
■ Have run market scans, vendor evaluations, or innovation programs
  
  
**This role is not…**
■ A hands-on engineering or model-building role
  
  
■ Writing production code, data pipelines, or agent frameworks
  
  
■ Pure delivery / project management
  
  
■ A back-office bid-desk formatting role
  
  
WHY JOIN US
  
  
■ Shape how leading global enterprises adopt AI — and how the firm wins in the AI market.
  
  
■ Work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and growth, with direct visibility to account and practice leadership.
  
  
■ Collaborate with a team of AI experts, solution architects, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
■
**Continuous learning**
— You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
  
  
■
**Success as defined by you**
— We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
  
  
■
**Transformative leadership**
— We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
  
  
■
**Diverse and inclusive culture**
— You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Market Performance Manager
description:
At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.
  
  
**What We Do...**
Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.
  
  
That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.
  
  
**About The Market Performance Manager Role…**
The Market Performance Team Manager leads a high-performing team of Market Performance Team Leads and Specialists who optimise distribution and revenue strategy for our hotel customers. This role is accountable for building and scaling a centre of excellence in market performance — ensuring hotels maximise bookings and profitable revenue through the intelligent use of SiteMinder’s platform, channel mix, and pricing strategies.
  
  
Combining strategic leadership, deep commercial acumen and strong people management, the Market Performance Team Manager oversees pipeline and performance across all optimisation initiatives, drives capability development in revenue and distribution management, and partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver measurable uplift in customer value, retention and revenue outcomes.
  
  
**What You’ll Do…**

* Strategic Leadership: Develop and implement comprehensive market management strategies that maximise product value and drive customer ROI, with a strong focus on revenue and distribution optimisation.
* Team Development & Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop Market Performance Team Leads and Specialists. Provide coaching, training and feedback to build deep revenue and distribution optimisation capability across the team.
* Pipeline Management: Own and manage the optimisation and revenue pipeline (initiatives, cases and opportunities), including forecasting, prioritisation and resourcing. Monitor pipeline health, conversion and velocity, and drive continuous improvements in team productivity.
* Performance Reporting: Build and maintain clear performance reporting on optimisation pipeline, revenue impact and team productivity, providing visibility to internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, to customers.
* Distribution Optimisation: Design and oversee strategies that optimise distribution mix (OTAs, direct, GDS and other channels) to drive profitable bookings for hotels. Ensure the team can diagnose channel performance issues and execute corrective actions.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing and Sales to ensure market performance and optimisation needs inform product development and go-to-market strategies.
* Optimisation Program Design: Create and implement scalable optimisation programs that systematically improve customer outcomes and revenue performance across different tiers and segments.
* Performance Management: Consistently meet or exceed team KPIs. Monitor pipeline, revenue and productivity metrics, and coach Team Leads and Specialists to improve conversion, quality and impact.
* Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across the business. Represent the market performance function in executive forums and champion customer and revenue outcomes.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance optimisation processes, tools and methodologies. Drive innovation in market performance and revenue optimisation delivery to maintain competitive advantage.

**What You Have…**

title: Category Manager
description:
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a dynamic, detail-oriented
**Category Manager – Mobility, Transit & Tourism t**
o own the end-to-end performance of this unified vertical on DigiHaat. You will build and scale a comprehensive mobility and tourism marketplace covering daily/regional transit options, stays, local experiences, guided tours, and travel-linked products such as handicrafts, local produce, and curated travel kits. You will onboard and manage supply, ensure listing quality, track bookings and fulfillment, and work with product and tech teams to deliver a seamless buyer journey across transit and travel.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Category Strategy and Growth
* Define and execute the category strategy for mobility, transit, and tourism with clear goals, priorities, and KPIs in collaboration with product, marketing, and business teams.
* Identify high-potential segments across transit & mobility (first-mile/last-mile connectivity, intercity bus/rail integrators, local transit options) alongside tourism segments (homestays, rural & heritage tourism, craft and culinary experiences, pilgrimage and wellness travel).
* Build the category roadmap around seasonality, commuting patterns, regional demand, festivals, and travel trends.
* Align category operations with broader business objectives of growth, network adoption, profitability, and customer satisfaction.
* Supply Onboarding and Partner Management
* Onboard and nurture a diverse supply base: transit operators, mobility service providers, homestay owners, tour operators, local guides, experience hosts, artisans, and tourism-linked sellers.
* Build strong relationships with mobility aggregators, transport operators, travel suppliers, and logistics partners to ensure service reliability, availability, and cost efficiency.
* Set and monitor service standards, cancellation/refund policies, and compliance requirements, including transport permits, local licenses, and safety norms.
* Handhold small transit operators, experience hosts, and first-time digital sellers through onboarding, catalogue creation, and platform best practices.
* Booking, Transit & Order Lifecycle Operations
* Monitor the full lifecycle from route search, booking, ticket issuance, and service delivery to post-trip feedback to ensure a smooth end-to-end customer experience.
* Track and resolve operational issues such as schedule disruptions, cancellations, no-shows, overbooking, service quality complaints, refunds, and physical product deliveries.
* Work with operations teams to streamline fulfillment for mobility bookings and tourism-linked retail products.
* Identify and implement process improvements to reduce operational costs and maximize booking efficiency.
* Pricing, Inventory and Demand Management
* Use demand forecasting to manage inventory, seat/stay availability, and peak/off-peak capacity across daily transit and travel seasons.
* Develop dynamic pricing strategies, bundled offers, and multi-modal travel packages (e.g., Transit Pass + Stay + Experience + Local Products) to improve conversion and basket value.
* Work with marketing on customer acquisition campaigns, transit usage incentives, destination-led promotions, and seasonal travel offers.
* Data-Driven Decision Making
* Use data and analytics to track category performance: GMV, total bookings, route throughput, conversion rate, repeat rate, cancellation rate, customer ratings, and partner reliability.
* Identify commuting and travel trends, regional transit bottlenecks, and category expansion opportunities.
* Deliver regular performance reports and actionable insights to internal and external stakeholders for continuous platform optimization.
* Listing Quality and User Experience
* Ensure listings, routes, and travel options are accurate, current, and compelling - covering departure/arrival schedules, stay descriptions, itineraries, amenities, pricing, availability, and policies.
* Analyze customer reviews, ratings, and ride/trip feedback to identify pain points and collaborate with tech/product teams to address them.
* Drive product enhancements for multi-modal travel discovery, transit routing, category search filters, and trust signals for mobility and travel services.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Total Experience: 8–12 years in category management, marketplace operations, or business leadership roles.
* Mandatory Industry Experience: Direct, proven experience across Mobility / Transit, the Travel Industry, and Tourism Management.
* Track Record: Proven success in building, scaling, and monetizing digital platforms in mobility, travel, or multi-service marketplaces.

**Must-Have Attributes**

* Hands-on experience with buyer-facing apps in mobility, transit, travel, hospitality, or experience marketplaces (e.g., transit/cab apps, OTAs, activity platforms).
* Deep understanding of the Indian mobility and tourism ecosystem, including urban/rural transit networks, regional travel dynamics, and localized tourism.
* Expertise in yield management, dynamic pricing, route/inventory capacity planning, and user acquisition strategies.
* Solid grasp of agile methodologies and demonstrated skill in working with cross-functional product and tech teams.
* Exceptional negotiation, partner management, and stakeholder communication skills.

title: Analyst
description:
**The Role**

As our Analyst, you'll be the analytical engine behind our online sales and paid acquisition. The role suits someone equally comfortable in a spreadsheet, a SQL editor, and a conversation with a media buyer.

**What You'll Do**

* Own reporting on ecommerce performance (traffic, conversion rate, AOV, revenue, margin) and paid media (ROAS, CAC, CPA, CTR, CPM) across Google, Meta, TikTok, Amazon Ads, affiliates, and other channels.

* Analyze campaign and channel performance, and recommend budget allocation and bid, audience, and creative optimizations.
* Design, run, and read A/B tests on landing pages, site experience, promotions, and ad creative.

* Analyze customer behavior, including cohorts, retention, lifetime value (LTV), repeat purchase rates, and LTV:CAC by channel.
* Support merchandising and promotional planning with product, category, pricing, and discount performance analysis.
* Forecast revenue and marketing spend for weekly, monthly, and seasonal peaks such as Black Friday/Cyber Monday and holidays.
* Audit tracking and data quality (pixels, UTMs, conversion APIs, GA4 events) with marketing and engineering.

**What You Bring**

* 2–4 years of experience in ecommerce, digital marketing, or retail analytics.
* Strong SQL skills and advanced Excel/Google Sheets.
* Hands-on experience with GA4 and at least two major ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, Amazon Advertising).
* Experience building dashboards in a BI tool.
* Solid grasp of performance marketing metrics, funnel analysis, and attribution concepts.
* Working knowledge of A/B testing and basic statistics (significance, sample size).
* The ability to explain complex data simply and turn analysis into a clear "here's what we should do."
* Attention to detail and a healthy skepticism about data quality.

**Nice to Have**

* Python or R for analysis or automation.
* Experience with Shopify, Magento/Adobe Commerce, or Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
* Familiarity with marketing mix modeling, incrementality testing, or tools like Northbeam, Triple Whale, or Rockerbox.

**Position Overview**

Vida is looking for an experienced and highly analytical Paid Search Manager to join our growing performance marketing team.

This role will help manage and grow paid search programs across multiple D2C brands within the Vida portfolio. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience managing significant Google Ads budgets across multiple e-commerce accounts and has a proven track record of driving revenue growth and ROAS improvement.

**Paid Search & Shopping Management**

  + Google Shopping

* Develop keyword and search strategies across brand, non-brand, category, product, competitor, and seasonal campaigns.

* Strong experience independently managing multiple paid search accounts simultaneously.
* Demonstrated experience managing significant paid media budgets and being accountable for revenue and ROAS goals.
* Strong D2C/e-commerce experience with an understanding of how paid search contributes to overall business growth.
* Advanced hands-on knowledge of:
* + Google Search
  + Google Shopping
  + Performance Max
  + Demand Gen
  + Google Merchant Center
  + Microsoft Advertising
* Advanced understanding of Google Smart Bidding, including Target ROAS and value-based bidding strategies.
* Strong experience with Shopping campaign structures, product segmentation, and product-level performance analysis.
* Hands-on experience working with Google Merchant Center and product feeds.
* Strong understanding of campaign structures, match types, keyword strategy, search-term analysis, and negative keyword management.
* Ability to determine when performance issues are driven by bidding, budget, feed quality, campaign structure, conversion rate, tracking, competition, seasonality, or other factors.
* Strong understanding of e-commerce KPIs including revenue, ROAS, conversion rate, CPA, AOV, CPC, impression share, and profitability.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn complex performance data into actionable recommendations.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to QA campaign setups, budgets, conversion tracking, feeds, URLs, promotions, and account changes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple brands, projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to proactively bring recommendations and growth opportunities rather than relying solely on direction from senior leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

The successful Paid Search Manager will be able to independently own assigned accounts while consistently identifying opportunities to improve performance and grow the business.

Success in this role means:

* Meeting or exceeding ROAS and business performance targets.

title: Engineer, TSG Software Quality Assurance
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  
  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  
  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

This position sits within an agile data engineering team, owning the quality of end-to-end data pipelines from source ingestion through medallion-layer transformation (Bronze/Silver/Gold) to BI/reporting consumption. The role suits someone who thinks like a data architect and builds/tests like an engineer, equally comfortable with pipeline design and hands-on SQL, PySpark, and automated data quality frameworks.

  
  

**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**

The engineer independently owns the data testing strategy for their workstream, including a reusable SQL validation library usable for both manual and automated checks, and constructively challenges design or process decisions that risk data integrity or delivery quality. Works closely with Data Engineers, the QA Manager, Product/Project Managers, and business stakeholders.

  
  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Requirement, Project and Business Understanding (20%)**

* Develop deep expertise in the data domain and business context source systems, transformation logic, medallion layers, and downstream BI consumption.
Build a thorough understanding of the pipeline lifecycle (ingestion staging transformation* curated/BI layer).
* Review source-to-target mappings and transformation logic before test design begins.
* Support the team on data QA methodologies and processes, with guidance from QA leadership.

**Test Planning, Design, Execution, and Defect Management (35%)**

* Own the data testing strategy across full, incremental, delta, and historical loads, including insert/update/delete/cancel and effective-dated transactions.
* Design and execute ETL/ELT validation, reconciliation, schema, null/completeness, and transformation test cases across the medallion architecture.
* Validate pipelines end-to-end source through Databricks/ADF/Spark to final BI output, confirming numbers, aggregations, and business logic tie out.
* Define and enforce data quality rules and build reusable checks; investigate anomalies and drive root-cause analysis with Data Engineers.
* Manage the defect lifecycle and prepare test evidence, quality dashboards, and RCA reporting for release sign-off.

**SQL Script & Automation Engineering (20%)**

* Build and maintain a structured, version-controlled Databricks/SQL validation queries usable standalone for manual checks and pluggable into automated regression/CI without rework.
* Own inline maintenance of the library: refactor as schemas evolve, retire obsolete checks, keep naming and parameterization consistent, and document each script's purpose, inputs, expected output, and edge cases so it stays usable by the wider team.
* Set up and maintain automated data testing frameworks (e.g., Datagaps, PySpark-based checks) that consume the library for scheduled/CI-triggered runs.
* Work with Data Engineers to wire validation into CI/CD, ensuring failures surface with actionable, traceable output.

**Collaboration (15%)**

* Provide input into the test strategy mix (manual/automated/framework-driven) in partnership with QA leadership and data engineering.
* Constructively challenge decisions that risk data quality or testability and propose practical alternatives.
* Participate fully in agile ceremonies; raise risks and quality concerns early and clearly.
* Partner with the business to understand the wider data system and act as a quality partner for delivery.

**Leadership (10%)**

* Own data testing deliverables, including the health of the automation/SQL library, for the workstream.
* Lead or contribute to QA initiatives that raise the bar on data testing practice across the team.
* Mentor junior testers on ETL/data testing techniques, SQL standards, and automation tooling
  

  

**ABOUT YOU**

* Strong understanding of ETL/ELT concepts, dimensional modeling, fact/dimension tables, and medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), with the ability to trace a data point end-to-end into its BI report representation.
* Hands-on proficiency with Azure SQL/Databricks/Apache Spark (PySpark) for large-scale data validation and transformation testing.
* Working knowledge of Azure Data Factory (pipelines, linked services), Azure Storage (partitioning, Parquet/Delta), and third-party API integrations (e.g., Salesforce, etc.)
* Advanced SQL for backend validation and reconciliation across SQL Server/PostgreSQL/Databricks, with emphasis on writing maintainable, reusable, parameterized scripts.
* Working knowledge of Python for test scripting and validation automation.
* Practical exposure to ETL/data quality tools, Datagaps DataOps Suite (good to have), or equivalent (DQX, QuerySurge, Informatica, Talend, DataStage, SSIS).
* Ability to define and apply data quality rules systematically (completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, timeliness).
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted test generation or anomaly detection, with the ability to adapt checks for AI-produced and consumed data pipelines.

* Comfort with Agile/Kanban delivery, CI/CD practices, and defect management tooling (JIRA, Azure Boards, or similar).
* A curious, quality-first mindset confident to constructively challenge decisions when quality is at risk.
* Strong written/verbal communication and stakeholder partnership skills; strong critical thinking and independent problem-solving.

**Experience:**

* 4-6 years in data testing/automation, with hands-on ETL, Data Warehouse, and/or Big Data testing experience.
* Proven experience testing pipelines on Databricks/Spark within a medallion or layered Lakehouse architecture.
* Experience with Azure Data Factory and Azure cloud storage constructs.
* Experience validating data through to BI/reporting layers (Power BI, Tableau, or similar), not just the warehouse layer.
* Experience with data quality frameworks/rule design and writing SQL validation scripts reused across both manual testing and automated regression, ideally with exposure to a tool such as Datagaps.
* Experience with SDLC/STLC, Agile ceremonies, and defect lifecycle management; prior ownership of a test strategy independently is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted testing or data validation tools

Job Description: Business Development Manager (BDM)

**Company:** TBW Global Sourcing House Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Netaji Subhash Place, Pitampura, New Delhi  
**Department:** Business Development Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 2–5 years preferred

**About the Company**

TBW Global Sourcing House, part of the TWI Group of Companies, specialises in industrial product sourcing and strategic project supply, helping businesses meet their industrial procurement and supply requirements.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a result-orientated business development manager to identify new business opportunities, develop relationships with industrial clients, understand their sourcing requirements, and generate revenue through product sourcing and project supply solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities with manufacturers, industrial companies, contractors, project developers, and corporate procurement teams.
* Generate leads through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, networking, and industry research.
* Identify potential clients requiring industrial products, equipment, materials, and project-related supplies.
* Understand client procurement requirements, product specifications, quantities, budgets, and delivery expectations.
* Coordinate with sourcing and procurement teams to identify suitable products, suppliers, and commercial solutions.
* Develop and maintain relationships with buyers, procurement managers, suppliers, and business partners.
* Prepare business proposals, quotations, product presentations, and commercial offers based on client requirements.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and commercial conditions to secure profitable business opportunities.
* Follow up on enquiries, quotations, and proposals to convert prospects into confirmed orders.
* Explore new industries, markets, and project opportunities to expand the company's customer base.
* Maintain a database of prospective clients, business opportunities, and ongoing negotiations.
* Track sales performance, prepare business development reports, and achieve assigned revenue targets.

**Required Skills**

* Strong B2B sales, lead generation, and client acquisition skills.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building abilities.
* Understanding of industrial procurement, product sourcing, or project supply is preferred.
* Ability to understand client requirements and coordinate with internal sourcing teams.
* Strong market research, commercial awareness, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and CRM tools.
* A proactive, target-driven approach with the ability to develop business independently.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 2–5 years in business development, B2B sales, industrial procurement, or sourcing-related business.
* Candidates with experience handling industrial clients, corporate procurement, vendor networks, or project-based sales will be preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* New client acquisition and qualified lead generation.
* Conversion of enquiries and proposals into confirmed orders.
* Revenue generation and achievement of assigned sales targets.
* Development of long-term client and business partner relationships.
* Expansion into new industrial markets and project supply opportunities.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience you have?
* What was your last CTC?

Work Location: In person

description:
Job Description – Sales Engineer

**Company:** Nedisha Group  
**Position:** Field Sales Manager  
**Head Office:** Dichaon Kalan, Najafgrah  
**Locations:** Delhi, Gujarat, Pune, Noida, Dehradun, and Ludhiana

**Shift:** Day Shift  
**Qualification:** BBA / MBA – Sales & Marketing preferred  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Required

Job Summary

Nedisha Group is looking for an energetic and experienced **Sales Engineer** to develop business opportunities for **woodworking and wood finishing machinery**.

The candidate will be responsible for visiting customers, conducting business meetings, presenting machinery solutions, generating leads, and converting opportunities into orders.

Key Responsibilities

* Visit customers and prospective clients for **business meetings**.

* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable machinery solutions.
* Generate new leads through field visits, references, and market development.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers, dealers, and distributors.
* Conduct product presentations and coordinate machine demonstrations when required.
* Prepare and follow up on quotations and commercial proposals.
* Regularly follow up with prospective customers until closure.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* Coordinate with the technical, service, and management teams for customer requirements.
* Maintain proper records of customer visits, leads, follow-ups, and sales opportunities.
* Conduct market visits and identify new business opportunities.

Candidate Requirements

* **BBA / MBA completed**, preferably in Sales & Marketing.
* Experience in **field sales/B2B sales** preferred.
* Excellent **English communication and presentation skills**.
* Confident and comfortable conducting face-to-face customer meetings.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
* Good negotiation, follow-up, and relationship-management skills.
* Strong sales orientation and target-focused approach.
* Candidates who can join **immediately** are required.

Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.Professional Experience■ 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.■ Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.■ Experience building offerings, roadmaps, business cases, and executive-facing collateral for enterprise clients.■ Exposure to market research, competitive benchmarking, startup / vendor evaluation, or innovation programs is a strong plus.Soft Skills■ Exceptional storytelling and executive presence — able to turn complex AI concepts into a compelling, simple business narrative.■ Strong structured thinking and problem-solving; title: Director of Marketing & Growth
description:
**Location:**
Noida, Uttar Pradesh (Onsite)

**Experience:**
10+ Years

**Primary Market:**
North America / US, with expanding global responsibility

**Customer Segments:**
Pro-AV System Integrators, AV/IT Consultants, Enterprise AV Teams, Technology Managers and Commercial Technology Providers.

**Role Overview**

XTEN-AV is transforming the Pro-AV industry with an AI-powered platform for AV design, proposals, project management and workflow automation.

We are looking for a
**Director of Marketing & Growth**
to join our leadership team at our Noida headquarters. This is not a role focused primarily on managing day-to-day marketing activities.
**Your primary mandate is growth.**
We are looking for someone who can continuously answer the questions that matter most to our business:

**Where will our next phase of growth come from? Why are we winning or losing customers? Which markets, customer segments, channels and messages represent the biggest opportunities? What should we do differently to grow faster?**

You will analyze markets, customers, competitors, channels, positioning, product adoption and the customer journey to uncover growth opportunities. You will develop hypotheses, test new approaches, challenge existing assumptions and turn successful ideas into scalable growth strategies.

You will work closely with our founders and across Marketing, Sales, Product and Customer Success to translate insights into measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate combines
**B2B SaaS marketing expertise with exceptional strategic thinking, commercial judgment, creativity and a strong bias toward experimentation.**

**Key Responsibilities**

i- Growth Strategy & Opportunity Identification

ii- Continuously identify and prioritize new growth opportunities across customer segments, geographies, products, pricing, partnerships, channels and the customer lifecycle.

iii- Evaluate the size and potential of opportunities, develop hypotheses and build strategies for capturing them.

Think beyond existing marketing programs and continuously ask
**where XTEN-AV's next significant source of growth can come from.**

**Strategic Problem Solving**

i- Diagnose growth challenges using customer behavior, funnel data, market intelligence, competitive analysis and first-principles thinking.

ii- Go beyond identifying
**what happened**
to understand
**why it happened and what we should do about it.**

iii- Challenge assumptions and existing marketing playbooks when the data or market suggests a better approach.

**Growth Experimentation**

i- Build a disciplined experimentation framework across messaging, acquisition, conversion, onboarding, activation, adoption, retention and expansion.

ii- Develop hypotheses, define success metrics, run experiments quickly and turn successful experiments into scalable growth programs.

iii- Create an environment where the marketing organization continuously learns rather than simply executes.

iv- Full-Funnel Growth

v- Think beyond lead generation.

vi- Identify opportunities across the entire customer journey:

**Awareness → Acquisition → Conversion → Activation → Adoption → Retention → Expansion**

Work closely with Sales, Product and Customer Success to identify friction, improve conversion and increase customer lifetime value.

**Positioning & Category Strategy**

i- Define how XTEN-AV and its products should be positioned within the rapidly evolving intersection of
**AI, Pro-AV design and workflow automation.**

ii- Develop differentiated narratives that clearly communicate why customers should choose XTEN-AV over existing software, manual workflows or emerging competitors.

iii-Translate sophisticated capabilities—including AI-assisted AV design, automated schematics, BOM creation, CAD workflows and project automation—into compelling business outcomes and ROI stories.

**Market & Customer Intelligence**

Develop a deep understanding of our customers, including Pro-AV integrators, consultants, enterprise technology teams and AV professionals.

**Continuously analyze:**

* Customer needs and behavior
* Market trends
* Competitive positioning
* Win/loss patterns
* Product adoption
* Pricing and packaging
* Emerging technologies
* New customer segments and geographic opportunities

-Turn market intelligence into actionable growth strategies.

-Demand & Pipeline Strategy

-Determine the right combination of
**ABM, inbound, content, paid acquisition, events, partnerships, community, outbound support and other channels**
based on customer segment and economics.

-Build scalable programs that generate qualified pipeline and measurable ARR.

-Rather than simply operating existing channels, continuously evaluate
**where marketing resources should be invested for the highest incremental return.**

**Creative & Messaging Strategy**

i- Develop creative approaches for communicating complex technology simply and memorably.

ii- Challenge conventional B2B SaaS marketing and develop campaigns, narratives and creative concepts capable of standing out in the Pro-AV and technology markets.

iii- Ensure that messaging resonates differently when communicating with technical users, business leaders, enterprise buyers and industry partners.

**Growth Economics & Analytics**

Establish the metrics that matter most for growth and use them to guide business and marketing decisions.

Maintain a strong understanding of:

* CAC and LTV
* Customer acquisition by channel
* Funnel conversion
* Activation and product adoption
* Retention and churn
* Expansion revenue
* Pipeline velocity
* Marketing-attributed ARR
* Channel economics and ROI

The expectation is not simply to
**report numbers**
but to use those numbers to determine
**what the company should do next.**

**Marketing Leadership**

i- Lead, mentor and develop our marketing team across growth, demand generation, product marketing, content, creative and performance marketing.

ii- Establish clear priorities and empower functional team members to handle execution while maintaining strategic ownership of the overall marketing and growth direction.

iii- Build a culture of
**curiosity, experimentation, accountability and continuous improvement.**

**What We're Looking For**

i- Exceptional Strategic & Critical Thinking

ii- You can look at a complex business problem, separate symptoms from root causes, identify opportunities others may have overlooked and develop an actionable strategy.

iii- You are comfortable challenging assumptions—including your own.

**Proven Growth Track Record**

You have personally contributed to meaningful growth at a B2B technology or SaaS company and can clearly explain:

**What the situation was → what you discovered → what you changed → why you changed it → what happened as a result.**

**Senior B2B SaaS / Technology Experience**

i- 10+ years of experience in B2B marketing, growth, product marketing or related disciplines, including significant experience in senior leadership roles.

ii- Experience selling software or technology to professional, mid-market or enterprise customers is strongly preferred.

**Commercial Mindset**

i- You understand that marketing exists to create business outcomes.

ii- You are comfortable discussing revenue, ARR, pipeline, pricing, customer acquisition economics, retention and market opportunity—not simply campaigns, impressions and leads.

iii- Strong Product Marketing Foundation

iv- You can take a sophisticated technical product and make its value understandable and compelling to different audiences.

v- Experience marketing engineering software, workflow platforms, AI products, design tools or other technically complex B2B products is highly valuable.

**Experimentation Mindset**

i- You naturally turn questions into hypotheses and hypotheses into experiments.

ii- You are comfortable testing ideas, learning from unsuccessful experiments and changing direction when evidence contradicts your assumptions.

**Data Fluency**

i- You are comfortable working with marketing, product and revenue data and can independently derive insights from it.

ii- Experience with platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics, Mixpanel or equivalent systems is valuable, but
**strategic interpretation of data matters more than mastery of any particular tool.**

**Creativity & Intellectual Curiosity**

i- You actively study customers, markets, competitors, technology and human behavior.

ii- You bring original ideas rather than simply repeating established B2B marketing playbooks.

**Leadership**

You can set direction, communicate clearly and raise the quality of thinking across a team without needing to personally manage every activity.

**On-Site Presence**

This is a leadership position based at our
**Noida office**
and requires full-time in-office presence.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this position will not be measured by how many campaigns the marketing team launches.

We will measure success by whether you:

* Identify meaningful new sources of growth.
* Improve the economics and effectiveness of customer acquisition.
* Increase qualified pipeline and marketing-influenced ARR.
* Improve conversion throughout the customer journey.
* Strengthen XTEN-AV's positioning and differentiation.
* Develop successful growth experiments and scale the winners.
* Improve our understanding of customers, competitors and markets.
* Help leadership make better growth decisions.
* Build a marketing organization that thinks strategically rather than simply executes tasks.

**What We Offer**

**Strategic Influence:**
A seat at the leadership table with direct involvement in company growth strategy.

**Global Opportunity:**
Build the growth engine for an AI technology company serving customers across North America and international markets.

**Ownership:**
Significant autonomy to challenge existing approaches, test new ideas and influence where the company invests.

**Competitive Compensation:**
Industry-leading compensation, performance incentives and company stock options.

**High-Growth Environment:**
A fast-moving technology environment where strong ideas can quickly turn into company-wide initiatives.

title: Category & Brand Manager – Beauty
description:
We are looking for professionals to work directly with the founders and core team as part of Wingit’s 0-to-1 journey.

What we’re building:

* We’re building India’s first beauty commerce concierge, bringing Sephora’s shopping experience to your home. We’ll be the first lifestyle commerce platform for the top 1% (similar to Firstclub for F&B, CRED for fintech).

Our gunpowder:

* Our team (+ hopefully you):
* Founders: CEO (Jaipur, EE IITK ‘21, BCG, Warburg), CTO (Jaipur, EE IITB ‘21, NVIDIA, Even)
* We’re raising ~$7m seed funding led by two of India’s largest VC firms along with a solid set of angels (Kunal Shah, Kunal Bahl, Tanmay Bhat, Founders of Firstclub, Scapia, Man Matters, GIVA, etc.). This is one of the largest seed rounds in the beauty category in a while.

Mission & Problem Statement:

* Our mission is to reimagine how people shop - quick commerce made shopping quick; but we will make shopping at home an experiential delight. The goal is to build a category-defining company.
* Problem we’re solving: Today’s platforms are archaic, don’t accept returns, and aren’t personalized because they were built when India bought only value products. Someone buying a ₹1,000 lipstick should get a better buying experience than someone buying a ₹200 soap.
* Our solution: We’re building a platform for the top 1% where quick, advisor-led try-and-buy at home, and personalization are different limbs of the platform (building Sephora for India)

Who we are looking for:

* You feel you’re insanely good and are hungry to prove it AND
* You are comfortable with 6 days work from office setup (based out of Gurgaon)

Website: Wingit

Job Description:

You will work closely with the founders and take ownership of real business problems across product, growth, operations, category, marketing and customer experience. The role will involve research, problem-solving, execution and working on 0-to-1 initiatives.

Eligibility Criteria:

* Upto 6 years of experience in the relevant field
* Strong problem-solving, communication and execution skills
* High ownership and willingness to work in a fast-paced startup environment
* Willingness to work 6 days a week from our Gurugram office

Stipend:

Competitive compensation, based on the role and candidate profile.

Nature of Work:

Full-time, work from office in Gurugram, 6 days a week.

Expected Date of Commencement:

Immediate / mutually agreed joining date based on the candidate’s availability.

Interested candidates can apply through the following application form:

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1mYm\_KnwcK6-sYQOZq6p2Dd\_ESTkjSqqb0m6Vpswu7rQ/edit?usp=sharing

Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: International Expansion GTM Lead
description:
**International Expansion GTM Lead**

**Location:**
Noida, India

**Experience:**
4-8 years

**About the Company**

We are building a growth-oriented organization with ambitions to expand beyond India and establish a meaningful presence in international markets. Our immediate priority is to create a repeatable go-to-market engine across the Americas and Europe, connecting market insight, positioning, partnerships, sales execution, and customer learning into one operating system. The company values ownership, commercial judgment, and practical experimentation over rigid playbooks. This role will work closely with leadership to shape where we compete, how we enter new markets, and which investments can produce sustainable growth. As our international expansion develops, the person in this role will help translate company strengths into relevant regional propositions and measurable commercial outcomes. This is an opportunity to influence market strategy early, build operating discipline, and create the foundations for a scalable global business from our Noida base.

**About the Role**

The International Expansion GTM Lead will own the company’s expansion agenda across the Americas and Europe. You will convert strategic ambition into a focused market-entry plan, defining priority segments, regional positioning, acquisition channels, partnership motions, and revenue milestones. The role combines market discovery with hands-on execution: validating demand, building early pipelines, creating repeatable sales systems, and turning customer feedback into sharper propositions. You will establish the operating cadence that helps leadership understand what is working, where investment should increase, and which markets require a different approach. Success means creating qualified international opportunities, improving conversion through disciplined GTM execution, and building a scalable expansion playbook that can be reused across geographies.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own international GTM strategy across the Americas and Europe, translating company goals into market priorities, entry plans, revenue milestones, and accountable execution rhythms.
* Lead market discovery through customer interviews, competitor research, partner conversations, and commercial analysis, converting evidence into clear segment and geography decisions.
* Build regional positioning and messaging with cross-functional teams, ensuring the company’s value proposition is relevant, differentiated, and commercially usable in each priority market.
* Establish pipeline generation across outbound, inbound, partnerships, events, and channel programs, measuring channel productivity and reallocating effort toward scalable sources of demand.
* Develop early international opportunities from qualification through close, improving sales discipline, forecasting quality, conversion rates, and learning from wins and losses.
* Create the international expansion operating system, including dashboards, review cadences, experiments, budgets, and decision criteria that connect activity to revenue and market traction.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Demonstrated experience building or scaling GTM motions across international markets, with practical ownership of segmentation, positioning, demand generation, sales execution, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong understanding of market-entry strategy, regional buyer behavior, competitive analysis, partnership development, and the operating differences between the Americas, Europe, and India.
* Commercial fluency across pipeline management, funnel metrics, forecasting, conversion analysis, experimentation, and revenue planning, supported by structured decision-making.
* Excellent customer discovery, storytelling, negotiation, and executive communication skills, with the ability to turn market insight into action across diverse stakeholders.
* Hands-on capability with CRM systems, marketing automation, analytics dashboards, spreadsheets, and productivity tools used to manage international GTM performance.
* Ability to operate independently in ambiguity, prioritize limited resources, and build repeatable processes without waiting for mature infrastructure or large teams.

**Additional Plus**

* Previous experience in HR technology, recruitment technology, or adjacent workforce software is preferred, particularly where the candidate owned market expansion or complex B2B growth.
* Experience launching an AI-enabled product or business in new countries, especially across the Americas or Europe, with evidence of learning quickly from early commercial signals.
* Background in partnerships, channel sales, international business development, or founder-led growth within a fast-moving company or emerging category.

**What You'll Bring**

* You bring four to eight years of experience in go-to-market, business development, sales, partnerships, or international expansion, with evidence of owning outcomes rather than only supporting execution.
* You bring a builder’s mindset: you can move from an unclear opportunity to customer discovery, a tested proposition, a working pipeline, and an informed decision about scaling investment.
* You bring strong commercial judgment, balancing speed with rigor and distinguishing genuine market pull from activity that creates noise without durable revenue potential.
* You bring the ability to work across cultures and time zones, communicate clearly with customers and senior leaders, and adapt the GTM approach without losing strategic focus.
* You bring operational discipline, using data and structured reviews to make performance visible, identify constraints, and create accountability across internal and external contributors.
* You bring resilience and curiosity, treating objections, failed experiments, and competitive pressure as inputs for sharper positioning and better market decisions.

**Why Join Us**

This role offers the chance to shape international growth at a formative stage, with direct visibility into the decisions that determine where and how the company expands. You will not inherit a narrow regional execution brief; you will help define the markets, motions, and systems that become the company’s global growth engine. The work combines strategy with action, giving you ownership from market selection through pipeline creation, customer learning, and repeatable commercial execution. You will partner closely with leadership and influence product, marketing, sales, and operational priorities through evidence from the market. The Americas and Europe provide meaningful complexity and upside, while the Noida base offers the opportunity to build global operating capability from India. If you enjoy creating structure where little exists, learning directly from customers, and seeing your decisions translate into market traction, this role provides a broad platform for impact and career growth.

**What We Offer**

* Significant ownership of international expansion, with the mandate to shape market priorities, GTM systems, partnerships, and commercial outcomes across multiple geographies.
* Close collaboration with company leadership and cross-functional teams, creating visibility into strategic decisions and the opportunity to influence the broader business direction.
* A high-autonomy, learning-oriented environment where disciplined experimentation, customer evidence, and measurable results guide investment and recognition.
