title: Recruitment Business Partner
description:
**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a Recruitment Business Partner to lead recruitment delivery for a portfolio of client accounts from our India delivery centre. You will lead a team of team leads and recruiters, partner with Sales and client hiring managers, and own the full hiring cycle from requirement to joining.

This is a delivery leadership role, not a desk-recruiting role. You will be measured on outcomes: how quickly strong candidates reach the client, how many are selected, and how many join. You will also act as a trusted advisor to Sales and clients, using market insight and data to shape realistic requirements, rates and timelines.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Delivery ownership**

* Own monthly and quarterly hiring targets (selections and joiners) for the accounts in scope.
* Prioritise open requirements each week, and decide which to push, escalate or pause.
* Make sure quality profiles reach the client quickly, especially on priority roles.
* Track every requirement from intake to joining, and step in early when a role stalls, a candidate disengages or an offer is at risk.

**Stakeholder management**

* Lead intake and calibration discussions so every role has a clear brief, a realistic budget and an agreed interview process before sourcing starts.
* Agree feedback timelines with Sales and clients, and follow up with data when they slip.
* Advise Sales on which requirements are likely to close and where the team should focus.

**People leadership**

* Lead, coach and manage team leads and recruiters against clear weekly productivity goals.
* Run regular performance reviews, identify gaps early and put development plans in place.
* Hire, onboard and ramp up new recruiters, and develop future team leads.

**Process and data**

* Make sure the team follows the agreed recruitment process, with accurate and complete data in the applicant tracking system.
* Use dashboards and reports to find bottlenecks across the hiring funnel (submission interview selection joining) and fix them.
* Keep offer and post-selection drop-outs low, and lead root-cause reviews when they rise.

**Quality and candidate experience**

* Raise screening quality so clients see fewer, better-matched profiles.
* Make sure every candidate receives timely updates and a clear outcome.

**Sourcing channels**

* Work closely with the central sourcing team on role allocation, handovers and turnaround time.
* Make effective use of job boards, referrals, vendor partners and internal talent pools.

**Reporting**

* Prepare monthly account and team performance reviews for leadership, with clear commentary on trends and actions.

**How success is measured**
---------------------------

* Selections and joiners against target
* Time to first qualified profiles on priority roles
* Submission-to-interview and interview-to-selection conversion
* Offer and post-selection drop-out rates
* Joiner retention in the first 30 days
* Team productivity and data quality
* Stakeholder satisfaction (Sales and client feedback)

**What you bring**
------------------

**Must have**

* 8–12 years in recruitment, with at least 3 years leading recruiters or team leads against delivery targets.
* A strong background in IT recruitment or staffing (contract, permanent or managed services), ideally for international clients.
* A proven record of meeting hiring targets, which you can back with your own numbers.
* Confidence with senior stakeholders: you run intake calls, challenge with evidence and handle escalations calmly.
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable with funnel metrics, Excel and BI dashboards.
* A coaching leadership style that balances accountability with development.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Global Capability Centres (GCC), offshore or captive delivery models.
* Experience working with European clients and across time zones.
* Experience integrating teams after a merger or acquisition.
* Experience managing recruitment vendors.
* Hands-on experience with ATS and CRM tools.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* A visible leadership role in a growing India delivery centre serving international clients.
* Ownership of client accounts and a team, with the scope to shape how delivery runs.
* Quarterly performance incentive linked to hiring outcomes.
* A central sourcing team, shared dashboards and a well-defined recruitment process to support you.
* Clear growth path into wider account or regional leadership.

title: Workday Analyst
description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/

**Job Description:**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

  

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

  

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

Solventum is seeking a highly motivated **Workday Analyst** to join our team and provide ongoing support for various Workday modules, including **HCM Core, Recruiting and Compensation** . The Workday Analyst will support 2 to 3 of the above modules and work closely with the US-based team to drive system initiatives, deliver improvements, and provide day-to-day support for Workday-related activities.

In this role, the analyst will be responsible for managing support tickets, resolving issues, assisting with system configurations, performing testing, and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure the optimal use of Workday functionality. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of Workday, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to work across time zones with the US team.

  

**Primary Responsibilities:**

  

* **Workday Recruiting:**
  + Serve as the first point of contact for the US-based team, addressing Workday-related support tickets and providing timely resolutions for any system issues.
  + Configure and maintain Workday Recruiting processes such as job requisitions, candidate pipelines, interview scheduling, offer management and Onboarding
  + Strong experience resolving configuration and functional issues across recruiting and onboarding modules, as well as touchpoints with other modules.
  + Collaborate with HR and Talent Acquisition teams to optimize recruiting workflows
  + Ensure the integrity of data across modules by monitoring system performance, investigating discrepancies, and implementing solutions.
  + Document and track issues, solutions, and improvements to provide a knowledge base for future support.
  Strong expertise in designing complex Workday calculated fields, with a solid understanding of business objects, data sources, and the appropriate placement of calculations.

  

* **Workday Compensation:**
  + Configure and maintain compensation plans, packages, eligibility rules, compensation grades and grade profiles, compensation basis and related reference data.
  + Support compensation transactions within staffing and worker lifecycle processes, including hire, change job, promotion and compensation change events.
  + Analyze compensation configuration issues, eligibility outcomes and process routing; recommend corrective actions and sustainable design improvements.
  + Collaborate with Compensation, HR and Payroll stakeholders to validate requirements, assess downstream impacts and support accurate, controlled deployment.
  Support the execution of global compensation processes, including Annual Review Process, AIP and other compensation initiatives, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.

  

* **Collaboration with US-Based Team:**
  + Work closely with the US-based Workday team to understand business requirements, provide technical expertise, and ensure system configurations are aligned with organizational goals.
  + Assist in the implementation and execution of new features, functionality, and module upgrades by following established processes.
  Participate in cross-team meetings with the US team to align on priorities, project timelines, and best practices.

  

* **Workday Configuration & System Maintenance:**
  + Assist with the configuration and maintenance of Workday HCM, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent, and Reporting modules based on business needs.
  + Support system updates, testing, and deployment activities to ensure smooth transitions during Workday upgrades or new releases.
  Ensure that workflows, business processes, and security roles are accurately configured to meet the needs of the business.

  

* **Project Support & Initiative Execution:**
  + Collaborate with the US-based team to drive global initiatives and provide support for ongoing projects, including process improvements and system enhancements.
  + Participate in system testing for new releases, changes, and enhancements, ensuring that all configurations meet business requirements.
  Assist with documenting project requirements, processes, and procedures to ensure proper system utilization.

  

* **Reporting & Data Analysis:**
  + Develop and maintain Workday reports and dashboards to support HR, payroll, and business requirements.
  + Assist with extracting, validating, and analyzing data to support business decision-making and compliance requirements.
  Collaborate with the reporting team to create custom reports or modify existing ones based on user feedback.

  

* **Training & Knowledge Sharing:**
  + Provide training and guidance to HR and business teams on Workday best practices, system functionality, and process improvements.
  Maintain up-to-date documentation on configurations, processes, and system changes to facilitate knowledge sharing across teams.

  

* **Continuous Improvement:**
  + Identify opportunities for process improvement and suggest enhancements to increase system efficiency and user satisfaction.
  Proactively address potential issues by analyzing trends, preparing solutions, and collaborating with the US team to resolve them.

  

**Your Skills and Expertise**

  

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  

* **Experience:** 5+ years of experience in Workday support or HRIS roles with exposure to multiple Workday modules.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in human resources, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* **Workday Expertise:** Solid experience supporting multiple Workday modules (HCM Core, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent, Reporting).
* **Analytical Skills:** Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify system issues, resolve problems, and offer solutions.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Proficient in Workday’s reporting tools, Calc Fields, security configuration, and business process configuration.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams across different time zones.
* **Problem-Solving:** Strong problem-solving abilities to address support tickets, improve system functionality, and handle system issues efficiently.
* **Project Management:** Experience supporting system upgrades, new functionality, and process improvements.

  

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

* **Workday Certifications:** Workday certifications in relevant modules (e.g., Workday HCM Core, Workday Compensation, Workday Recruiting) are highly desirable.
* **Global Workday Experience:** Experience in supporting global Workday implementations or managing cross-country configurations.
* **Reporting Expertise:** Strong experience in creating and maintaining custom reports and dashboards in Workday.

title: Product Lead, Analytics
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

Rippling recently launched Data Cloud, opening up a new opportunity to help customers understand and act on data across their business. By bringing together first-party, third-party, and customer-created data across HR, IT, finance, and external systems, Rippling can answer business questions that traditional analytics tools struggle to connect.

As Product Lead for Analytics, you will turn this extraordinary technical depth into simple, powerful products for enterprise and mid-market customers. You will own customer-facing analytics experiences and the shared capabilities that power analytics across Rippling—from intuitive reporting for business users to sophisticated analysis for advanced users.

This is a rare opportunity to define new AI-centric experiences beyond classic dashboards. You will build agentic experiences that help customers investigate questions, uncover insights, and proactively learn when meaningful events in their data need attention. AI will be the backbone of the features you ship—and a core part of how you build them.

Your core engineering team is based in India. You will work closely with engineering, design, AI, Data Catalog, and stakeholder teams across India and the USA to shape the product direction for a foundational part of Rippling’s Data Cloud and AI strategy.

### **What you’ll do**

* Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for Analytics within Rippling’s Data Cloud.
* Define and build new experiences for how customers analyze data in the AI era, extending beyond classic reports and dashboards.
* Make sophisticated analysis intuitive for admins and business users while giving advanced users the depth and flexibility they need.
* Build agentic experiences that help customers investigate questions, explain trends, and proactively discover meaningful events in their data.
* Partner with your India-based engineering team and engineering, design, AI, Data Catalog, and product stakeholders across India and the USA to deliver trusted analytics across Rippling and external data.
* Work directly with enterprise and mid-market customers to understand their needs, win adoption, and measure customer value.
* Use AI extensively to accelerate discovery, prototyping, delivery, and product iteration.

### **What you’ll need**

* 8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping complex B2B products.
* Experience building analytics, BI, data platforms, or adjacent products; experience with shared platform capabilities is valuable.
* Strong customer and UX judgment, with the ability to make sophisticated analysis intuitive without sacrificing power.
* Technical fluency in data modeling, querying, metrics, and permissions, and the ability to work closely with engineering on product trade-offs.
* AI fluency: an understanding of how to build reliable AI and agentic experiences, evaluate their quality, and use AI effectively in your own work.
* Strong systems thinking, clear communication, and the ability to drive execution across teams and geographies with high ownership.
* Alignment with Rippling’s leadership principles: We push the limits of possible, We challenge each other directly, and We go and see.

If you don’t necessarily meet all of the requirements listed here, we still encourage you to apply because skills can be used in lots of different ways, your life experience is equally important sometimes.

description:
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.

**What to know:**

* Commvault does *not* conduct interviews by email or text.
* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
* Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com

  

**About Commvault**

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI-powered platform combines best-in-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data.

**Data Engineer**

**The Opportunity:**

The Data Engineer is a critical member of the Business Intelligence and Analytics organization, responsible for architecting, building, and scaling enterprise data platforms that power advanced analytics and decision-making. This role focuses on designing and operationalizing robust, cloud-native data pipelines and data stores, ensuring reliable, high-quality, and governed data is available across the enterprise.

The Data Engineer partners closely with analytics, data science, and business teams to transform raw data into trusted, consumable assets. By leveraging modern data technologies and best practices, this role drives data accessibility, performance optimization, and scalability while enforcing strong data governance and quality standards.

**What you’ll do…**

**Data Engineering & Pipeline Development**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable ELT/ETL pipelines across multiple data sources
* Develop data ingestion frameworks for batch and near real-time data processing
* Ensure data integrity through validation, monitoring, and error handling mechanisms
* Optimize pipelines for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency

  

**Data Modeling & Architecture**

* Design and implement logical and physical data models for analytics and reporting
* Build and maintain data warehouses, data marts, and Lakehouse structures
* Apply best practices in schema design (e.g., star/snowflake models)

**Cloud Platform & Tools**

* Develop and optimize solutions using Azure Synapse, Azure Databricks, SQL Server, and related cloud services
* Support and enhance data platform scalability, reliability, and performance
* Leverage distributed processing frameworks (e.g., Spark) for large-scale data transformation

  

**Data Quality, Governance & Reliability**

* Implement data quality checks, monitoring, and alerting for critical data assets
* Ensure alignment with enterprise data governance, metadata, and security standards
* Maintain data lineage and support auditability and compliance requirements
* Uphold data accuracy, consistency, and availability SLAs

  

**Analytics & BI Enablement**

* Deliver curated, modeled datasets to support BI tools such as Power BI
* Partner with analytics teams to enable dashboards, reporting, and self-service analytics
* Ensure data structures are optimized for performance and usability in reporting environments

  

**Performance Optimization**

* Tune SQL queries, data models, and pipelines for optimal performance
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across data systems
* Recommend improvements to data infrastructure and processing workflows

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with business areas and BSA teams to align data requirements
* Translate business needs into scalable and maintainable data solutions
* Support project planning, requirements gathering, and solution design
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and data-driven innovation

**Engineering Best Practices**

* Follow best practices for version control, testing, and deployment of data pipelines
* Contribute to CI/CD processes for data engineering workflows
* Document data flows, models, and processes for maintainability and knowledge sharing
  

**AI / ML & Advanced Analytics Enablement**

* Awareness of emerging AI/GenAI capabilities and their data requirements
* Familiarity of integration patterns for Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar tool-based interfaces, enabling AI agents and copilots to interact with enterprise data
* Support integration of AI/ML solutions by enabling reliable data flows between enterprise data platforms and downstream applications
* Support data requirements for model explainability, lineage, and governance
* Exposure to tools such as Python (Pandas, NumPy), MLflow, or similar
* Experience working with large-scale datasets for predictive or AI-driven applications

**Who you are?**

* **2-4+ years** of experience in data engineering, BI/analytics engineering, or data architecture

* Strong proficiency in **SQL**, data modeling, and performance tuning, aligning with the original expectations for SQL expertise.

* Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines
* Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms (Azure preferred, including Synapse and Databricks)
* Knowledge of data warehousing, data modeling, and database design
* Experience with distributed data processing (e.g., Spark)
* Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field
* Master’s degree in a relevant discipline is a plus

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Microsoft Azure Data Engineer Associate or similar cloud certification
* Databricks or Spark-related certifications
* Relevant certifications in data engineering, cloud platforms, or analytics

title: Senior Security Engineer - Cloud & AI Platform
description:
**About Ema**
=============

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.  
  
We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

Ema builds AI agents that act on sensitive enterprise data and systems. You’ll make sure the agents, and the platform they run on, are secure by design. You’ll build security controls for autonomous agents operating across multi-tenant enterprise environments, including cloud, on-prem and air-gapped deployments. You’ll solve zero-trust problems where the code isn’t static logic but non-deterministic models making live API calls against sensitive customer data. Our agents orchestrate 100+ LLMs, call third-party tools through MCP, execute code in sandboxes and drive headless browsers, and each of those is an attack surface you’ll help define.

**What you’ll own**
===================

***AI and agent security***
---------------------------

* Threat model new AI agent features before launch: direct and indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration through agent outputs, and over-privileged tool use
* Design guardrails for agentic workflows: least-privilege tool and connector scopes, human-in-the-loop approvals for high-risk actions, and output filtering
* Enforce tenant and data isolation across retrieval (RAG), context stores, and model calls, so no customer’s data leaks into another’s context
* Secure the AI supply chain: model and provider vetting, third-party MCP servers and connectors, prompt and config versioning
* Run AI red-team exercises and build automated adversarial tests (prompt injection suites) into CI

***Cloud and platform security***
---------------------------------

* Security baselines for Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure: RBAC, network policies, workload identity, secrets management, per-tenant network isolation
* Security in CI/CD: IaC scanning, SAST and dependency scanning, policy-as-code guardrails

**What you’ll contribute to**
=============================

* AI-aware detection with our current technology and tooling: logging prompts, tool calls and agent actions, and alerting on anomalous agent behavior
* Partner with the Security & Compliance Lead on technical controls and evidence for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA and ISO 42001, plus the NIST AI RMF

**Must-haves**
==============

* 5+ years in cloud security, application security, or DevSecOps (GCP/Azure Preferred)
* Deep hands-on Kubernetes and cloud security experience
* Security automation with IaC (Terraform/Helm) and Python or Bash.
* A working understanding of LLM application risks (OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) and how agentic systems fail
* Comfortable influencing engineers without formal authority

**Nice-to-haves**
=================

* Hands-on experience securing LLM, RAG, or agentic systems in production
* AI red teaming, or familiarity with MITRE ATLAS
* CNAPP/CSPM tooling, SIEM/detection engineering
* Contributions to AI security research, open-source tools, or CTFs

**Why Join Ema?**
=================

* **At the frontier of AI:** Secure agentic systems that are driving real enterprise transformation.
* **Security is the product:** Enterprise CISOs evaluate our security before they buy. Here it’s a core feature, not a checkbox.
* **Security as a peer, not a gate:** You’ll report to the Security & Compliance Lead and partner directly with Engineering and Product leadership. You’ll sit in design reviews from day one and have a real say in what ships.
* **Ownership:** Help set the baseline for enterprise trust in AI agents and shape the security DNA of a category-defining company.
* **Elite talent:** Work with engineers and researchers from top-tier tech companies who value deep execution

**Ema's Culture & Values**
==========================

* **High Bar on Quality:** We value excellence and expect world-class execution.
* **Ownership & Accountability:** We take full responsibility for our work and outcomes.
* **Impact-Driven Approach:** We set ambitious goals and measure success through real-world impact.
* **No Hierarchy, Just Execution:** Everyone is an individual contributor focused on delivering results.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

title: Product Lead, Finance Accounting
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the Team**

The Finance Accounting team builds the accounting foundation behind Rippling’s Finance products. We help customers turn the activity happening across spend, procurement, reimbursements, and other finance workflows into accurate, auditable data in their ERP.

This is a high-leverage product area where accounting infrastructure, ERP connectivity, and AI automation meet. The team’s work spans the full lifecycle of financial data: helping customers configure accounting rules, validate transactions before they post, recover when syncs fail, and ultimately close their books with more confidence and less manual work.

**About the role**

We’re looking for a Product Lead to lead Finance Accounting at Rippling. You will own the accountant experience across Rippling’s Finance products and help define the future of accounting automation on top of Rippling’s platform.

Your mandate spans two important problems. First, you will build the accounting infrastructure, workflows, and ERP integrations required for Rippling to serve complex enterprise Finance customers. Second, you will help create a new generation of AI-powered accounting workflows that automate manual close work — from validating transaction coding and configuration readiness, to recovering failed syncs, reconciling activity, and preparing adjustments.

Rippling sits in a unique position between the systems where business activity originates and the ERP where the official books live. That gives us the context to automate work accountants perform manually today and to build an accounting product that can become a major platform in its own right.

**What you will do**

* Set the product strategy and roadmap for Finance Accounting, with a clear point of view on how Rippling should help finance teams translate their operational activity in Rippling into accurate accounting outcomes.
* Build the core accounting platform behind Rippling’s Finance products, including the workflows customers use to configure rules, map data, post to their ERP, and resolve issues when syncs fail.
* Design product experiences that give accountants confidence in the accuracy, completeness, and auditability of their books.
* Lead the development of AI-assisted accounting workflows that help customers validate transactions, identify exceptions, recover from failures, and reduce manual close work.
* Partner deeply with engineering and design to turn complex accounting and integration problems into intuitive, reliable product experiences.
* Spend time with customers, implementation teams, support, accounting experts, and ERP partners to understand where accounting workflows break down and where the product can remove friction.
* Define how Rippling should support enterprise customers and their unique needs, like multi-entity setups, tax and currency needs, and high expectations for controls and reporting.

**What you will need**

* 7+ years of product management experience, ideally working on complex B2B software.
* Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into a clear strategy.
* Experience building technically complex products that depend on integrations, data models, or platform infrastructure.
* A strong understanding of accounting workflows and the financial systems businesses use to run them, or the ability to quickly develop fluency in them.
* The ability to work closely with engineers on complex system and data problems.
* Strong customer instincts and a willingness to learn detailed accounting workflows firsthand.
* High ownership. You should be comfortable setting direction and making decisions in a fast-moving environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

If you don’t meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. Skills and experiences can show up in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and backgrounds.

**Nice to have**

* Experience building accounting, ERP, fintech, or financial operations products.
* Familiarity with systems such as NetSuite, QuickBooks, Sage Intacct, or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Experience with month-end close, reconciliation, transaction coding, or financial integrations.
* Experience building AI agents or AI-powered workflow products.
* Experience building products for controllers, accountants, or enterprise finance teams.

**Elevate Your Career with Zalaris**
Zalaris is a rapidly expanding global leader in Tech HR and payroll solutions.
  
  
We’re big enough for you to grow and be a part of an international environment but small enough for you to be visible and truly make a difference.
  
  
We foster open communication and short decision-making paths that encourage creative and innovative thinking.
  
  
Zalaris’ culture is rooted in values inspired by Nordic working ethos:
**everyone matters, aiming high and team spirit**
. We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace where everyone brings their own uniqueness. Zalaris’ employees come from different backgrounds, cultures, and walks of life, and we are proud of it.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Holds end-to-end ownership of the HR service relationship for a portfolio of clients/business units, operating as a strategic advisor to client leadership. Retains involvement in select high-complexity client work while being accountable for service excellence, risk management, final escalation resolution, and continuous improvement across the portfolio and for leading and developing the HRSS Partner team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the overall HR shared services relationship for a cluster of clients, acting as the senior point of contact and trusted advisor to client leadership/HRBPs.
* Personally handle complex, sensitive, or high-risk employee relations and compliance matters escalated from HRSS Partners, involving Legal/HRBP leadership as needed.
* Set and govern SLAs/KPIs for the cluster; conduct root-cause analysis on systemic service issues and drive corrective/preventive action plans.
* Lead, coach, and performance-manage the team of HRSS Partners supporting the cluster; review and quality-check their work on complex cases.
* Design and lead governance forums (monthly/quarterly business reviews) with senior client stakeholders, presenting insights, risks, and improvement roadmaps.
* Drive strategic process transformation, automation, and standardization initiatives.
* Own audit and compliance outcomes for the portfolio, ensuring readiness for internal/external audits.
* Act as change agent for new HR policies, systems, or organizational changes impacting the client group(s).
* Contribute to workforce planning and HRSS capacity/resourcing decisions.
* Build strong cross-functional partnerships with HRBPs, COEs (Talent, Rewards, L&D), and senior business leaders.
* Step in personally on select high-value or high-visibility client engagements that require senior-level presence.

**Client Accountability & Ownership**

* Fully accountable for the HR service relationship and outcomes across an entire client cluster.
* Owns escalation resolution at the most senior level within HRSS before matters go to HR leadership.
* Accountable for strategic outcomes: client satisfaction, risk/compliance posture, cost/efficiency of service delivery, and team performance — not just operational metrics.
* Trusted advisor relationship with client senior leadership; expected to proactively identify risks and opportunities rather than only respond to issues.
* Ultimate accountability for the team's client-facing conduct and decisions across the portfolio.

**Skills & Experience**

* 14+ years of experience in HR shared services/HR operations, including people-management and senior client-relationship experience.
* Proven track record of managing escalations, driving process transformation, and leading teams.
* Strong business acumen, executive presence, and stakeholder influencing skills.
* Deep knowledge of labor law, compliance, and HR risk management.
* Bachelor's degree required; Master's in HR or relevant certification (SHRM-SCP, HRCI) preferred.

**Reports to:**
Team Manager

title: Head of HR & Administration – India / APAC Operations
description:
BUILD THE TEAM. SHAPE THE CULTURE. POWER OUR GROWTH.

Head of HR & Administration – India / APAC Operations

IRISS Inc. | Chennai, Tamil Nadu

Periodic travel to our Bangalore office required.

IRISS is expanding—and we’re looking for an HR leader who can turn business growth into organizational capability. As a global manufacturer of Electrical Safety, Reliability, and Asset Monitoring solutions, IRISS is growing its India presence through a new manufacturing facility in Chennai and a Sales & Distribution office in Bangalore.

This is an opportunity to build the people practices, leadership capabilities, and workplace infrastructure that will support our next phase of growth.

The Opportunity

You will lead HR and Administration across our India Manufacturing and Sales/ Distribution Operations, partnering with local and global leadership to build a high-performing organization and support broader APAC priorities.

Combining strategic leadership with hands-on execution, you will help attract the right talent, develop effective leaders, strengthen employee relations, and establish consistent, scalable HR practices across manufacturing and commercial teams.

Your Impact

Build the workforce: Lead workforce planning and recruitment across production, technical, supervisory, engineering, sales, and support functions.

Establish the foundation: Develop and implement HR policies, systems, onboarding, and processes that support a growing manufacturing and sales/ distribution organization.

Strengthen employee relations: Build trust, coach managers, and manage grievances, disciplinary matters, safety, training, and industrial relations with fairness and sound judgment.

Lead compliance: Oversee applicable labour and employment requirements, factory-related HR compliance, statutory filings, employee records, and audit readiness.

Develop talent and leadership: Drive performance management, learning, career development, and succession planning.

Support accurate payroll: Maintain reliable payroll inputs, employee data, and HR documentation in partnership with payroll and finance.

Run effective workplaces: Oversee facilities administration, security, housekeeping, service providers, vendor contracts, and related budgets across Chennai and Bangalore.

Inform business decisions: Use workforce data to identify risks, improve retention, and align people priorities with operational needs.

What You Bring

MBA/PGDM in Human Resources, Personnel Management, Labour Welfare, or a related discipline.

At least 12 years of progressive HR experience, including fast growing manufacturing and corporate environments and responsibility for HR leadership.

Strong working knowledge of Indian labour laws, statutory requirements, factory compliance, and industrial relations.

Experience building or scaling HR practices in a growing organization; new facility setup experience is highly desirable.

Ability to support both factory employees and sales/commercial teams.

Strong communication, stakeholder management, and change leadership skills.

A practical, accountable approach and the confidence to work closely with global leadership. Broader APAC experience is an advantage.

What Success Looks Like

A capable workforce hired against business priorities. Effective onboarding and performance management. Timely statutory compliance and payroll inputs. Strong employee relations, improved retention, and well-managed facilities within budget.

Why IRISS?

Build and lead a function with meaningful business impact, direct exposure to global leadership, and the opportunity to shape our growing India operations. Ready to help build what comes next?

Know an exceptional HR leader? Please share this opportunity.

title: Recruiting Solutions
description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Recruiting Solutions Project Manager, U.S. Bancorp India**
The Recruiting Solutions Project Manager will support the U.S. Bancorp India Global Capability Center recruiting organization by enabling effective, compliant, and scalable recruiting operations across India. This position will play a central role in preparing and supporting recruiters through training, process and technology enhancements, change management, communications, risk and compliance coordination, and knowledge base management.
  
  
The Recruiting Solutions Project Manager will partner with the India recruiting team, Global Enterprise Recruiting Solutions team, HR Product and Engineering, Legal, Risk, and other key stakeholders to ensure recruiting processes and technology meet local business requirements, support a consistent recruiter and candidate experience, and are successfully adopted by the recruiting organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and support recruiting operations, process, training, and technology initiatives for the U.S. Bancorp India GCC recruiting organization.
* Develop and deliver recruiter training, tools, job aids, and other enablement resources that strengthen recruiter readiness, process adherence, and operational consistency.
* Assess recruiter training needs and translate new or changing processes, policies, and technology capabilities into practical learning materials and communications.
* Partner with HR Product and Engineering teams to identify, document, prioritize, and track recruiting product enhancement requests based on India business and recruiter needs.
* Coordinate and participate in user acceptance testing and post-implementation validation and hyper care for recruiting tools and system changes.
* Identify technology defects, process gaps, and user experience issues, document findings and partner with product team and vendors through resolution.
* Partner with Legal, Risk, Compliance, and other subject matter experts to ensure India recruiting processes, procedures, communications, and technology configurations align with applicable laws, regulatory expectations, company policies, and established controls.
* Develop and deliver appropriate change management, communication, training, and adoption plans in response to recruiting process, policy, and technology changes
* Monitor adoption of new recruiting processes and tools, gather feedback from users, identify barriers, and recommend actions to strengthen adoption and effectiveness.
* Maintain India recruiting knowledge base content and ensure materials remain accurate, current, accessible, and aligned with global standards and local requirements.
* Serve as a resource for India recruiters and recruiting leaders by addressing questions, identifying appropriate referrals, and supporting resolution of complex process and technology issues.
* Leverage recruiter feedback, operational data, testing results, and adoption insights to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Build strong partnerships across India recruiting, Global Enterprise Recruiting, HR Product and Engineering, Legal, Risk, and other cross-functional teams to drive alignment and successful delivery in a matrixed environment.
* Act as a recruiting operations and enablement subject matter expert by maintaining awareness of evolving business needs, India recruiting practices, technology capabilities, and industry trends.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent work experience.
* Five years of experience in recruiting operations, recruiting, change management, HR technology, learning and development, or a related field.

**Preferred Skills/Experience**

* Demonstrated experience supporting recruiting operations, recruiter enablement, HR technology, process improvement, or large-scale organizational change.
* Experience developing and facilitating recruiter training, process education, job aids, presentations, and other enablement materials.
* Knowledge of recruiting processes and technology, preferably including Workday Recruiting, Phenom, or comparable applicant tracking and candidate relationship management platforms.
* Experience gathering and documenting business requirements, enhancement requests, use cases, testing scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience supporting user acceptance testing, defect documentation, issue resolution, and implementation of HR or recruiting technology.
* Understanding of India recruitment practices, employment-related compliance requirements, and the importance of partnering with Legal and Risk to translate requirements into practical recruiting procedures.
* Experience developing communications and change management plans that support successful adoption of new processes, policies, and technology.
* Strong technical writing and process documentation skills, including the ability to create clear knowledge articles, standard operating procedures, process guides, and user-facing instructions.
* Ability to synthesize complex policy, legal, risk, process, and technology information into clear and actionable guidance for recruiters.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines.
* Innovative, resourceful, solutions-oriented, and committed to identifying opportunities to improve recruiting processes, workflows, user experience, and operational efficiency.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, including the ability to influence without authority and work effectively across global and cross-functional teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, presentation skills, and attention to detail.
* Ability to work effectively across India and U.S. time zones when collaboration with global stakeholders is required.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; working knowledge of recruiting reporting, metrics, and analytics is preferred.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.
  
  
**Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants.**
This is an U.S. Bancorp India posting. U.S. Bancorp India is a part of the U.S. Bank family.

title: Associate Director
description:
**About Taggd**

Taggd is a digital recruitment platform that provides Ready-to-Hire talent to India Inc. Combining human knowledge and data, we have fulfilled talent mandates for 100+ clients and ensured hiring manager success for half a million jobs across 14+ sectors. Our vision is to fulfil 1 million jobs through our talent platform by 2030.

**Role Snapshot**

* **Designation:**
  Associate Director – Talent Solutions
* **Location:**
  Chennai
* **Industry Focus:**
  Manufacturing / Automobile
* **Reports to:**
  Senior Director – Talent Solutions
* **Team Span:**
  30+ recruiters
* **Hiring Volume:**
  1,000–1,500 hires annually across multiple business functions
* **Experience:**
  13+ years in recruitment or RPO, including 6–8 years leading a team

**About the Role**

Own the end-to-end talent acquisition mandate for an assigned manufacturing or automotive account. You will deliver the annual hiring plan to SLA, protect account revenue, and build a recruitment team that consistently meets its targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Delivery and Operations*

* Deliver the annual hiring plan of 1,000–1,500 hires, tracked as monthly fulfilment against plan (target: 95%+)
* Keep time-to-fill within the contracted SLA for each role band and review every requisition ageing beyond 30 days in the weekly account review
* Track funnel ratios weekly (CV-to-shortlist, shortlist-to-interview, interview-to-offer) and act on any stage below benchmark
* Maintain offer-to-join conversion at 85% or above through structured candidate engagement
* Publish a weekly dashboard covering open positions, ageing, pipeline health, SLA status and offers in hand
* Own account revenue against the annual plan, including billing accuracy and on-time collections
* Ensure 100% ATS data accuracy with same-day candidate status updates

*Sourcing and Talent Pipeline*

* Lead hands-on sourcing for critical and niche mandates and head-hunt for roles portals cannot fill
* Build ready pipelines of active and passive candidates for repeat-demand and hard-to-fill roles
* Introduce at least one new sourcing channel or campaign format each quarter and report its yield
* Complete skill and sub-skill mapping for 100% of active requisitions

*Client and Stakeholder Governance*

* Run weekly requisition reviews with hiring managers and monthly and quarterly business reviews with client leadership
* Act as the single point of contact for all recruitment, sourcing and escalation matters on the account
* Share market intelligence (talent availability, compensation trends, competitor movement) in every monthly review
* Measure hiring manager CSAT each quarter and close every feedback item with a documented action

*Technology and AI Adoption*

* Drive full team adoption of AI-enabled tools for campaign creation, sourcing, screening and candidate engagement
* Ensure governance and compliance with zero audit exceptions on the account

*People Management*

* Create KPIs for every team member on the HRMS and manage performance through the year
* Share the quarterly scorecard with the Performance Management team on time
* Run structured engagement and team-bonding connects, and build a documented career path for each team member
* Plan and track training; hold voluntary attrition at or below 15%

**What We’re Looking For**

* 13+ years in recruitment or RPO delivery, of which 6–8 years leading a recruitment team through an annual hiring plan
* Volume hiring experience in manufacturing or automotive, with a clear view of where the talent sits, what it costs and why offers fall through (mandatory requirement)
* Ability to hold your own with business heads and CHRO-level stakeholders and challenge unrealistic briefs with data
* Hands-on sourcing skills: head-hunting, Boolean and advanced search, portals and professional networks
* Strong funnel analysis: spot a failing stage early, explain the cause and act on it
* Comfort with AI-enabled sourcing tools (CV matching, Gen AI Boolean strings and adverts, automated outreach) and measuring what each one yields
* Ability to run the weekly delivery dashboard and monthly account MIS, and act on what the numbers show
* Skill in building recruiter capability: identify gaps, coach and add capability where needed
* Ownership of the measures the client judges the account on: hiring plan fulfilment, TAT and SLA management
* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred

title: Manager - IR & Admin
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Statutory Approvals – Project & Construction Phase

Coordinate and obtain applicable approvals from DTCP/competent planning authorities, TANGEDCO/TNEB, TNPCB and other relevant government departments.
  
  
Coordinate factory building approvals, factory plan approvals, factory license and other applicable permissions in consultation with the concerned departments.
  
  
Ensure applicable statutory requirements relating to land use, building construction, electrical installations, fire safety, environmental compliance and occupational safety are addressed.
  
  
Coordinate with Civil, Electrical, EHS, Projects and external consultants to secure approvals before commencement of relevant activities.
  
  
Track approval timelines, dependencies and critical-path activities to avoid delays in construction and commissioning.
  
  

* Factory Operational Compliance

Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, factory legislation, industrial relations requirements, environmental regulations and other statutory obligations.
  
  
Coordinate applicable registrations, licenses, renewals, periodic returns, inspections and statutory submissions.
  
  
Maintain a statutory compliance calendar and proactively monitor due dates, validity periods and regulatory changes.
  
  
Coordinate statutory inspections, audits, notices and correspondence with government authorities and ensure timely closure of observations.
  
  
Maintain statutory registers, records, certificates, approvals and supporting documentation for audits and inspections.
  
  

* Industrial Relations & Contract Labour Management

Coordinate contract labour compliance, contractor documentation, labour license requirements, applicable registrations and statutory records.
  
  
Ensure compliance with applicable wage, social security, employment and other labour-related requirements.
  
  
Support workforce-related IR matters, contractor coordination, employee welfare and grievance resolution as required.
  
  

* Administration & Stakeholder Coordination

Act as the single point of contact for statutory and regulatory matters relating to the new facility.
  
  
Manage external statutory consultants and coordinate with internal functions for timely submission of documents and closure of requirements.
  
  
Establish a structured compliance tracker, responsibility matrix and periodic review mechanism.
  
  
Provide periodic updates to management on approval status, pending actions, compliance risks and mitigation plans.
  
  
**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
Timely completion of applicable statutory approvals as per the project schedule.
  
  
All required licenses and permissions in place before the relevant construction, commissioning or operational activities.
  
  
100% timely completion of applicable statutory returns, renewals and submissions.
  
  
Zero avoidable statutory non-compliances, penalties or production interruptions attributable to compliance failures.
  
  
Timely closure of statutory inspection observations and audit findings.

description:
**Associate Senior Solutions Architect**

**Job #:**

req38665

World Bank

Information Technology

GG

Chennai,India

  

**Required Language(s):**

English

  

**Preferred Language(s):**

  

**Closing Date:**

10/28/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC

**Description**

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd  
  
**VPU Context:**  
  
The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150+ locations.  
For more information on ITS, see video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload=9&v=VTFGffa1Y7w  
  
**Unit Context:**  
  
The WBG Corporate Solutions Department (ITSCO) is focused on the digital transformation of essential corporate services to ensure WBG operations are seamless, resilient, and future ready. Uniting digitalization roadmaps, experience design, process optimization, application delivery, systems management, and technology modernization across 70+ products, the department links business ambition with operational excellence - from intuitive employee experiences and precision payroll to data-driven decision making, intelligent automation, and AI enablement. The unit will oversee vital corporate systems such as personnel administration, global payroll, benefits, tax, pension, budget and planning, cost and expense management, internal audit, ethics and justice processes, heath services, and other essential corporate services. These operations—and their supporting platforms—demand uncompromising accuracy, confidentiality, and resilience, operating in environments where reliability is non-negotiable.  
  
**Duties and Accountabilities:**  
  
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect leads the execution of strategic business requirements by designing integrated, AI-ready technology solutions and guiding their implementation across software, data, and cloud infrastructure. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role synthesizes business, information, and technical perspectives to create scalable architectures aligned with enterprise principles. By evaluating functionality, constraints, and compatibility across platforms, it ensures interoperability, stability, usability, and high availability in distributed environments, enabling corporate application teams to deliver with greater velocity, quality, and efficiency.  
  

* Translate budget policy changes and new WBP requirements into functional and technical specifications for planning models, allocation rules, workflows, and approval routing.

  

* Define integration patterns between the planning tools, SAP ERP/FM, HR position data, and the enterprise data platform, keeping one consistent version of budget and actuals.

  

* Design, configure, and support planning applications in Jedox, including cubes, rules, Integrator jobs, and web reports and forms, alongside other periphal enterprise tools in use.

  

* Serve as the subject matter expert for SAP BW on HANA data models, planning functions,

  

* Partner with data engineering teams to integrate budget, actuals, and commitment data into the enterprise reporting tools such as Azure Databricks

  

* Deliver trusted budget-versus-actual, trajectory, and performance reporting for WBP, VPU budget teams, and senior management.

  

* Identify and shape AI-enabled opportunities, such as anomaly detection in budget submissions, forecasting support, and natural-language access to budget data, with responsible AI and human oversight built in.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Engineering, or a related field with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience; OR a Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in enterprise planning, budgeting systems, or SAP BI; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  

* Advanced expertise in areas – Data Analysis, Data Engineering, Reporting and Planning.

  

* Required Certifications: Scaled Agile certification (SAFe Architect, SAFe POPM, or SAFe Agilist); Any of the data technology such as Azure Synapse, Databricks or SAP BW/4HANA or SAP BW on HANA (or equivalent SAP BI/HANA certification); Any of the data engineering such as Databricks, Azure, GCP

  

* Recommended: Jedox Certified Modeler or Jedox Certified Consultant;

  

* Optional: TOGAF, or a public financial management credential (e.g., CIPFA, IPSAS certificate).

  

* Demonstrated experience leading the modernization of corporate budget and planning systems — including end to end implementation of planning applications across large, multi-stakeholder organizations with complex financial planning structures.

  

* Strong ability to translate organizational budget priorities and financial planning requirements into practical Jedox implementation strategies, phased rollout roadmaps, configuration decisions, and measurable planning outcomes

  

* Advanced expertise in at least two relevant disciplines, such as financial planning and analysis (FP&A), budget system architecture, Jedox model design, reporting, process redesign for planning cycles, organizational change management, or performance management frameworks.

  

* Proven systems-thinking skills applied to budget and planning environments, including the ability to identify cross-functional data dependencies, resolve model integrity issues, and address root causes of planning inefficiencies within Jedox or connected systems.

  

* Strong advisory and facilitation skills, with experience building trust among finance leads, budget owners, IT teams, and senior management to drive adoption of Jedox-based planning processes and data-driven decision-making

  

* Alongside planning expertise, a strong grasp of modern data technologies, including relational, columnar in-memory (e.g., SAP HANA), MPP warehouse, file-based (Parquet/Delta on cloud storage), and distributed processing platforms (e.g., Apache Spark, Databricks). Also hands-on experience with enterprise reporting tools such as Power BI, SAP BusinessObjects, and Analysis for Office.

  

* Understanding of AI-enabled forecasting, predictive analytics, and emerging automation capabilities within modern planning platforms – Planning and Reporting.

As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
* Bring experience working in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV) contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.

**WBG Culture Attributes:**

1. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.  
2. Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
  
3. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

World Bank Group Core Competencies

*The World Bank Group offers comprehensive benefits, including a retirement plan; medical, life and disability insurance; and paid leave, including parental leave, as well as reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities.*

*We are proud to be an equal opportunity and inclusive employer with a dedicated and committed workforce, and do not discriminate based on gender, gender identity, religion, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability.*

title: HR Business Partner (HRBP)
description:
**Position: HR Business Partner (HRBP)**
**Team: Corporate**
**Location: Hyderabad**
**Who We Are…**
GlobalData is a specialist information services business on a mission to help our clients decode the future, make better decisions and reach more customers. Using our unique data, expert analysis and innovative solutions we deliver intelligence on the world’s largest industries for companies, government organisations and industry professionals.
  
  
We began our journey in 2016, by combining a diverse range of specialist information services companies, with decades of trusted customer relationships and deep sector specialisms. Today, we operate as a single company and one fully integrated platform, with more than 3,500 colleagues worldwide, across 20+ industries, delivering value for over 5,000 customers.
  
  
**Why join GlobalData?**
GlobalData is at a pivotal point in its growth journey. Following multiple acquisitions and having recently received transformational investment we need curious, ambitious, courageous people to support us in achieving our vision of becoming the world’s trusted source of strategic industry intelligence.
  
  
Our big ambitions mean that life at GlobalData is fast paced, entrepreneurial and rewarding. We recognise the collective power of our people, and it’s the collaboration of our teams that have shaped our success and will continue to do so in the future.
  
  
**Position: HR Business Partner (HRBP)**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a proactive and strategic HR Business Partner (HRBP) to collaborate closely with the business leadership and drive people initiatives aligned to organizational goals. The ideal candidate will be from product development/technology-driven organizations, possess strong stakeholder management skills, and demonstrate exceptional communication and analytical capabilities. Candidates from Tier-1/Premium institutions are highly preferred.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders on all people-related matters, including workforce planning, performance management, talent development, and employee engagement.
* Partner with stakeholders to understand business priorities and develop HR strategies that support organizational growth and productivity.
* Lead and drive the annual performance review cycle, including goal setting, talent calibration, and compensation planning processes.
* Collaborate with the talent acquisition team to support hiring decisions, workforce planning, and the onboarding experience.
* Identify skill and competency gaps and partner with Learning & Development to design and implement capability-building programs.
* Drive employee engagement initiatives, culture-building activities, and change management programs.
* Analyse HR metrics, employee feedback, and attrition trends to generate actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making.
* Develop and maintain HR dashboards and reports to track key workforce metrics, including headcount, attrition, hiring, diversity, and employee engagement.
* Prepare and present periodic workforce reports and executive summaries to senior leadership, highlighting key HR metrics and business impact.
* Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and compliance across HR systems while driving automation and continuous improvement in reporting processes.
* Ensure policy adherence, promote a positive employee experience, and address employee relations matters with fairness and compliance.
* Champion HR best practices to enhance processes, operational efficiency, and overall business impact.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 6 to 15 years of experience as HRBP, preferably supporting technology/product development teams.
* Post-graduation from Tier-1/Premium institutions (IIMs/XLRI/TISS/ISB/SCMHRD or equivalent) highly preferred.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
* Proven track record in driving HR processes across talent management, performance, and employee engagement.
* Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
* Strong analytical mindset and experience using HR dashboards, MIS, and reporting tools.

Company Description WIN Information Technology Pvt Ltd (WINIT) is a technology partner that helps businesses transform how they sell, distribute, and grow, enabling them to scale into global leaders. With nearly three decades of experience and a presence in 27 countries, WINIT delivers Sales Force Automation, Distribution Management Systems, and AI-powered solutions that enhance foresight, precision, and scalability across workflows. Its platform supports van sales and pre-sales, demand forecasting and route optimization, AI-driven supervision and merchandising, conversational AI voice agents, and digital B2B and B2C commerce. Headquartered in Hyderabad with a regional office in Dubai, WINIT partners with enterprises across GCC, APAC, and Europe to drive streamlined execution, faster cycles, fewer errors, and sustainable growth.

**1. Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented HR & Recruitment Manager to manage the complete human resources function, including IT recruitment, talent acquisition, employee engagement, performance management, HR operations, and employee relations.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in recruiting IT professionals, managing end-to-end recruitment processes, implementing HR policies, ensuring statutory compliance, and developing effective HR strategies aligned with the company's business objectives.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from manpower planning and sourcing to interviewing, salary negotiation, and onboarding.
* Recruit IT professionals for various roles, including Software Developers, Full Stack Developers, Java Developers, .NET Developers, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers, Cloud Engineers, Business Analysts, Project Managers, and IT Support Engineers.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, recruitment agencies, and other channels.
* Screen resumes, conduct initial HR interviews, coordinate technical interviews, and evaluate candidate suitability.
* Work closely with technical managers and department heads to understand job requirements and hiring priorities.
* Negotiate compensation packages and manage offer releases, follow-ups, and joining formalities.
* Maintain a recruitment database, candidate pipeline, and hiring reports.
* Monitor recruitment metrics, including time-to-hire, cost-per-hire, offer acceptance rate, and joining ratio.

**B. HR Operations & Administration**

* Manage employee onboarding, induction, documentation, confirmation, transfers, promotions, and exit formalities.
* Maintain employee records, personnel files, attendance, leave records, and HR databases.
* Develop, implement, and update HR policies, procedures, and employee handbooks.
* Coordinate payroll processing, salary inputs, reimbursements, and employee benefits with the finance team.
* Handle employee queries, grievances, disciplinary matters, and workplace concerns.
* Manage employee separation, exit interviews, full and final settlements, and clearance procedures.

**C. Employee Engagement & Retention**

title: Marine HR Executive (Planning)
description:
Behind every well-crewed vessel is a team that plans, coordinates, and keeps things running seamlessly from shore. As an Executive in the EPS Marine HR Planning team, you will play a central role in managing the manpower pipeline for our fleet, from forecasting crew requirements and coordinating with manning offices worldwide to supporting crew evaluations and handling day to day HR matters for ship staff. If you enjoy working in a fast paced, people focused environment where your decisions have a real and direct impact on vessel operations, this is a position worth considering.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review and forecast manpower requirements in coordination with the Manager and Assistant Manager, Marine HR.
* Plan, source, and coordinate the recruitment of ship staff to meet fleet manning requirements, including processing applications for assigned ranks.
* Coordinate with EPS-appointed manning offices worldwide to ensure compliance with company policies, STCW 95 requirements, and crew qualification standards.
* Handle crew-related HR matters including crew evaluations, promotions, counselling, and NTBR cases.
* Monitor seafarer readiness with manning offices, manage unassigned ship staff, and finalise crew assignments in COMPAS.
* Ensure crew changes are carried out in a timely, cost-effective, and respectful manner.
* Follow up on LLP and pension requests for assigned ranks, coordinating with Manning offices and Crew Accounts for approvals and remittances.
* Review seniority data, identify manpower gaps, and prepare gap analysis and monthly reports as required.
* Provide timely responses to vessel queries and liaise with the Marine HR Manager on exceptions highlighted from crew evaluations.
* Calculate wages for take-over vessels and ensure Matrix compliance assignments are completed for the Tanker Fleet.

**Requirements**

* More than 3 to 4 years of working experience in a Marine HR portfolio (preferred).
* Good knowledge of STCW, MLC 2006, and related maritime regulations.
* Familiarity with crew management systems and payroll processes.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Good communication skills, with the ability to work across a multinational and professional environment.
* Proficient in MS Office applications, including MS Word and Excel.

At EPS, we know that a strong shore team is the backbone of a well-run fleet. We are committed to being an industry-leading ship management company, and we invest in people who are passionate about the maritime industry. EPS is equally committed to minimizing the environmental impact of its business, having achieved the ISO 14001 Environmental Management Standard. If you are looking to build a meaningful and long-term career in Marine HR, we would be glad to hear from you.

Personal data collected from applications will be used for recruitment purposes only.

Notice: We do not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies, and we will not be responsible for any associated fees for unsolicited submissions. We also do not require job applicants to pay a fee as part of the recruitment process.

*With a history spanning 60 years, Eastern Pacific Shipping is a leading shipping company that is committed to the green and technology-driven growth of the industry. Headquartered in Singapore for the past 30 years, EPS is driven by its mission to be the safe and efficient transportation provider of choice to the shipping industry. Empowering that mission are 8,000 skilled and dedicated sea and shore staff that oversee a versatile fleet of 34 million deadweight-tonnes across four core segments of containership, dry bulk, gas, and tanker vessels. EPS's shore team is fully integrated with in-house commercial, finance, innovation, IT, legal, manning, operations, and technical departments.*
