title: Partner Operations Manager
description:
**Company Description**

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.

We’re an award-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:

* UK & Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft & Oracle partner
* 3300+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland & UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK & Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.

 **Job Description**

As Partner Operations Manager you will support the Partner Commercial Lead ensuring Version 1 meets and advances its tier and compliance obligations across Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, and Anthropic (and other partnerships as we scale). You will lead a back-office team responsible for the operational infrastructure underpinning our partner programmes - tracking certifications, managing partner portals, monitoring consumption and funding, and ensuring timely reporting to both internal stakeholders and partner organisations. You will work closely with the partner operations team who manage the day-to-day strategic relationships, providing the operational rigour that enables those relationships to deliver commercially. You will support across the Partner Hub, Sales, Marketing, and Delivery to ensure partner requirements are understood and met across the business.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of partner programme requirements across Microsoft (Solutions Partner/CSP), AWS (Partner Network tiers), Oracle (OPN), and Anthropic (Claude Partner Network), and ensure Version 1 meets all tier thresholds and compliance obligations.
* Support the partner commercial leads in building strong operational relationships with key partner stakeholders across Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, and Anthropic, ensuring Version 1 is visible and well-positioned within each partner ecosystem.
* Increase awareness within Version 1 of the requirements and benefits of working collaboratively with our strategic partners, acting as the internal subject matter expert on partner programme mechanics.
* Manage partner funding programmes throughout their entire lifecycle, acting as the primary liaison between vendors, partner hubs, and commercial sellers. Accountable for maintaining a funding automation solution and ensuring all submissions are progressed through to funding drawdown.
* Work closely with Parter Managers and Presales to identify and capitalise on key partner-involved deals early in the pipeline, and support collaboration with Commercial to optimise partner involvement in major opportunities.
* Own the development and maintenance of a Partner Performance Dashboard; closely monitor consumption and rebate revenue across all partner programmes, communicating performance issues and corrective actions to Hub Leads.
* Identify partner accreditation and certification opportunities that underpin and endorse our offerings.
* Maintain a consolidated schedule of accreditation and certification audits across all four partners and communicate requirements and deadlines to the relevant partner managers and the Partner Commercial Lead.
* Be accountable for the successful execution of partner accreditation and certification audits.
* Own day-to-day operation of all partner portals: Microsoft Partner Center, AWS Partner Central, Oracle Partner Network portal, and Anthropic's partner management platform. Responsible for pipeline updating, opportunity registration, and ensuring Version 1's profile and credentials are current across each.
* Monitor and analyse partner performance across all programmes, identifying areas for improvement and implementing corrective actions.
* Support partner-based marketing activities across all four partner ecosystems.
* Ensure that partner marketplaces (Azure Marketplace, AWS Marketplace, Oracle Cloud Marketplace) are refreshed regularly with Version 1 offerings.
* Assist with the formulation of win-wires and partner award submissions across all partner programmes.
* Deliver data-driven insights on training, accreditation, certification, and competency requirements across all partner programmes, ensuring Version 1's investment in credentials directly enhances our partnership tier status and commercial position.
* Serve as a central source of partner programme information across the business - ensuring compliance, maintaining consistency, and implementing corrective measures as necessary, while overseeing monthly and quarterly reporting to track progress against partner objectives.
* Mentor, train, and develop back-office team members for career progression, performance improvement, and recognition purposes.
* Act as the operational interface between the Partner Commercial Lead and the partner managers, translating strategic priorities into actionable compliance, certification, and reporting tasks with clear ownership and deadlines.

  
**Qualifications**  

* **7+ years** of Experience in the technology industry, ideally within a partner, alliances, or vendor management function.
* Proven track record in developing and implementing successful partner programmes and managing partner operations requirements.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships both internally and with partner organisations.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyse partner performance data and identify trends and risks.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple partner workstreams simultaneously.
* Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines, compliance schedules, and stakeholder requirements simultaneously.
* Experience managing and developing operational teams, including performance management, mentoring, and workload prioritisation.
* Sufficient commercial and technical literacy to understand cloud and AI partner programme structures, consumption models, and marketplace mechanics across hyperscaler and AI vendor ecosystems.

  
**Additional Information**

Why Version 1?

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Embark on a rewarding and challenging career as a Business Analysis Manager with our dynamic team. You'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact by supporting process improvements, key initiatives and expanding your creative skills in a supportive and collaborative environment. Join us and contribute to our mission while advancing your career.
  
  
As a Business Analysis Manager within JPMorganChase, you will be a key player in driving strategic initiatives and operational improvements. Your role will involve leveraging your deep understanding of business analysis principles and data analytics expertise to uncover patterns, identify trends, and generate innovative solutions. You will be responsible for managing a diverse team, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality service within your area of responsibility. Your ability to think strategically, delegate effectively, and coach your team members will be crucial in achieving our common goals. With your advanced computer literacy and digital proficiency, you will be instrumental in implementing automation initiatives and optimizing processes, thereby enhancing our operational efficiency and customer service.
  
  
**Job responsibilities**

* Partner with Program and Project Managers to assess the data implications of strategic programs across Party, Account, and KYC domains.
* Define, document, and drive changes required to the data model in support of the firm's strategic agenda, ensuring clear communication and timely delivery.
* Lead collaboration with Technology and Remediation teams to prioritize data remediation programs and ensure data is in good order to support strategic business initiatives.
* Facilitate alignment between business users and data owners to ensure comprehensive understanding of data structures, definitions, and usage.
* Develop and deliver executive-level presentations and materials for stakeholder reviews, project team meetings, and leadership forums.
* Build and manage strategic partnerships across Operations, Technology, Business Management, and Advisory functions.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration across Lines of Business, Compliance, and Technology to conduct root-cause analysis and define strategic remediation paths for data quality issues across critical WM applications.
* Serve as the primary subject matter expert for WM Data Quality, providing guidance and support across teams on ad hoc and strategic data issues.
* Own documentation of resolution processes and procedures, ensuring effective handover to Operations upon completion.
* Establish and govern data quality metrics and KPIs across Lines of Business and relevant data sources.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and data excellence.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Demonstrated expertise in conducting business analysis, with a focus on data collection, integrity, utilization, requirements, and analysis, showcasing skills equivalent to 5+ years of experience..

* Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with experience engaging senior stakeholders and translating complex data issues into actionable business outcomes. Based on existing communication requirements in the role description.
* Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with the ability to develop and clearly present conclusions and solutions with consideration to inherent risks.
* Leadership: Proven ability to lead teams, manage multiple priorities, and deliver results in a complex and highly collaborative environment.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Capability to leverage artificial intelligence and AI tools to enhance data analysis, uncover business trends, and provide actionable insights for strategic decision-making.
* Advanced proficiency in implementing automation solutions to streamline business processes and improve operational efficiency.
* Expertise in applying customer service skills to understand client needs and deliver tailored business solutions, while utilizing conflict management skills to resolve stakeholder issues and facilitate effective collaboration.
* Proficiency crafting clear and effective prompt writing to guide data analysis and ensure consistent outcomes.
* Ability to contribute to a collaborative work environment by sharing knowledge and supporting team initiatives.
* Competence in technology/process release management, with proficiency in using software applications, digital platforms, and other technological tools to solve problems and improve processes.

Morgan and Chase brands. Vocera now a part of Stryker is looking for Senior Technical R&D Manager is sought to lead the Embedded OS and UX team responsible for creating dependable, intuitive, and maintainable device platforms. This role combines people leadership with technical direction across Yocto Linux and/or Android OS, board support packages, system services, device integration, and user experience. The manager will guide a multidisciplinary team through architecture, development, validation, release, and sustainment, partnering across product, hardware, quality, security, and operations to deliver high-quality embedded products.

Success in this role means establishing technical clarity, raising engineering quality, and shipping platform capabilities that are scalable, secure, testable, and intuitive for the people who use them.

**What You Will Do**

**Technical / Managerial Responsibilities**

  

* Lead the design and implementation of embedded OS platform architecture using Yocto Linux and/or Android OS, aligning platform choices with product, hardware, security, and UX goals.

  

* Own the team roadmap, architectural direction, technical debt strategy, and delivery plans for platform, middleware, device integration, and embedded UX capabilities.

  

* Provide technical leadership across board support packages, bootloaders, Linux kernel configuration, device drivers, hardware abstraction layers, system services, and application frameworks.

  

* Partner with Product, UX, Hardware, Systems, Quality, and Security teams to translate customer workflows into coherent, responsive, and accessible device experiences.

  

* Establish reproducible build and release practices, including source control, code review, continuous integration, automated validation, artifact traceability, and release governance.

  

* Strengthen product quality through unit, integration, system, performance, reliability, hardware-in-the-loop, and end-to-end testing across target devices.

  

* Guide secure platform engineering, including secure boot, signed software, permissions, vulnerability remediation, SBOM practices, and over-the-air update strategies.

  

* Work closely with Release Engineering and DevOps teams to ensure the smooth operation of build, test, packaging, deployment, and sustaining-engineering workflows.

  

* Drive functional excellence initiatives, deliver high-quality R&D functional deliverables, and ensure technical excellence for product or technology development. Drive technical projects of major magnitude and scope.

  

* Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies, applying this knowledge to continuously improve embedded platform architecture, development practices, and UX quality.

  

* Act as a performance coach by providing actionable feedback, setting clear objectives, developing technical talent, and building an inclusive, accountable engineering culture.

  

* Communicate plans, risks, trade-offs, and technical information clearly to team members and business stakeholders, supporting decisions with evidence and sound engineering judgment.

**What You Will Need**

**Technical Skills**

  

* Strong experience building and shipping embedded Linux and/or Android-based products, with a practical understanding of OS architecture, system startup, resource management, and device lifecycle.

  

* Hands-on expertise with the Yocto Project, including custom layers, recipes, image generation, SDKs, reproducible builds, package management, and distro or machine configuration.

  

* Experience with Android OS or AOSP, including the Android build system, framework services, HALs, permissions, system applications, OTA updates, and platform customization.

  

* Proficiency in modern C/C++ and scripting with Python and shell; familiarity with Java or Kotlin for Android platform and application integration is a plus.

  

* Deep understanding of BSP development, U-Boot or other bootloaders, Linux kernel configuration, device drivers, middleware, and hardware abstraction layers.

  

* Experience with embedded UX technologies such as Android UI, Qt/QML, Wayland/Weston, or comparable frameworks, including performance, responsiveness, and accessibility considerations.

  

* Working knowledge of hardware and connectivity interfaces such as I2C, SPI, UART, USB, Ethernet, CAN, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and display or input subsystems.

  

* Strong debugging and profiling skills using tools such as GDB, perf, ftrace, kernel logs, logcat, crash dumps, tracing, and system observability tooling.

  

* Experience with CI/CD and engineering tools such as Git, Gerrit, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or similar technologies.

  

* Understanding of embedded security, secure boot, code signing, key management, vulnerability response, SBOMs, and long-term product maintenance.

  

* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and develop creative, evidence-based solutions.

  

* Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in Agile, cross-functional, and geographically distributed development environments.

**Leadership Experience**

  

* Talented performance coach who is skilled at providing actionable feedback to team members, setting clear performance objectives, and managing team member performance.

  

* Experience executing a talent and performance-management strategy, including hiring, onboarding, development planning, succession planning, and organizational health.

  

* Demonstrated ability to communicate plans and technical information to team members and stakeholders within a business unit.

  

* Proven ability to deliver programs or other business goals on time, on quality, and within budget while managing scope, risk, dependencies, and trade-offs.

  

* Ability to balance hands-on technical depth with thoughtful delegation, coaching, and long-term team capability building.

**Education & Experience**

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field required; master's degree in a related field preferred.

  

* 15+ years of applicable experience, with 6+ years of direct people-management experience preferred.

  

* A strong level of understanding and experience in one's technical or functional disciplines, with the ability to mentor others and raise the engineering bar.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Front Office Executive
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Job Description – Front Desk Executive
  
  
**Position:** Front Desk Executive
  
**Department:** Facilities / Workplace Experience
  
**Reporting To:** Facilities Manager / Account manager
  
  
**Role Purpose:**  
The Front Desk Executive is responsible for delivering an outstanding workplace and visitor experience by managing front desk operations, coordinating service requests, supporting workplace administration, and ensuring seamless communication between employees, visitors, vendors, and internal stakeholders. The role requires a proactive, customer-focused professional with strong coordination skills and experience in corporate office environments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Front Desk & Workplace Experience
  
Serve as the first point of contact for employees, visitors, clients, and guests, ensuring a professional and welcoming experience.
  
Manage reception operations, visitor registration, access management, and guest facilitation in compliance with security protocols.
  
Handle employee and visitor queries promptly, professionally, and efficiently.
  
Maintain high standards of customer service and represent the organization's values and workplace culture.
  
Service Ticket Management
  
Manage and monitor workplace-related service requests through ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow.
  
Track, coordinate, and follow up on service tickets to ensure timely resolution within defined service levels.
  
Liaise with internal functions and service partners to address facility, housekeeping, maintenance, engineering, security, and workplace-related concerns.
  
Maintain service records, prepare operational reports, and escalate critical issues as required.
  
Meeting Room & Executive Support
  
Coordinate meeting room bookings and ensure readiness of meeting spaces.
  
Arrange and monitor support services, including audio-visual equipment, seating arrangements, and meeting requirements.
  
Support leadership visits, business meetings, and workplace engagement activities.
  
  
Safety, Compliance & Incident Management
  
Adhere to and promote workplace safety, security, and compliance standards.
  
Report, track, and escalate incidents, service disruptions, and operational concerns in a timely manner.
  
Support audits, inspections, and compliance-related activities.
  
Ensure compliance with organizational policies and established workplace procedures.
  
Continuous Improvement
  
Identify opportunities to enhance workplace services and operational efficiency.
  
Support implementation of best practices and process improvements.
  
Contribute to initiatives focused on improving employee, visitor, and client experience.
  
Required Skills & Competencies
  
Excellent customer service and front office management skills.
  
Strong verbal and written communication abilities.
  
Effective stakeholder, vendor, and customer relationship management.
  
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced corporate environment.
  
Strong problem-solving, coordination, and organizational skills.
  
High level of professionalism, attention to detail, and service orientation.
  
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  
Technical Knowledge
  
Hands-on experience with ServiceNow or other service ticketing/helpdesk platforms.
  
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  
Knowledge of meeting room booking and visitor management systems.
  
Understanding of corporate workplace and facilities management processes.
  
Experience & Qualifications
  
Graduate in any discipline.
  
Preference will be given to candidates with a Hotel Management degree/diploma specializing in Front Office Operations.
  
Minimum 5 years of experience in Front Office Operations, Workplace Experience, Facilities Management, Hospitality, or Customer Service within a corporate office environment.
  
Proven experience in managing service tickets, stakeholder coordination, visitor management, and workplace operations.
  
Experience in handling leadership interactions and executive-facing workplace services will be an added advantage.
  
  
**Key Attributes:** Customer-centric mindset, excellent presentation skills, strong interpersonal abilities, and the capability to deliver a seamless workplace experience in a corporate setting.
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Regional Key Account Manager

title: Account Director
description:
**Role Purpose**

To lead client relationships, drive strategic thinking and deliver integrated marketing and communication solutions across traditional and digital channels. The Account Director is responsible for understanding clients’ business objectives, translating them into effective brand and marketing strategies, ensuring excellent execution, and identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts.

The role requires a strong understanding of digital marketing, social media, content, performance marketing and data-led communication, alongside conventional advertising and brand building.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Client Relationship Management**

- Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key client stakeholders.

- Develop a thorough understanding of clients’ businesses, categories, consumers, competition and marketing objectives.

- Act as the senior point of contact for assigned accounts and proactively address client needs.

- Build client confidence through strategic inputs, proactive recommendations and consistent delivery.

**2. Brand Strategy and Integrated Planning**

- Translate business and marketing objectives into effective brand and communication strategies.

- Lead the development of annual brand plans, campaign briefs and integrated communication roadmaps.

- Integrate traditional advertising, digital marketing, social media, content and other relevant channels into cohesive brand solutions.

- Bring consumer insights, category intelligence, cultural trends and competitive analysis into strategic recommendations.

- Identify opportunities for brands to strengthen their positioning, relevance and engagement across consumer touchpoints.

**3. Digital Marketing and Social Media**

- Develop a strong understanding of digital ecosystems and their role in achieving brand and business objectives.

- Lead client discussions on digital strategy, social media, content planning, audience engagement and online brand building.

- Guide the development of digital-first campaigns, platform-specific content and always-on communication plans.

- Stay abreast of emerging platforms, digital trends, consumer behaviour and marketing technologies, including AI-led opportunities.

- Ensure digital initiatives are integrated with the overall brand strategy rather than operating as disconnected activities.

**4. Campaign Management and Execution**

- Oversee campaigns from briefing and planning through creative development, production, approval and execution.

- Coordinate delivery across creative, digital, social media, media, production and external partners.

- Ensure campaign quality, brand consistency, platform relevance and adherence to timelines and budgets.

- Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high standards of execution.

- Ensure clear briefs, defined deliverables, approval processes and accountability across teams.

**5.Business Development and Account Growth**

- Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts across integrated communication, digital, social media, content and other agency services.

- Proactively recommend solutions based on emerging client needs and business opportunities.

- Develop strategic proposals, presentations and recommendations for the client.

- Strengthen client partnerships by demonstrating the agency’s ability to deliver measurable business and brand value.

**6.Commercial and Financial Management**

- Manage account budgets, estimates, billing, purchase orders and payment follow-ups in coordination with finance.

- Maintain accurate revenue forecasts and project cost tracking.

- Ensure commercial discipline across both traditional and digital deliverables.

**7.Team Leadership and Collaboration**

- Lead, mentor and develop account management team members.

- Establish clear responsibilities, timelines and accountability for deliverables.

- Collaborate effectively with creative, digital, social media, media specialists.

- Ensure teams work towards shared client objectives and integrated solutions.

- Foster a proactive, solution-oriented and collaborative working culture.

**8.Reporting and Account Governance**

- Maintain account plans, campaign trackers, meeting minutes and action reports.

- Keep agency leadership informed about account health, revenue opportunities, risks and client feedback.

- Ensure client commitments are tracked and fulfilled.

- Maintain clear communication and efficient workflows between clients and internal teams.

Required Skills and Experience

- 8–12 years of experience in advertising, marketing communications or an integrated agency environment.

- Strong client servicing, relationship management, presentation and communication skills.

- Good understanding of brand strategy, integrated campaigns and consumer behaviour.

- Working knowledge of digital marketing, social media strategy, content marketing and performance marketing.

- Ability to interpret digital campaign reports, understand KPIs and derive actionable insights.

- Familiarity with paid, owned and earned media, digital platforms and emerging marketing technologies.

- Strong project management, commercial acumen and financial discipline.

- Ability to lead teams, manage multiple priorities and work under tight deadlines.

- A proactive mindset, strategic orientation and strong sense of ownership.

Interested candidate share CV at alrina.alvares@rkswamy.com

title: City Lead
description:
We operate through two key sales channels — Spinny Retail and Spinny Partners (B2B Auction platform).

●
**Retail:**
We purchase used cars on our inventory, refurbish them at our owned workshops, and sell them through our retail outlets in Hub and Park formats

●
**Auction:**
We enable digital auctions for used car dealers based on in-house inspection reports. Prices are offered to sellers only after a confirmed dealer bid, ensuring minimal inventory risk.

The Supply vertical (car procurement) is common to both channels. Every incoming car runs through the Auction platform for the best price discovery, leveraging our network of 10,000+ channel partners, including Spinny Retail.

**SUPPLY CHANNELS**

We operate two primary procurement channels:

● G1 (Online C2B): Direct sellers who connect with Spinny digitally

● G3 (Offline B2B): Partnerships with new car dealerships, OEMs, leasing companies and corporate sellers

**G1 SUPPLY FUNNEL**

1. Lead Generation: Through Spinny’s digital platforms (website and app)

2. Inside Supply: A telecalling team that qualifies leads and schedules car evaluations at the customer’s preferred time and location

3. Inspection Ops: A fleet of technical evaluators who work in defined slots, moving from one scheduled evaluation to another. Each evaluator starts and ends their day from their home location 4. Closure: A tele-sales team responsible for price negotiation with sellers. They attempt to bridge price gaps by collaborating with sales teams, and schedule delivery once the price is agreed

5. Delivery Ops: A team of drivers and documentation agents who manage the final pickup, verify documentation, and trigger payment upon approval.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Lead Ground Operations (G1 Supply):**

● Oversee evaluation, delivery, documentation, and logistics for the G1 channel

● Drive key operational KPIs including fulfilment of scheduled evaluations and deliveries, operational SOP adherence, and quality metrics

● Manage hiring, training, daily operational planning and performance monitoring for the on-ground fleet

**2. Scale G3 Channel (B2B Supply):**

● Own the end-to-end funnel for the G3 channel — from lead generation to final delivery and price negotiations

● Lead growth and P&L for the G3 vertical in the respective geography

● Develop and execute strategies to expand partnerships with new car dealerships to maximise procurements from the exchange enquiries

● Manage a team of Business Development Managers (BDMs) responsible for relationship management and lead generation

**REQUIREMENTS**

● 3-6 yrs. of professional work experience, preferably have worked at a high growth startup/FMCG/FMCD in an execution driven role.

● Graduate from Tier 1/2 College/University.

● Good stakeholder management skills.

● Excellent written, communication, research, and analytical skills.

● Ability to think creatively about business problems and come up with solutions.

● Previous team management/leadership ability to lead teams of at least 15-20 members.

title: Consulting Manager
description:

.

* Drive outcomes through collaboration and influence across highly matrixed global organizations.

* Partner closely with Information Security, Operational Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Audit teams.
* Strengthen resilience, disaster recovery, business continuity, and operational readiness capabilities.
* Maintain rigorous controls appropriate for a highly regulated financial services environment.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent in related field.
* 20+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, technology delivery, and digital transformation.
* 15+ years of leadership experience managing large engineering organizations.
* Demonstrated success managing complex global technology organizations – prefer Bank’s GCC.
* Proven experience leading senior technology leaders, engineering managers, and architects.

* Strong background in software delivery, platform engineering, Dev/ML Ops, Site Reliability Engineering, and technology operations.
* Experience leading large-scale modernization and digital transformation initiatives.
* Expertise in Agile product development methodologies and engineering excellence frameworks.

* knowledge of Consumer Banking, Business Banking, Digital Banking and Money Movement technologies.
* Experience supporting customer-facing digital channels and financial products.
* Strong understanding of regulatory, risk, compliance, and security requirements within financial institutions.
* Experience operating in highly regulated environments.

**Leadership**

* Proven track record building and scaling engineering organizations with 500+ technology professionals.
* Exceptional ability to influence senior executives and drive outcomes without direct authority.
* Demonstrated success in talent development, succession planning, and organizational transformation.
* Strong executive presence with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams.

This role represents a unique opportunity to shape the future of the bank's consumer, business and digital technology landscape while building one of the industry's most impactful banking technology organizations in India.

title: Product Support Specialist
description:
**Product Support Specialist**

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**The Opportunity:**

We are seeking a Product Support Specialist to act as the bridge between Dwell subscribers and our engineering team. In this role, you will report to the director of revenue products. In this hybrid role, you will spend part of your time leading high-touch customer support and relationship management, and the other part translating those frontline insights into the product roadmap. You understand user pain points firsthand because you talk to customers every day, and you have the technical and strategic skills to build permanent solutions into our software or service offerings.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Customer Service & Advocacy**

* Customer Support Response Management: Handle approximately 200 customer support tickets per week for Dwell brand subscribers, including email tickets and phone support for customer voicemails
* Payment and Account Administration: Utilize Stripe platform to resolve customer access issues, update user email addresses and payment methods, and address general customer concerns
* Issue Analysis and Reporting: Create reports documenting common customer support issues in Google Docs/Sheets format to enable product teams to prioritize system improvements and enhance customer experience
* Third-Party Coordination: Collaborate with Dwell Magazine's fulfillment partner, CDS Global, to resolve complex customer issues that cannot be addressed through Stripe's platform capabilities
* Client Enablement: Create and update customer-facing knowledge bases, release notes, training materials, and troubleshooting guides.
* Relationship Management: Build trust-based relationships with subscribers, gathering qualitative feedback on product experience.

**Product Management**

* Feedback Synthesis: Analyze support ticket trends, churn reasons, and customer feature requests to identify systemic product gaps.
* Roadmap Prioritization: Own and prioritize the product backlog, balancing urgent customer fixes with long-term strategic product goals.
* Requirements Definition: Write Product Requirements Documents and user stories for the engineering and design teams.
* Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate with engineering, QA, and marketing to guide features from concept through launch, ensuring the support team is fully trained before release.
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) including Customer Satisfaction, Net Promoter Score (NPS), Customer Retention/Churn, and Feature Adoption Rates.
* Report monthly insights to executive leadership regarding how product updates impact customer happiness and business revenue.

**Job Qualifications:**

* Experience: 3+ years of combined experience in customer service management, customer success, or technical support, alongside 2+ years in an associate product manager or product-adjacent role.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Customer Empathy: Exceptional listening, patience, and written/verbal communication skills with a proven track record of de-escalating frustrated clients.
* Product Sense: Ability to look at a repetitive customer complaint and conceptualize a scalable, software-driven solution.
* Experience using modern helpdesk software (e.g., Zendesk, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud) and product management tools (e.g., Jira, Productboard, Linear, Asana).
* Preferred: basic technical literacy (familiarity with API logs, SQL, or web technologies) to effectively communicate tradeoffs with engineering teams.

**About Dwell**

For over two decades, Dwell has been the definitive voice of modern architecture and design, exploring how smart, intentional design makes everyday life better across print, Dwell.com, and social channels.

**About Ziff Davis**

Ziff Davis (NASDAQ: ZD) is a vertically focused digital media and internet company whose portfolio includes leading brands in technology, shopping, gaming and entertainment, connectivity, health, cybersecurity, and martech. Today, Ziff Davis is focused on seven key verticals – Technology, Connectivity, Shopping, Entertainment, Health & Wellness, Cybersecurity and Marketing Technology. Its brands include IGN, Mashable, RetailMeNot, PCMag, Humble Bundle, Spiceworks, Ookla (Speedtest), RootMetrics, Everyday Health, BabyCenter, Moz, iContact and Vipre Security.

**Our Benefits**

Lifestyle offers competitive salaries in addition to robust, health and wellness-focused benefits. We are committed to a work-life balance with paid time off when you need it.

At Ziff Davis, we remain dedicated to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to succeed. We offer Employee Resource Groups, company-sponsored events, and regular opportunities for professional growth through educational support, mentorship programs, and career development resources. Our employees are recognized and celebrated through employee engagement programs and recognition awards.

If you're seeking a dynamic and collaborative work environment where you can see the direct impact of your performance and thrive both personally and professionally, then Lifestyle is the place for you.

Ziff Davis is an Equal Opportunity Employer. At Ziff Davis, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) has always been about fairness, equal opportunity, and belonging. DEI enables us to attract and retain the best talent, regardless of background or circumstances, while enabling our thousands of employees worldwide to thrive. title: Senior Engineering Manager – AI CoE
description:
**Senior Engineering Manager** **– AI** **CoE**

**About Redwood**

Redwood Software helps the world's largest enterprises automate mission-critical business processes. Our platforms support complex enterprise workloads across ERP systems, business applications, cloud infrastructure, and on-premises environments.

Redwood is building reusable AI infrastructure, agentic capabilities, developer tools, and platform services that enable enterprise-ready AI features across its product portfolio.

**Role Mission**

As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will lead the engineering team responsible for delivering Redwood's shared AI platform and agentic capabilities.

You will translate the AI strategy into an executable engineering roadmap, build a high-performing team, and ensure the delivery of secure, scalable, observable, and commercially valuable AI systems. The role requires sufficient technical depth to guide architecture and challenge engineering decisions while remaining accountable for people's leadership, execution, team health, and delivery outcomes.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead one or more engineering teams responsible for AI platform services, agentic capabilities, developer tools, and product integrations.
* Translate business and product priorities into a clear engineering roadmap, delivery plan, and team-level objectives.
* Recruit, onboard, manage, and retain engineers with the skills required to build production-grade AI and agentic systems.
* Establish clear ownership, performance expectations, decision-making responsibilities, and development plans across the team.
* Drive predictable execution through effective planning, dependency management, risk identification, and operational readiness.
* Partner with senior individual contributors to guide architecture and technical direction without becoming a bottleneck for engineering decisions.
* Ensure consistent engineering practices across AI evaluation, observability, model governance, security, reliability, performance, and cost management.
* Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Security, Data, Legal, and product engineering teams to deliver enterprise-ready AI capabilities.
* Balance shared platform investments with customer-facing requirements and immediate product priorities.
* Monitor delivery, quality, platform adoption, incidents, operational performance, and engineering effectiveness.
* Establish an engineering culture focused on ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and customer outcomes.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance discussions, and career development planning.
* Communicate engineering progress, risks, dependencies, and investment requirements to senior stakeholders.
* Maintain sufficient technical involvement to understand architectural risks, challenge decisions, and support critical engineering outcomes.
  

**Scope and Expected Impact**

  

* Own engineering outcomes for a critical AI platform domain or multiple related engineering teams.
* Convert broad strategic priorities into measurable plans, milestones, and delivery commitments.
* Make organizational, staffing, prioritization, and delivery decisions with medium- to long-term impact.
* Create alignment across senior engineers, Product, Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders.
* Improve delivery predictability, platform adoption, engineering quality, and operational reliability.
* Scale the organization through clear ownership, repeatable engineering practices, and strong technical leadership.
* Ensure the team can deliver effectively without depending excessively on any single individual.

  

**Must Have Qualifications**

  

* 15+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 4+ years in an engineering people-management or team-leadership role.
* Experience leading one or more engineering teams responsible for complex software products or platform services.
* Demonstrated experience hiring, managing performance, coaching engineers, and supporting career development.
* Track record of delivering enterprise SaaS, cloud, distributed systems, platform, ML, or AI products into production.
* Strong working knowledge of generative AI, agentic architectures, LLM-based applications, orchestration, and production deployment considerations.

* Understanding agent workflows involving tool use, retrieval, enterprise data, APIs, memory, guardrails, and human oversight.

* Experience managing technical roadmaps, delivery risks, dependencies, incidents, quality, and operational performance.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, APIs, cloud-native systems, automated testing, CI/CD, security, and observability.
* Ability to guide technical decisions and architecture discussions while empowering senior engineers to own implementation.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical and business trade-offs to senior stakeholders.
* Experience working effectively with distributed and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to operate with high autonomy and manage ambiguity in a product or high-scale technology environment.

  

**Strong Plus**

  

* Experience establishing or scaling an AI platform, agentic engineering team, Center of Excellence, or developer platform function.
* Hands-on exposure to LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or custom agent orchestration frameworks.
* Experience with AI evaluation platforms, model gateways, vector databases, prompt lifecycle management, or AI observability tools.
* Understanding of responsible AI, model governance, privacy, compliance, and enterprise security requirements.
* Experience in enterprise middleware, workflow orchestration, ERP, automation, or integration platforms.
* Experience balancing greenfield platform development with the modernization of existing enterprise products.
* Experience working in regulated, security-sensitive, or high-availability environments.

  

**What Success Looks Like**

  

* Builds a healthy, appropriately staffed engineering team with clear responsibilities and strong technical ownership.
* Delivers AI platform and agentic capabilities predictably while maintaining security, reliability, quality, and cost discipline.
* Creates measurable adoption of shared AI capabilities across Redwood's product engineering teams.
* Establishes clear engineering standards for AI evaluation, observability, governance, and production readiness.
* Improves team effectiveness, delivery predictability, and operational performance.
* Develops capable engineers and reduces organizational dependency on individual contributors.
* Provides senior stakeholders with a clear, evidence-based view of progress, risks, dependencies, and investment requirements.

*If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!*

  

**THE LEGAL BIT**  
Redwood is an equal opportunity employer. Redwood prohibits unlawful discrimination based on race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, marital or veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member), sexual orientation, pregnancy or any other consideration made unlawful by regional or local laws. We also prohibit discrimination based on a perception that anyone has any of those characteristics or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of those characteristics. All such discrimination is unlawful and will have a zero tolerance policy applied to it.

Manager, Intelligent Automation
  
  
We are looking for an Intelligent Automation Manager for our JBS Business, as part of our Global Business Excellence and Transformation team. This is a senior developer role, one level below the P3 Senior Manager. The core role responsibilities are helping us build out the Automation capability for the organization — spanning RPA and Gen AI-enabled automation — and supporting the design, delivery, and maintenance of these solutions for our customers, as well as supporting the delivery of a broader array of technology initiatives for JBS.
  
About JLLWe're JLL. We're a professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We help organizations around the world achieve their ambitions by owning, occupying and investing in real estate.
  
If you're looking to step up your career, JLL is the perfect professional home. At JLL, you'll have a chance to innovate with the world's leading businesses, put that expertise into action on landmark projects, and work on game-changing real estate initiatives. You'll also make long-lasting professional connections through sharing different perspectives, and you'll be inspired by the best. We're focused on opportunity and want to help you make the most of yours. Achieve your ambitions - join us at JLL!
  
Role PurposeThe Intelligent Automation Manager for JBS role requires working collaboratively with teams and sponsors to design, build, and support automation solutions of varying size and complexity - primarily RPA, with growing exposure to Gen AI-enabled automation. This role will utilize technical and change management principles and tools to focus on driving financial results for assigned workstreams, ensuring deliverables are tangible and well-constructed, with the lead providing overall technical direction.
  
What This Job InvolvesResponsible for design, development, run support and maintenance of RPA solutions
  
Be a subject matter contributor in Automation - primarily RPA technologies (Automation Anywhere A360 & Power Platfrom), but also other low code/no code technologies and Gen AI-enabled automation - from a design/delivery/maintenance perspective
  
Be accountable for the design, development, and execution of the RPA and Gen AI-enabled automation solutions assigned to them
  
Design, develop, and implement RPA solutions using Automation Anywhere A360 to streamline processes and maximize efficiency
  
Design automation processes as per the operational needs of the organization, using Workload Management for scalability
  
Scripting/coding in the RPA tool to resolve automation issues
  
Review code and design for peer solutions, providing input on development and systems integration
  
Configure new automations with efficient and easily understandable automation tools
  
Document automation procedures
  
Collaborate with RPA Governance on best practices and code reviews
  
Contribute to training businesses on the use of RPA technologies and automation best practice
  
Participate in technical discussions and help develop strategies to solve technical challenges
  
Perform root-cause analysis for errors/incidents
  
Support the identification of the over-arching framework to deliver RPA and Gen AI-enabled solutions from inception to maintenance and ongoing monitoring of digital worker performance
  
Work closely with technology to support a holistic Automation SDLC that integrates and operates effectively with technology infrastructure requirements, including basic prompt-related considerations for Gen AI-enabled automations
  
Build and maintain effective communications with key stakeholders, cross functional leaders and project team members
  
Be accountable for delivering agreed internal client benefits for their assigned automations
  
Coach and guide developers where necessary
  
Contribute to a culture of process re-engineering into automation and Gen AI-enabled solution design
  
Model and develop robotic process and Gen AI-enabled solutions to reduce manual processes and improve employee productivity
  
Apply best practices to reduce complexity, improve scalability, reusability, security and increase efficiency through standardisation
  
Provide support in performing QA testing and supporting User Acceptance Testing as needed whilst contributing to the broader capability, including flagging inconsistent or unreliable Gen AI outputs for review
  
Support governance and regular report-out to help achieve defined outcomes within defined timeframes
  
The CandidateThe successful candidate will combine the ability to work with multiple teams/workstreams with prior experience delivering the benefits of transformational change.
  
The candidate needs a demonstrable and highly technical mind-set, strong design acumen in addition to excellent listening and communication skills. A logical, structured approach to problem solving and common sense are key.
  
ExperienceExtensive professional experience in a technology delivery role, ideally with exposure to a top-tier strategy consulting firm and/or a firm with a well-established transformation agenda

title: Software Engineering Manager -Big Data Engineering Manager
description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a **Software Engineering Manager** to lead a team of **engineers** building and operating **mission‑critical Risk and Finance data platforms**.

This role blends **software engineering leadership**, **data engineering** and **SRE practices**, with accountability for **platform reliability, data correctness, and operational excellence**. You will work closely with Risk, Finance, Infrastructure, and Platform teams operating with a strong **sense of urgency** in a highly regulated environment.

**In this role, you will:**

* Function as the technical representative for the product during cross-team collaborative efforts and planning
* Identify and recommend opportunities for driving resolution of technology roadblocks including code, build and deployment while also managing overall software development cycle and security standards
* Act as an escalation partner for scrum masters and the teams to make decisions and help remove impediments, obstacles, and friction while encouraging constant learning, experimentation, and continual improvement culture

* Manage allocation of people and financial resources for technology engineering including career development and performance management for engineers and managers on the team
* Hire, mentor and guide talent development of direct reports to build the skills required to effectively design and deliver innovative solutions for the supported product areas/products

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 2+ years of Leadership experience

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Big Data & Storage: Apache Iceberg, Hive, Big Data platforms
* Processing & Streaming: Spark, Kafka
* Platforms: Data Private Cloud, NexusOne Intelligence
* Cloud & Infra: Private Cloud / Hybrid Cloud environments
* Practices: CI/CD, observability, automation, incident management

**Job Expectations:**

* Lead engineers delivering **production-grade data platforms** for Risk, Finance, and Regulatory reporting.
* Own **reliability, availability, performance, and recoverability** of data platforms.
* Apply **SRE principles**: Observability, automation and tooling.
* Partner closely with **Risk and Finance stakeholders** to deliver accurate, reconciled, auditable data under strict deadlines.
* Collaborate daily with **Data Platform, Private Cloud, Infrastructure and platform teams**.
* Drive **fast, high‑quality execution** while balancing delivery, stability, and regulatory risk.
* Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
* Act with urgency to unblock teams, resolve issues, and keep critical platforms stable.

15 Oct 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. title: Team Lead – Implementation
description:
**About Clari5**
Clari5, a product of CustomerXPs (now part of the Perfios group), is a category-leading real-time Enterprise Financial Crime Management platform trusted by banks across 15+ countries. The platform processes 12 billion+ transactions and secures over 200 million accounts, helping financial institutions combat fraud, manage AML compliance, and drive revenue — all in real time. Clari5 is consistently recognised in Chartis RiskTech Quadrants and has won multiple global awards for fraud detection innovation.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Team Lead – Implementation is a high-impact delivery role within Clari5’s Global Professional Services team. You will lead end-to-end implementation engagements of the Clari5 platform at banking and financial institution clients, owning project delivery from kick-off to go-live. You will manage a small squad of functional and technical consultants, serve as the primary client interface during implementation, and ensure every deployment meets Clari5’s quality, timeline, and customer-satisfaction benchmarks.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of banking domain expertise, product knowledge, and project leadership — ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, client-facing environment and wants to shape how one of the world’s most advanced fraud management platforms goes live at marquee banks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implementation Delivery

+ Own end-to-end delivery of Clari5 implementations from project initiation to go-live and hypercare, ensuring adherence to scope, timelines, and quality benchmarks.
+ Create and maintain detailed project plans, milestone trackers, risk logs, and status dashboards for each engagement.
+ Drive sub-90-day go-live timelines by leveraging Clari5’s pre-built integration adapters and accelerators.
+ Manage parallel implementation streams (EFM, AML, Case Management) across banking channels and core banking integrations.
+ Coordinate UAT cycles, defect triage, and sign-off activities with client teams.
+ Client Engagement & Stakeholder Management

+ Act as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders (CTO, CIO, Risk Heads, IT teams) throughout the implementation lifecycle.
+ Conduct requirement-gathering workshops, present solution design documents, and validate functional configurations against client needs.
+ Manage client expectations proactively; communicate changes in scope, risk, and mitigation plans transparently.
+ Build lasting relationships that support successful post-go-live adoption and open doors for further engagement.
+ Team Leadership

+ Lead, mentor, and guide a team of 3–5 functional/technical consultants across implementation engagements.
+ Assign work, track deliverables, and conduct performance reviews for team members.
+ Foster a collaborative culture of continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and delivery excellence.
+ Onboard and ramp new team members on Clari5 product, banking domain, and delivery methodology.
+ Technical & Functional Oversight

+ Review and sign off on Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Solution Design Documents (SDDs), Interface Requirement Documents (IRDs), and test plans.
+ Oversee and validate configurations of fraud rules, AML scenarios, case workflows, and reporting dashboards.
+ Liaise with the Clari5 product engineering and DevOps teams on environment setups, deployments, patches, and escalations.
+ Ensure integrations with core banking systems (Finacle, Flexcube, Temenos, etc.), payment switches, and ancillary systems are correctly designed and executed.
+ Process & Quality

+ Enforce Clari5’s implementation methodology, quality gates, and project governance standards across all engagements.
+ Contribute to the development and improvement of delivery playbooks, templates, and best-practice documentation.
+ Conduct post-go-live reviews and capture lessons learned to continuously improve delivery quality.
+ Identify and escalate risks and issues in a timely manner with clear mitigation plans.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Must Have


+ 7–10 years of experience in banking technology delivery, with at least 3 years in a team lead or project lead capacity.
+ Hands-on experience implementing banking software products (fraud management, core banking, AML, payments, or similar enterprise banking solutions).
+ Strong working knowledge of banking channels and operations: Core Banking, Payments (RTGS/NEFT/UPI/SWIFT), Cards, Mobile/Internet Banking.
+ Experience preparing and reviewing BRDs, SDDs, IRDs, test plans, and go-live checklists.
+ Proficiency in project management methodologies (Agile/Scrum or Waterfall) and tools (Jira, MS Project, Confluence, or equivalent).
+ Unix Shell script/ Python/ Database(RDBMS, Oracle/MYSQL/MSSQL)/ Java Debugging etc
+ Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
+ Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and engagements.
+ Willingness to travel to client sites domestically and internationally.

* Good to Have


+ Prior experience implementing Fraud / AML platforms.
+ Exposure to integration middleware and API-based integrations (REST/SOAP) in a banking context.
+ Understanding of regulatory frameworks: RBI guidelines, FATF AML, PMLA, IRDAI, or regional equivalents.
+ PMP, Prince2, or equivalent project management certification.
+ Experience with BI/reporting tools and SQL for data validation during implementations.
+ Knowledge of real-time decisioning architectures, rule engines, and in-memory computing concepts.

Core Competencies
  
  
**Leadership & Delivery**

* Project & program management
* Team supervision & mentoring
* Risk & issue management
* Stakeholder communication

**Domain & Technical**

* Banking products & channels
* Fraud / AML platform configuration
* Core banking integrations
* SQL, APIs, test management tools

What We Offer
  
  

* Work on world-class fraud management technology deployed at Tier 1 banks across Asia, Middle East, and Africa.
* Exposure to complex, large-scale enterprise implementations — including the world’s largest real-time fraud management deployment.
* A dynamic, high-ownership environment where your impact is visible and your contributions are recognised.
* Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
* Opportunities for global travel and cross-geography client engagement.
* A collaborative team of banking technology veterans committed to delivery excellence.
* Access to Clari5’s continuous learning resources, product certifications, and industry events.

Earthful is a plant-based nutrition brand for women's health, backed by Fireside Ventures and V3 Ventures. • Keep every channel CM2-positive, tracking contribution margin by platform on a monthly basis

• Own strategic relationships with marketplace and quick-commerce platform category/account teams — unlocking better placements, programs, and support

• 3+ years of experience in marketplace, e-commerce, or quick-commerce roles, including directly managing a team

• Proven experience owning contribution margin (CM1/CM2) or channel profitability for an e-commerce or marketplace channel, not just topline revenue

• Direct, hands-on experience managing retail media and ad spend on marketplace platforms (Amazon Ads, Flipkart Ads) and/or quick-commerce sponsored placements

• Experience building or managing a team of Key Account Managers or similar account-owning roles

• Strong analytical and Excel/dashboard skills

title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.
  
  
We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Sell

+ Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
+ Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
+ Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
+ Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements

**Deliver**

* Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C-suite
* Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions
* Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
* Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
* Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time

**Manage People**

* Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
* Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
* Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
* Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume

You may be a fit if
  
  

* You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job
* You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
* You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement
* You've built and scaled IC-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

title: Associate Director - FIG
description:
**About Us**
At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our customers. Our Institutional bank helps our largest customers move trade and capital around the region, providing our people with great opportunities to build their technical expertise and their careers.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Associate Director in Financial Institutions Group, India, you will play an active role in driving a customer-centric, solutions-led and fast-growing FIG franchise. The role carries responsibility for client coverage, origination, portfolio management and execution activities, while contributing to revenue growth, risk discipline and high-quality client outcomes.
  
  
This is an independent Relationship Manager role with meaningful commercial accountability and exposure to client coverage in an Institutional setting. The role would suit a technically strong banker with sound commercial judgement, clear communication skills and the ability to contribute to origination, execution discipline, revenue delivery and portfolio growth. Understanding of relationship management, credit risk, key products and compliance is highly desirable
  
  
Financial Institutions Group (FIG) is a global business which entails tapping and optimising opportunities emanating from and into our global and regional clients and initiatives. It comprises Banks, Diversified Financials (DF), Insurance and Funds segments.
  
  
FIG India is part of the FIG South East Asia, India and Middle East (SEAIME) region and covers all the four FIG segments. The business offers its clients a wide range of products including clearing, FX, derivatives, precious metal sales, syndicated and bilateral loans, trade and debt capital markets.
  
  
FIG India is a growing business with a track record of prudent risk management, quality client coverage and superior returns.
  
  
Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
  
  
Role Location: Altimus, Mumbai
  
  
Role Type: Permanent
  
  
**What will your day look like?**

* Client Coverage: Take primary coverage responsibility for a portfolio of clients, while shadowing senior banker/s on strategic relationships. Develop a strong understanding of client priorities, decision-makers, wallet opportunities, and near-term revenue potential.
* Origination & Revenue Delivery: Support the origination of new business opportunities across the FIG portfolio, including identifying transaction ideas, maintaining an active pipeline, tracking deal conversion and contributing to revenue targets for the business.
* Portfolio Growth & Business Planning: Account planning, client prioritization and portfolio growth initiatives, including revenue budgeting, pipeline reviews, wallet analysis and preparation of business performance updates.
* Strategy and Planning: Contribute to FIG India’s strategic priorities through sector research, target client analysis, data-led insights and preparation of senior management presentations.
* Special Projects and Campaigns: Lead or support priority campaigns and special projects such as targeted segment campaigns, including financial sponsor banking initiatives.
* Information Management: Maintain accurate and actionable business information across revenue, pipeline, client activity and portfolio metrics to support timely decision-making.
* Transactional Support: Support transaction execution, documentation and client servicing in partnership with product, legal, risk, operations and support teams.
* Know Your Customer (KYC) & Customer Readiness: Ensure timely and thorough completion of inbound and outbound KYC for the portfolio, streamline the KYC process and ensure customers are deal-ready for key products and geographies.
* Risk & Compliance Assurance: Support disciplined business growth by ensuring activities are managed within applicable risk, compliance and governance standards.
* Product Exposure: Develop and apply knowledge of products relevant to FIG clients, including transaction banking for financial institutions (clearing, guarantees, local cash, trade), relationship lending, global markets investor sales, syndicated loans, debt capital markets and commodities

**What will you bring?**
To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
  
  

* A commercially minded team player who strives for excellence and demonstrates ownership of client and business outcomes working in a fast paced International bank.
* Ability to form effective working relationships with clients, senior bankers, product partners and internal stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving ability, growth mindset and capacity to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Good verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear client materials and senior management updates.
* High attention to detail and accuracy, particularly around pipeline, revenue, portfolio, KYC and transaction information.
* Graduate qualification in Commerce, Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline.
* Approximately 8-10 years of experience as a FIG Relationship Manager in banking.
* Experience with coverage of Indian Financial Sponsors and NBFCs will be considered positively.
* Understanding of origination processes, risk management and compliance requirements.
* Thorough understanding of banking regulation and local market nuances including Gift City.
* Understanding of the credit and documentation principles.
* Proficiency in computers, especially Co-Pilot, Microsoft Excel, word and PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical capability to review client, portfolio, pipeline and revenue information and translate it into actionable insights

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**So why join us?**
ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
  
  
We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.
  
  
We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.
  
  
To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number 124978.
