title: Investor Coverage Manager
description:
**Before the Bell (SintraCap Advisors LLP) · Lower Parel, Mumbai · Full time**

**Before the Bell is a pre-IPO deal desk for Indian family offices/AIF Cat 2 Funds.**

**Every company on the Before The Bell desk is profitable, private and on a path to a main-board listing, and each is checked by our bankers and CAs before an office sees it. Approved offices sign an NDA, read the same structured deal room for every company, put questions to the promoter and request allocations. We are looking for the person who owns those offices.**

**What you will do**

* Own the relationship with every registered family office, AIF, other investors: their mandate, ticket size, sectors and how they decide
* Bring 50 new principals, CIOs and CFOs onto the desk in your first two months, from your network and ours
* Walk an office through each new company within a week of it going live, and get their questions to the promoter
* Run promoter sessions with the analyst and the banker on the deal
* Turn interest into allocation requests, and requests into signed documents, alongside the deal team
* Keep an honest record of what each office wants and what it passed on, so the desk brings the right companies



**What you bring**

* 2–5 years in private wealth, a family office, an IPO syndicate desk, or PE fundraising in India
* Principals in India who take your call
* Comfort reading a P&L, a cap table and a draft offer document, and explaining a valuation against listed peers
* Judgement about what can and cannot be said about an unlisted company, and when to stop selling
* NISM certifications are a plus

**Why join**

**A small team that commits its own capital to the companies it brings; the companies on the next year's IPO calendar, seen early; a desk built on a modern platform rather than spreadsheets and WhatsApp forwards.**

* **Apply with a short note on the three offices you would bring first, to desk@beforethebell.in.**

title: Customer Success Executive
description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
We’re looking for someone who can walk into a boardroom with a CIO, CFO, or CHRO and be treated as a peer — not a vendor. This person owns post-sales outcomes across the full customer lifecycle — implementation, adoption, and value realization — in ServiceNow’s large enterprise accounts in India, building the trusted relationships and business fluency that connect the customer’s ambition to what ServiceNow can deliver. Success here isn’t measured by activity — it’s whether your accounts renew, expand, and see real value from the platform.
  
  
This is a foundational role with real room to grow — you’ll be building the account ownership and executive presence the next level of this career path demands.
  
  
**What You Get To Do In This Role**

* Develop and nurture executive relationships (CIO, CFO, CHRO, business unit leaders), building the kind of trust senior stakeholders extend over time
* Own the customer’s post-sales journey end to end — implementation, adoption, and value realization — and are accountable for the KPIs that matter: technical health, renewal, satisfaction, and expansion
* Help translate customer goals into a platform roadmap tied to measurable business outcomes
* Set clear, measurable success metrics with the customer, track progress, and refine the plan as milestones shift
* Support and help coordinate co-delivery models across ServiceNow, GSIs, and SI partners so delivery feels seamless to the customer
* Bring a discovery-first mindset — ask the right questions before proposing a fix, and know when to loop in accelerators, advisory sessions, or expert services
* Contribute to implementation and readiness strategies that help shorten time-to-value
* Support delivery governance on multi-track programs, including organizational change efforts
* Help build and communicate the value story for your accounts — able to speak to advisory and platform value, not just professional services ROI
* Champion ServiceNow’s best practices and stay current on how AI and agentic capabilities are changing customer operating models
* Deliver strong, durable customer satisfaction that shows up in renewals and expansion

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 8–12 years in a professional services or consulting environment, ideally with exposure to technology-enabled transformation (Digital/SaaS/Enterprise Software)
* Experience working with or supporting CxO-level stakeholders, with the poise to grow into owning those relationships directly
* Experience at large India enterprise accounts, with solid judgment navigating multiple stakeholders
* Strong command over knowledge of digital transformation — design, implementation, and management
* Emerging expertise in one industry
* IT, HR, or GBS transformation exposure
* Experience partnering with Big 4 or large SI’s in a delivery context
* 2–5 years of experience on large, multi-tracked programs, ideally including organizational change management
* Experience leveraging AI to enhance work processes, decision-making, and problem-solving — including AI-powered automation, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights
* Prior ServiceNow platform exposure is a strong plus — but we’ll weight fast learning and the ability to translate the platform into business language just as heavily

**Why This Role Is Worth Being Ambitious About**
You’ll be backed by proven practices drawn from thousands of engagements, with a clear runway for growth as you build account ownership and executive trust. If you want a role where every year adds visibly more responsibility and access, this is where that starts.
  
  
FD21

title: Manager, Agency Sales
description:
**About the Role**

Razorpay Ads is building a commerce media and audience intelligence business powered by Razorpay’s transaction ecosystem. We are looking for a
**Manager – Agency Sales**
to build and scale our relationships with leading media agencies, digital agencies, agency trading teams, and their advertiser portfolios.

This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of
**advertising, data, commerce and fintech**
. You will be responsible for making Razorpay Ads a strategic partner for agencies — helping them leverage Razorpay’s audience intelligence and media capabilities to solve advertiser objectives across performance, customer acquisition, brand building, audience targeting and measurement.

The role goes beyond selling individual campaigns. You will own agency relationships, develop advertiser pipelines within agency portfolios, unlock briefs and budgets, and build a repeatable agency-led revenue engine for Razorpay Ads.

**What You’ll Own**

**Agency Relationship & Business Development**

* Build and own strategic relationships across leading agency networks, independent agencies and digital/performance agencies.
* Develop strong relationships with senior stakeholders across
  **agency leadership, investment, planning, strategy, digital, performance and account management teams**
  .
* Establish Razorpay Ads as a preferred partner for data-led, commerce-media and performance advertising solutions.
* Create agency-level account plans covering priority agencies, key stakeholders, advertiser portfolios, opportunities and revenue potential.
* Drive regular agency engagements, capability sessions, workshops and joint client conversations.

**Advertiser & Revenue Development**

* Identify high-potential advertisers within agency portfolios and build a structured pipeline of briefs and opportunities.
* Work with agency teams to understand advertiser objectives, media plans, campaign challenges and investment priorities.
* Convert agency relationships into
  **active advertisers, repeat advertisers and scalable revenue opportunities**
  .
* Own the sales cycle from prospecting and solutioning through proposal, commercial negotiation, campaign closure and renewal.
* Drive penetration across priority categories including
  **BFSI, fintech, D2C, e-commerce, travel, consumer internet, auto and other digitally intensive categories**
  .
* Build quarterly and annual agency revenue plans and maintain strong visibility on pipeline, closures and forecasts.

**Consultative & Solution Selling**

* Translate advertiser and agency briefs into solutions using Razorpay Ads’ media, audience and data capabilities.
* Position Razorpay’s transaction-led audience intelligence as a differentiated alternative or complement to conventional digital targeting signals.
* Develop solutions spanning
  **audience intelligence, transaction-led targeting, onsite/offsite media, performance campaigns, brand campaigns and measurement**
  .
* Build compelling narratives and proposals that connect Razorpay’s capabilities to measurable advertiser outcomes.
* Partner with agencies to create customized solutions rather than relying on standardized inventory-led selling.

**Agency GTM**

* Build a structured GTM strategy for priority agency groups and their advertiser portfolios.
* Map agency stakeholders, key accounts, upcoming pitches, annual planning cycles and seasonal/festive opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for agency-level partnerships, preferred partner programs, joint pitches and advertiser workshops.
* Develop repeatable playbooks for converting agency relationships into briefs, campaigns and recurring advertiser investments.
* Represent Razorpay Ads at relevant agency forums, industry conversations and advertiser engagements.

**Campaign Success & Account Growth**

* Partner closely with Campaign Management, Product and Operations teams to ensure campaigns deliver against advertiser objectives.
* Stay engaged beyond campaign closure to ensure strong advertiser and agency experience.
* Use campaign results and insights to drive renewals, upsells and larger annual commitments.
* Identify opportunities to expand successful campaigns across brands, categories and agency teams.
* Build case studies and proof points that can accelerate adoption across the wider agency ecosystem.

**Market Intelligence & Product Feedback**

* Maintain a strong understanding of the Indian digital advertising ecosystem, agency structures, advertiser budgets and emerging media trends.
* Track competitive offerings across ad networks, commerce media, retail media, audience platforms and large digital publishers.
* Bring structured agency and advertiser feedback to Product, Strategy and Campaign teams.
* Help shape Razorpay Ads’ positioning, packaging, pricing and product roadmap based on market demand.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role will be measured primarily through:

**Agency penetration:**
Depth and quality of relationships across priority agencies and senior agency stakeholders.

**Active advertisers:**
Number of advertisers activated through the agency ecosystem.

**Quality advertisers:**
Ability to acquire strategic advertisers with meaningful and scalable budget potential.

**Advertiser retention:**
Repeat campaigns and continued investment from activated advertisers.

**Pipeline creation:**
Strength and quality of advertiser briefs and qualified opportunities generated through agencies.

**Revenue:**
Achievement of quarterly and annual revenue objectives.

**Strategic relationships:**
Ability to convert transactional agency relationships into long-term partnerships.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **5–8 years of experience**
  in agency sales, digital advertising, media sales, adtech, commerce media, publisher sales or related businesses.
* Strong existing relationships across
  **media agencies, digital agencies and/or performance agencies**
  in India.
* Demonstrated experience selling digital advertising solutions through agencies and influencing advertiser budgets.
* Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem including
  **Meta, Google, programmatic, publisher media, performance marketing and brand advertising**
  .
* Ability to engage comfortably with stakeholders ranging from agency planners and account leads to Business Heads, Managing Partners and CXOs.
* Strong consultative selling and solutioning capabilities — able to start with a client problem rather than an inventory proposition.
* Strong commercial orientation with experience owning pipelines, negotiations and revenue targets.
* Good understanding of advertising metrics including CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL, CPA, ROAS, reach, frequency and brand/measurement metrics.
* Ability to interpret campaign performance and convert results into a compelling growth narrative.
* Strong presentation, communication and negotiation skills.
* High ownership, bias for action and comfort operating in an early-stage business where GTM playbooks are still being built.

**Strong Plus**

* Experience working at an
  **ad network, large digital publisher, commerce/retail media network, DSP, adtech platform or agency partnership function**
  .
* Existing relationships across leading agency networks and independent digital agencies.
* Experience selling to BFSI, fintech, D2C, e-commerce or consumer internet advertisers.
* Experience selling both
  **performance and branding solutions**
  .
* Exposure to first-party data, audience intelligence, CDPs, clean rooms, retail/commerce media or transaction-led advertising.
* Experience building a new agency channel or GTM motion from an early stage.

**The Person We’d Like to Hire**

We are looking for someone who is
**well-networked but not dependent on their network; commercially aggressive but consultative in approach; comfortable selling what exists today while helping shape what needs to be built tomorrow**
.

The ideal candidate understands how agencies operate, knows how budgets and briefs move through the ecosystem, can open senior-level conversations, and has the persistence and strategic thinking required to turn those relationships into a sustainable revenue engine for Razorpay Ads.

title: Sr Sales Manager
description:

The organization provides comprehensive end-to-end logistics services, offering clients and partners a one-stop logistics platform. Headquartered in New Delhi, Navigators covers all major metros, key sea ports, and airports in India, with an international office in Shenzhen, China. * Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools, and comfort working with data to support decision-making.
* Prior experience in managing sales in Ahmedabad or similar markets, and willingness to travel for client meetings as needed.

title: Channel Ops Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Honeywell is seeking a highly motivated and analytical
**Channel Operations Manager**
to drive operational excellence across our channel partner ecosystem. This role is responsible for managing channel operations, partner performance governance, sales process optimization, program execution, reporting, and business insights to support revenue growth and customer satisfaction.
  
  
The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Marketing, and Authorized Channel Partners to ensure efficient execution of channel programs, accurate forecasting, partner compliance, and operational effectiveness.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Channel Operations Management**

* Lead daily channel operations supporting distributors, system integrators, resellers, and strategic partners.
* Ensure smooth execution of channel programs, partner onboarding, and operational processes.
* Monitor compliance with Honeywell channel policies, procedures, and contractual requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance channel efficiency and productivity.

**Channel Expansion**

* Assess channel coverage models and identify gaps.
* Lead new partner identification, evaluation, onboarding, and ramp-up.
* Drive partner capability development and business growth initiatives.
* Champion partner enablement and adoption of tools and programs.

**Sales Operations & Analytics**

* Develop and maintain channel performance dashboards, KPIs, and business reports.
* Analyze sales trends, pipeline health, bookings, and partner productivity metrics.
* Provide actionable insights to leadership teams for business planning and decision-making.
* Support sales forecasting, quota tracking, and territory performance reviews.

**Partner Program Administration**

* Administer channel incentive programs, rebates, MDF (Market Development Funds), and promotional activities.
* Validate partner claims and ensure accurate incentive calculations and processing.
* Manage partner segmentation, certifications, and performance scorecards.
* Support partner engagement initiatives and operational communications.

**Process Excellence**

* Identify process gaps and implement automation opportunities.
* Standardize channel management practices to improve scalability and effectiveness.
* Collaborate with IT and business stakeholders to eCommerce.
* Ensure data integrity across Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, or other business systems.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Customer Service, and Supply Chain teams.
* Resolve operational issues affecting channel partners and customers.
* Support business reviews, audits, and compliance requirements.
* Participate in strategic planning and channel transformation initiatives.

**Leadership Expectations**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales Leadership and Country Management teams.
* Influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives involving Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Marketing, and Operations.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Channel revenue growth
* New Partner Contribution
* Forecast accuracy
* Rebate and incentive processing accuracy
* Channel productivity metrics
* Inventory Health & Aging
* Data quality and reporting accuracy
* Program adoption and compliance rates
* Operational process efficiency improvements

**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Operations Management, Finance, or related field.
* MBA preferred.

**Experience**

* 10-15 years of experience in Channel Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, or Partner Management.
* Experience supporting indirect sales channels in industrial automation, building automation, or industrial products sectors preferred.
* Experience working with global and regional channel partners.
* Demonstrated success in leading business planning and performance governance initiatives.

**Technical Skills**

* Microsoft Power point, Microsoft Excel and Power BI skills.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce CRM, SAP, Oracle, or equivalent systems.
* Data analysis, forecasting, and reporting expertise.
* Process improvement and project management skills.
* Understanding of channel incentive and rebate programs.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
* High attention to detail and operational discipline.
* Customer-focused mindset with strong business acumen.
* Ability to influence without direct authority.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a multinational organization.
* Experience managing large-scale channel transformation initiatives.
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies.

**What Success Looks Like**
Within the first 12 months, the Channel Operations Manager will:
  
  

* Increase revenue from new and existing channels
* Improve channel operational efficiency and process compliance.
* Enhance visibility through robust reporting and analytics.
* Drive higher partner engagement and program adoption.
* Support sustainable channel revenue growth across Honeywell businesses.

**Honeywell Competencies**

* Customer Focus
* Results Orientation
* Innovation & Continuous Improvement
* Collaboration & Teamwork
* Integrity & Accountability

Strategic Thinking
  
  
**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

**The Opportunity:**

We are seeking a Product Support Specialist to act as the bridge between Dwell subscribers and our engineering team. In this role, you will report to the director of revenue products. * Issue Analysis and Reporting: Create reports documenting common customer support issues in Google Docs/Sheets format to enable product teams to prioritize system improvements and enhance customer experience
* Third-Party Coordination: Collaborate with Dwell Magazine's fulfillment partner, CDS Global, to resolve complex customer issues that cannot be addressed through Stripe's platform capabilities
* Client Enablement: Create and update customer-facing knowledge bases, release notes, training materials, and troubleshooting guides.

title: Manager - Credit Implementation
description:
### **FinBox: Where Fintech Meets Fun!**

Welcome to FinBox, the buzzing hive of tech innovation and creativity!

Since our inception in 2017, FinBox has built some of the most advanced technologies in the financial services space that help lenders like Banks, NBFCs and large enterprises build and launch credit products within a matter of days, not months or years. FinBox is a Series B funded company which is expanding globally with offices in India, Vietnam, Indonesia and Philippines.

Our vision is to build the best-in-class infrastructure for lending products and help Banks & Financial Services companies across the world scale and launch credit programs that set a new standard in the era of digital finance. So far, we’ve helped our customers disburse Billions of Dollars in credit across unsecured and secured credit including personal loans, working capital loans, business loans, mortgage and education loans. FinBox solutions are already being used by over 100+ companies to deliver credit to over 5 million customers every month.

### **Why Should You be a FinBoxer:**

* **Innovative Environment:** At FinBox, we foster a culture of creativity and experimentation, encouraging our team to push the boundaries of what's possible in fintech.
* **Impactful Work:** Your contributions will directly impact the lives of millions, helping to provide fair and accessible credit to individuals and businesses alike.
* **Growth Opportunities:** We are a Series B funded startup and have ample opportunities for growth, professional development and career advancement.
* **Collaborative Culture:** Join a diverse and inclusive team of experts who are passionate about making a difference and supporting one another.

### **Who’s a Great FinBoxer:**

At FinBox, we’re on the lookout for exceptional folks who are all about innovation and impact. If you’re excited to shake things up in the banking & financial services world, keep reading!

**Creative Thinkers:** If your brain is always bubbling with out-of-the-box ideas and wild solutions, you’re our kind of person. We love disruptors who challenge the norm and bring fresh perspectives to the table.

**Customer Heroes:** Our customers are our champions, and we need heroes who can understand their needs, deliver magical experiences, and go above and beyond to keep them happy.

**Team Players:** We believe in the power of “we.” If you thrive in a collaborative environment, value different viewpoints, and enjoy being part of a spirited, supportive team, you’ll fit right in.

### **What You’ll Do:**

* Own end-to-end implementation of credit and lending products for new FinBox clients
* Collaborate with client credit/risk teams to define underwriting criteria, rule sets, and approval logic
* Translate credit policies into technical configurations within FinBox’s decisioning tools and APIs
* Coordinate cross-functionally with internal product, engineering, and customer success teams
* Act as the subject matter expert for credit risk workflows—pre, during, and post go-live
* Monitor early performance of launched credit products and recommend improvements
* Continuously refine implementation playbooks, templates, and best practices

### **What We’re Looking For:**

* 3-5 years of experience in **credit underwriting**, credit operations, or credit product management
* Strong exposure to **retail and/or SME lending processes in banks, NBFCs, or Fintechs**
* 2+ years of hands-on experience in project management or credit tech implementation roles
* Familiarity with decisioning systems, rule engines, and credit scoring models
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills - internal and external
* A problem-solving mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in ambiguity
* Bonus: **Experience working with BRE, policy frameworks, and low-code/no-code platforms**

The Data Center Engineering Operations Cluster Manager is responsible for the management of all aspects of the performance of the data centre infrastructure within the region. The role requires a highly driven, self-managed individual who demonstrates initiative and proactively seeks solutions to problems.  
  
Amazon Data Centres  
  
AWS pioneered cloud computing in 2006, creating cloud infrastructure that allows customers build securely and innovate faster. We continuously innovate the designs and systems within our Data Centres to protect them from man-made and natural risks. As a result, Amazon data centres are large-scale high-density centres where you will work on changing the face of Cloud Technology in the region.

To succeed in Amazon, people must be self-motivated, highly technically-minded and intent on delivering world-class results. * Setting and maintaining the highest standard for safety and actively promoting a world-class safety culture

* Delivering 100% uptime on all customer supporting infrastructure

* Managing strong technical teams with responsibility for the training and/or development of others to ensure operational excellence
* Successful delivery of a portfolio of strategic projects on critical infrastructure
* The successful delivery of build-out and retrofit of facility infrastructure in existing and new regional locations
* Managing vendor performance by consistently setting high standards, driving accountability and conducting regular performance reviews
* Risk Management: adopt and plan corporate risk strategy.
* Critical Event Response readiness (planning, escalation/incident management, customer impacting event management response and recovery.)
* Experience working and managing within complex organizational matrix, manage and grow relationships between cross-functional teams.

  
Key job responsibilities  
This position within Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) requires broad Data Center knowledge with Subject Matter Expertise (SME) in as many specific fields as possible. The location for this job will be in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

About the team  
About AWS  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 12+ years of management experience
* Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Knowledge of the electrical and mechanical systems involved in critical data center operations including systems such as feeders, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, ATS units, PDU units, chillers, pumps, air handling units, and CRAC units
* Experience with large scale mechanical and power systems
* Experience hiring, developing, and managing high-performing technical teams

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of electrical engineering best practices including breaker coordination studies, switchgear sequence of operation, and NEC code
* Experience owning the operation of a mission-critical team or product
* Experience with large-scale technical operations or large-scale compute farms
* Experience with process improvement techniques such as Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma

Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
The Customer Renewal Manager (CRM) is responsible for driving the end-to-end renewal lifecycle for assigned customers in a defined Unit/Area. As part of Teradata’s Go-To-Market (GTM) organization, this position will serve as the primary role responsible for sustaining/renewing customers and growing our ARR baseline. The CRM will partner closely with the Account team including Customer Experience and Finance to ensure effective account collaboration and cancels and erosions prevention.
  
  
The CRM will be responsible for managing several customers to business objectives including recurring revenue retention and growth, on-time renewal execution, expansions, and outlook accuracy. The CRM will work with the account team on account planning to identify customer needs/risks and opportunities both in preparation for upcoming renewals as well as mid-term adjustments and Cloud opportunities. The CRM is responsible for being the expert in Teradata’s renewal/sustainment strategy and works directly with the customer to negotiate standard and custom renewals including terms, SLAs and penalties. The CRM will align the renewal strategy with the Account Executive (AE), Customer Solution Architect (CSA) and wider account team to achieve optimal results.
  
  
A key responsibility of the CRM is completing and executing preventive actions on Cancellations and Erosions, leveraging early insights and collaborating with Field Technology Management, Services Delivery Management and Customer Services Management. The CRM will be responsible for the development, application and delivery of cancel and erosion save plans alongside the Customer Services Architect (CSA), with the aim to increase customer retention and revenue retention; in addition to the identification of upsell and cross sell.
  
  
As an integrated member of the GTM account team, this role is primarily responsible for retaining recurring revenue across Teradata’s business through exceptional renewal sales execution. This includes building and maintaining strong partnerships with both internal and customer stakeholders.
  
  
**Renewal Scope Areas Include**
:
  
  

* Basic understanding of the components that make up a renewal in order to articulate the e2e solution.
* Understanding of sales process including managing account relationships and customer interaction.
* Renewals includes any revenue in Teradata that has been previously sold and should be retained through repeat contracting on a scheduled basis, including Term, Cloud, Maintenance and SWUR.
* Turn-key Renewals: CRM will own the oversight of the renewal process, managing customer engagement supported by the process from the back-office teams.
* Upsell/Cross-Sell/New-Sell: In certain circumstances the CRM will own the sales cycle for the generation of new revenue. This will be part of the normal renewal lifecycle in accounts, where there is opportunity to expand the scope of the renewal to new business, like increasing a customer support Success Tier and Cloud services.
* Customer Presentations: Prepare and deliver customer presentations to align with business objectives and ensure common understanding of scope of work and renewal strategy. Renewal Contract documentation: Be responsible for overseeing or/and preparation & development of renewal contract/SOW as necessary.
* Technical knowledge of database systems, operating systems (desirable)

**Account planning, selling and negotiating are core elements of success in this role. This role will focus on:**

* Effective account planning and renewal preparation, leveraging the entire Teradata portfolio to protect and drive recurring revenue growth
* Renewing Teradata's recurring revenue footprint with existing customers with on-time accuracy and oversight of all contract lifecycle management activities
* Creation and execution of Cancel and Erosion save plans, with the aim to increase customer retention and revenue retention.
* Maintaining forecast accuracy and participating in Sales Outlook cadence calls
* Participate in quarterly services delivery and operational excellence reviews
* Capable of understanding Teradata analytic technology, to find the customer value and competitive position that drives price in opportunities for customer use of Teradata products and services
* Creative thinker able to come up with alternatives that increase offer effectiveness and protect current and future price realization
* Ability to work closely with sales and sales management, and draw on other company resources
* The ability to professionally discuss business issues with management and offer advice and alternatives
* Ability to review and interpret complex contract/customer agreement detail

It will be vital for the CRM to build strong relationships and drive collaboration with other functions in the business.
  
  
**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* BSc/BA degree or equivalent
* Minimum of 5 years related work experience

**What You Bring**

* Demonstrated sales success managing account relationships and developing new account opportunities
* Ability to work with multiple Customers at the same time including capturing each engagement’s discussions, notes, follow-up, issues, etc.
* Ability to work successfully at the intersection of business, technology and services and translate/communicate across both
* Presence: enthusiastic and high energy, but also poised, confident and extremely professional
* Innovative and assertive, with the ability to pick up new technologies and assess situations quickly
* Fluent in the following tools:
* Salesforce, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, ERP, Install Base and Contract Lifecycle Management solutions
* Advanced interpersonal, listening and communication skills, including presentation and facilitation skills, and a track record of effectively communicating with and influencing at all levels
* Must possess excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proven project and time management skills with ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team environment and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Demonstrate personal and professional values consistent with Teradata’s values.
* Be highly collaborative, transparent, organised, detail oriented and a stickler for accuracy

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Manager, Identity Maturity Acceleration
description:
**Why SailPoint?**

Love what you do. And love where you do it. Smart people, fun culture, innovative work, beautiful offices — oh, and everyone’s really nice. That’s what people say about SailPoint. We’re known as the company where everyone wants to work, and we have the awards to prove it. If you’re passionate about outsmarting cybercriminals and working at a company where you can truly have an impact, we want you to join our team.

SailPoint empowers the largest, most complex organizations by putting identity at the Center of Security and IT.  Our 2,000+ customers include global financial institutions, government entities, and pharmaceutical organizations and more.

**About the role:**

SailPoint is the leading AI-driven identity security platform delivering autonomous governance to secure the modern enterprise. We provide unified security across the human fabric (employees, contractors, partners) and the emerging agentic/non-human fabric (autonomous AI agents, machine identities, service accounts).

Within SailPoint’s Identity Maturity Acceleration (IMA) organization, the Manager, Agentic Identity Acceleration is a high-impact, client-facing growth role designed for an ambitious, humble, and technically grounded professional ready to step into practice leadership.

In this customer-facing role, you will partner with our elite Technical Advisors (TAs) to guide enterprise clients through modern identity governance, AI agent security, and maturity acceleration using the SailPoint Agentic Fabric and SailPoint Atlas. This role offers a clear path to develop your executive advisory presence, lead strategic client programs, and grow into a full-scale practice leader.

**What You Will Do**

Client Advisory & Program Acceleration (60%)

* Executive Partnership & Steering Committees: Partner with client IAM leaders, CISOs, and enterprise stakeholders to run steering committees, track program milestones, and communicate business value across human and agentic identity programs.

* Support & Amplify Technical Advisors: Work hand-in-hand with designated Technical Advisors on key enterprise accounts—handling engagement planning, stakeholder alignment, and operational health so the TA can lead technical architecture with CISOs and AI Officers.

* Maturity Framework Guidance: Help clients assess and progress along the Identity Maturity Acceleration (IMA) curve, moving from foundational governance (Horizons 1–2) toward advanced, automated security (Horizons 4–5).

* Engagement Health & Scope Governance: Monitor delivery health, identify risks early, and coordinate with Delivery Partners and System Integrators to ensure engagements stay on track and deliver on contracted outcomes.

* GTM & Scoping Collaboration: Work alongside Sales, Sales Engineering, and Agentic Technology Specialists (ATS) to assist in scoping Advisory and Delivery Assurance proposals.

Practice Development & Growth (40%)

* Mentorship & Team Coordination: Coordinate day-to-day engagement assignments, mentor junior team members, and foster a collaborative, high-trust team culture.

* AI-Augmented Operational Learning: Eagerly adopt and test internal AI accelerators (e.g., Harbor Pilot), automated workflows, and agentic tools to make practice reporting and status tracking faster and more efficient.

* Field Insights Feedback: Gather feedback and emerging use cases from client interactions to help Product and GTM teams refine our Agentic Fabric offerings.

* Continuous Personal Development: Actively seek coaching from senior leadership to expand your executive presence, C-level communication, and commercial acumen.

**Who You Are (Qualifications & Mindset)**

* Hungry, Humble & Curious: You bring strong self-awareness, low ego, and high intellectual curiosity. You love learning new technologies (especially AI and identity) and are eager to prove yourself in a leadership capacity.

* Experience Baseline: 5 –10+ years of progressive experience in IAM/IGA, Cybersecurity consulting, Technical Account Management, or SaaS Professional Services.

* Technical & Domain Foundation: Solid foundational knowledge of Identity Governance, access lifecycles (JML), cloud security, and an eager appetite to master Non-Human Identities (NHI) and autonomous AI agent concepts.

* Consultative Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead structured client meetings, present project findings clearly, and navigate stakeholder expectations.

* Project & Delivery Organization: Demonstrated experience managing multiple client projects, tracking deliverables, mitigating risks, and maintaining engagement momentum.

* Leadership Potential: Prior experience informally mentoring peers, leading project squads, or acting as a lead consultant, with a clear desire to grow into people management.

**Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent practical experience.**

SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.  

Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. Contact applicationassistance@sailpoint.com or mail to 11120 Four Points Dr, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78726, to discuss reasonable accommodations.  NOTE: Any unsolicited resumes sent by candidates or agencies to this email will not be considered for current openings at SailPoint.

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Guidance Notes**
This job profile provides a broad overview of the Job Category Client Management and is not intended to exhaustively describe the role.
  
  
**Job Profile: GCB 5**
The Global Payment Solutions (GPS) Account Manager (AM) is responsible for the global satisfaction of a portfolio of GPS clients. The purpose of this role is to ensure clients receive a superior service experience both locally and globally; to be a client’s single point of contact for service for those complex queries that are fall above and beyond basic transactional queries.
  
  
The Account Manager’s portfolio will be a mix of top tier, highly complex GPS clients and complex clients. The Account Manager will be accountable for the overall satisfaction with GPS produts and services and support the broadening and deepening of these client relationships to drive commercial outcomes for the GPS business.
  
  
This includes overseeing execution of query management for the client, oversight of transactional activity, providing insights to clients on how to optimize through Client Service Reviews, coordination of a clients global Treasury and Cash Management initiatives and projects, and proactively managing the GPS client relationship on a day to day basis. Depending on the complexity and geography of the client this role will either lead the client relationship or play a supporting role on a global squad covering the client.
  
  
**Basic Job Expectations**

* Manage the liquidity and cash management needs of a portfolio of Financial Institutions, Multi-National Corporations and Local Corporates. Maintain relationships with key influencers in the client’s local or regional Treasury and Finance organisation.
* Be accountable for the retention of annual revenue of your portfolio of clients, including capturing opportunities and supporting growth of your clients (revenue targets included in scorecard)
* Accountable for the identification of opportunities to deliver Client Service excellence locally and regionally; effectively managing any risks and issues.
* Responsible for resolving assigned queries.
* Accountable for monitoring and guiding the completion of all global queries and local basic queries that may be assigned to others.
* The role holder must have a strong understanding of the cash management business including identifying and dealing with actual or potential business or relationship risks.
* Strong written and oral communication skills; must be able to put complex product and/or technical information into simple terms.
* Maintain a client footprint with the basic information required to deliver a superior client experience.

**Senior Account Manager**
In addition to the above activities, the
**Senior Account Manager**
will also be:
  
  

+ The point of escalation for other stakeholders supporting the client and for the client themselves on all GPS Service engagements when they are the lead.
+ The point person to coordinate projects focused on existing business retention (i.e. GBS/TWIST billing global setups, file format conversions, Connect Digital migration).
+ Will proactively review local/regional client activity and existing solutions with GPS in order to identify any opportunities to improve the client’s experience with HSBC. This includes but is not limited to; reducing service queries and reject/error rates, streamlining processing time, improved data/payment security, identify opportunities to streamline client processes, eliminate redundancy, strengthen relationships, and increase wallet share by recomending new products & solutions that will benefit the client’s business operations.
+ Will provide analysis and recommendations to senior management on client focus, attrition, and engagement.

Monitor metrics and performance indicators of service levels and develop and implement remedial actions as needed.
  
  

* Continuously adapt to balance and prioritise different demands of their portfolio while managing requirements from multiple stakeholders

**Customer Engagement**

* Engage with their client’s operational and Treasury teams as needed or agreed to with the client. This includes but is not limited to a client’s Treasury Operations and IT teams and the wider Finance and Treasury Organization.
* Gather and maintain specific intimate knowledge of their client’s Treasury operations and how they interface with HSBC products and services.
* Engage and work cross functionally with various internal partners (Operations, Technology, Sales, and the RM) coordinating client interactions and recommendations relating to existing GPS business. Must be flexible and willing to go outside work assignment boundaries to ensure their client’s satisfaction.
* Develop and deliver standard Client Service Reviews on an ad hoc basis using key client metrics to proactively identify issues and trends including things like payment flows, rejection and return rates, and industry benchmarks. Work with the client and internal stakeholders to remediate and improve metrics to benefit the client.

**Qualifications**
**Essential**

* Strong knowledge of local and global cash management and clearing services, products, and techniques.
* Proven ability in identifying and meeting customer needs through matching a broad range of products and services.
* Ability to understand a customer’s business and the fundamentals of running a business.
* Good level of business acumen and commercial awareness, including economic, cultural, procedural, and regulatory issues
* Strong range of communication skills, including written, verbal, and the ability to deliver compelling presentations.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to interact and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to thrive in a complex matrix environment with several stakeholders with differing goals/expectations.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced work environment; continually changing lines of communication, technological advances etc.
* Excellent time management, planning and organization skills with ability to manage multiple time sensitive tasks.
* Strong analytical skills
* Ability to travel.

**Desirable**

* Previous banking experience working with FIs/Corporates in a relationship or account management role. Specific experience with large multi-national corporations or financial institutions including Global/Regional HQ names will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of day-to-day workings of a Corporate Treasury environment, foreign exchange, intercompany loans, payroll, and payments.
* Knowledgeable about our competitors’ products and services, strategies, and client relationship practices.
* Broad knowledge of HSBC Group companies and product ranges

**Pro Tip:**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  
**Additional Notes:**
Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required
  
  
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
  
  
Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India

title: Team Lead – Business Operations (Customer Order Management)

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
  
  
We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
Job title: Team Lead – Business Operations (Customer Order Management)
  
  
Job location: Pune
  
  
As Team Lead – Business Operations, you will be responsible for achieving functional excellence in Customer Order Management. This includes managing the process from Order Booking to Closure. Additionally, you will drive business productivity and Operational efficiency across the organisation. Furthermore, you will adopt technological advancements to automate processes. Manage engagement for Business in areas of Order Management & Invoicing (Contracts Delivery Operations) and work with global partner to finds areas to reduce complexity, standardise and improve the way of execution. You will report into Manager – Business Operations and will have a hybrid working. We will ask to provide strategic leadership to assigned organisation.
  
  
You will be reporting to MANAGER GEBS BUSINESS OPERATIONS.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Lead / manage Business operations assignments (Customer order booking), which are moderate to high in complexity, following all relevant procedures.
* Provide leadership to the assigned team to lead efficiency in execution.
* Maintain the confidentiality of sensitive and proprietary technical, financial, and commercial information.
* Manage business process transitions and find areas to reduce complexity in building the tasks and standardising the way of execution.
* Ensure that you adequately document all audits (internal/external), and deal with risk areas promptly.
* Engage with multiple partners to identify opportunities for increased engagement, seek feedback on deliverables and to improve overall engagement
* Provide deliverables of good quality on time and on budget with high levels of Internal Customer Satisfaction, ensuring the team delivers them.
* Manage use of all resources and ensure accurate capacity planning.
* Manage resources and to assign right skills to the work.
* Work with required regional & domestic partners to ensure compliance & smooth processing of the activities/processes assigned.
* Manage & use the Business ops resources throughout different Regions for required support
* Use resources to ensure the team to meet process requirements defined in Standard Processes also respects the Quality Management System processes.
* Manage team performance to develop team capability and motivate the team. Create developmental plans for any identified gaps.
* Support best practice sharing and knowledge transfer among teams to improve competency of whole team.
* Lead the teams in Operations including third-party resources to comply with RA standards.
* Assess and develop competency and capabilities among the team. Encourage multi-skilling within the team to ensure better use.

**Leadership**

* A conceptual and out of the box thinker with experience establishing processes, SOPs, streamlining workflow and creating teamwork environment to enhance the productivity.
* Maintain professional demeanour, show empathy for customers, communicate and respect.
* Create an work environment by establishing positive and respectful work relationships.
* Commitment to achieving goals and guiding issues to resolution.
* Hold self and team accountable for keeping commitments, maintaining standards, and achieving goals. Develop people & teams – Planning and supporting relevant, learning for individuals and teams
* Build Organisational Talent - Takes responsibility for individual performance and is aware of team performance goals.
* Work with all partners (in varying roles and departments); provide succinct information on time
* Experience with delivering excellent customer experience.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree. Diploma / degree in Business Administration
* Minimum of 10+ years of relevant experience in Business Operations.
* Typically requires 5+ years of hands-on experience in the Order-to-Cash (O2C) process lifecycle (Projects / contracts delivery or fulfilment)
* Have exposure to Global Work style, engagement with clients while sitting at remote locations.
* Willing to work in flexible business shifts / global time zones including NA/LA time zone to lead partner connect
* Flexibility to travel, 10% of the time, within and outside India (if required) to meet functional, client/ stakeholder teams

**Preferred**

* Master's in Business Administration
* Experience in technological adoption for process automation, optimization as well enhancements for increased efficiency with sustained / improved customer satisfaction.
* Lean Six Sigma Certification (Green Belt & above).

**What We Offer**
Our benefits package includes …
  
  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!

*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: Engagement Manager
description:
Bit about us

At Progreva, our mission is to be a leading progressive, values-driven organization that transforms the employee experience, whether in the office, at home or wherever our people choose to work. Our employees’ and contractors’ well-being comes first.

We’re building a culture of camaraderie, work-life balance and empathy, where people feel comfortable, confident and empowered, with the ownership, space and autonomy to succeed.

We believe that when we take great care of our people, they take exceptional care of our clients. That’s why we work only with clients who share our employee-centric values. And yes, we also build breakthrough digital products for our global clients, and have fun along the way!

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced
**Engagement Manager**
to lead Progreva’s engagement with a global energy-technology enterprise, delivered through our European delivery partner. The role has three parts:

·      a
**hands-on consultant**
embedded in the client’s IT organisation

·      a
**trusted advisor**
who helps application owners modernise their systems and grows the account

·      the
**people lead**
for the Progreva engineers on the programme

You will help the client’s application managers put their needs into words, show them what modern technology makes possible, and turn that into well-scoped work for our team. You will also build the same consultative, opportunity-spotting mindset in our engineers.

Responsibilities:

Client-facing Business Analysis

·      Work inside the client’s IT organisation as a
**billable business analyst / application consultant**
, first alongside an experienced Progreva consultant, then on your own.

·      Run
**requirement workshops**
with application managers and users, and turn their needs into user stories, acceptance criteria and prioritised backlogs.

·      Create and maintain
**application documentation**
: functional specs, process flows, architecture overviews, user guides and runbooks.

·      Find
**security and compliance gaps**
(penetration-test findings, access management, outdated components) and coordinate the fixes.

Account Growth & Solutioning

·      Map the client’s applications, understand each product’s users and roadmap, and spot pain points early.

·      Shape
**modernisation opportunities**
: .NET upgrades, cloud migration, UX redesign, test automation and QA, AI automation, data platforms, dashboards and analytics.

·      Turn opportunities into
**scoped proposals**
(problem, solution, estimate, business value), and work with Progreva leadership and our delivery partner to turn them into statements of work.

·      
**Coach engineers**
to spot improvement opportunities in their own products, run regular opportunity reviews, and collect each application’s annual roadmap.

·      Maintain the
**account opportunity pipeline**
and report growth progress to Progreva leadership.

Team Management

·      
**Set clear goals and expectations**
, track individual and team performance, and give regular feedback and support for career development.

·      
**Handle escalations**
as the first point of contact for delivery issues, and own
**account growth**
alongside Progreva leadership.

·      Support
**hiring, onboarding, documentation and knowledge transfer**
, so the team keeps the right skills and continuity across locations.

·      Coordinate plans, timelines, dependencies and status reporting so that commitments are
**delivered on time and to quality**
.

Stakeholder & Partner Management

·      Build long-term relationships with application managers, IT leadership and our delivery partner’s account team.

·      Run regular account and service reviews covering delivery, team health, risks and opportunities.

·      
**Travel to Europe**
when needed (up to 1 month per year) for workshops, planning and partner meetings.

An ideal candidate:

**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or IT. An MBA is a plus.

**Skills:**

·      
**6–10 years in IT services**
, including 3+ years in a client-facing BA, consultant, project manager or customer success role, and
**2+ years leading a small team**
.

·      A
**proven track record of growing an account**
by finding, scoping and winning follow-on work.

·      Enough
**technical grounding**
to talk credibly with engineers about software development, cloud, databases, APIs, data/BI and application security. No coding is expected.

·      Strong at
**requirements elicitation and documentation**
, using tools such as Jira/Azure DevOps and Confluence.

·      A
**consultative communicator**
with excellent English, comfortable advising senior business and technical stakeholders without overselling.

·      A natural
**people leader**
who sets clear expectations, gives honest feedback and keeps a distributed team motivated.

·      Familiar with Agile/Scrum. CBAP, SAFe PO/PM, PSM/CSM or PMP is a plus.

·      Experience with
**European clients**
, or in the
**energy, utilities, manufacturing or industrial**
domain, is a strong advantage.

·      Comfortable working
**CET hours**
.

What is in it for you?

·      Helping build an employee-centric, values-driven organization

·      Being part of a growing start-up that is setting new standards for employee well-being while delivering breakthrough digital products

·      Working in an international, distributed environment for industry-leading clients

·      A hybrid setup: 3 days a week at our Baner, Pune office and 2 days from home

·      Working as part of a large client organization, with interesting challenges every day, rather than in an “outsourced model”

·      A competitive salary, a performance-based incentive and a
**healthy work-life balance**

·      A
**visible leadership role**
with direct access to the founder and room to grow as the account grows

How to Apply:

Send your resume and a short cover letter explaining your interest in the
**Engagement Manager**
role to hr@progreva.com. During the interview process you’ll also speak with members of our team to learn about our culture and values. We’ll keep interviewing until we find the right person, so if you’ve read this far, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior Business Analyst, AI
description:
At NiCE, we don't limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We're ambitious. We're game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you're like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

  

**Business Analyst, AI**
========================

**So, what's the role all about?**
----------------------------------

NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. Your idea. Our spark.

As Business Analyst in the SPARK team, you will be the bridge between the people who have the ideas and the architects and builders who make them real. You will shape raw ideas into clear, prioritised, buildable use cases, and make sure what we build solves the problem it was meant to solve.

This is a business analysis role with a technical edge. You come from a programming background, so you can read code, query data, test an API, and prototype a quick proof of concept, and you can still run a room full of non-technical stakeholders. You will work closely with the Project Manager, the AI Architects & Builders, and the Change Management & Evangelist.

**How will you make an impact?**
--------------------------------

You will own the front end of the incubation pipeline, from the first conversation about an idea through to accepted, measurable outcomes, working hands-on with business teams, architects, and delivery colleagues across regions.

### **Discover and Shape Ideas**

* Run discovery sessions, interviews, and workshops with business teams to understand pain points, current processes, and the outcome they want
* Turn ideas into clear use case briefs covering the problem statement, users, expected value, data needs, risks, and success measures
* Assess and rank ideas against business value, feasibility, data readiness, effort, and risk, and give the team a clear recommendation on what to build next
* Build lightweight business cases, including estimated time saved, quality gains, and cost or revenue impact for presentation to Management and AI steering committee

### **Define What Gets Built**

* Map as-is and to-be processes, and identify where an AI agent, an automation, or a human-in-the-loop step fits best
* Write user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that architects and builders can build from without guesswork
* Specify expected AI behaviour: what the solution should do, what it should never do, when it hands over to a person, and how answers will be checked for quality
* Prepare test scenarios and evaluation datasets with the builders to measure accuracy, reliability, and usefulness before launch
* Update initiative register

### **Prototype and Validate**

* Use SQL, Python, or low-code tools to analyse process data, test assumptions, and build simple prototypes that prove an idea before engineering effort is committed
* Review APIs and system documentation to confirm integration feasibility with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft 365
* Gather early user feedback on prototypes and turn it into prioritised backlog items

### **Support Delivery and Adoption**

* Own and groom the product backlog, and take part in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives
* Plan and run user acceptance testing with business users, and manage defects and feedback through to closure
* Partner with the Change Management & Evangelist and the Support Helpdesk to turn user questions and feedback into clear improvements

### **Measure and Share Value**

* Capture baseline metrics before launch and track results afterwards, so every solution can show real impact
* Understand the Software Development Lifecylse to review adoption, continuous business iteration and value realization.
* Maintain the use case library, requirement templates, and playbooks that make the next idea faster to shape

**Have you got what it takes?**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 5-8 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Systems Analyst in a software, technology, or digital transformation environment
* A programming background: hands-on experience writing code in at least one language such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or C#, plus working knowledge of SQL and REST APIs
* Proven skill in requirements engineering: process mapping, user stories, acceptance criteria, and traceability from need to delivered outcome
* Experience facilitating workshops and aligning senior business stakeholders with technical teams
* Experience working in Agile teams, with tools such as Jira and Confluence
* Working understanding of how large language models, RAG, and AI agents work and what they can and cannot do reliably, with hands-on use of AI assistants in your own work
* Some finance background or knowledge will be a plus
* Strong analytical, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical ideas in plain business language
* Fluency in English

### **You will have an advantage if you also have:**

* Hands-on experience on AI, GenAI, or automation projects, from use case definition through to production
* Experience with low-code or agent-building tools such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot Studio or similar
* Background in CX, contact centre, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS environments
* Familiarity with evaluating LLM output quality, including test set design and acceptance thresholds
* Business analysis certification such as CBAP or PMI-PBA
* Experience working across regions and time zones, with teams in International and the Americas

**What's in it for you?**
-------------------------

SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.

Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate about AI, innovative at heart, and excited to constantly raise the bar on what intelligent technology can do, you may just be our next NiCEr!

**Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!**
--------------------

At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

**Requisition ID:** 11870

**Reporting into:** Jean Lee

Vice President, Business Operations. Sales Ops

***About NiCE***

*NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.*

*Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.*

*NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*

title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.
  
  
We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Sell

+ Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
+ Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
+ Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it

title: Category Manager
description:
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a dynamic, detail-oriented
**Category Manager – Mobility, Transit & Tourism t**
o own the end-to-end performance of this unified vertical on DigiHaat. You will build and scale a comprehensive mobility and tourism marketplace covering daily/regional transit options, stays, local experiences, guided tours, and travel-linked products such as handicrafts, local produce, and curated travel kits. * Category Strategy and Growth
* Define and execute the category strategy for mobility, transit, and tourism with clear goals, priorities, and KPIs in collaboration with product, marketing, and business teams.
* Identify high-potential segments across transit & mobility (first-mile/last-mile connectivity, intercity bus/rail integrators, local transit options) alongside tourism segments (homestays, rural & heritage tourism, craft and culinary experiences, pilgrimage and wellness travel).
* Build the category roadmap around seasonality, commuting patterns, regional demand, festivals, and travel trends.
* Align category operations with broader business objectives of growth, network adoption, profitability, and customer satisfaction.
