* Onboard and nurture a diverse supply base: transit operators, mobility service providers, homestay owners, tour operators, local guides, experience hosts, artisans, and tourism-linked sellers.
* Build strong relationships with mobility aggregators, transport operators, travel suppliers, and logistics partners to ensure service reliability, availability, and cost efficiency.
* Set and monitor service standards, cancellation/refund policies, and compliance requirements, including transport permits, local licenses, and safety norms.
* Handhold small transit operators, experience hosts, and first-time digital sellers through onboarding, catalogue creation, and platform best practices.
* Booking, Transit & Order Lifecycle Operations
* Monitor the full lifecycle from route search, booking, ticket issuance, and service delivery to post-trip feedback to ensure a smooth end-to-end customer experience.
* Track and resolve operational issues such as schedule disruptions, cancellations, no-shows, overbooking, service quality complaints, refunds, and physical product deliveries.
* Work with operations teams to streamline fulfillment for mobility bookings and tourism-linked retail products.
* Identify and implement process improvements to reduce operational costs and maximize booking efficiency.
* Pricing, Inventory and Demand Management
* Use demand forecasting to manage inventory, seat/stay availability, and peak/off-peak capacity across daily transit and travel seasons.
* Develop dynamic pricing strategies, bundled offers, and multi-modal travel packages (e.g., Transit Pass + Stay + Experience + Local Products) to improve conversion and basket value.
* Work with marketing on customer acquisition campaigns, transit usage incentives, destination-led promotions, and seasonal travel offers.

* Use data and analytics to track category performance: GMV, total bookings, route throughput, conversion rate, repeat rate, cancellation rate, customer ratings, and partner reliability.
* Identify commuting and travel trends, regional transit bottlenecks, and category expansion opportunities.
* Deliver regular performance reports and actionable insights to internal and external stakeholders for continuous platform optimization.
* Listing Quality and User Experience
* Ensure listings, routes, and travel options are accurate, current, and compelling - covering departure/arrival schedules, stay descriptions, itineraries, amenities, pricing, availability, and policies.
* Analyze customer reviews, ratings, and ride/trip feedback to identify pain points and collaborate with tech/product teams to address them.
* Drive product enhancements for multi-modal travel discovery, transit routing, category search filters, and trust signals for mobility and travel services.

* Total Experience: 8–12 years in category management, marketplace operations, or business leadership roles.
* Mandatory Industry Experience: Direct, proven experience across Mobility / Transit, the Travel Industry, and Tourism Management.

title: Account Manager (Performance Marketing)
description:
We're hiring an Account Manager (Performance Marketing) at Neuroid :)

Type - Hybrid // 4 days WFO // Ghitorni, New Delhi

Must have performance marketing & D2C growth understanding.

Neuroid is a performance and content agency built for D2C brands - furniture, jewellery, skincare, apparel, F&B - managing ad spend in crores every month. We integrate performance marketing with content and creative, so the ads and the assets behind them are built to work together, not handed across a wall.

We’re hiring an Account Manager to own the relationship side of 8 to 10 D2C accounts. You sit between the founder, the media buyers and the client. The buyers run the ads; you run the account - the numbers, the conversation, the next step, and the renewal.

* You can open Ads Manager and explain an account’s last 30 days without a buyer in the room
* You know what a healthy D2C P&L looks like: ROAS, CAC, AOV, contribution margin, and why a brand at 2X might be fine and a brand at 4X might not be
* You write clearly, run a meeting without a deck, and are comfortable telling a client something they don’t want to hear
* You’ve managed at least 5 accounts at once and nobody slipped
* In-office at Ghitorni (3rd Floor, 354, 100ft Road, near Ghitorni metro), five days a week

**What you get**

* 8 to 10 named accounts from day one, with real authority over how they’re run
* Direct access to the founder, the Head of Ops and the buyers; no layers

  + Experience with Nutanix AHV required
  + Experience with Microsoft Hyper-V preferred

  + Experience with VCF's automated deployment and configuration of vSphere, vSAN, NSX, and vRealize Suite or Aria components
  Demonstrated ability to manage converged infrastructure through VCF's unified platform spanning compute, storage, networking, and security
10+ yrs of experience with operational administration of enterprise IT systems  
10+ yrs of experience with performance and infrastructure monitoring tools (LogicMonitor, Elastic, or comparable platforms)  
5+ yrs of experience with an enterprise ITSM system. ServiceNow preferred  
* Experience with Cisco UCS and Dell hardware systems required
Familiarity with Dell PowerFlex/PowerStore/VxRail preferred  
* Operating System skills with Windows and Linux preferred
Understanding of PowerShell and PowerCLI with ability to create and utilize scripts for administration, troubleshooting, reporting, and automation required  
Managed Services or consulting experience required  
VMware Certified Professional certification required; VMware Certified Advanced Professional certification preferred

title: Technical Customer Solutions Manager, India CSM Team
description:
**Description**
Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
  
  
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.
  
  
You will take end-to-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.
  
  
Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best-practices are applied, including: (1) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.
  
  
In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and modernization and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration and modernization hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration and modernization progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.

title: Manager- Customer Experience & Queries
description:
**Job Description**
**Manager – Customer Experience (Queries)**
Global Business Services | Order-to-Cash (O2C)
  
  
**About Us**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.
  
  
Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.
  
  
Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
**About The Function**
Global Business Services (GBS) is where Diageo runs and transforms its core commercial and financial processes at scale. Within GBO, the Order-to-Cash (O2C) team owns the end-to-end journey from customer order through to cash collection — and the customer experience that surrounds it.
  
  
Customer Experience (Queries) sits at the heart of that journey. When a customer raises a query, dispute or claim, how quickly and cleanly we resolve it shapes their trust in Diageo and the cash we collect. This team is accountable for resolving customer queries at pace, removing the root causes behind them, and raising the service bar across markets.
  
  
It’s a space that blends operational delivery with transformation — where you improve today’s service while redesigning tomorrow’s, and see the impact of your work on both customers and the P&L almost immediately.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Manager – Customer Experience (Queries), you are the expert owner of customer query, orders, dispute and claim resolution across your markets, and a driving force behind improving and transforming how that work is done. This is an individual contributor role: you are accountable for service performance — speed, quality and customer satisfaction — and for reducing the volume and root causes of queries over time.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end transformation of Order-to-Cash and customer service across people, process, technology and data — lifting service levels and reducing cost-to-serve across markets.
* Own process and technology solution transformation from design and business case through build, deployment and adoption, ensuring measurable service and efficiency gains.
* Drive continuous-improvement initiatives that embed a culture of ongoing improvement across query, dispute and claim resolution.
* Identify and eliminate the root causes of recurring queries, partnering with upstream O2C, master data and commercial teams to fix them at source.
* Use data and insight to track performance, prioritise improvements and report to senior stakeholders.
* Act as a subject-matter resource for the team on query-resolution best practice, helping embed standard ways of working as the market footprint grows.

**Essential**
**Experience / skills required**

* 10–12+ years' experience in Order-to-Cash, with deep end-to-end process knowledge.
* Proven track record of delivering transformation and change in an O2C or shared-services environment.
* Experience managing senior stakeholders across multiple markets.
* Strong analytical, data-driven approach to performance improvement.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-influencing skills.

**Preferred**

* Lean / Six Sigma qualification, or demonstrable process-improvement experience.
* Customer service, query or dispute-management experience.
* Experience operating across multiple international markets.

**Working with us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package.
  
  
**Diversity statement**
Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
  
  
We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.
  
  
Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.
  
  
If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.
  
  
**Recruitment Scam Warning**
Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we’ll never ask for money.

Regular

Gurugram

* Deliver procedural support during surgical cases, including troubleshooting and follow-up activities to ensure customer satisfaction and therapy adoption.
* Conduct product training and in-service programmes for new and existing customers on assigned therapy portfolios.
* Partner with key implant center's to develop strategies that increase product utilisation and support progression toward technical self-sufficiency.
* Gather and communicate market intelligence, customer feedback, competitive activity, and product performance insights to internal stakeholders.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience
* OR Associate’s Degree AND 6+ years experience
* OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4+ years experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Degree or certification in Perfusion Technology.
* Master's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or Master of Business Administration.
* Experience supporting live surgical procedures and working directly with cardiac surgeons and operating room teams.
* Knowledge of hospital purchasing processes, account development strategies, and healthcare market dynamics within South India.

In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.
  
  
You will take end-to-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.
  
  
Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best-practices are applied, including: (1) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.
  
  
In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and modernization and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration and modernization hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration and modernization progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.

Partner Development Manager – Middle East & Southeast Asia

**MachineAstro (formerly CIMCON Digital)**
· Location: Ahmedabad | Travel across Middle East & Southeast Asia

Who we are

Every manufacturing plant runs on thousands of machines that, until recently, could not tell anyone how they were feeling. MachineAstro changes that.

MachineAstro is a fast-growing Industrial IoT platform and solutions company that puts sensors, data and AI to work on the plant floor, enabling smart manufacturing and Industry 4.0 for the most demanding manufacturing industries in the world. Our solutions span predictive maintenance, energy analytics, digital twins and video analytics, deployed across Cement, Automotive, Chemical, FMCG, Steel, Metals and Pharma.

Today, MachineAstro is trusted by 120+ manufacturing plants across the globe. We have installed 20,000+ IoT devices on 8,000+ assets and helped our customers avoid 6,000+ hours of unplanned downtime. Those are not pilot numbers. They are production numbers, earned one plant at a time.

 Why join MachineAstro

1. **Opportunity to scale a proven business:**

2. **Work where AI meets the plant floor:**

3. **Earn what you deliver:**

We are entering our next phase of growth and need enterprising, self-motivated people who want to own outcomes. People who are comfortable walking into a steel plant or a pharma line, understanding what keeps the plant head awake at night, and translating that into a solution the customer will pay for and keep. * BE in Instrumentation & Control or Electronics & Communication preferred.
* MBA in Business Administration, Marketing or a related field preferred.
* Minimum 8–10 years of experience selling industrial software, Industrial IoT or industrial automation solutions to manufacturing or process industries.
* Proven experience in channel or partner development, including recruiting and growing system integrators, distributors or value-added resellers.
* Working experience in, and a partner and customer network across, the Middle East and/or Southeast Asia.
* Understanding of condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, Industrial IoT and edge computing applications.

* Excellent online and offline software demonstration skills.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and presentation skills.
* Results-driven, with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets through indirect channels.

Send your resume to naina@machineastro.com with the subject line "Partner Development Manager – ME & SEA"

We are looking for self-driven individuals to join our Moveworks Technical Support team, supporting a sophisticated Moveworks ServiceNow platform powered by machine learning, enterprise search (RAG), and agentic workflows. title: SharePoint - OneDrive And Power Platform Operations - Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**SharePoint ,OneDrive & Power Platform Operations/ Engineer**
In our globalizing economy the availability of skills and expertise is becoming more and more distributed. Within the Compute Services – SharePoint, OneDrive & Power Platform Operations and engineering team, we enable EY professionals to meet the increasing pace of business change by delivering productivity and collaboration solutions that empower them to work together where they want and how they want.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have over 300,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology**
supports our technology needs through three business units:
  
  

* Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Technology (ET) – ET supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the most affordable possible cost for quality services. ET will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

**The opportunity**
The SharePoint Operations Engineer is part of a global SharePoint team in a large, complex, and multinational environment. They have expert knowledge in SharePoint (both Cloud and On-Prem). The individual will be providing Level 3 Operational/Engineering support for areas involving SharePoint Online, with a good understanding of SPO and associated technologies, SharePoint On-Prem, MS Teams, OneDrive for Business, and other M365 services.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* In-depth knowledge of SharePoint, OneDrive and Power platform its features, and related M365 services.
* Experience in installing and configuring SharePoint 2016,2019 & SE.
* Good troubleshooting skills in both sharepoint on-prem (2016/SE) along with SPO.
* Advanced experience with Microsoft PowerShell scripting & automation.
* Intermediate to advanced knowledge of CSOM, MSMQ & Provider Hosted Apps (PHA).
* Intermediate experience with continuous integration systems.
* Understanding of multiple access and authentication models such as NTLM, Kerberos, Claims-based, ADFS, SSL, card services, TMG, UAG, etc
* Knowledge of troubleshooting tools and techniques related to networks and systems i.e. remote access tools, Windows Support tools, connectivity tests, etc
* Detailed understanding of both Classic and Modern SharePoint functionality including Lists, Document Libraries, Pages, Search, Permissions, and Settings
* In-depth support knowledge and experience in providing 24/7 support for SharePoint
* In-depth knowledge in troubleshooting SharePoint end user/client issues.
* In-depth knowledge in SharePoint permissions, webparts, lists, views and any other site level issues.
* Expert knowledge in Incident management, Service requests, Change requests and ServiceNow processes for SP support.
* In-depth knowledge on SharePoint support workflow, level 1, level 2 and level 3. This role is for Level 3 support.
* Capability to help customer to fix the issue and/or create tickets for Microsoft for further troubleshooting.
* In-depth knowledge on PowerShell scripting and automation experience using scripts.
* Desirable - Knowledge in deploying SharePoint solutions, updating automation scripts and html pages.
* Desirable – Knowledge of Power Platform products, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI
* Experience with SCRUM/Agile development process is a plus.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
How your skills and experience will make an impact:
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* History of working credibly within teams and delivering high level of support services on the SharePoint platform
* Proactively anticipates service issues before they occur and able to make recommendations around resolution.
* Proactively monitor outages within a small group or wider group.
* Ability to communicate platform capabilities to customer and provide appropriate recommendations.
* Adapts personal communication style to the style of others, develops rapport and stays calm under pressure or escalating issues using advanced oral and written English communication skills.
* Strong verbal and written skills including strong cross-cultural communication and the ability to draft effective communications
* Ability to work with people in a variety of cultures, countries and time zones
* Utilizes all aspects of Emotional Intelligence to navigate the interactions and complexities of the business environment and drive leadership performance in oneself and in others.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* This role does not have a direct supervision responsibility but should proactively own tasks/issues and drive towards resolution independently.
* A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline, or equivalent work experience required
* 2-5 years of experience in support role with at least last 1 year in SharePoint support.

**What We Look For**

* Passionate, committed and determined
* Candidate must be flexible to the demands of the services we provide and any project to which they are assigned. The role may require out of office hours work.
* This role is for 24/7 support and requires working in night shift periodically.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Product Support Engineer III
description:
**Who We Are**
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
  
  
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced Mobile Product Support Engineer to join our Global Technical Support organization. This role is ideal for a technical leader who thrives on solving highly complex mobile-related issues, with a strong focus on customer impact, operational workflows, and regulatory considerations.
  
  
As a Product Support Engineer, Mobile Experience, you will serve as a senior technical escalation owner responsible for leading complex investigations end-to-end across Samsara’s mobile ecosystem. You will work cross-functionally with Engineering and Product teams to drive issue resolution, improve product quality, and influence roadmap decisions that enhance the reliability, compliance, and supportability of Samsara’s mobile applications.
  
  
PSE III is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong technical depth, ownership, and leadership. You will be expected to set a high bar for technical investigations, mentor and guide L2 engineers, and take ownership of high-impact, multi-customer issues spanning multiple products and regions.
  
  
**You should apply if:**

* You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
* You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
* You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

**In this role, you will:**

* Act as primary L3/PSE owner for high‑impact and ambiguous mobile issues (Driver, Fleet, routing and dispatch flows; Asset Maintenance, Connected Workflows, mobile‑to‑cloud data mismatches)
* Lead structured, hypothesis‑driven investigations: define the problem, build reproducible cases, analyze logs and telemetry, and drive to clear root cause and mitigation across mobile clients, backend services, and configuration layers.
* Partner closely with engineering teams (Mobile Experience, Driver Management, Routing & Dispatch, Connected Workflows, Asset Maintenance, Compliance, Product Security) to Assess impact and risk, Prioritize fixes or mitigations, Influence roadmaps for reliability, observability, and operational guardrails.
* Own customer and stakeholder communication for critical issues:

+ Craft clear business impact assessments and timelines,
+ Provide concise, periodic updates to Support, CSMs, Sales, and Product,
+ Deliver customer‑ready narratives and post‑incident summaries suitable for senior audiences in EMEA and globally.

* Proactively identify patterns across customer tickets,and incidents to recommend and drive product and tooling improvements (e.g., improved logging, app‑state capture, diagnostics, in‑app surfaces, guardrails) that reduce future volume and time‑to‑resolution.
* Contribute to and maintain internal runbooks, incident playbooks, and knowledge base content for mobile workflows, ensuring they reflect regional nuances (EMEA regulations, language support, rollout status).
* Mentor and coach L2 engineers, raising the bar on Troubleshooting depth and documentation quality, Reproduction and scoping of issues, Escalation criteria and communication with engineering.
* Advocate for the voice of the customer in discussions with product and engineering, grounded in real data from escalations, patterns, and frontline feedback.
* Analyze device telemetry and fleet-level patterns using internal tools, translating raw data and logs into clear, actionable technical narratives.

**Minimum requirements for the role:**

* B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical), or other technical fields.
* 8+ years of experience in technical support, solutions engineering, or similar roles working directly with complex SaaS products; at least one major area of depth in mobile applications or fleet/telematics workflows.
* Proven expertise troubleshooting mobile apps across Android and/or iOS, including device/OS constraints, network behavior, authentication flows, app configuration, and data synchronization with backend services.
* Strong debugging and root‑cause analysis skills: able to decompose ambiguous, multi‑system issues, quickly identify high‑leverage logs and signals, and drive toward a clear root cause and mitigation.
* Demonstrated experience working directly with engineering and product: reading JIRA tickets/RFCs, validating hypotheses in lower environments, and influencing prioritization using data and customer impact.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English, comfortable presenting complex technical narratives to both engineers and non‑technical stakeholders (CSMs, Sales, customers, leadership) across regions.
* Strong ownership mindset and bias for action—able to lead investigations, make pragmatic decisions under time pressure, and follow through until issues are fully resolved and learnings are captured.
* Demonstrated strong resourcefulness, creativity, and problem-solving skills.
* Adaptability and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.
* Experience in direct customer interaction, incident response, and participation in a rotational after-hours/on-call support cadence is essential.

**An ideal candidate also has:**

* Experience in the Telematics industry is a plus.
* Data Analysis skills; Databricks, Python, SQL and Tableau.

**Total Rewards**
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
  
  
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
  
  
**Flexible Working**
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
  
  
**Belonging at Samsara**
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
  
  
**Accommodations**
Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
  
  
**Our Commitment to Authenticity**
We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
  
  
**Fraudulent Employment Offers**
Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Junior Site Engineer
description:
Ctrl Alt Experience (CAX) builds immersive experience centres, museums and interactive installations across India, the UAE and Saudi Arabia. Touch tables, projection, large format displays, real time 3D, interactive exhibits.

We are hiring a Site Engineer to help take these from a packed crate to a working, signed off installation.

This is a site role and an early career one. You will spend most of your time at project sites, learning from people who have done this for years. We are not looking for someone who already knows our stack. We are looking for someone who thinks clearly under pressure and can be trusted in front of a client.

Location: Bengaluru based, with frequent travel to project sites across India and occasional travel to the UAE and Saudi Arabia. Site stays of two to three weeks during installation phases are normal.

WHAT WE ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT

Communication. You will be on site with the client, the main contractor and their IT team while our developers are in Bangalore. You need to describe what you are seeing accurately, in writing and on a call, to people who cannot see it. "It is not working" is not a report. "Station 4 shows the Windows desktop, the app does not launch, this started after the power cut last night" is.

Reading a situation. Knowing when something is a five minute fix and when it is a problem that needs to be escalated now. Knowing when to tell a client you do not have an answer yet, and when the next update will come. Knowing what matters three hours before a client walkthrough and what can wait.

Troubleshooting instinct. Changing one thing at a time. Checking the obvious before the exotic. Swapping in something known to work to narrow down the fault. Noticing what changed since it last worked. This is a way of thinking, not a list of facts, and it is the thing we cannot teach quickly.

Ownership. On site you are often the only CAX person there. Nobody will assign you the next task.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Site surveys and readiness checks: power, network, mounting, access, dimensions

- Install and mount displays, touch tables, media players, PCs, projectors and sensors

- Run, terminate, test and label network and AV cabling

- Set up PCs and media players: OS configuration, displays, kiosk mode, startup behaviour, remote access

- Deploy software builds to site machines and verify each station works as specified

- Work through the commissioning checklist station by station and drive the snag list to zero

- Diagnose faults on site and either fix them or report them precisely enough that a remote developer can

- Report daily site status with photos and a clear list of what is open

- Maintain handover documentation: device inventory, IP schedules, cable schedules

- Support client walkthroughs, UAT and handover

WHAT YOU NEED

- 1 to 2 years of experience in any hands on technical role: IT support, AV, systems integration, ELV, electronics, networking, field service, hardware support. Fresh graduates with real hands on project work will be considered

- Comfortable with Windows, and willing to learn macOS. Able to install software, change display settings, find logs

- Basic networking understanding: what an IP address is, the difference between static and DHCP, how to use ping to check whether something is reachable. You will learn the rest here

- Comfortable opening things up, mounting hardware, running and terminating cable

- Clear written and spoken English. You will be writing site reports the client reads

- Willing and able to travel, with a valid passport or willing to get one

- Able to work in an active construction or fit out environment, including late nights before a client walkthrough

- Diploma or degree in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Computer Science or similar is useful but not required

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN HERE

- AV systems: signal paths, extenders, matrix switchers, projection setup and alignment, audio

- Media players and digital signage platforms including BrightSign

- Network configuration on site: VLANs, switches, static addressing, device connectivity

- Deploying and troubleshooting Unity, Unreal Engine and real time 3D builds

- How a large experiential project actually gets delivered, from survey to handover

WHO THIS SUITS

Someone early in their career who would rather be on site than at a desk. Someone who checks the input selection before escalating, changes one variable at a time, and labels the cables properly because they know who has to fix it at 2am six months from now. Someone who can stand in front of a client and give an accurate status instead of a reassuring one.

If you want to learn this industry from the inside and you are not precious about long days and unglamorous work, this is a good place to start.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Work on some of the most ambitious experiential projects in the region

- A small, senior team. You will learn AV, software and real time 3D from people doing it hands on

- Real ownership of sites early, rather than a slot in a large delivery machine

- A clear path toward Project Engineer and site ownership

* To apply, send your CV and a short note answering this: describe something technical that stopped working, and how you worked out why. It does not have to be from a job.

title: Senior Support Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking a Senior Support Engineer to join our Cloud Customer Support organization. In this role, you will independently investigate and resolve complex cloud and infrastructure challenges, driving customer issues through timely and effective resolution. You will collaborate with Engineering and Operations, mentor fellow engineers, and drive continuous improvements that strengthen service reliability and deliver an exceptional customer experience.
  
  
As a Senior Support Engineer, you will serve as a trusted technical interface for OCI customers, applying strong technical judgment and structured troubleshooting to challenging production issues. You will work across cloud infrastructure technologies, analyze technical evidence, identify potential causes, and engage the appropriate teams when an issue requires cross-functional expertise.
  
  
You will own customer issues throughout the support lifecycle, maintaining clear and proactive communication while balancing technical depth, urgency, and customer impact. Your work may involve complex or multi-technology scenarios where the resolution path is not immediately known, requiring independent investigation, effective technical judgment, and timely collaboration with subject matter experts to drive issues toward resolution.
  
  
Beyond resolving individual incidents, you will contribute to the effectiveness of the broader Support organization by sharing technical knowledge, mentoring engineers, improving troubleshooting practices and documentation, and identifying opportunities to improve support processes and customer outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Independently investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex customer issues involving cloud infrastructure and related technologies.
* Own customer issues throughout the support lifecycle, driving timely progress while maintaining high standards of technical quality and customer communication.
* Apply structured troubleshooting methodologies using logs, telemetry, diagnostic tools, technical documentation, runbooks, and engineering experience to isolate problems and determine appropriate next steps.
* Troubleshoot across multiple infrastructure technologies, including compute, networking, operating systems, storage, virtualization, and related cloud services.
* Work effectively with customers during complex or business-impacting incidents, providing clear technical guidance, meaningful progress updates, and well-defined next steps.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Service Operations, and other technical teams to investigate cross-service issues, identify product-related issues, and restore customer services.
* Escalate issues appropriately when additional expertise is required while continuing to maintain ownership of the customer experience and support engagement.
* Identify recurring technical and operational issues and contribute recommendations that improve troubleshooting effectiveness, service reliability, support processes, and customer experience.
* Create and improve technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks that enable consistent and efficient issue resolution.
* Share technical knowledge, troubleshooting techniques, and best practices with peers and mentor less-experienced engineers.
* Contribute to team projects and initiatives that improve support quality, operational efficiency, case handling, and customer outcomes.
* Capture key technical findings and lessons learned from customer incidents to improve organizational knowledge and future troubleshooting effectiveness.
* Continuously develop expertise across OCI services, cloud infrastructure, and technologies relevant to the supported environment.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Engineering, or a related technical filed.
* At least 4 years of relevant technical experience and at least 6 years of overall professional experience.
* Demonstrated experience supporting, operating, administering, or troubleshooting cloud infrastructure, enterprise infrastructure, or related technologies.
* Strong understanding of cloud computing and infrastructure concepts, with demonstrated troubleshooting and problem-solving capability.
* Ability to independently investigate complex technical issues, identify root causes, and drive effective resolution.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure technologies such as compute, networking, operating systems, storage, and virtualization.
* Ability to analyze logs, system behavior, diagnostic information, and other technical evidence to isolate issues and determine appropriate actions.
* Strong customer orientation and the ability to manage technically challenging customer situations with professionalism, urgency, and empathy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical information clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across Support, Engineering, Operations, and other technical teams.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies, apply that knowledge to customer problems, and share technical knowledge with others.
* Atleast 2 completed cloud certifications from recognized cloud providers.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in cloud technical support, infrastructure support, production operations, NOC, SRE, systems engineering, or a comparable technical environment.
* Strong understanding of Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), particularly Compute, Storage and Networking.
* Hands-on troubleshooting experience with Linux and/or Windows operating systems.
* Knowledge of networking concepts and technologies such as TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing, and network connectivity troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with virtualization, storage, and distributed cloud infrastructure.
* Experience supporting enterprise customers and managing complex or business-impacting production incidents.
* Experience creating technical documentation, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, or operational runbooks.
* Familiarity with scripting, automation, diagnostic tooling, APIs, or software development concepts.
* Understanding of cloud security, operational best practices, and relevant industry security and compliance standards.

**Location & Work Schedule:**

* This is a full-time, permanent position based in Bengaluru, India.
* The role supports a global customer environment and requires flexibility to work assigned shifts, including rotational weekend and holiday coverage, based on business needs.

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

Product Support Specialist

In this hybrid role, you will spend part of your time leading high-touch customer support and relationship management, and the other part translating those frontline insights into the product roadmap. Customer Service & Advocacy

* Issue Analysis and Reporting: Create reports documenting common customer support issues in Google Docs/Sheets format to enable product teams to prioritize system improvements and enhance customer experience
* Third-Party Coordination: Collaborate with Dwell Magazine's fulfillment partner, CDS Global, to resolve complex customer issues that cannot be addressed through Stripe's platform capabilities
* Client Enablement: Create and update customer-facing knowledge bases, release notes, training materials, and troubleshooting guides.
* Relationship Management: Build trust-based relationships with subscribers, gathering qualitative feedback on product experience.

Product Management
  
  

* Feedback Synthesis: Analyze support ticket trends, churn reasons, and customer feature requests to identify systemic product gaps.
* Roadmap Prioritization: Own and prioritize the product backlog, balancing urgent customer fixes with long-term strategic product goals.
* Requirements Definition: Write Product Requirements Documents and user stories for the engineering and design teams.
* Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate with engineering, QA, and marketing to guide features from concept through launch, ensuring the support team is fully trained before release.
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) including Customer Satisfaction, Net Promoter Score (NPS), Customer Retention/Churn, and Feature Adoption Rates.
* Report monthly insights to executive leadership regarding how product updates impact customer happiness and business revenue.

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are looking for an experienced Linux system Administrator to be part of the global Engineering-IT organization. The ideal candidate must have 4+ years’ experience in managing Linux environment in large enterprise, troubleshooting system/OS issues, implementing security best practices, and supporting critical business applications. This role requires strong technical and problem-solving skills, along with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Linux System Administration**

* Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade Linux OS & application (Red Hat and Ubuntu) in a physical and virtual environment
* Perform system monitoring, patching, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
* Manage enterprise identity services and access controls.

**Infrastructure & Platform Support**

* Support physical, virtual, and AWS-based Linux environments used for semiconductor design.
* Manage core infrastructure services such as DNS, LDAP, NFS, email, printing, and web/application servers.
* Administer HPC clusters, job scheduling platforms, and engineering data management tools.
* Ensure system reliability, availability, and security.

**Security & Compliance**

* Implement security best practices, system hardening, and vulnerability remediation.
* Support audits, compliance activities, firewall management, and access reviews.

**Incident Management & Operations**

* Monitor infrastructure health and respond to system issues and outages.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
* Maintain operational documentation and procedures.

**Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop tools and automation solutions to improve operational efficiency.
* Support infrastructure automation, configuration management, and DevOps initiatives.

**Collaboration & Support**

* Work closely with engineering, network, security, cloud, and application teams.
* Provide technical support and knowledge sharing across the IT organization.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or equivalent.
* 4+ years of Linux system administration experience.
* Experience managing enterprise Linux environments, including Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and Ubuntu.
* Experience supporting virtualized environments such as VMware, Hyper-V, or similar platforms.
* Proficiency in scripting (shell/ python) and advanced Linux command-line administration.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, SSH, and NTP.
* Experience with configuring monitoring and logging tools (Nagios, Prometheus, Grafana).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in semiconductors, EDA, or high-performance computing (HPC) environments.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, particularly AWS.
* Knowledge of NetApp storage, and on-prem & cloud based backup/recovery solutions
* Experience with configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible or Puppet.
* Knowledge of container technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes.
* Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
* Advanced certifications in RedHat , AWS etc. are a plus.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Effective communication and teamwork skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Customer-focused mindset.
* Experience with project management and using AI tools to improve productivity is a plus.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

Moveworks is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce.

Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt.=

Moveworks is trusted by over 5.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft’s 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award.

In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow’s leading workflow automation with Moveworks’ Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business.

Come join us!

ServiceNow

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for self-driven individuals to join our Moveworks Technical Support team, supporting a sophisticated Moveworks ServiceNow platform powered by machine learning, enterprise search (RAG), and agentic workflows. This role sits at the intersection of understanding a complex AI driven product and clearly communicating its behavior and value to our growing customer base.

Our platform enables users to not only find answers but also automate tasks end to end through AI agents that reason, plan, and execute actions across enterprise systems . As a result, customer questions range from configuration guidance to deeper investigations into why the assistant behaved a certain way spanning both educational support and complex debugging of AI behavior, integrations, and workflows.

An ideal candidate is curious, proactive, and thrives in a fast-paced environment, with a strong appetite for learning and solving complex technical problems.

**What you get to do in this role:**

* Provide day to day technical support to customers using the AI Assistant platform to drive automation, search, and workflow execution
* Troubleshoot issues across:

  + AI responses (RAG based retrieval and answer quality)
  + Agentic workflows (planning, execution, and action failures)
  + API integrations with enterprise systems
* Communicate clearly with customers and simplify complex AI/system behaviors
* Identify root causes of issues using logs, telemetry, and system analysis (e.g., Kibana, Grafana)
* Identify defects, document them clearly, and track them in defect management systems
* Ensure timely responses to customers and adherence to SLAs
* Triage support tickets and escalate to appropriate teams (Customer Success Engineering, Product, Engineering, etc.)
* Analyze API failures and integration issues across connected enterprise systems
* Perform configuration changes to optimize assistant behavior and fulfill customer requirements
* Identify recurring issues and contribute to internal and customer facing knowledge bases
* Reproduce, document, and communicate bugs, outages, and workflow failures effectively

 **Qualifications**

**Qualifications and technical skills that will lead to success:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* 2-5 years of experience in customer-facing technical support or similar roles
* Experience working with ServiceNow platform and enterprise integrations
* Strong understanding of REST APIs and debugging integration issues
* Experience working with automated, bi-directional integrations between systems
* Understanding of system design concepts to distinguish between configuration issues and product limitations
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Ability to analyze logs and monitoring tools (e.g., Kibana, Grafana)
* Strong written communication skills and ability to simplify complex technical concepts
* Ability to debug issues across workflows, APIs, and system interactions
* Experience reproducing, documenting, and communicating bugs effectively
* Passion for technology with a strong desire to learn and grow

Nice to Haves:

* Familiarity with AI/ML systems, especially RAG-based search or conversational AI
* Understanding of agent-based or workflow automation systems
* Familiarity with configuration file formats such as XML, JSON, and YAML
* Experience with logging and observability tools such as Kibana and Grafana
* Basic coding skills, preferably Python
* Knowledge of distributed version control systems (Git is a plus)
* Experience with enterprise IT platforms (Okta, Workday, Google Workspace, Microsoft Active Directory)

 **Additional Information**

**Work Personas**

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Identity and Access Management (IAM) has taken the center stage with growing digital transformation in Philips. It is critical to have good governance to enforce robust Identity and access management across multiple channels, including mobile, social and cloud. IAM helps strengthen compliance and reduce risk by protecting and monitoring user access in today's cloud based multi-perimeter environments.

IAM solutions help safeguard valuable data and applications with context-based access control, security policy enforcement and business-driven identity governance. Armed with user metrics and audit reports on user entitlements and access activities, you can deal more quickly and efficiently with the complexities of user access management, insider threats and compliance requirements.

* Working experience in managing and implementing application integrations, MFA and conditional policies, application proxy, admin consents, graph API etc.

title: ELN/LIMS configurations expert
description:
**Company Description**
DigAIT is a scientific technology and consulting partner that supports chemical and life sciences organizations in accelerating digital transformation across research, development, laboratory, manufacturing, and operations. The company combines AI, IT, scientific data, and deep domain expertise to design and implement digital solutions that make scientific processes more connected and data-driven. Its capabilities span process modeling, laboratory and manufacturing solutions, data analytics, business intelligence, and advanced AI technologies, including machine learning and generative AI. DigAIT works across the full transformation journey—from assessing current processes to implementing ELN/LIMS, integrating data, and enabling scalable analytics and AI. The team is experienced with leading platforms and tools such as LIMS, ELN, MES, ERP, SAP Signavio, BPMN, Power BI, Tableau, AWS, Azure, Python, and modern AI/LLM platforms.

**Role Description**
For Client based in Europe, we are looking for a ELN/LIMS configurations expert. This role based will be in Chennai, structured as a hybrid position that combines on-site work with some work-from-home flexibility. You will connect lab users, data science teams, and IT, ensuring that experimental data is captured in a structured, high-quality, and ML-ready form. The role combines hands-on configuration, product ownership, roll-out coordination for targeted labs and sites, and IT operations.

**Key responsibilities:**

1. Configurations and trainings

* Work with lab colleagues to design and configure workflows, data uploaders, templates, and master data especially related to formulation development process (materials, formulations, raw materials, test methods, properties, units)
* Translate lab processes in chemistry and material development into robust platform configurations
* Train users, support onboarding, and drive adoption

2. Product management

* Collect, prioritize, and manage requirements from business stakeholders
* Maintain the product backlog and roadmap, and deliver in an agile (Scrum) setup
* Run sprint planning, reviews, and stakeholder communication
* Manage releases, change requests, and configuration testing/validation

3. Integrations and IT operations

* Coordinate the development of integrations between the ELN and other systems (LIMS, ERP, PLM, instruments/CDS, data lakes, analytics/ML platforms) via APIs and interfaces
* Handle incident and problem management, second-level support, and vendor coordination
* Maintain knowledge documentation (configuration specs, SOPs, user guides, FAQs)

4. Roll-out and adoption coordination

* Coordinate roll-out activities end-to-end for specific smaller labs or sites (e.g., HTE lab, a particular site roll-out), building on the platform already established in the larger labs
* Reuse and adapt existing configurations, templates, and master data from the larger labs, and identify only the lab-specific extensions needed (e.g., HTE-specific workflows, uploaders, instrument interfaces)
