title: Trainee – Electronics Lab & Technical Support
description:
**Trainee – Electronics Lab & Technical Support**

**Company:** CircuitSpark  
**Location:** Valasaravakkam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Work Mode:** In person  
**Experience:** 0–2 years, based on practical skills  
**Monthly Salary:** ₹8,000–₹20,000

**About CircuitSpark**

CircuitSpark focuses on practical electronics learning, circuit building, Arduino projects, embedded systems and hands-on technical experiments.

We are looking for an enthusiastic Electronics Lab & Technical Support Trainee to assist with practical sessions, electronics project preparation, lab equipment management and basic circuit testing.

This opportunity is suitable for freshers who are interested in electronics, enjoy hands-on technical work and want to develop practical skills in a learning and project-based environment.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Electronics Lab Support**

* Prepare electronic components, tools, breadboards and equipment for practical sessions.
* Organise electronics kits, sensors, modules, Arduino boards and other lab materials.
* Ensure that lab equipment and project kits are ready for use.
* Maintain a clean, organised and safe electronics lab.

**2. Circuit Assembly and Testing**

* Assist with basic electronic circuit assembly and breadboard connections.
* Perform basic soldering and component replacement under supervision.
* Check circuits using a multimeter and other basic testing instruments.
* Identify simple connection errors and report faults to the trainer or engineer.
* Help verify that demonstration circuits and project kits work correctly.

**3. Arduino and Electronics Projects**

* Assist with Arduino boards, sensors, LEDs, displays, relays and other electronic modules.
* Support the preparation and demonstration of beginner-level electronics projects.
* Help with basic Arduino code uploading and circuit simulation under guidance.
* Assist in preparing project kits and practical demonstration materials.

**4. Student and Trainer Support**

* Help trainers prepare practical exercises and project materials.
* Assist students with component identification and basic circuit connections.
* Support the smooth conduct of practical sessions.
* Follow instructions from trainers and maintain proper lab discipline.

**5. Component Inventory and Maintenance**

* Sort and organise electronic components.
* Maintain component stock records and project kit checklists.
* Check received components and report shortages or damaged items.
* Keep tools, cables, modules and testing equipment in their designated places.

**Eligibility and Skills**

* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Diploma, ITI, B.Sc. or BE/B.Tech in Electronics, ECE, EEE, Instrumentation or a related discipline is preferred.
* Basic understanding of electronic components such as resistors, capacitors, diodes, LEDs and transistors is an advantage.
* Interest in Arduino, sensors, circuit building and practical electronics.
* Willingness to learn soldering, circuit testing and troubleshooting.
* Basic computer skills and a responsible attitude.
* Good attention to detail, punctuality and willingness to learn.

Previous work experience is not mandatory. Candidates with practical projects, college laboratory experience or a strong interest in electronics are encouraged to apply.

Training and Growth Opportunities

The selected candidate will gain hands-on exposure to electronic components, circuit assembly, Arduino projects, basic testing instruments, electronics lab operations and embedded systems.

Practical training and guidance will be provided according to the candidate's learning progress and assigned responsibilities.

Pay: ₹8,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: IT Support Analyst – Service Desk & End-User Support
description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India (GCC)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
2–5 years

About pharma&

pharma& is a privately owned global pharmaceutical company headquartered in Vienna, Austria. We focus on breathing new life into proven medicines, preserving their availability, and ensuring essential treatments reach patients worldwide.

With a growing portfolio across hematology, oncology, and other therapeutic areas, we operate through a global network of subsidiaries, joint ventures, and partners to support development, manufacturing, and access.

About the Role

We are looking for an IT Support Analyst to join our growing Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Hyderabad.

In this role, you will provide day-to-day IT support to colleagues across our global organisation, helping resolve technical issues, manage service desk tickets and ensure employees have the equipment, systems and access they need to work effectively.

You will work closely with our international IT team, supporting users across multiple countries and time zones. The role covers a broad range of IT activities, including troubleshooting, Microsoft 365 support, user account administration, device provisioning, onboarding and offboarding, and IT asset management.

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, takes ownership of issues and can provide a professional and responsive service to colleagues.

Key Responsibilities

**IT Service Desk & User Support**

* Manage and resolve IT support requests through our centralised ticketing system, Freshservice.
* Provide Level 1 and Level 2 technical support to users across different countries and locations.
* Troubleshoot Windows laptops, Microsoft 365 applications, email, connectivity, VPN, printers and other workplace technology.
* Investigate incidents, identify root causes and escalate more complex issues to the appropriate technical teams or external providers.
* Prioritise support requests based on business impact, urgency and agreed service levels.
* Maintain accurate ticket records, document resolutions and follow up with users to ensure issues are resolved.

**Microsoft 365 & User Administration**

* Provide day-to-day support for Microsoft Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint and other Microsoft 365 applications.
* Assist with user account creation, access changes, password resets, multifactor authentication and licence assignments.
* Support routine administration activities within Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365, following established procedures and access controls.
* Troubleshoot common authentication, email and application access issues.
* Escalate advanced Microsoft 365 configuration or security issues to the relevant administrators.

**Device Management & IT Operations**

* Prepare, configure and deploy Windows laptops and other IT equipment for new and existing employees.
* Support Microsoft Intune device enrolment, configuration, compliance checks and troubleshooting.
* Assist with software installation, device updates and standard endpoint maintenance.
* Coordinate hardware replacements, repairs, procurement and deliveries with vendors and local colleagues.
* Maintain accurate records of laptops, mobile devices, accessories and other IT assets.
* Support equipment recovery, access removal and device reassignment during employee offboarding.

**Employee Onboarding & Offboarding**

* Coordinate with HR, hiring managers and IT colleagues to prepare accounts, equipment and access for new starters.
* Verify approved employee information and requirements before provisioning accounts or devices.
* Ensure new employees receive their IT equipment and necessary access in a timely manner.
* Carry out IT offboarding tasks, including account deactivation, access removal, licence recovery and equipment collection.
* Help identify opportunities to improve and standardise onboarding and offboarding processes.

**IT Processes & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain IT support documentation, troubleshooting guides and knowledge base articles.
* Support routine operational checks and recurring IT administration tasks.
* Follow established IT security policies, procedures and change management requirements.
* Assist with identifying recurring technical issues and recommending practical improvements.
* Work collaboratively with infrastructure, Microsoft 365 and cybersecurity colleagues to resolve issues and improve service quality.
* Support the continued development of a reliable, consistent and well-documented global IT support function.

Required Skills & Experience

* Approximately 2–5 years of experience in IT support, service desk, desktop support or a similar role.
* Strong troubleshooting experience with Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 applications.
* Practical experience supporting Outlook, Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including basic user and access administration.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Intune or a similar endpoint management platform.
* Experience working with IT service management or ticketing systems such as Freshservice, ServiceNow or Jira Service Management.
* Understanding of basic networking concepts, including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, Wi-Fi and VPN connectivity.
* Experience preparing, configuring and troubleshooting laptops and workplace devices.
* Good understanding of IT security fundamentals, including MFA, access management and endpoint protection.
* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple requests and communicate effectively with non-technical users.

Desirable Skills

* Experience providing remote IT support to users across multiple countries.
* Previous experience working within a global organisation or shared services environment.
* Knowledge of ITIL principles and service management best practices.
* Experience with Microsoft Autopilot and Windows device deployment.
* Familiarity with Apple devices, mobile device management or Apple Business Manager.
* Exposure to PowerShell scripting or basic IT support automation.
* Previous experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or another regulated industry.
* Familiarity with IT asset management, documentation and operational compliance requirements.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a practical, dependable and service-minded IT professional who takes ownership of problems and follows them through to resolution.

You should be comfortable dealing directly with users, working with colleagues in different countries and balancing multiple priorities.

This is an opportunity to join a growing global IT function, gain exposure to a broad range of technologies and contribute to improving the way IT services are delivered across pharma&.

title: Representative, GCC Application Support
description:
**Job Description**
This role is responsible for providing advanced first-line support for global logistics and supply chain applications. This role ensures effective monitoring of business transactions, system alerts, application health, and incident queues, while coordinating timely resolution and escalation of issues impacting customers and internal users. This role works closely with business stakeholders, customers, and Development teams to maintain service stability, minimize business disruption, and ensure seamless logistics operations across global regions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Application Monitoring & Operations
  
  

* Monitor global logistics and supply chain applications to ensure continuous availability and operational stability.
* Proactively monitor business transaction flows, integrations, batch jobs, interfaces, and operational dashboards to identify exceptions or service disruptions.
* Monitor system alerts, application health checks, and automated notifications, and take appropriate action based on established runbooks and SOPs.
* Validate successful completion of critical business processes and escalate failures impacting customer or operational activities. Incident & Service Request Management
* Act as the first point of contact for incidents, service requests, and user inquiries.
* Monitor ticket queues and support dashboards to ensure timely response and resolution in line with defined SLAs.
* Perform initial diagnosis, troubleshooting, and resolution of application-related issues.
* Accurately log, categorize, prioritize, and assign incidents and requests within the ITSM platform.
* Escalate unresolved or complex issues to development support teams with appropriate documentation and analysis. Business Process Support
* Support critical logistics processes including order management, shipment execution, transportation, inventory, warehouse operations, and customer-facing transactions.
* Investigate failed transactions, processing exceptions, and integration issues impacting business operations.
* Coordinate with business users to validate issue resolution and restore normal service. Customer & User Support
* Provide timely and professional support to internal business users, external customers, and operational teams across multiple regions and time zones.
* Communicate incident status, updates, and resolutions effectively to stakeholders.
* Manage user expectations and maintain a high level of customer satisfaction. Knowledge Management & Documentation
* Execute support procedures in accordance with documented SOPs, work instructions, and support playbooks.
* Maintain accurate incident records, troubleshooting notes, and resolution details.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of knowledge articles, FAQs, and operational documentation. Service Operations & Governance
* Participate in shift handovers and ensure proper communication of open issues, business risks, and ongoing activities.
* Identify recurring issues and support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing incident volumes and improving service quality.
* Ensure compliance with operational processes, security policies, and support governance standards.
* Support major incident management activities by providing timely updates, diagnostics, and coordination assistance. Reporting & Escalation
* Track and report operational issues, trends, and service performance metrics.
* Escalate critical incidents, business-impacting issues, and SLA risks according to defined escalation procedures.
* Assist in preparing operational reports and shift summaries for management review. Release Planning & Readiness
* Participate in application release and deployment activities by supporting release planning, readiness checks, and implementation schedules.
* Validate release prerequisites, deployment checklists, and operational readiness prior to production deployments.
* Coordinate with development, testing, infrastructure, and business teams to ensure successful release execution. Deployment & Release Support
* Support production deployments and scheduled releases during business and non-business hours, as required.
* Execute predefined deployment validation and smoke test procedures following application releases.
* Monitor application performance, business transaction flows, integrations, and critical alerts immediately after deployment.
* Identify, document, and escalate any release-related issues impacting system stability or business operations. Post-Release Monitoring & Validation
* Perform post-release health checks to confirm successful deployment and application functionality.
* Validate critical business processes, interfaces, batch jobs, and integrations following production releases.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders and support teams to verify successful completion of release validation activities.
* Support rollback activities and incident management processes when release-related issues are identified. Change Management
* Follow established Change Management processes and governance requirements for production implementations.
* Review and understand release notes, deployment instructions, known issues, and support impacts prior to releases.
* Maintain release documentation, deployment records, and post-implementation reports.
* Participate in post-release reviews and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to enhance release quality and operational stability.

**Qualifications**
0-1 years of application support experience.
  
  

* Experience supporting enterprise applications.
* ServiceNow experience preferred, any other Ticketing tool experience works.
* Exposure to logistics, transportation, supply chain, or warehouse management applications is an advantage.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
**ABOUT OOLIO:**

Oolio is a leading B2B SaaS platform transforming how hospitality venues operate and grow. Trusted by more than 22,000 venues, we power mission-critical POS, payments, online ordering, kiosks, loyalty, kitchen management, and real-time insights — all within one connected ecosystem.

We are building the operating system for modern hospitality — simplifying complex operations, accelerating service, and unlocking smarter, data-driven decisions. Built by hospitality professionals with decades of industry experience, we understand the realities of every shift, every service rush, and every guest interaction. From cafes and quick-service restaurants to pubs, multi-site groups, and stadiums, Oolio enables venues to operate seamlessly at scale. With next-business-day settlements, powerful third-party integrations, and 24/7 real human support, we go beyond software — we become long-term partners in growth.

As a rapidly scaling product-led organisation, we’re shaping the future of hospitality technology.

We build the technology backbone that powers modern hospitality businesses to perform, compete, and thrive at scale.

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

At Oolio,
**Technical Support Specialist**
are customer champions who take ownership of post-installation success across mission-critical POS and payments platforms. You will play a key role in ensuring hospitality venues operate smoothly by delivering timely, empathetic, and technically sound support within a fast-paced SaaS environment.

You will collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams in Hyderabad, as well as our Level 1 Support team in Manila, to resolve production issues, communicate product updates, and deliver an exceptional customer experience across single-site venues, franchise networks, and multi-location hospitality groups in Australia.

**Key focus area's**
-

(1) Customer Support & Communication

(2) Product Expertise & Cross-Team Collaboration

(3) Incident Ownership & Escalation

(4) Internal Tools & Process Adaptability

* Own end-to-end resolution of customer issues—from first response through troubleshooting, escalation, follow-up, and confirmed closure.

* Handle customer queries via live chat, ticketing systems, email, and phone while maintaining high responsiveness and service quality standards.
* Develop deep expertise in the POS and payments ecosystem including online ordering, third-party integrations, time & attendance, reservations, loyalty systems, billing workflows, and payment processing.

* Take ownership of incidents reported by customers or internal L1 teams and ensure structured escalation to development teams when required.
* Follow up proactively with Engineering and Product teams until resolution is delivered back to the customer.
* Translate complex technical issues into simple, customer-friendly explanations.
* Maintain accurate documentation, ticket updates, and internal communication across support systems.
* Adapt quickly to new product enhancements, support tools, and process updates.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of support documentation, knowledge bases, and internal workflows.
* Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure seamless customer experience across multi-venue and franchise operations.

**Role Title:**
Customer Support and Product Specialist – Level 1 Support (f
*inal role/title may vary based on experience and interview outcomes*
)

2 – 6 Years (strong hands-on experience in Tech Support / SaaS / POS systems preferred)

**Education:**
Bachelor’s Degree (Any discipline)

**Domain Preference**
: POS & Payments | Hospitality Technology

**Work Model:**
Work from Office – 5 Days a Week (Flexible Day Offs)

**Work Timings:**
7.30 AM – 4.30 PM IST (also have other Rotational shifts availability includes weekends)

**Technology & Tools:**
POS Systems, Payment Terminals, Online Ordering Platforms, Networking Basics, Hardware Troubleshooting (Printers, Tablets, Devices), Intercom, HubSpot / Zendesk (or similar ticketing systems), Microsoft Teams, Outlook

* Strong troubleshooting skills across software, hardware, networking basics, and third-party integrations.

title: IT Operations Analyst [T500-30162]
description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.**

**Who are we:**

Core Insurance Platforms (CIP) is Zurich’s global capability responsible for building, running, and evolving core insurance technology. We set a unified, scalable operating model—covering governance, standards, architecture, service delivery, and reuse—so our business units can deliver at speed and scale.

CIP is the strategic steward of Zurich’s Guidewire ecosystem, aligning platform roadmaps to business strategy while driving stability, modernization, reduced supplier dependency, and long term cost efficiency.

India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. We bring together experts in AI, engineering, analysis, quality, and architecture to deliver product & process solutions, application run services, change and transformation initiatives, and centralized platform services across both on prem and Guidewire Cloud environments. Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**New Employee Onboarding:**

* Coordinate end-to-end technology onboarding activities for new employees and contingent workers.
* Review onboarding requests to ensure required information has been provided and identify missing or incomplete requirements.
* Coordinate activities with hiring managers and supporting IT teams to promote Day 1 technology readiness.
* Track onboarding requests from initiation through completion and follow up on outstanding dependencies.
* Maintain accurate onboarding records and provide status visibility to stakeholders.
* Identify potential onboarding delays and coordinate resolution before the employee's scheduled start date.
* Support standardized onboarding profiles based on employee role and technology requirements.

* Manage or validate appropriate Active Directory security groups, shared resources, and access requirements.
* Work with identity management and application support teams when provisioning requires specialized fulfillment.
* Verify that required access has been completed and identify outstanding access dependencies.
* Troubleshoot and escalate provisioning issues that could affect employee readiness.

* Coordinate the ordering and preparation of laptops, monitors, docking stations, peripherals, and other approved equipment.
* Use
  **COUPA**
  and applicable procurement processes to facilitate hardware purchasing and monitor fulfillment.
* Coordinate required software installation based on employee role and business requirements.
* Track equipment orders and resolve or escalate fulfillment issues.
* Coordinate delivery or availability of equipment based on an employee's work location.

* Use
  **ServiceNow**
  as a primary platform for managing onboarding requests and associated IT work.
* Monitor assigned onboarding requests and related fulfillment activities.
* Maintain accurate ticket status, notes, assignments, and completion information.
* Coordinate dependencies across technical teams and escalate issues when necessary.
* Ensure requests are appropriately completed and documented.

**Scheduling and Coordination:**

* Schedule and coordinate onboarding-related activities with new employees, hiring managers, technicians, and supporting teams.
* Coordinate technology setup or installation appointments when required.
* Communicate upcoming onboarding schedules and outstanding requirements.
* Adjust schedules when equipment, access, employee availability, or other dependencies change.
* Provide clear status communication throughout the onboarding process.

**Reporting, Data Management and Automation:**

* Maintain onboarding data using
  **Excel, SharePoint, and ServiceNow**
  .
* Use Excel to analyze onboarding data, identify exceptions, reconcile information, and support operational reporting.
* Maintain accurate SharePoint lists and other onboarding data repositories where applicable.
* Use
  **Power Automate**
  to support workflow automation, notifications, reminders, data updates, and process improvements.
* Identify repetitive manual activities that may be candidates for automation.
* Support reporting that measures onboarding completion and operational effectiveness.

**Qualifications:**

**Must have Skills:**

Candidates should have working knowledge or experience with:

* **ServiceNow**
  : Request, incident, task, workflow, and onboarding ticket management
* **Active Directory**
  : User accounts, security groups, and access administration
* **Microsoft Intune**
  : Endpoint management, device configuration, and application deployment
* **Microsoft Excel**
  : Data tracking, filtering, reconciliation, formulas, and reporting
* **Microsoft SharePoint**
  : Lists, documentation, collaboration, and operational data management
* **Microsoft Power Automate**
  : Workflow automation, notifications, approvals, and data integration
* **COUPA**
  : Hardware purchasing, procurement, and order management
* Microsoft 365 applications and Windows endpoint environments.

**Core Competencies:**

**Organization and Attention to Detail:**

* Ability to manage multiple employees, start dates, orders, access requests, and technical dependencies simultaneously while maintaining accurate records.

**Customer Focus:**

* Strong commitment to providing new employees and hiring managers with a professional, responsive, and positive onboarding experience.

**Communication:**

* Ability to communicate clearly with new employees, hiring managers, technical teams, procurement teams, and other stakeholders.

**Ownership and Follow-Through:**

* Ability to take ownership of onboarding requests and proactively follow outstanding activities through resolution rather than simply handing work between teams.

**Problem Solving:**

* Ability to identify onboarding roadblocks, investigate their cause, engage the appropriate technical teams, and coordinate resolution.

**Process Improvement:**

* Ability to identify inefficient or repetitive processes and recommend opportunities for standardization or automation.

**Collaboration:**

* Ability to work effectively across End User Computing, Access Management, Procurement, application support, hiring managers, and other teams involved in onboarding.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting IT new-hire onboarding or employee lifecycle processes.
* Experience in an enterprise IT support or End User Computing environment.
* Experience coordinating hardware, software, and system-access provisioning.
* Experience with ServiceNow request or workflow management.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 technologies and endpoint management.
* Experience with purchasing or procurement processes.
* Experience developing or supporting workflow automation using Power Automate.
* Strong Excel data-management and reporting skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

title: Microsoft 365 Administrator
description:
About pharma&

pharma& is a privately owned global pharmaceutical company headquartered in Vienna, Austria. We focus on breathing new life into proven medicines, preserving their availability, and ensuring essential treatments reach patients worldwide. With a growing portfolio across haematology, oncology and other therapeutic areas, we operate through a global network of subsidiaries, joint ventures and partners to support development, manufacturing and access.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Microsoft 365 Administrator to join our Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Hyderabad.

You will be responsible for the administration, security, reliability and continuous improvement of our Microsoft 365 environment, supporting colleagues across our global organisation.

This is a
**100% hands-on technical position**
, not a coordination or management role. You will be expected to work directly within Microsoft administration portals, troubleshoot complex issues, implement configuration changes and take ownership of assigned services.

Working closely with our international IT team, you will also help strengthen security, improve operational processes, maintain documentation and reduce reliance on external support providers.

Key Responsibilities

**Microsoft 365 & Exchange Online**

* Administer Microsoft 365 services, tenant configurations, user accounts, groups, licensing and service health.
* Manage Exchange Online, including shared mailboxes, distribution lists, delegation, mail flow, email authentication and archiving.
* Monitor mailbox capacity, retention and recoverability, and resolve escalated email-related issues.
* Support Microsoft 365 licensing management, optimisation and administrative reporting.

**SharePoint, OneDrive & Microsoft Teams**

* Administer SharePoint Online, OneDrive and Microsoft Teams, including provisioning, permissions, external sharing and governance.
* Review and remediate excessive access permissions, oversharing risks and inappropriate external access.
* Support SharePoint governance and access reviews using administrative tools such as SysKit or equivalent solutions.
* Work with business stakeholders to ensure confidential information is appropriately protected.

**Microsoft Entra ID & Endpoint Management**

* Administer Microsoft Entra ID, including identity lifecycle management, MFA, Conditional Access, privileged access and enterprise application integrations.
* Configure and maintain Microsoft Intune, including device enrolment, Windows Autopilot, compliance policies, application deployment and endpoint configuration.
* Support Windows and mobile-device management, including device provisioning, security and offboarding.
* Maintain secure administrative access, including emergency access accounts and privileged access controls.

**Security, Compliance & Data Protection**

* Configure and maintain Microsoft Purview capabilities, including data loss prevention, sensitivity labels, retention, audit and eDiscovery.
* Support legal hold, data preservation and authorised discovery requests in coordination with Legal, Compliance and IT leadership.
* Administer Microsoft 365 backup and recovery solutions, including AvePoint or equivalent platforms.
* Perform data restoration, recovery testing and maintain supporting documentation.
* Work with the Security Analyst to implement security recommendations and remediate Microsoft 365 configuration weaknesses.

**Microsoft 365 Copilot & Automation**

* Support Microsoft 365 Copilot administration, licensing, configuration and ongoing governance.
* Assess SharePoint and OneDrive permissions and data exposure risks associated with Copilot.
* Work with stakeholders to implement appropriate access controls before and during AI adoption.
* Automate repetitive administration using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and other approved Microsoft tools.

**IT Operations & Continuous Improvement**

* Resolve escalated Microsoft 365 incidents and service requests through the IT service management platform.
* Maintain accurate technical documentation, operational procedures and troubleshooting runbooks.
* Support onboarding, offboarding, access reviews, audits and periodic administrative activities.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, security and support colleagues on cross-platform incidents and changes.
* Support Microsoft 365 tenant migrations, integration projects and platform improvements where required.
* Identify opportunities to improve reliability, security, automation and operational efficiency.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum
  **5 years of hands-on Microsoft 365 administration experience**
  in a corporate or enterprise environment.
* Strong practical expertise in Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive and Microsoft Teams administration.
* Demonstrated experience managing Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, Conditional Access and identity security.
* Hands-on experience administering Microsoft Intune, device compliance, configuration and application deployment.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Purview, including retention, data loss prevention and eDiscovery.
* Experience troubleshooting complex Microsoft 365 issues and implementing configuration changes independently.
* Good PowerShell scripting skills and familiarity with Microsoft Graph.
* Understanding of Microsoft 365 security principles, least-privilege access and data protection.
* Strong communication, problem-solving and documentation skills.

Desirable Experience

* AvePoint or another enterprise Microsoft 365 backup and recovery solution.
* SysKit or similar SharePoint governance and reporting tools.
* Microsoft 365 Copilot administration and information protection.
* Microsoft 365 tenant migrations or multi-tenant environments.
* Experience supporting regulated industries such as pharmaceuticals or life sciences.
* Microsoft certifications such as MS-102, MD-102, SC-300 or SC-400.

Why Join pharma&?

* Work directly with a global IT team supporting an international pharmaceutical organisation.
* Take genuine technical ownership of enterprise Microsoft 365 services.
* Gain exposure to security, compliance, modern workplace technologies and AI governance.
* Join a growing GCC with opportunities to develop your technical expertise and responsibilities.

Working Conditions

* **Location:**

* **Working hours:**
  11:00 AM to 8:00 PM IST, aligned with European business hours.
* **Employment:**
  Full-time.
* **Work environment:**
  International corporate setting, collaborating with colleagues across multiple countries.

Workplace Expectations

* Maintain strict confidentiality and protect sensitive company and business information.
* Follow company security policies, change management procedures and professional conduct standards.
* Take ownership of technical responsibilities and maintain clear, accurate operational documentation.

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India (Office-based)

11:00 AM – 8:00 PM IST

**Experience:**
5+ years

**Employment type:**
Full-time

title: Senior Support Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking a Senior Support Engineer to join our Cloud Customer Support organization. In this role, you will independently investigate and resolve complex cloud and infrastructure challenges, driving customer issues through timely and effective resolution. You will collaborate with Engineering and Operations, mentor fellow engineers, and drive continuous improvements that strengthen service reliability and deliver an exceptional customer experience.
  
  
As a Senior Support Engineer, you will serve as a trusted technical interface for OCI customers, applying strong technical judgment and structured troubleshooting to challenging production issues. You will work across cloud infrastructure technologies, analyze technical evidence, identify potential causes, and engage the appropriate teams when an issue requires cross-functional expertise.
  
  
You will own customer issues throughout the support lifecycle, maintaining clear and proactive communication while balancing technical depth, urgency, and customer impact. Your work may involve complex or multi-technology scenarios where the resolution path is not immediately known, requiring independent investigation, effective technical judgment, and timely collaboration with subject matter experts to drive issues toward resolution.
  
  
Beyond resolving individual incidents, you will contribute to the effectiveness of the broader Support organization by sharing technical knowledge, mentoring engineers, improving troubleshooting practices and documentation, and identifying opportunities to improve support processes and customer outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Independently investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex customer issues involving cloud infrastructure and related technologies.
* Own customer issues throughout the support lifecycle, driving timely progress while maintaining high standards of technical quality and customer communication.
* Apply structured troubleshooting methodologies using logs, telemetry, diagnostic tools, technical documentation, runbooks, and engineering experience to isolate problems and determine appropriate next steps.
* Troubleshoot across multiple infrastructure technologies, including compute, networking, operating systems, storage, virtualization, and related cloud services.
* Work effectively with customers during complex or business-impacting incidents, providing clear technical guidance, meaningful progress updates, and well-defined next steps.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Service Operations, and other technical teams to investigate cross-service issues, identify product-related issues, and restore customer services.
* Escalate issues appropriately when additional expertise is required while continuing to maintain ownership of the customer experience and support engagement.
* Identify recurring technical and operational issues and contribute recommendations that improve troubleshooting effectiveness, service reliability, support processes, and customer experience.
* Create and improve technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks that enable consistent and efficient issue resolution.
* Share technical knowledge, troubleshooting techniques, and best practices with peers and mentor less-experienced engineers.
* Contribute to team projects and initiatives that improve support quality, operational efficiency, case handling, and customer outcomes.
* Capture key technical findings and lessons learned from customer incidents to improve organizational knowledge and future troubleshooting effectiveness.
* Continuously develop expertise across OCI services, cloud infrastructure, and technologies relevant to the supported environment.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Engineering, or a related technical filed.
* At least 4 years of relevant technical experience and at least 6 years of overall professional experience.
* Demonstrated experience supporting, operating, administering, or troubleshooting cloud infrastructure, enterprise infrastructure, or related technologies.
* Strong understanding of cloud computing and infrastructure concepts, with demonstrated troubleshooting and problem-solving capability.
* Ability to independently investigate complex technical issues, identify root causes, and drive effective resolution.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure technologies such as compute, networking, operating systems, storage, and virtualization.
* Ability to analyze logs, system behavior, diagnostic information, and other technical evidence to isolate issues and determine appropriate actions.
* Strong customer orientation and the ability to manage technically challenging customer situations with professionalism, urgency, and empathy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical information clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across Support, Engineering, Operations, and other technical teams.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies, apply that knowledge to customer problems, and share technical knowledge with others.
* Atleast 2 completed cloud certifications from recognized cloud providers.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in cloud technical support, infrastructure support, production operations, NOC, SRE, systems engineering, or a comparable technical environment.
* Strong understanding of Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), particularly Compute, Storage and Networking.
* Hands-on troubleshooting experience with Linux and/or Windows operating systems.
* Knowledge of networking concepts and technologies such as TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing, and network connectivity troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with virtualization, storage, and distributed cloud infrastructure.
* Experience supporting enterprise customers and managing complex or business-impacting production incidents.
* Experience creating technical documentation, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, or operational runbooks.
* Familiarity with scripting, automation, diagnostic tooling, APIs, or software development concepts.
* Understanding of cloud security, operational best practices, and relevant industry security and compliance standards.

**Location & Work Schedule:**

* This is a full-time, permanent position based in Bengaluru, India.
* The role supports a global customer environment and requires flexibility to work assigned shifts, including rotational weekend and holiday coverage, based on business needs.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Major Incident Co-ordinator
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
  
  
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience.
**Want to be part of it?**

You'll be the central point for escalations, working with teams to resolve issues and prevent future incidents.

Incident Management
  
  

* Oversee all Major and critical incidents, ensuring SLA compliance
* Own and manage business-critical escalations and communication to all management levels
* Take full ownership of issues from identification through resolution
* Liaise with partners and suppliers, providing regular proactive updates

Root Cause Analysis & Improvement
  
  

* Lead RCA for all major incidents within Keyloop and 3rd Party providers
* Identify trends and patterns to prevent recurring issues
* Document learnings and share knowledge across teams
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives

Reporting & Communication
  
  

* Create and maintain operational dashboards for real-time monitoring
* Prepare executive summaries for senior management
* Use automation tools (Copilot, etc.) to summarize meetings and generate reports
* Provide clear communication to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

System Management
  
  

* Manage incidents and workflows using Jira and Jira Service Management (JSM)
* Keep all systems updated with current status and actions
* Monitor for fraudulent activity and raise security incidents as needed

**Required Qualifications**
**Experience**

* Minimum of 5+ years in IT, Infrastructure and Cloud Services
* Strong Working knowledge with: Application integration, AWS and other Cloud Services, Middleware, Data Centres, Networks, Compute and Databases

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced proficiency in Jira and Jira Service Management
* Dashboard creation and metrics analysis
* Automation tools and AI assistants (Copilot)
* ITIL framework and incident management best practices

**Essential Skills**

* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Ability to translate complex technical issues into clear executive summaries
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
* Calm under pressure during high-level escalations
* Diplomatic and professional manner
* Time management with ability to handle multiple priorities

title: Product Support Specialist
description:
**Description**
*Position at Ziff Davis*
Product Support Specialist
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
The Opportunity:
  
  
We are seeking a Product Support Specialist to act as the bridge between Dwell subscribers and our engineering team. In this role, you will report to the director of revenue products. In this hybrid role, you will spend part of your time leading high-touch customer support and relationship management, and the other part translating those frontline insights into the product roadmap. You understand user pain points firsthand because you talk to customers every day, and you have the technical and strategic skills to build permanent solutions into our software or service offerings.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  
Customer Service & Advocacy
  
  

* Customer Support Response Management: Handle approximately 200 customer support tickets per week for Dwell brand subscribers, including email tickets and phone support for customer voicemails
* Payment and Account Administration: Utilize Stripe platform to resolve customer access issues, update user email addresses and payment methods, and address general customer concerns
* Issue Analysis and Reporting: Create reports documenting common customer support issues in Google Docs/Sheets format to enable product teams to prioritize system improvements and enhance customer experience
* Third-Party Coordination: Collaborate with Dwell Magazine's fulfillment partner, CDS Global, to resolve complex customer issues that cannot be addressed through Stripe's platform capabilities
* Client Enablement: Create and update customer-facing knowledge bases, release notes, training materials, and troubleshooting guides.
* Relationship Management: Build trust-based relationships with subscribers, gathering qualitative feedback on product experience.

Product Management
  
  

* Feedback Synthesis: Analyze support ticket trends, churn reasons, and customer feature requests to identify systemic product gaps.
* Roadmap Prioritization: Own and prioritize the product backlog, balancing urgent customer fixes with long-term strategic product goals.
* Requirements Definition: Write Product Requirements Documents and user stories for the engineering and design teams.
* Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate with engineering, QA, and marketing to guide features from concept through launch, ensuring the support team is fully trained before release.
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) including Customer Satisfaction, Net Promoter Score (NPS), Customer Retention/Churn, and Feature Adoption Rates.
* Report monthly insights to executive leadership regarding how product updates impact customer happiness and business revenue.

Job Qualifications:
  
  

* Experience: 3+ years of combined experience in customer service management, customer success, or technical support, alongside 2+ years in an associate product manager or product-adjacent role.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Customer Empathy: Exceptional listening, patience, and written/verbal communication skills with a proven track record of de-escalating frustrated clients.
* Product Sense: Ability to look at a repetitive customer complaint and conceptualize a scalable, software-driven solution.
* Experience using modern helpdesk software (e.g., Zendesk, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud) and product management tools (e.g., Jira, Productboard, Linear, Asana).
* Preferred: basic technical literacy (familiarity with API logs, SQL, or web technologies) to effectively communicate tradeoffs with engineering teams.

**About Dwell**
For over two decades, Dwell has been the definitive voice of modern architecture and design, exploring how smart, intentional design makes everyday life better across print, Dwell.com, and social channels.
  
  
**About Ziff Davis**
Ziff Davis (NASDAQ: ZD) is a vertically focused digital media and internet company whose portfolio includes leading brands in technology, shopping, gaming and entertainment, connectivity, health, cybersecurity, and martech. Today, Ziff Davis is focused on seven key verticals – Technology, Connectivity, Shopping, Entertainment, Health & Wellness, Cybersecurity and Marketing Technology. Its brands include IGN, Mashable, RetailMeNot, PCMag, Humble Bundle, Spiceworks, Ookla (Speedtest), RootMetrics, Everyday Health, BabyCenter, Moz, iContact and Vipre Security.
  
  
Our Benefits
  
  
Lifestyle offers competitive salaries in addition to robust, health and wellness-focused benefits. We are committed to a work-life balance with paid time off when you need it.
  
  
At Ziff Davis, we remain dedicated to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to succeed. We offer Employee Resource Groups, company-sponsored events, and regular opportunities for professional growth through educational support, mentorship programs, and career development resources. Our employees are recognized and celebrated through employee engagement programs and recognition awards.
  
  
If you're seeking a dynamic and collaborative work environment where you can see the direct impact of your performance and thrive both personally and professionally, then Lifestyle is the place for you.
  
  
Ziff Davis is an Equal Opportunity Employer. At Ziff Davis, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) has always been about fairness, equal opportunity, and belonging. DEI enables us to attract and retain the best talent, regardless of background or circumstances, while enabling our thousands of employees worldwide to thrive. If you have a disability or learning difficulty that requires accommodation, please let us know by sending an email to [email protected].

title: System Specialist
description:
*Diasorin is a global leader in diagnostic solutions, pushing the boundaries of science and technology to create cutting-edge tools that improve healthcare worldwide. With a legacy spanning over 50 years, we've earned our reputation for excellence by developing innovative diagnostic assays and instruments that are trusted by healthcare providers around the world.*
*Our broad offering of diagnostic tests and Licensed Technology solutions, made available thanks to ongoing investments in research, positions us as the player with the widest range of specialty solutions in the sector and identifies us as the "Diagnostics Specialist."*
***Why Join Diasorin?***

* Impactful Work: When you join Diasorin, you become part of a team that's dedicated to improving lives. Your contributions will directly impact patient care, making a meaningful difference in the world.
* Global Reach & Innovation: Our work transcends borders. Joining Diasorin means collaborating with colleagues from all over the world, expanding your horizons, and contributing to global healthcare solutions at the forefront of the diagnostic industry.

*Diverse and Inclusive Culture: We believe in the strength of diversity, and our inclusive culture reflects this commitment. We value your unique perspective and offer a supportive, collaborative environment where everyone can thrive.*
*Join Our Team: If you're passionate about innovation, diversity, and making a positive impact on healthcare, Diasorin is the place for you. We're looking for passionate and talented individuals who are ready to embrace new challenges and drive healthcare solutions forward.*
*Are you ready to be part of a dynamic team that's shaping the future of diagnostics? Join Diasorin and become a catalyst for change in the world of healthcare. Apply today and be a part of our exciting journey toward a healthier, more connected world. Together, we can make an impact!*
**Job Scope**
To provide technical service (in alignment with approved local and group practice) and support to customers with instrument maintenance, calibration, troubleshooting, education and repair on our analytical devices. Promote the image of the company in co-operation with sales and specialist workforce. Become a specialist in frontline service of the device group.
  
  
**Key Duties And Responsibilities**

* Comprehensively understand and grasp the particularity of the technology, application, and maintenance of DiaSorin products. Participate in the training courses on DiaSorin Products, technologies and services, and pass the training examination.
* Providing technical service and maintenance service support to dealers and to end users, in and after sales: Assist sales team with technical inputs, demonstrations to successfully close details.
* Frequently visit the users for monitoring the satisfaction and technical demand of end users of DiaSorin company and distributors. Produce weekly work reports for discussion and for Service Managers approvals.
* Monitoring the technological advantages and disadvantages and application situations of the competing products in the market, produce monthly report for discussion for Service Managers approvals.
* Manage and report all activities through SFDC on a daily basis as per the corporate policies. Other missions assigned by DHIPL, Country Manager and National Service Manager.
* Ensure compliance with corporate policies and supplying adequate inputs into the service organization. Handle, manage and maintain spare parts and car stock through SGAT.
* Provide technical service and maintenance service support to end users as per the organizational requirements.
* All the service activities have to be captured in SFDC on a daily basis and all the calls to be concluded on the same day as per corporate policies.
* All country stock spare parts inventory status to be updated on a monthly basis.
* Any other task may be assigned by the National Service Manager from time to time.

**Education, Experience, And Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree or diploma in Engineering
* 5-7 years in a field directly related to the work
* Previous experience in the IVD (In Vitro Diagnostics) and/or highly regulated environments and biotechnology industry.
* Previous IVD service experience
* Knowledge and skill in preventative maintenance in installing, servicing, troubleshooting, repairing, calibrating, and maintaining medical diagnostic or clinical laboratory instrumentation
* Knowledge/understanding of electronics and medical terminology
* Ability to demonstrate and explain correct operation of equipment
* Understanding of good laboratory practices and techniques
* Working knowledge of diagnostic equipment
* Current Drivers Licence

**What We Offer**
Receive a competitive salary and benefits package as you grow your career at DiaSorin. Join our team and discover how your work can impact the lives of people all over the world.

description:
**Description**
We are seeking a dedicated Base Building Maintenance Escalation Specialist to join our Amazon Maintenance Operations Centre (AMOC) team. This role is essential in providing 24/7 monitoring and response for our Amazon business unit, ensuring continuous operation through effective vendor management and technical support. The successful candidate will be responsible for first-line monitoring, vendor dispatch coordination, and escalation management across multiple Amazon business units.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Respond to and triage incoming work requests within standard service level agreements (SLAs).
* Manage remote works from start to end, including work order/purchase order raising and invoice processing.
* Communicate effectively and efficiently with stakeholders (Reliability Maintenance Engineering, Ops, H&S etc.).
* Provide updates on vendor status, take the lead on coordinating works during an escalation.
* Identify and escalate critical issues through appropriate channels to maintain equipment reliability and minimize operational impact.
* Monitor, respond to, and manage refrigeration alarm systems, ensuring timely response to critical alerts.
* Manage and prioritize work queues based on urgency and SLA requirements.
* Coordinate with local vendors and maintenance teams to ensure timely resolution of facility issues.
* Execute emergency response procedures during critical facility incidents.
* Document all actions and maintain accurate case records.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives for processes and procedures.

The Amazon Maintenance Operation Center International (AMOC INTL) is a 24/7/365 centralized function within Central RME, delivering remote maintenance services and support to field RME teams across all business types worldwide. Since launching in Q4 2019 with 24 European AGL/GSF sites, AMOC INTL has grown over 5 316%, now managing 1 300+ buildings across North America (1 099 sites), Europe (170 sites), APAC, LATAM, and AMET. title: Data Center Infrastructure Specialist
description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Data Center Deployment Specialist to join its Professional Services team. Academic and commercial groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to revolutionize deep learning and data analytics, and to power data centers. Join the team building many of the largest and fastest data centers in the world! NVIDIA is looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer-focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills.
  
  
As a Data Center Infrastructure Specialist, you will be interacting with customers, partners, and internal teams, to analyse, define and implement large scale Datacenter projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Datacenter Infrastructure design and cluster deployment planning.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Design and implement flawless data center infrastructure solutions to meet the needs of our customers.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful deployment of data center infrastructure.
* Datacenter Planning: Floor Plan, Rack Elevation, Simulation
* Cable deployment planning including - ensuring requirements are accurate such as number and type of connections, port assignments, and timing of activity while following standard methodologies, Point-to-Point Design.
* Deploy and Support NVIDIA products.
* Validating and updating all related work instructions for Datacenter activities.
* Responsible for providing input for Data Center Standards updates as required; balancing multiple activities and priorities; participate in projects calls.
* Documenting processes and keeping event logs.

title: Network Operations Center - Shift Lead
description:
**About Us**
Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
  
  
At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
  
  
**Why We Do What We Do**
In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
  
  
Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award-winning culture.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The NOC Shift Lead is responsible for leading a team of Network Engineers during a designated shift, managing Major Incidents, ensuring the smooth operation, monitoring, and maintenance of the organization's computer networks. This role involves both technical expertise and leadership skills.
  
  
**Job Overview**
At Zelis, Network Operating Center (NOC) Shift Lead is a leadership role within the NOC responsible for overseeing the activities of a team of engineers during a specific shift. This role requires a combination of technical expertise in network operations, leadership skills, Incident Management and the ability to manage and respond to network incidents.
  
  
The NOC Shift Lead is responsible for leading a team of Network Engineers during a designated shift, managing Major Incidents, ensuring the smooth operation, monitoring, and maintenance of the organization's computer networks. This role involves both technical expertise and leadership skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Working in 24/7 Operational support.
* Monitor network, server, and health infrastructure using tools like LogicMonitor, New relic.
* Network Service & Protocols (DHCP, DNS, NTP, VPN & Tunneling, QoS, Common Protocols)
* Good experience in Firewalls, IDS/IPS and Authentication, configuration & troubleshooting of Router, Firewalls (Palo Alto), VPNs & Switch, troubleshooting tools (ping, traceroute, netstat, Wireshark) and Access control.
* Respond to alerts and incidents, perform initial troubleshooting, and escalate as needed.
* Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) for issue resolution and escalation.
* Assist in routine maintenance tasks such as patching, backups, and system checks.
* Windows Server Administration and troubleshooting.
* Perception of analyzing the workflow, issue or the cause of the problem.
* Manages firewalls, IDS/IPS, and endpoint protection systems is an added advantage.
* Mentors junior staff and enforces security best practices.
* Able to perform the Firewall, WLC, Switch and Meraki upgrades.
* Lead Incident Management activities, ensuring timely resolution and communication.
* Initiate bridge calls or war rooms to drive communication among stakeholders for timely incident resolution.
* Plan and coordinate the activities of the NOC team during the shift.
* Assign tasks and responsibilities to team members.
* Act as the point of contact for major incidents during the shift.
* Communicate effectively with management and other teams during incidents.
* Monitor network performance and respond to alerts as needed.
* Analyze incidents, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure that network issues are resolved within established SLAs.
* Maintain accurate records of incidents, resolutions, and activities during the shift.
* Generate shift reports and provide updates to management and relevant stakeholders.
* Provide ongoing training to NOC Engineers to enhance their technical skills.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement within the team.
* Collaborate with other NOC Shift Leads and teams to address cross-functional issues.
* Participate in regular meetings to share insights and updates.
* Collaborate with Network Engineering, Infrastructure, Cloud, Security, Application Support, Service Management, and vendor teams, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on service availability and reducing MTTD, MTTA, and MTTR.
* Ensure compliance with security protocols and procedures.

**Qualifications**

* 5-6 years of experience in relevant domain NOC
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications such as Cisco Certified Network Associate CCNA or CCNP
* Proven experience in network administration and incident response.
* Previous leadership or supervisory experience.
* Practical understanding of ITIL-based Incident, Change, Problem, and Major Incident Management processes.

**Skills**

* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent communication and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to handle high-pressure situations and make informed decisions.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, log-analysis, and ITSM platforms such as Splunk, Datadog, LogicMonitor, Jira Service Management, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong incident troubleshooting, prioritization, escalation, service restoration, alert correlation, and RCA support skills.
* Ability to communicate concise incident updates covering impact, actions taken, findings, ownership, next steps, and outstanding risks to both technical and operational stakeholders.
* Strong written documentation and knowledge-transfer skills, including incident notes, shift handovers, SOPs, runbooks, Knowledge Base articles, and troubleshooting guides.
* Ability to identify opportunities for operational automation and continuous improvement, with strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and customer-service skills.

This role requires strong technical and operational skills, with the ability to independently monitor, triage, troubleshoot, escalate, document, and support restoration of network, server, infrastructure, and application incidents during assigned shifts.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.

Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

description:

The Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer (Teams & Slack) is a senior technical practitioner responsible for the engineering, administration, reliability, security, and continuous improvement of enterprise messaging and productivity platforms, with a primary focus on Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate. The role will also support and engineer the firm’s enterprise Slack environment. This is a Hybrid role and works in 2pm-11pm IST shift.

The engineer will serve as a subject matter expert for enterprise messaging, productivity, and low-code automation technologies, partnering with Digital Workplace engineering teams, Information Security, Identity & Access Management, business stakeholders, service delivery teams, and managed service partners to deliver secure, reliable, and intuitive digital workplace experiences for employees globally.
  
  

* Engineer, administer, and continuously improve enterprise Microsoft Teams, Power Platform, and Slack environments.
* Design and maintain platform configurations, policies, standards, governance controls, integrations, and lifecycle processes.

* Engineer and support Microsoft Power Platform capabilities, with a particular focus on Power Apps and Power Automate.

* Develop solutions that improve platform administration, reporting, provisioning, governance, lifecycle management, and operational efficiency.

* Monitor Power Platform environments, applications, flows, capacity, connectors, and related platform health.

* Strong hands-on experience administering and engineering Microsoft Teams in a medium-to-large enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 architecture and the relationships among Teams, Power Platform, Entra ID, and other Microsoft 365 services.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Apps and Power Automate.

* Experience working within enterprise Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.
* Strong technical documentation and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

description:
**About DHL Group and Procurement:**
DHL Group the logistics provider of the world with over 580,000 employees in more than 220 countries and territories. We are an organization that is not just moving goods around, we have a very clear purpose, and we are: Connecting People. Improving Lives. We provide challenges and opportunities for personal and professional development, we recognize the difference you bring to our business and together we share the pride of building one of the largest world leaders in logistics and supply chain.
  
  
DHL
**Corporate Procurement**
is a trustworthy business partner that builds a competitive ecosystem for the DHL Group –
**SUSTAINABLE, AGILE, CONNECTED, FORWARD LOOKING**
. We transform the way DHL Group is sourcing products, systems and services from external partners, leveraging modern digital tools and technologies. Our global procurement team is our biggest asset and by focusing on clear priorities, we drive tangible value for our colleagues. As our business keeps growing, we want you in our APAC region.
  
  
Ready to immerse yourself in the exciting world of Procurement? Join the team and bring your expertise on board! As part of DHL Group, you will be working with a global network of Procurement colleagues and benefit from a wide range of development opportunities.
  
  
We are looking for an immediate, full-time, permanent position in APAC at Mumbai, India.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**

* Lead the global roll-out and operational administration of Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) solutions within the Source-to-Contract (S2C) landscape. Drive successful deployment, user adoption, and continuous improvement of CLM tools and integrations, ensuring compliance with procurement standards and policies. Act as the primary point of contact for system administration, run support, and change management, delivering service excellence.
* Own the end-to-end configuration workstream by consolidating local requirements into standardized processes. Document business requirements with BPOs and translate them into automated tool workflows. Serve as the subject matter expert for functional, integration, and user acceptance testing of the CLM application.
* Focus on optimizing contract management and S2C processes through AI-powered tools and automation. Play a key role in enhancing efficiency, reducing risk, and strengthening overall contract management capabilities.

**Your tasks:**
**CLM application governance**

* Translate stakeholder requirements (legal, procurement, business) into scalable technical solutions.
* Advise business process experts on tool-supported solutions to meet functional needs.
* Lead end-to-end functional and integration testing, including scenario design and execution for CLM features.
* Analyze current contract management processes and workflows to identify automation and efficiency opportunities.

**Roll-out Management:**

* Execute global CLM roll-outs, including testing, migration, and stakeholder onboarding.
* Coordinate within Procurement the release management, change requests, and incident handling to ensure business continuity.
* Develop and deliver training materials and user documentation in collaboration with other workstreams to drive adoption.

**Run Administration:**

* Act as system administrator for CLM applications, managing configurations, workflows, and integrations. In charge of the application governance.
* Monitor system performance, manage ticket triage, and implement measures to reduce incidents.
* Conduct service reviews and ensure SLA compliance for support activities.

**Continuous Improvement & Governance:**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify process optimization opportunities.
* Maintain governance of templates, clauses, and metadata in CLM systems.
* Drive automation initiatives and apply AI/LCNC tools to enhance efficiency.
* Explore and define use cases of new/additional CLM modules

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Act as liaison between Global Project Managers, Business Process Owners, IT teams, and external providers.
* Build strong cross-functional relationships and influence adoption of best practices.
* Coach stakeholders on advanced automation and contract AI solutions; propose improvements for system usage and process efficiency.
* Represent Procurement in technical alignments at the CLM platform level.

**Your profile:**

* Strong knowledge of Contract Lifecycle Management and S2C processes.
* Expert knowledge in configuring and testing contract lifecycle management tool
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Ability to manage complex projects in a global environment with minimal supervision.
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and with the ability to present technical details to a non-technical audience
* Proficiency in MS Office, integration technologies, and automation tools (Power Automate).
* Fluent in English;
* Strong understanding of contract management processes, including contract analysis, extraction, and lifecycle management.
* High self-motivation, solution-oriented thinking and creativity
* Ability to stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies in CLM, AI and automation.
* Service mindset to continuously delivery excellent service.

**Experience Level:**

* More than 3–5 years in procurement digitalization, CLM/eSourcing tools
* Hands-on experience with CLM platforms (e.g., Sirion Labs, Jaggaer).
* Proven track record in managing IT projects in matrix organization and support processes.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead and drive initiatives from conception to implementation and within scope/costs/quality.
* Experience in change management and training end users of CLM applications/S2C tools.

**Education Level:**
Bachelor degree, ideally also Master degree (preferably in business administration, IT, Data Science, Technology, science) or equivalent
  
  
**We offer:**

* Great opportunity to work for the biggest logistics company in the world
* International and virtual environment
* Flexibility and great opportunity to learn
* Tempting Compensation and benefits

DHL Group is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
  
  
If this is something you would like to do, don’t hesitate and start your application.
