title: SAP CCM
description:
Job Description: SAP CCM
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced
**SAP Functional Lead / Senior Consultant**
with
**8 to 10 years**
of hands-on expertise across Application Maintenance (AM) support and Application Development (AD)/enhancements. The ideal candidate will possess deep specialization in
**SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)**
—including rebate processing, accruals, and settlement logic—backed by robust knowledge of
**SAP SD and Pricing**
.
  
  
In this role, you will lead complex enhancements, drive continuous process improvements, and provide robust L2/L3 production support in an S/4HANA enterprise environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enhancements & Application Development (AD)**

* Process Enhancement & Delivery: Lead the design and delivery of CCM enhancements, including new condition contract types, specialized settlement logic, and custom rebate models tailored to evolving business requirements.
* Functional Specifications: Gather business requirements and translate them into comprehensive Functional Specifications (FS) for custom RICEF objects.
* System Configuration: Configure condition contract types, pricing conditions, settlement parameters, and cross-module integration points.
* Development & Testing: Partner closely with technical (ABAP) teams through development, unit testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure defect-free production releases.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive process optimization and automation initiatives within CCM and pricing operational workflows.

**Application Maintenance & Production Support (AM)**

* L2/L3 Incident Management: Deliver high-quality L2/L3 support for SAP S/4HANA CCM operations, ensuring strict adherence to SLAs and minimal business disruption.
* Troubleshooting & Resolution: Analyze and resolve complex issues related to rebate processing, settlement runs, accrual postings, and pricing discrepancies.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform in-depth RCA on recurring defects and implement permanent preventive fixes.
* ITSM Governance: Efficiently manage incidents, problem records, and service requests within ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Period-End Operations: Monitor, validate, and support period-end settlement runs and corresponding financial postings.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance**

* Integration Alignment: Collaborate with SD and FI teams to resolve complex, cross-module integration issues and ensure seamless Order-to-Cash (O2C) processing.
* Change Management: Adhere strictly to change management, transport release, and governance protocols for all system enhancements.
* Knowledge Management: Maintain detailed functional documentation, conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions, and promote standard SAP best practices.

**Required Candidate Profile**

* Experience: 8–10 years of SAP hands-on experience covering both Application Support (AMS) and Enhancements/Implementations in SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Core Functional Expertise: Deep domain expertise in SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)—rebates, accruals, settlements, and contract maintenance.
* Domain Knowledge: Solid expertise in SAP SD (Order-to-Cash) and advanced SAP Pricing Procedure configurations.
* Technical Interface Skills: Proven track record of designing functional specs for custom RICEF objects and working with ABAP teams.
* Support Proficiency: Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow) and standard ITIL support processes.

Skills: processing,sap,application,ccm,testing

title: Platform Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, Cloud AI, Networking, Migrations, Security.
* Experience driving the entire business cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building the technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors).

**About The Job**
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
  
  
As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your business acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and present solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.
  
  
You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving engagement within existing ones. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend business expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted business motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through demos, pilots and workshops.
* Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: L2/L3 Backup Administrator Engineer - Location - Mumbai
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**L2/L3 Backup Administrator Engineer**

*Enterprise Backup • Commvault • DR/NDR • Data Protection*

**Position**

L2  Backup Administrator Engineer

**Experience**

5–10 Years

**Employment Type**

[Full-Time / Contract]

**Location**

Mumbai

**Primary Technology**

Commvault Backup & Recovery

**Preferred**

Veritas / Cloud Backup/Commvault

1. Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced L2/L3 Backup Administrator Engineer responsible for designing, implementing, administering, troubleshooting, and optimizing enterprise backup and recovery infrastructure. The role requires strong hands-on experience with Commvault, with additional knowledge of Veritas for migration activities.

The engineer will manage backup and recovery across virtual machines, physical servers, databases, Kubernetes, storage infrastructure, and enterprise applications, while supporting DR/NDR operations, backup migrations, restoration, capacity planning, security, compliance, and continuous improvement.

2. Key Responsibilities

Backup Solution Design & Implementation

**•**
Design, implement, configure, and manage enterprise backup solutions for critical systems, applications, and databases.

**•**
Understand application and infrastructure requirements and design appropriate backup policies and protection strategies.

**•**
Build new backup environments/solutions from scratch based on business and technical requirements.

**•**
Perform workload onboarding and migration to new backup platforms with minimum business disruption.

**•**
Configure backup policies, schedules, retention, storage pools, deduplication, compression, and auxiliary copy requirements.

**•**
Ensure backup solutions meet defined RPO, RTO, retention, and business continuity requirements.

Commvault Administration

**•**
Administer and troubleshoot Commvault Backup & Recovery environments, including CommCell, MediaAgents, storage pools, deduplication databases, libraries, policies, and schedules.

**•**
Manage backup, restore, auxiliary copy, retention, and storage operations.

**•**
Monitor backup health, failed/pending jobs, storage utilization, deduplication, and overall environment performance.

**•**
Troubleshoot Commvault configuration, infrastructure, connectivity, and performance issues.

**•**
Raise and manage OEM/vendor support cases and coordinate resolution through closure.

**•**
Implement applicable Commvault security and hardening capabilities.

Backup Monitoring & Operations

**•**
Monitor backup operations and ensure successful completion within agreed SLAs.

**•**
Review daily backup reports and identify failed, missed, pending, or abnormal jobs.

**•**
Perform root-cause analysis for recurring backup failures and implement permanent corrective actions.

**•**
Maintain daily/weekly/monthly backup operational reports and dashboards.

Backup Troubleshooting & Restoration

**•**
Handling incidents and complex backup-related technical issues.

**•**
Troubleshoot backup and restore failures across VMware/VMs, physical servers, Linux, Windows, Solaris, Oracle, MS SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Kubernetes, and enterprise applications.

**•**
Perform file-level, VM-level, database-level, and application-level restoration.

**•**
Validate restoration integrity and prepare RCA/corrective action plans for major incidents.

Disaster Recovery – DR/NDR

**•**
Develop and maintain backup and disaster recovery procedures.

**•**
Configure and maintain backup/replication copies at DR and NDR locations.

**•**
Enable backup protection for workloads migrated to DR and maintain required secondary copies.

**•**
Participate in DR drills, BCP exercises, and disaster recovery activities.

**•**
Validate restoration capability during DR drills and document observations and corrective actions.

Backup Migration

**•**
Plan and execute migration from legacy backup platforms to Commvault or other target platforms.

**•**
Support Veritas-to-Commvault workload migration.

**•**
Analyze existing policies, retention, storage consumption, and application dependencies before migration.

**•**
Validate successful backup and restoration after migration.

Capacity Planning & Optimization

**•**
Perform backup data sizing and capacity planning.

**•**
Monitor storage growth, deduplication ratios, compression, and retention consumption.

**•**
Optimize backup policies, storage utilization, backup windows, compression, deduplication, and auxiliary copy strategies.

Security & Compliance

**•**
Implement backup security and access controls as per organizational policies.

**•**
Support advanced Commvault security features and secure backup practices.

**•**
Support internal/external audits, including RBI and banking regulatory requirements where applicable.

**•**
Maintain audit evidence, backup reports, restoration records, policies, and governance documentation.

Documentation

**•**
Maintain up-to-date backup infrastructure and operational documentation.

**•**
Prepare Backup Architecture, Configuration, Policy Matrix, Backup/Restore SOPs, DR/NDR Configuration, Migration Plans, Health Check Reports, RCA documents, DR Drill documents, and Capacity Reports.

**•**
Update documentation after major configuration or infrastructure changes.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

**•**
Work with Application, Database, Server, Storage, Network, Security, and DR teams.

**•**
Understand application requirements and recommend suitable backup/recovery solutions.

**•**
Coordinate with OEMs and vendors for complex issues and technical escalations.

**•**
Participate in change management, implementation planning, and technical reviews.

Extended & Major Incident Support

**•**
Handle complex and critical backup incidents independently.

**•**
Provide L3 support for major backup failures, data recovery issues, and infrastructure incidents.

**•**
Provide support during DR drills, migrations, planned maintenance, and major implementation activities during weekends/night shifts when required.

**•**
Leave/comp-off will be managed as per agreed organizational/customer terms and applicable policy.

Continuous Improvement

**•**
Prepare and implement a quarterly backup process improvement plan.

**•**
Identify opportunities to improve reliability, performance, security, and operational efficiency.

**•**
Automate repetitive monitoring and operational activities where feasible.

**•**
Reduce recurring incidents through permanent corrective actions.

3. Mandatory Technical SkillsBackup Technologies

**•**
Strong hands-on experience with Commvault Backup & Recovery.

**•**
Enterprise backup administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, restore, retention, deduplication, compression, auxiliary copy, and capacity management.

Protected Workloads

**•**
VMware / Virtual Machines; Physical Servers; Linux; Windows; Solaris; Oracle; Microsoft SQL Server; PostgreSQL; MySQL; Kubernetes; Enterprise applications.

Storage & Infrastructure

**•**
Hands-on understanding of SAN, NAS, disk-based backup storage, backup repositories, storage capacity/performance, and deduplication storage.

**•**
Understanding of backup servers, MediaAgents, Fibre Channel, Ethernet networking, server hardware, and RAID concepts.

title: Security Operations Center Analyst
description:
**Job Title : SOC Analyst – L2**

**Experience : 3+ to 5+ Years of Experience in Security Operations**

**Location : Mumbai : BKC (Bandra Kurla Complex - Work from Office)**

**Job Summary :**

We are looking for an experienced and highly analytical
**SOC Analyst L2**
to join our Security Operations Center (SOC) / Cyber Defense Center (CDC). The SOC Analyst L2 will serve as an advanced incident responder responsible for investigating complex security incidents, conducting advanced threat hunting activities, developing detection use cases, and supporting security monitoring platforms such as
**IBM QRadar**
and
**SentinelOne EDR/XDR**
.

The candidate should possess deep expertise in incident investigation, malware analysis, threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, SIEM content development, and security operations processes. The role requires close collaboration with IT, Cloud, Engineering, and Security teams to enhance the organization's overall detection and response capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Security Monitoring & Incident Response**

* Perform in-depth investigation and analysis of security alerts escalated from L1 analysts.
* Lead the triage, containment, eradication, and recovery activities for cybersecurity incidents.
* Handle high-severity and critical incidents, including malware outbreaks, ransomware attacks, account compromises, insider threats, and advanced persistent threats (APTs).
* Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and provide actionable remediation recommendations.
* Act as an escalation point for complex security investigations.

**Threat Hunting & Threat Intelligence**

* Conduct proactive threat hunting using endpoint, network, cloud, and identity telemetry.
* Leverage threat intelligence feeds, Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), Indicators of Attack (IOAs), and TTPs to identify emerging threats.
* Map attack techniques to the MITRE ATT&CK framework and identify gaps in detection coverage.
* Develop advanced hunting queries and investigative methodologies to uncover hidden threats.
* Monitor threat actor trends and emerging attack campaigns relevant to the organization's environment.

**Detection Engineering & Use Case Development**

* Design, develop, and optimize SIEM correlation rules and security analytics.
* Create and enhance custom dashboards, workbooks, reports, and visualizations.
* Perform alert tuning and reduce false positives while improving detection effectiveness.
* Develop security use cases aligned to threat intelligence and MITRE ATT&CK techniques.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve logging and visibility across enterprise environments.

**SIEM & EDR Administration**

* Manage and optimize IBM QRadar SIEM for monitoring, correlation, and investigations.
* Perform advanced investigations using SentinelOne EDR/XDR.
* Support onboarding and parsing new log sources.
* Develop custom integrations for unsupported data sources.
* Ensure data quality, normalization, and log source health across monitoring platforms.

**Malware, Phishing & Forensics Analysis**

* Analyze malware samples, suspicious files, and malicious URLs.
* Investigate phishing incidents utilizing email security tools and threat intelligence.
* Conduct endpoint investigations and digital forensic triage activities.
* Review attack chains and identify attacker techniques and persistence mechanisms.
* Document findings with detailed forensic timelines and recommendations.

**Incident Management & Process Improvement**

* Develop and maintain SOC playbooks, runbooks, and standard operating procedures.
* Participate in incident response tabletop exercises and simulation activities.
* Identify automation opportunities and support SOAR implementation initiatives.
* Review security incidents and recommend process improvements.
* Contribute to SOC maturity and continuous improvement programs.

**Collaboration & Mentorship**

* Mentor and guide L1 analysts during investigations and incident triage.
* Review and validate incident reports generated by junior team members.
* Collaborate with cloud, infrastructure, identity, and network teams for remediation activities.
* Provide technical expertise during internal and customer-facing security discussions.
* Participate in executive and customer incident briefings as required.

**Experience & Technical Skills**

* Minimum
  **3+ to 5+ years of experience in a SOC, Incident Response, Threat Detection, or Cyber Defense role.**
* Minimum
  **2+ years of hands-on experience with IBM QRadar SIEM.**
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **SentinelOne EDR/XDR**
  .
* Experience leading investigations of complex and critical security incidents.
* Proven experience in threat hunting and incident response activities.

**Security Operations**

* Advanced incident response and investigation skills.
* Threat detection and threat hunting expertise.
* Malware analysis and phishing investigation experience.
* Security monitoring and event correlation.
* Digital forensics and endpoint investigations.

**Frameworks & Methodologies**

* MITRE ATT&CK Framework.
* Cyber Kill Chain.
* NIST Incident Response Framework.
* Threat Intelligence Lifecycle.
* Security Operations Best Practices.

**SIEM & EDR**

* IBM QRadar administration and content management.
* Correlation rule creation and optimization.
* Dashboard and report development.
* SentinelOne EDR/XDR investigation capabilities.
* Alert tuning and use-case engineering.

**Networking & Security Fundamentals**

* TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP.
* IDS/IPS, Firewalls, Proxy Technologies.
* Network traffic analysis.
* Active Directory and Identity Management.
* Cloud security monitoring.

**Scripting & Automation**

* Security Automation and SOAR platforms

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Managed Security Services (MSSP) environments.
* Experience with threat intelligence platforms.
* Experience building custom parsers, DSMs, and integrations.
* Experience with vulnerability management and attack surface monitoring.
* Experience working in customer-facing consulting engagements.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture.
* Experience performing purple team, threat emulation, or adversary simulation exercises.

**Preferred Certifications**

The following certifications are highly desirable:

**Industry Certifications**

* CompTIA CySA+
* CompTIA Security+
* EC-Council Certified SOC Analyst (CSA)
* EC-Council Certified Incident Handler (ECIH)
* GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH)
* GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA)
* Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
* CISSP (Associate or Certified)
* IBM QRadar SIEM Certifications
* SentinelOne Certifications
* Splunk Enterprise Security Certifications

A successful L2 SOC Analyst will:

* Independently investigate and resolve complex security incidents.
* Identify advanced threats through proactive threat hunting.
* Develop high-quality detection content and SIEM use cases.
* Reduce alert fatigue through effective tuning and optimization.
* Improve overall security visibility and detection coverage.
* Mentor junior analysts and contribute to SOC operational maturity.
* Drive continuous improvements in security monitoring, incident response, and threat intelligence integration.

description:
**Description**
*Position at Ziff Davis*
Product Support Specialist
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
The Opportunity:
  
  
We are seeking a Product Support Specialist to act as the bridge between Dwell subscribers and our engineering team. In this role, you will report to the director of revenue products. In this hybrid role, you will spend part of your time leading high-touch customer support and relationship management, and the other part translating those frontline insights into the product roadmap. You understand user pain points firsthand because you talk to customers every day, and you have the technical and strategic skills to build permanent solutions into our software or service offerings.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  
Customer Service & Advocacy
  
  

* Customer Support Response Management: Handle approximately 200 customer support tickets per week for Dwell brand subscribers, including email tickets and phone support for customer voicemails
* Payment and Account Administration: Utilize Stripe platform to resolve customer access issues, update user email addresses and payment methods, and address general customer concerns
* Issue Analysis and Reporting: Create reports documenting common customer support issues in Google Docs/Sheets format to enable product teams to prioritize system improvements and enhance customer experience
* Third-Party Coordination: Collaborate with Dwell Magazine's fulfillment partner, CDS Global, to resolve complex customer issues that cannot be addressed through Stripe's platform capabilities
* Client Enablement: Create and update customer-facing knowledge bases, release notes, training materials, and troubleshooting guides.
* Relationship Management: Build trust-based relationships with subscribers, gathering qualitative feedback on product experience.

Product Management
  
  

* Feedback Synthesis: Analyze support ticket trends, churn reasons, and customer feature requests to identify systemic product gaps.
* Roadmap Prioritization: Own and prioritize the product backlog, balancing urgent customer fixes with long-term strategic product goals.
* Requirements Definition: Write Product Requirements Documents and user stories for the engineering and design teams.
* Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate with engineering, QA, and marketing to guide features from concept through launch, ensuring the support team is fully trained before release.
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) including Customer Satisfaction, Net Promoter Score (NPS), Customer Retention/Churn, and Feature Adoption Rates.
* Report monthly insights to executive leadership regarding how product updates impact customer happiness and business revenue.

Job Qualifications:
  
  

* Experience: 3+ years of combined experience in customer service management, customer success, or technical support, alongside 2+ years in an associate product manager or product-adjacent role.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Customer Empathy: Exceptional listening, patience, and written/verbal communication skills with a proven track record of de-escalating frustrated clients.
* Product Sense: Ability to look at a repetitive customer complaint and conceptualize a scalable, software-driven solution.
* Experience using modern helpdesk software (e.g., Zendesk, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud) and product management tools (e.g., Jira, Productboard, Linear, Asana).
* Preferred: basic technical literacy (familiarity with API logs, SQL, or web technologies) to effectively communicate tradeoffs with engineering teams.

**About Dwell**
For over two decades, Dwell has been the definitive voice of modern architecture and design, exploring how smart, intentional design makes everyday life better across print, Dwell.com, and social channels.
  
  
**About Ziff Davis**
Ziff Davis (NASDAQ: ZD) is a vertically focused digital media and internet company whose portfolio includes leading brands in technology, shopping, gaming and entertainment, connectivity, health, cybersecurity, and martech. Today, Ziff Davis is focused on seven key verticals – Technology, Connectivity, Shopping, Entertainment, Health & Wellness, Cybersecurity and Marketing Technology. Its brands include IGN, Mashable, RetailMeNot, PCMag, Humble Bundle, Spiceworks, Ookla (Speedtest), RootMetrics, Everyday Health, BabyCenter, Moz, iContact and Vipre Security.

At Ziff Davis, we remain dedicated to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to succeed. We offer Employee Resource Groups, company-sponsored events, and regular opportunities for professional growth through educational support, mentorship programs, and career development resources. Our employees are recognized and celebrated through employee engagement programs and recognition awards.

title: Support Engineer
description:
**Position Overview**
Our customers are at the forefront of some of the most interesting data in the world, using SingleStore to push the boundaries every day. To do this well, they leverage the expertise of our Support Engineering Team, composed of technical subject matter experts on the frontline of critical customer issues.
  
  
This Support Engineering role skews far more towards engineering than typical technical support as you will need to delve into database internals and memory allocators, investigate Linux and host-related configurations, and diagnose SQL query behaviour, all in the name of resolving complex database issues. Our Support Engineers are constantly learning a wide range of customer systems and technical concepts and are thrilled by the new and exciting challenges that they encounter on a regular basis.
  
  
To accurately identify the source and solution of an issue, this team will take the time to learn about the customer’s business and systems while helping to improve their fundamental SingleStore and database operational knowledge. This often requires additional research and time spent on learning new technologies and tools outside of SingleStore while also being deeply engaged with multiple departments including development teams, query performance engineering, product management, infrastructure SREs, etc.
  
  
**Required Hours**

* The hours required are from 11:30 AM IST - 8:30 PM IST (9 hours) for 5 days
* Participate in our on-call rotation that may include weekends and holidays.

**Role And Responsibilities**

* Provide email and live technical support to our enterprise customers, acting as the first line of defense for complex technical issues, bug diagnosis, or resolving critical outages.
* Identify and reproduce product issues, perform QA, and submit formal bug reports or feature requests to the appropriate Engineering team.
* Collaborate closely with software developers, sales engineers, and technical account managers to keep all teams up to date with current issues a customer may be facing.
* Work to streamline and improve various Support and Engineering processes and tools, author new internal run-books or public documentation, and help the team continually improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Ensure customers have a positive support experience during every interaction.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 4+ years of advanced customer-facing technical support experience.
* Experience with MySQL or MySQL-like (MariaDB, Aurora, etc) database and SQL Query Optimization.
* A solid Kubernetes and sysadmin skill set. Also, comfortable testing software and finding its limits, hands-on with Linux, checking utilization of system I/O, measuring network throughput, and are comfortable navigating large log files.
* Experience with a scripting or coding language. Whether it’s Python, Bash, or Go, you should have a go-to solution for quick and dirty problem-solving and be able to navigate through our code base.
* Familiarity with distributed systems and AWS/GCP. You understand how organizations deploy and maintain distributed applications and services across multiple machines Bonus points for knowing how to analyze them for performance bottlenecks and remove single points of failure.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Have the ability to explain technical concepts to a wide range of end-users.

SingleStore delivers the cloud-native database with the speed and scale to power the world’s data-intensive applications. With a distributed SQL database that introduces simplicity to your data architecture by unifying transactions and analytics, SingleStore empowers digital leaders to deliver exceptional, real-time data experiences to their customers. SingleStore is venture-backed and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Sunnyvale, Raleigh, Seattle, Boston, London, Lisbon, Bangalore, Dublin and Kyiv.
  
  
Consistent with our commitment to diversity & inclusion, we value individuals with the ability to work on diverse teams and with a diverse range of people.
  
  
*To all recruitment agencies: SingleStore does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to SingleStore employees. SingleStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.*
SingleStore values individuals for their unique skills and experiences, and we’re proud to offer roles in a variety of locations across the United States. Salary is based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location, and is just one part of our total compensation and benefits package. Certain roles are also eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases and annual bonuses.

*California Recruitment Privacy Notice*
*. For candidates residing in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland, please see our*
*EEA, UK, and Swiss Recruitment Privacy Notice.*

title: Mobility Specialist
description:
**Job Title: Mobility Specialist**
**Position Summary**
The Mobility Specialist provides operational support for enterprise mobile services, including mobile device provisioning, carrier support, eSIM management, and user assistance. This role works with employees, mobile service providers, and internal teams to ensure reliable mobile connectivity and timely resolution of mobility-related requests.
  
  
The ideal candidate is customer-focused, organized, and experienced in supporting mobile devices, wireless services, and telecommunications processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Position Location & Regional Coverage**
We are currently hiring multiple Mobility Specialists to support employees across the following regions:
  
  

* North America (NAM)
* Latin America (LATAM)
* Europe, Middle East & Africa (EMEA)
* Asia Pacific (APAC)

Each Mobility Specialist will serve as the primary mobility operations resource for their assigned region, providing support for mobile services, carrier relationships, eSIM administration, provisioning activities, mobile number management, and end-user mobility support. While aligned to a specific region, team members will collaborate globally to ensure a consistent mobility experience and service delivery model across the organization.
  
  
**Mobile Service Administration**

* Process mobile service requests including new activations, upgrades, line changes, suspensions, and disconnects.
* Coordinate mobile device replacements and service transfers.
* Maintain accurate records of mobile numbers, devices, and service information.
* Assist with mobile inventory tracking and asset management activities.

**SIM & eSIM Support**

* Provision and activate physical SIMs and eSIMs.
* Support users with eSIM setup and activation.
* Troubleshoot common SIM and eSIM issues.
* Coordinate SIM replacements and device upgrade activities.

**User Support**

* Provide day-to-day support for mobile phones, tablets, and wireless services.
* Troubleshoot mobile connectivity, voice, text messaging, and data service issues.
* Assist users with device setup and carrier-related issues.
* Support requests involving lost, stolen, or damaged devices.
* Provide white-glove support for VIP users when required.

**Carrier Coordination**

* Submit support requests and service orders with mobile carriers.
* Track carrier tickets and follow up on outstanding issues.
* Escalate service-impacting issues when necessary.
* Assist with number porting and mobile service changes.

**Security & Account Support**

* Assist users with PIN and PUK code requests.
* Support carrier verification and account authentication processes.
* Coordinate SIM swap requests using approved procedures.
* Report suspected mobile fraud or unauthorized activity.

**Operational Support**

* Maintain mobility documentation and knowledge articles.
* Assist with reporting and inventory audits.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
* Participate in mobility-related projects and service enhancements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Associate degree or equivalent work experience.
* 1-3 years of experience supporting mobile devices, telecommunications services, or end-user technology.
* Experience working with mobile phones, tablets, and wireless carriers.
* Basic understanding of eSIM technology and mobile service provisioning.
* Strong customer service and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple requests and priorities.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting enterprise mobile phone programs.
* Experience working with wireless carriers such as Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile, Vodafone, Orange, or Telefónica.
* Familiarity with telecom inventory management systems.
* ITIL or customer support experience.
* Experience supporting corporate mobile device deployments.

**Key Competencies**

* Customer Service
* Mobile Device Support
* eSIM Administration
* SIM Management
* Carrier Coordination
* Problem Solving
* Inventory Management
* Attention to Detail
* Communication Skills
* Organization and Planning

**Success Measures**

* Timely completion of mobility requests
* User satisfaction with mobility services
* Accuracy of device and service inventories
* Resolution of carrier and connectivity issues
* Successful device provisioning and activations
* Compliance with service-level expectations

**Reporting To:**
Mobility Services Lead / EUC Manager
  
  
This role serves as the primary operational resource for employee mobility services, ensuring users receive timely support for mobile devices, carrier services, eSIM activation, and mobile connectivity needs. This version will typically attract Mobility Analysts, Telecom Analysts, Service Desk Leads, and junior Mobility Specialists rather than senior telecom administrators or mobility architects.

description:
**Description**
*Position at Ziff Davis*
Product Support Specialist
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
The Opportunity:
  
  
We are seeking a Product Support Specialist to act as the bridge between Dwell subscribers and our engineering team. In this role, you will report to the director of revenue products. In this hybrid role, you will spend part of your time leading high-touch customer support and relationship management, and the other part translating those frontline insights into the product roadmap. You understand user pain points firsthand because you talk to customers every day, and you have the technical and strategic skills to build permanent solutions into our software or service offerings.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  
Customer Service & Advocacy
  
  

* Customer Support Response Management: Handle approximately 200 customer support tickets per week for Dwell brand subscribers, including email tickets and phone support for customer voicemails
* Payment and Account Administration: Utilize Stripe platform to resolve customer access issues, update user email addresses and payment methods, and address general customer concerns
* Issue Analysis and Reporting: Create reports documenting common customer support issues in Google Docs/Sheets format to enable product teams to prioritize system improvements and enhance customer experience
* Third-Party Coordination: Collaborate with Dwell Magazine's fulfillment partner, CDS Global, to resolve complex customer issues that cannot be addressed through Stripe's platform capabilities
* Client Enablement: Create and update customer-facing knowledge bases, release notes, training materials, and troubleshooting guides.

* Feedback Synthesis: Analyze support ticket trends, churn reasons, and customer feature requests to identify systemic product gaps.

* Requirements Definition: Write Product Requirements Documents and user stories for the engineering and design teams.
* Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate with engineering, QA, and marketing to guide features from concept through launch, ensuring the support team is fully trained before release.

* Report monthly insights to executive leadership regarding how product updates impact customer happiness and business revenue.

* Product Sense: Ability to look at a repetitive customer complaint and conceptualize a scalable, software-driven solution.
* Experience using modern helpdesk software (e.g., Zendesk, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud) and product management tools (e.g., Jira, Productboard, Linear, Asana).

title: Associate Systems Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**

**Associate Systems Support Engineer**

This role involves working with monitoring tools such as AppDynamics (AppD), LogicMonitor, and Azure Monitor, as well as monitoring SQL databases, Windows servers, and Internet Information Services (IIS). The Associate Systems Support Engineer will provide L1 and L2 support while ensuring compliance with service level agreements (SLAs).

* Conduct regular health checks and performance tuning of SQL databases to ensure optimal operation.
* Oversee the functionality and performance of Windows servers and IIS, applying necessary configurations and updates as needed.

* Provide first-level support for system incidents, diagnosing issues and escalating problems to higher-level engineering teams when necessary.

* Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) for incidents to prevent future occurrences and improve system reliability.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement system upgrades, patches, and configurations while minimizing downtime.

* Familiarity with application performance monitoring tools such as AppDynamics, LogicMonitor, and Azure Monitor.
* Basic knowledge of SQL databases, including monitoring and troubleshooting techniques.
* Understanding of Windows Server administration and IIS management.
* Experience with monitoring server uptime, performance metrics, and alert management.
* Proficient in troubleshooting system issues and performing root cause analysis.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail to ensure high-quality service delivery.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

* Understanding of monitoring tools like AppDynamics and LogicMonitor.
* Understanding of healthcare application is an added advantage.

Full time

**About The Team**
The FIS Treasury Enhanced Application Managed Services (EAMS) team provides proactive functional and operational support for clients using FIS treasury and payments solutions. The team monitors critical processes, owns first-line investigation and service coordination, and connects clients with the right FIS specialists to maintain resilient day-to-day treasury operations.
  
  
Role purpose
  
  
The Senior Treasury EAMS Analyst independently owns complex client support and operational outcomes across treasury applications and processes. The role combines domain knowledge, structured incident leadership, client communication, cross-team coordination, and continuous improvement to reduce service risk and strengthen the quality of managed support.
  
  
What you will be doing
  
  

* Own complex incidents and service requests from initial assessment through restoration, resolution, or effective hand-off, ensuring clear accountability throughout
* Analyze issues across treasury process, application, interface, data, scheduler, and infrastructure layers using available diagnostics, logs, and operational evidence
* Assess business impact and priority, coordinate resolver teams, manage escalations, and maintain accurate client and stakeholder communication
* Lead operational monitoring and validation activities covering payments, statements, interfaces, reconciliations, batch jobs, application availability, and daily treasury controls
* Drive problem management and root cause coordination, identify recurring patterns, and translate findings into preventive actions, knowledge, automation, or process improvements
* Provide functional guidance on cash and liquidity management, payments, settlements, bank reconciliation, treasury accounting, messaging, and related workflows
* Lead client issue discussions and contribute to service reviews, reporting, risk updates, action tracking, and operational governance
* Support upgrades, releases, testing, change planning, cutover readiness, and post-change validation for assigned client environments
* Review and improve runbooks, standard operating procedures, controls, handovers, and knowledge articles for accuracy and usability
* Coach P2 analysts, support quality reviews, share product and domain knowledge, and help coordinate work across shifts when required
* Partner with Product Support, Technical Support, hosting, database, network, product management, professional services, and third parties to deliver end-to-end outcomes
* Promote a service ownership culture grounded in security, privacy, auditability, operational discipline, and continuous improvement

What you bring
  
  
**Required Experience And Domain Knowledge**

* 4-8 years of relevant client services, treasury, banking, payments, financial services application support, or managed services experience
* Strong working knowledge of treasury operations including cash and liquidity management, payments, settlements, accounting, bank reconciliation, statements, and daily controls
* Practical understanding of SWIFT MT and ISO 20022 messaging. Examples may include MT101, MT202, MT210, MT300, MT5xx, MT9xx, pain, and camt messages
* Demonstrated experience managing incidents, service requests, escalations, problem investigations, and root cause activities in an SLA-driven environment
* Experience communicating directly with clients and explaining technical or operational issues in clear business language
* Willingness to work flexible rotational shifts aligned to the approved global support model

Technical and operational skills
  
  

* Experience with a Treasury Management System or payments platform. FIS Trax, Quantum, Integrity, eBAM, Bank Connector, or Payment Hub experience is advantageous
* Ability to interpret logs, application diagnostics, job and interface statuses, data validation results, and monitoring alerts
* Working knowledge of SQL concepts and databases such as Oracle or SQL Server
* Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, or comparable service management and monitoring tools
* Understanding of hosted or cloud environments, secure file transfer, system dependencies, and application architecture
* Working knowledge of SFTP administration and troubleshooting, including SSH key-based authentication, host-key validation, permissions, directory and file conventions, and coordination with infrastructure or security teams
* Strong written documentation skills for ticket updates, handovers, procedures, and knowledge content
* Manage and support SWIFT FileAct and SWIFT FIN services for payment processing, statement delivery, and financial messaging
* Support ERP integrations for payment processing and bank statement reconciliation across treasury platforms
* Monitor and maintain Host-to-Host (H2H) banking connectivity to ensure seamless communication between enterprise systems and banking partners
* Provide application support for Treasury Management Systems (TMS), ensuring operational stability and timely issue resolution
* Create and maintain static data within the Treasury Management System, including bank accounts, counterparties, and related configurations
* Perform CEV (Connectivity and End-to-End Validation) activities to validate treasury and banking integrations
* Handle ServiceNow incidents, service requests, and change requests, ensuring timely resolution in accordance with SLA commitments
* Support integration and processing of MT940 and MT942 bank statement messages received from SWIFT and banking partners
* Analyze, validate, and support payment message formats including ISO 20022 PAIN.001/PAIN.002 and SWIFT MT101/MT199 messages
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, banks, and technical teams to troubleshoot integration issues and ensure uninterrupted treasury operations
* Participate in monitoring, incident management, testing, and continuous improvement initiatives related to treasury applications and banking connectivity

Core competencies
  
  

* Strong service ownership and sound judgment in complex or ambiguous situations
* Confident client-facing communication and stakeholder management
* Analytical problem solving, risk awareness, and disciplined root cause thinking
* Ability to prioritize competing incidents, requests, planned activities, and client commitments
* Coaching mindset with commitment to team capability, quality, and knowledge sharing
* Attention to detail with a track record of producing high-quality operational documentation

**Qualifications & Preferred Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Finance, Commerce, Business, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience
* ITIL Foundation certification is preferred. Treasury, payments, SQL, cloud, or service management certifications are advantageous
* Experience with FIS Trax, Quantum, Integrity, eBAM, Bank Connector, Payment Hub, or other TMS System
* Experience supporting multiple clients or products in a global managed services environment
* Exposure to service reporting, operational governance, audit support, user administration, and controlled static-data management
* Experience contributing to automation, monitoring enhancement, or continuous service improvement
* Ability to facilitate operational calls and guide less experienced analysts during high-priority issues

What success looks like
  
  

* Complex issues progress with clear ownership, effective coordination, accurate impact assessment, and timely communication
* Recurring incidents and operational risks are converted into measurable corrective or preventive actions
* Client interactions demonstrate confidence, transparency, domain knowledge, and sound expectation management
* Operational controls, documentation, and shift handovers consistently support reliable and audit-ready service delivery
* P2 analysts gain capability through coaching, review, and practical knowledge transfer
* Service quality improves through stronger monitoring, procedures, automation, and cross-team collaboration

What FIS offers you
  
  

* A role with meaningful responsibility supporting global treasury and payments operations
* Learning and career development opportunities across products, operations, technology, and client service
* Exposure to global clients, cross-functional teams, and industry-leading treasury solutions
* A collaborative, inclusive environment that values ownership, continuous improvement, and client outcomes

title: IAM Operations Engineer
description:
As an
**IAM Operations Engineer at Topsoe**
, you will play a key role in the daily operation, monitoring, support, and troubleshooting of our Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform and its integrations.
  
  
Your work will help ensure that identity lifecycle processes and access-management services remain available, reliable, and compliant throughout the employee journey—from
**joiner to mover to leaver**
. You will also help bring IAM platform ownership in-house as we transition responsibilities from our external partner.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Take ownership of the daily operations of Topsoe’s IAM platform and its integrations.
* Monitor platform health, performance, and connections with enterprise systems such as SAP.
* Handle L2/L3 support escalations from the L1 Service Desk and resolve incidents effectively.
* Troubleshoot provisioning, deprovisioning, access-request, and access-review issues.
* Investigate failed or delayed identity transactions and analyze access models and connectors.
* Coordinate complex investigations with development, architecture, application, and infrastructure teams.
* Support testing, deployment, rollback, access reviews, audits, documentation, and continuous improvement.
* You will also help educate L1 support colleagues, improve first-contact resolution, and maintain clear standard operating procedures and knowledge articles.

**What You Will Bring**
You should have more than 3 years of experience in operating IAM platforms and supporting identity lifecycle processes in a structured, service-oriented environment. You are analytical, methodical, and comfortable investigating technical issues with both business and security implications.
  
  
**We Are Looking For**

* Experience operating IAM platforms, preferably SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC).
* A good understanding of provisioning flows, connectors, and identity lifecycle processes.
* Experience with IT Service Management, including incident, problem, and change management.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* The ability to prioritize incidents based on business and security impact.
* Clear documentation skills and experience maintaining operational procedures.
* Basic knowledge of APIs and scripting.

**It Would Be An Advantage If You Have**

* SailPoint certification or a willingness to pursue certification.
* Experience working in a global organization with distributed teams.
* Knowledge of monitoring, alerting, and operational performance management.
* Scripting experience with PowerShell, Python, or similar tools.
* An ITIL Foundation certification.
* Experience supporting access reviews, audit controls, or compliance activities.

**Your new team**
You will join a dedicated internal IAM team of four professionals and help build the foundation for Topsoe’s future IAM operations. Together, the team will take on responsibilities currently managed by our external partner and develop effective ways of working for long-term operational ownership.
  
  
This is an opportunity to contribute to a collaborative and security-focused environment where your work will have a direct impact on Topsoe’s IT landscape.
  
  
**You Will Have The Opportunity To**

* Strengthen Topsoe’s internal IAM capabilities.
* Help ensure reliable identity and access services across the organization.
* Improve operational processes, monitoring, and support practices.
* Support the onboarding and stabilization of new applications.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and the development of the IAM team.
* Be part of Topsoe’s ongoing digital transformation.

**How You Can Apply**
If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.
  
  
**Application deadline: 18-10-2026**
.
  
  
You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both of these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process.
  
  
We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.
  
  
To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.
  
  
*To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.*
**About Us**
Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.
  
  
Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.
  
  
We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.
  
  
We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

title: SharePoint - OneDrive And Power Platform Operations - Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**SharePoint ,OneDrive & Power Platform Operations/ Engineer**
In our globalizing economy the availability of skills and expertise is becoming more and more distributed. Within the Compute Services – SharePoint, OneDrive & Power Platform Operations and engineering team, we enable EY professionals to meet the increasing pace of business change by delivering productivity and collaboration solutions that empower them to work together where they want and how they want.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have over 300,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology**
supports our technology needs through three business units:
  
  

* Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Technology (ET) – ET supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the most affordable possible cost for quality services. ET will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

**The opportunity**
The SharePoint Operations Engineer is part of a global SharePoint team in a large, complex, and multinational environment. They have expert knowledge in SharePoint (both Cloud and On-Prem). The individual will be providing Level 3 Operational/Engineering support for areas involving SharePoint Online, with a good understanding of SPO and associated technologies, SharePoint On-Prem, MS Teams, OneDrive for Business, and other M365 services.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* In-depth knowledge of SharePoint, OneDrive and Power platform its features, and related M365 services.
* Experience in installing and configuring SharePoint 2016,2019 & SE.
* Good troubleshooting skills in both sharepoint on-prem (2016/SE) along with SPO.
* Advanced experience with Microsoft PowerShell scripting & automation.
* Intermediate to advanced knowledge of CSOM, MSMQ & Provider Hosted Apps (PHA).
* Intermediate experience with continuous integration systems.
* Understanding of multiple access and authentication models such as NTLM, Kerberos, Claims-based, ADFS, SSL, card services, TMG, UAG, etc
* Knowledge of troubleshooting tools and techniques related to networks and systems i.e. remote access tools, Windows Support tools, connectivity tests, etc
* Detailed understanding of both Classic and Modern SharePoint functionality including Lists, Document Libraries, Pages, Search, Permissions, and Settings
* In-depth support knowledge and experience in providing 24/7 support for SharePoint
* In-depth knowledge in troubleshooting SharePoint end user/client issues.
* In-depth knowledge in SharePoint permissions, webparts, lists, views and any other site level issues.
* Expert knowledge in Incident management, Service requests, Change requests and ServiceNow processes for SP support.
* In-depth knowledge on SharePoint support workflow, level 1, level 2 and level 3. This role is for Level 3 support.
* Capability to help customer to fix the issue and/or create tickets for Microsoft for further troubleshooting.
* In-depth knowledge on PowerShell scripting and automation experience using scripts.
* Desirable - Knowledge in deploying SharePoint solutions, updating automation scripts and html pages.
* Desirable – Knowledge of Power Platform products, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI
* Experience with SCRUM/Agile development process is a plus.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
How your skills and experience will make an impact:
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* History of working credibly within teams and delivering high level of support services on the SharePoint platform
* Proactively anticipates service issues before they occur and able to make recommendations around resolution.
* Proactively monitor outages within a small group or wider group.
* Ability to communicate platform capabilities to customer and provide appropriate recommendations.
* Adapts personal communication style to the style of others, develops rapport and stays calm under pressure or escalating issues using advanced oral and written English communication skills.
* Strong verbal and written skills including strong cross-cultural communication and the ability to draft effective communications
* Ability to work with people in a variety of cultures, countries and time zones
* Utilizes all aspects of Emotional Intelligence to navigate the interactions and complexities of the business environment and drive leadership performance in oneself and in others.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* This role does not have a direct supervision responsibility but should proactively own tasks/issues and drive towards resolution independently.
* A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline, or equivalent work experience required
* 2-5 years of experience in support role with at least last 1 year in SharePoint support.

**What We Look For**

* Passionate, committed and determined
* Candidate must be flexible to the demands of the services we provide and any project to which they are assigned. The role may require out of office hours work.
* This role is for 24/7 support and requires working in night shift periodically.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: L2 Operations Engineer – Network Security
description:
**Designation: L2 Operations Engineer – Network Security**

**Support level: L2 Operations**

**Domain: Network Security**

**Scope: Palo Alto Firewalls, Zscaler, SSE, ZTNA, Enterprise Browser, Internet Security (SWG and FWaaS), and Private Access**

**Job Location / Reporting Location: NCR - Gurugram**

**Process:**

• End-to-end incident management, from L1/L1.5 escalation to closure.

• Run firewall health checks (CPU and memory) and act on breaches.

• Collect logs and evidence for firewall alert events.

• Troubleshoot reported issues and check network connectivity.

• Enable new access per application needs, through the client's change process.

• Handle port and rule requests from other teams, including server teams.

• Apply firewall patches and OS upgrades under change control.

• Handle outage calls to restore connectivity.

• Support Zscaler and Palo Alto firewalls.

• Protect data in transit and at rest from unauthorised access.

• Report security issues promptly with recommended actions.

• Follow client security standards and guidelines.

• Keep ServiceNow tickets current, with clear resolution and closure notes.

• Join RCA reviews. Update SOPs and knowledge-base articles.

• Work with Connectivity, Hosting, IDAM, DLP and Malware Tools on cross-tower issues.

• Trace policy evaluation in SSE (Zscaler Internet Access, Prisma Access and similar) – URL filtering, Cloud Firewall, SSL inspection, DLP, CASB – and in Prisma Access (security, decryption, URL filtering rules) to find unexpected allows or blocks.

• Diagnose Private Access failures across application segments, segment groups, server groups, access policies and Private Service Edge.

• Troubleshoot forwarding profiles, PAC files, trusted network detection and bypass configuration.

• Diagnose GRE and IPsec tunnel failures to Zscaler, and Remote Network and Service Connection tunnels in Prisma Access, including IKE/IPsec phase issues.

• Resolve DNS issues for private apps, including split DNS, conditional forwarding and DNS search domains.

• Troubleshoot SAML assertion and attribute problems, SCIM provisioning failures and group sync issues with Entra ID, Okta or Ping.

• Resolve device posture and trusted network check failures.

• Take and analyse packet captures (Wireshark, tcpdump, connector-side captures).

• Correlate logs across the SSE platform, SIEM, IdP and endpoint tools.

• Use ZDX and ADEM data to diagnose latency, edge selection and path problems.

**Tools:**

• Palo Alto firewalls (Cloud Firewalls)

• Zscaler

• Palo Alto NGFW, Panorama, Strata Cloud Manager, Strata Logging Service, Prisma Access

• Splunk SIEM

• Datadog

• Enterprise monitoring tools

• ServiceNow

• Okta (secondary skill)

**Technologies:**

• Subject-matter expertise (8+ years) in NGFWs, WAFs, multi-cloud networking and security controls, core networking protocols, and security architecture – primarily Palo Alto, AWS and Azure, with GCP and Alibaba Cloud as a plus.

• Deploying security policies with IPS, URL filtering, DNS security and SSL inspection.

• Firewall security policy tuning with tools such as AlgoSec.

• Quickly identifying and remediating root cause.

• ITaaS, ITIL, monitoring and metrics.

• Multi-cloud networking.

• Firewall administration.

• Secure web gateway.

• Access and rule management.

• Network segmentation.

• Firewall log analysis.

• TCP/IP and routing basics.

• Python or Ansible scripting.

• IaC tooling: GitHub, Octopus, Terraform.

• DNS expertise.

**Experience:**

• 12 years of experience in L2 network security operations

• 24x7 support environment

• Palo Alto firewall administration

• Zscaler administration (scope to be confirmed)

• Enterprise networking expertise

• Firewall rule and port request handling

• Log and evidence collection

• ITSM incident, problem and change processes

• Clear written and spoken English

**Certifications:**

• Palo Alto PCNSA / PCNSE

• Zscaler administrator certification

• CCNA

• A Proxy / SSE industry certification (Zscaler or Palo Alto)
