title: Technical Program Executive in Gurgaon
description:
We are looking for a curious, enthusiastic fresher to join our Gurgaon headquarters as a Technical Program Executive. You will help bring new clients onto the Zippee platform and make sure their systems connect smoothly with ours, working alongside Product, Engineering, Operations, clients, and technology partners. You do not need to be a software developer, and you do not need prior work experience. If you are curious about how apps and systems talk to each other, enjoy staying organized, and like solving problems, we will teach you the rest. You will be mentored by experienced team members and learn on real client projects from day one.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Help onboard new clients and support implementation projects from requirement gathering through go-live.
* Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Operations, clients, and technology partners to keep milestones on track.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT): prepare test cases, coordinate testing, log issues, and follow them until closed.
* Assist during production deployments and post-go-live activities.
* Learn how orders move between systems (order management, warehouse, logistics, partner platforms) and help spot where things get stuck.
* Work with technical teams to find and resolve integration issues, with guidance from senior members.
* Prepare project documents, simple process flows, trackers, and regular status updates.
* Explain technical issues in simple language to clients and business teams, and pass client requirements clearly to engineers.
* Track risks, open issues, and action items, and follow up with the right people on time.
* Suggest ideas to improve how we onboard clients and run integrations.

About Company: Zippee is India's 1st quick commerce logistics platform for e-commerce brands. Brands can connect their online stores to Zippee & kickstart quick commerce via our network of dark stores & last-mile fleets across India. This approach significantly improves customer loyalty, logistics costs, and RTOs. We're backed by VCs & founders of India's largest unicorns.

title: IT Engineer II, ITSE Solutions
description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
  
  
Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
  
  
While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a highly skilled ServiceNow ITSM Solution Engineer to serve as a critical bridge between business needs and technical implementation. In this role, you will partner closely with stakeholders, product teams, and service organizations to understand complex business challenges and translate them into scalable, cost-effective ServiceNow solutions. This position plays a key role in shaping solution design, ensuring alignment with ITSM product strategies, and delivering measurable value through a customer-centric approach.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a strong blend of consulting mindset, technical expertise, and business acumen—capable of gathering and prioritizing requirements, architecting tailored solutions, and producing clear, actionable design documentation. You will be responsible for guiding solution delivery from concept through implementation, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, ITIL best practices, and platform capabilities.
  
  
As a trusted advisor, the ServiceNow Solution Engineer will collaborate across cross-functional teams to drive successful project outcomes, optimize IT service workflows, and enable digital transformation. This role requires the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, while maintaining a focus on delivering intuitive, high-quality user experiences that enhance operational efficiency and long-term platform scalability.
  
  
**Key Functions**

* Requirements Engineering: Actively listening to customers to uncover, analyze, and document technical needs and pain points.
* Solution Design: Creating customized technical blueprints, architectures, and integration plans.
* Technical Consulting: Evaluating feasibility, researching best practices, and proposing cost-effective solutions.
* Product Demonstration/POC: Developing proof-of-concept models to visualize value and reduce risk for buyers.
* Documentation: Creating detailed technical specifications, proposals, and project documentation.
* Communicate with internal and external stakeholders in an open and timely manner, providing all needed information and support.
* Demonstrations & Proof of Concepts (POCs) to Minimum Viable Product (MVP): Tailoring product demos and developing POCs to demonstrate how the solution solves the client's specific problems.
* Prepares and presents comprehensive technical and administrative solutions to interpret requirements, identify alternatives, and recommendations-based experience and other findings.
* Product Feedback Loop: Working with internal product and engineering teams to relay client requirements and influence product improvements.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.
* This position will collaborate with multiple internal teams to design integrations with interfacing processes, enabling automated capabilities with procurement, finance, and third parties.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Convert business requirements into technical solutions—covering data models, workflows, integrations, and security.
* Ensure platform scalability, resilience, and compliance with security and regulatory requirements.
* Design and develop and engineer robust ServiceNow architectures aligned with business objectives and IT strategies while adhering to the product line model and SAFe Agile controls/process.
* Communication with peers and upper management, as appropriate, relative to issues, problems, and general status
* Leverage insights to advise on actionable areas for improvement or other actions to ensure operational value is maintained

**Additional/Secondary Responsibilities**

* Contributing to the development and refinement of the ITSM product line roadmap, management policies and schedules as needed for future enhancements.
* Engaging with internal and external resources to ensure clarification, changes, resolution, are addressed.
* Resolve stakeholder related issues and escalate to manager or Director of Strategy and Value Optimization as appropriate.

**Required Qualifications:**
Bachelor’s degree in IT or business equivalent
  
  
**Technical Expertise**

* Strong background in software, hardware, or systems architecture.
* Must have worked in similar environments within the last two years

**Certifications**

* ITIL Foundation
* ITSM Foundation
* ServiceNow certifications CTA, CSA; other

**Experience**

* Three or more years of experience supporting development and management of IT services relative to similar roles.
* Demonstrated capabilities with ITSM, ITIL and SAFeAgile factory models.
* Demonstrated success in large scale capability development and deployment.
* Working knowledge of ITIL and ITSM principles
* Understanding of SAFe Agile methodologies and practices, specifically within ServiceNow SPM (Service Portfolio Management) in planning and execution.
* Ability to problem solve issues to resolution
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and processes
* Highly flexible and adaptable to change
* Proficient in ITSM Foundation and experience with ServiceNow ITOM, ITSM, CMDB, KB etc.
* Microsoft Office and other productivity tools
* Global/international experience or exposure a plus

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Experience working with people and teams across various functions and regions.
* Demonstrated ability to create innovative solutions and think outside the box to solve complex and analytical problems.
* Demonstrated verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
* Highly flexible and adaptable to change

McCormick & Company is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
As a general policy, McCormick does not offer employment visa sponsorships upon hire or in the future.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

* **Role:**
  Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice & Conversational AI) -
  *Scale Voice & Conversational AI product suite across 0-1, 1-0, 10-100 journeys*
* **Department:**
  Product Management
* **Location:**
  Gurugram. Great, if you have a US travel Visa.
* **Team Stage:**
  Series B
* **Key Partners:**
  Product, Engineering, GTM, Onboarding, Customer Success
* **Work hours:**
  US hours (6pm IST onwards), frequent US travel

**About Spyne**

Spyne is building the AI operating system for automotive retail. It started with visual merchandising and has expanded into conversational AI. Spyne helps dealers move inventory faster, respond to buyers instantly, and run more of the dealership stack with AI. Founded by operators from Amazon, Cox, and OYO, Spyne has grown 30x in under three years and now powers 1,500+ dealerships across the US. Its products, Studio AI and Vini AI, are coming together into a full-stack Retail AI platform for modern dealerships.

* Rooftops live: 2,000+
* Growth: 2.5 to 3x a year for 3 consecutive years
* Revenue from the US: 80%+
* Net revenue retention: above 110%
* Integrations: 70+ across CRM, DMS, inventory, service and finance
* Team: 200+, primarily India-based
* Capital raised: $25M+ from Accel, Vertex Ventures and Storm Ventures

**The role**

Spyne sells AI to US franchise auto dealers. Vini AI is our voice agent for the dealer BDC: it handles sales inbound, sales outbound, and service inbound calls that a dealership would otherwise staff with people.

This role owns the technical side of making a dealer successful with Vini, from the first sales conversation to a live, performing deployment. You sit between our Sales, Onboarding, and Success teams as the person who can answer the hard product questions, configure the agent for a specific rooftop, debug a call flow at 11pm Central, and tell a GM why their service line is now booking 30% more appointments.

We have people who sell, onboard, and manage accounts. You are the one who makes the technology work for each customer across all three stages. You sit inside the product org. That's deliberate. You're the shortest path between a dealer who's blocked and the Product and Tech teams who can unblock them, and you're the field signal that decides what Vini builds next

**What you’ll own?**

*Pre-sales and sales closure*

* Join sales calls and demos as the technical authority on Vini. Answer dealer questions about call handling, integrations, data, and accuracy that an AE can't
* Run proof-of-concept setups for prospects. Configure a working agent against the dealer's real call scenarios so they hear it before they sign
* Map each prospect's BDC workflows (which calls, which CRM, which DMS, which phone system) and tell Sales what's straightforward and what's hard
* Build the technical knowledge base that lets AEs answer common questions without you, so your time goes to the deals that actually need it.

*Implementation and onboarding*

* Own the technical onboarding once a dealer signs. Connect Vini to their CRM, DMS, and telephony, configure the three call workflows, and set up routing, scripts, and escalation rules for their store
* Get the agent from copilot to autopilot on the dealer's timeline. Tune prompts, intents, and call logic against real calls until the dealer trusts it to run unattended
* Train the dealer's staff and BDC managers on how Vini fits their day, what to expect, and how to read its output
* Cut onboarding time. Find the steps that slow every deployment and turn them into repeatable setup, templates, or product requests

*Post-onboarding success*

* Become the subject matter expert the Success team brings in when an account has a technical problem they can't solve: a drop in answer rate, a workflow that needs reconfiguring after the dealer changes process, a new integration
* Monitor live deployments. Watch call performance, catch failures before the dealer does, and fix the agent or the config
* Expand accounts. Move dealers from one workflow to three, from one rooftop to a group, by proving Vini works on the calls they were nervous about

**What we expect?**

* 4+ years as an engineer, solutions engineer, FDE, or implementation engineer, with real time in front of customers. You've shipped code and you've also sat across from a frustrated user and fixed their problem live
* Comfort with APIs, integrations, and reading logs to find why something broke. You don't need to be a senior backend engineer, but you debug without waiting for the eng team
* Product sense. You can look at a pile of customer problems and tell which ones are config, which are training, and which are real product gaps. You write requests engineers want to pick up
* Experience working directly with Product and Engineering teams: filing well-scoped issues, sitting in on prioritization, and pushing for customer-facing fixes without burning the relationship
* Experience with at least one of: voice AI or conversational AI, telephony or contact-center systems, or CRM/DMS integrations
* The judgment to talk to a dealership GM and a Spyne engineer in the same hour and translate between them
* Willingness to work US-overlapping hours and travel to the US often, sometimes for a week or more at a time. Dealers want to see a person on site during go-live
* A bias toward owning the outcome. When a deployment stalls, you don't hand it off. You find out why and you fix it

**Bonus:**

* You've built or deployed production voice agents and know where they fail: latency, interruption handling, transfers, intent confusion
* You've owned a product feedback loop before: collecting field signal, turning it into specs, and seeing your requests through to shipped features
* You've been the first FDE or early implementation hire somewhere and built the playbook from nothing

title: Production Monitoring Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**
The Monitoring Engineer is a hands‑on technical role responsible for the day‑to‑day administration, configuration, and maintenance of enterprise monitoring platforms, with a primary focus on New Relic.
  
  
The role supports the delivery of effective monitoring and observability across FNZ platforms by implementing agreed monitoring standards, maintaining tooling health, and ensuring monitoring configurations remain current and reliable.
  
  
This position works closely with Monitoring Architects, Senior Analysts, Production Support, and Engineering teams. Monitoring requirements, strategy, and design direction are driven by Architects and senior operational stakeholders; the Monitoring Engineer is responsible for implementing, maintaining, and supporting those requirements effectively.
  
  
The Monitoring Engineer plays a key role in ensuring monitoring tooling enables timely issue detection, efficient incident investigation, and improved platform reliability.
  
  
**Team Responsibilities**
The current climate has no tolerance for slow performance, broken functionality or downtime with a need for constant and clear visibility into the end-to-end performance of our production applications.
  
  
Application Monitoring – developing new and innovative solutions to our monitoring requirements.
  
  
Stakeholder Communication – ensuring all monitoring solutions are embedded into production BAU and handed over to our operational support teams.
  
  
Project management – Manage our monitoring solutions from design, build, test, implementation and handover. Our team follows a Devops model so we will maintain our tooling and build for any upgrades, defects or improvements after go live.
  
  
Service Level Management – support the Service Managers in delivering FNZ services within KPIs, SLAs and contractual obligations.
  
  
**Specific Role Responsibilities**
Administer and maintain New Relic monitoring components under guidance from Architects and Senior Analysts, including agent configuration, alert policies, dashboards, and integrations.
  
  
Ensure New Relic agents are installed, configured correctly, and upgraded in accordance with agreed schedules and standards.
  
  
Implement monitoring for new services, applications, or infrastructure following provided requirements and design guidance.
  
  
Assist in managing requests for new monitoring deployments or changes, ensuring they are implemented accurately and consistently.
  
  
Support the maintenance of alerting rules and thresholds to ensure they are meaningful, reliable, and aligned with operational needs.
  
  
Create and maintain dashboards and visualisations to support Production Support and Engineering teams.
  
  
Maintain accurate documentation, including setup guides, configuration details, and operational runbooks.
  
  
Support vendor support cases and escalations, including collecting evidence and implementing recommended fixes.
  
  
Assist in tooling health checks and reviews to ensure monitoring platforms remain operational and effective.
  
  
Where applicable, support monitoring configuration using Infrastructure‑as‑Code approaches (e.g. Terraform) under guidance.
  
  
**Leadership & Development**
Work collaboratively with Architects, Senior Analysts, and Engineers to understand monitoring requirements and implement solutions.
  
  
Develop and maintain technical knowledge of New Relic and associated monitoring capabilities.
  
  
Share monitoring knowledge and best practices with Production Support and Engineering teams.
  
  
Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to improve monitoring quality and operational effectiveness.
  
  
Contribute to audit, risk, and operational assurance activities where required.
  
  
**Experience Required**
**What we are looking for:**
Minimum 5 years of experience in Monitoring, Production Support, Platform Operations, or similar technical roles.
  
  
Hands‑on experience working with New Relic or similar monitoring/observability tools.
  
  
Experience maintaining monitoring agents, integrations, dashboards, and alert configurations.
  
  
Understanding of basic observability concepts including metrics, logs, alerts, and service health.
  
  
Good technical troubleshooting skills and a methodical problem‑solving approach.
  
  
Strong attention to detail when implementing and maintaining tooling configurations.
  
  
Ability to follow architectural guidance and implement agreed standards consistently.
  
  
Clear written and verbal communication skills for documentation and team collaboration.
  
  
**Experience Preferred**
**Beneficial but not essential:**
Exposure to managing monitoring configuration at scale, including use of Terraform or similar tools.
  
  
Understanding of OTEL standards.
  
  
Experience working with operational tooling such as ServiceNow, PagerDuty, or Splunk.
  
  
Experience supporting monitoring in cloud, virtualised, or distributed environments.
  
  
Basic familiarity with application technologies such as .NET, APIs, SQL Server, or microservices.
  
  
Experience working in regulated or enterprise environments with formal change processes.
  
  
**About FNZ**
*FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.*
*We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.*
*We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2.4 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).
  
  
Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

title: Infrastructure Engineer II
description:
**Job Description**
The Infrastructure Patching & Security Engineering team ensures the security, stability, compliance, and operational resilience of enterprise infrastructure platforms through proactive patch management, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, automation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The team is responsible for maintaining secure and compliant Red Hat Linux, Windows environments by implementing enterprise patching strategies, addressing security vulnerabilities, reducing infrastructure risk, and ensuring adherence to organizational security standards.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Windows Server, VMware, system administration, OS patching, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, automation, and scripting. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing enterprise-wide patching operations, remediating security vulnerabilities, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, and driving automation to improve patch compliance and operational efficiency.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**OS Patching & Infrastructure Security Operations**

* Plan, coordinate, execute, and manage enterprise-wide operating system patching across Red Hat Linux and Windows infrastructure.
* Own end-to-end patch management activities, including patch assessment, planning, testing, deployment, validation, reporting, and remediation.
* Manage monthly, emergency, and out-of-band security patching cycles across production and non-production environments.
* Implement security patches, critical updates, kernel upgrades, and operating system fixes in accordance with enterprise security policies.
* Identify and remediate missing patches, outdated software packages, and infrastructure security vulnerabilities.
* Troubleshoot patch installation failures, dependency conflicts, repository issues, reboot failures, and post-patching system issues.
* Ensure patching activities are executed within approved maintenance windows with minimal business disruption.
* Develop patch rollback, recovery, and contingency procedures to minimize operational risks.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, cybersecurity, and change management teams to ensure timely patch deployment and compliance.

**Red Hat Linux, Windows & VMware Administration**

* Build, configure, administer, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Windows Server environments.
* Perform Linux patching using YUM, DNF, RPM, Red Hat Satellite, and related patch management tools.
* Manage Windows Server patching using Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), WSUS, or equivalent enterprise patching platforms.
* Support VMware ESXi and vCenter patching, upgrades, lifecycle management, and security remediation.
* Troubleshoot Linux kernel issues, package dependencies, system services, boot failures, filesystem issues, and OS performance degradation.
* Administer Windows Server infrastructure, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Windows Update services.
* Perform server health checks, pre-patching readiness assessments, and post-patching validation.
* Support operating system upgrades, end-of-life remediation, server migrations, and infrastructure modernization.

**Vulnerability Management & Security Remediation**

* Partner with cybersecurity and vulnerability management teams to identify, assess, prioritize, and remediate infrastructure vulnerabilities.
* Analyze vulnerability scan results from tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or equivalent enterprise security platforms.
* Remediate critical and high-severity vulnerabilities within defined security SLAs.
* Investigate vulnerabilities associated with operating systems, software packages, system configurations, and infrastructure components.
* Implement security hardening recommendations based on CIS benchmarks, vendor guidance, and enterprise security standards.
* Address security findings related to outdated packages, insecure protocols, weak configurations, unsupported operating systems, and missing security patches.
* Support vulnerability exception management, risk acceptance processes, and remediation tracking.
* Coordinate with application owners and infrastructure teams to resolve vulnerabilities requiring application compatibility testing or planned downtime.
* Maintain accurate vulnerability remediation records, compliance evidence, and audit documentation.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce vulnerability exposure and infrastructure security risk.

**Patching Automation & Scripting**

* Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions for enterprise infrastructure patching and security remediation.
* Automate Linux and Windows patch deployment, patch validation, compliance checks, and operational reporting.
* Develop automation scripts using Python, Bash, PowerShell, and Ansible.
* Implement Ansible playbooks for Linux patching, server configuration, security hardening, and vulnerability remediation.
* Automate patch readiness checks, server reboot coordination, service validation, and post-patching health checks.
* Integrate patching workflows with enterprise automation, orchestration, and IT service management platforms.
* Develop reusable scripts and automation frameworks to reduce manual intervention and improve patching consistency.
* Troubleshoot automation failures and continuously optimize patch deployment workflows.
* Identify opportunities to improve patch success rates, reduce patching cycle times, and increase infrastructure compliance through automation.

**Patch Compliance, Governance & Reporting**

* Track and maintain infrastructure patch compliance across Linux, Windows, and VMware platforms.
* Monitor patch deployment status, remediation progress, patch failures, and outstanding security vulnerabilities.
* Generate patch compliance dashboards, vulnerability remediation reports, and operational metrics.
* Ensure infrastructure patching activities align with enterprise security policies, regulatory requirements, and internal audit standards.
* Support security audits by providing patching evidence, remediation documentation, and compliance reports.
* Identify systems that are non-compliant, unsupported, or approaching end of life and develop remediation plans.
* Manage patching exceptions, risk assessments, and remediation timelines in coordination with cybersecurity and risk teams.
* Drive improvements in patch coverage, patch success rates, vulnerability remediation SLAs, and overall security posture.

**Infrastructure Support & Incident Management**

* Provide advanced L2/L3 technical support for Linux, Windows, VMware, and infrastructure patching platforms.
* Troubleshoot complex operating system, patching, application compatibility, performance, and availability issues.
* Participate in major incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), and problem management activities.
* Investigate infrastructure incidents caused by failed patches, operating system updates, configuration changes, or security remediation.
* Coordinate with application, database, network, storage, security, and infrastructure engineering teams to resolve cross-platform issues.
* Perform proactive infrastructure health checks, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Support production change implementation, maintenance activities, and emergency security patch deployments.
* Develop and maintain operational runbooks, patching procedures, troubleshooting guides, and technical documentation.
* Participate in on-call support and scheduled maintenance activities to ensure critical infrastructure availability.

**Qualifications**
**Required Experience & Technical Skills**

* 7 years of overall IT infrastructure, system administration, patch management, or infrastructure security engineering experience.
* Strong hands-on experience managing enterprise-wide operating system patching and vulnerability remediation across large-scale infrastructure environments.
* Extensive expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 7/8/9 or later), including administration, patching, kernel upgrades, troubleshooting, and security hardening.
* Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 or later, including administration, security updates, patch deployment, and troubleshooting.
* Strong experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, virtualization management, patching, and lifecycle operations.
* Hands-on experience with Linux patch management tools such as Red Hat Satellite, YUM, DNF, and RPM.
* Experience with Windows patch management platforms such as SCCM/MECM, WSUS, or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Strong understanding of vulnerability management processes and remediation using tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management using Ansible.
* Hands-on scripting experience using Python, Bash/Shell scripting, and PowerShell.
* Strong understanding of operating system security hardening, CIS benchmarks, vulnerability remediation, and patch compliance.

title: Senior System Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Hindustan Parking Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd (HPIPL) is an innovation-driven Indian company focused on designing, manufacturing, and installing next-generation parking systems that enhance urban mobility and efficiency. Guided by a Make in India philosophy, HPIPL blends Indian engineering with global technology standards to deliver ISO-certified, durable, and safe parking solutions. The company emphasizes automation, sustainability, and quality assurance, using premium components and offering nationwide and international service with 24/7 customer support. HPIPL’s comprehensive solutions span parking systems for buses, trucks, cars, bikes, and fully automatic installations for housing complexes, offices, airports, and commercial spaces. The organization is committed to building smarter, cleaner, and more connected spaces that support India’s future-ready infrastructure.
  
**Role Description**
The Senior System Engineer role at HPIPL is a full-time, on-site position based in Noida. The role involves leading the design, implementation, and maintenance of systems that support advanced parking infrastructure solutions, including hardware, software, and network components. Day-to-day responsibilities include overseeing system architecture, configuring servers and applications, monitoring system performance, and ensuring high availability and reliability of critical platforms. The Senior System Engineer will diagnose and resolve complex technical issues, provide technical support and guidance to project and installation teams, and document system configurations and procedures. This role also includes collaborating with engineering, operations, and customer support teams to optimize system design, improve security and scalability, and support ongoing innovation in smart parking technologies.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Systems Engineering and Systems Design skills for architecting, integrating, and optimizing complex technical solutions.
* Candidates should possess solid System Administration skills, including server management, configuration, monitoring, and performance tuning.
* Candidates should possess advanced Troubleshooting and Technical Support skills for diagnosing issues, resolving incidents, and supporting on-site deployments.
* Candidates should possess familiarity with networking, operating systems (Linux/Windows), and security best practices relevant to industrial and IoT environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; advanced certifications (e.g., CCNA, RHCE, MCSE) are an advantage.
* Experience in infrastructure projects, industrial automation, smart systems, or similar domains, preferably in a senior or lead engineering capacity.
* Ability to work on-site at Noida, collaborate with cross-functional teams, manage multiple projects, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and commitment to safety, reliability, and continuous improvement.

title: SAP CCM
description:
Job Description: SAP CCM
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced
**SAP Functional Lead / Senior Consultant**
with
**8 to 10 years**
of hands-on expertise across Application Maintenance (AM) support and Application Development (AD)/enhancements. The ideal candidate will possess deep specialization in
**SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)**
—including rebate processing, accruals, and settlement logic—backed by robust knowledge of
**SAP SD and Pricing**
.
  
  
In this role, you will lead complex enhancements, drive continuous process improvements, and provide robust L2/L3 production support in an S/4HANA enterprise environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enhancements & Application Development (AD)**

* Process Enhancement & Delivery: Lead the design and delivery of CCM enhancements, including new condition contract types, specialized settlement logic, and custom rebate models tailored to evolving business requirements.
* Functional Specifications: Gather business requirements and translate them into comprehensive Functional Specifications (FS) for custom RICEF objects.
* System Configuration: Configure condition contract types, pricing conditions, settlement parameters, and cross-module integration points.
* Development & Testing: Partner closely with technical (ABAP) teams through development, unit testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure defect-free production releases.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive process optimization and automation initiatives within CCM and pricing operational workflows.

**Application Maintenance & Production Support (AM)**

* L2/L3 Incident Management: Deliver high-quality L2/L3 support for SAP S/4HANA CCM operations, ensuring strict adherence to SLAs and minimal business disruption.
* Troubleshooting & Resolution: Analyze and resolve complex issues related to rebate processing, settlement runs, accrual postings, and pricing discrepancies.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform in-depth RCA on recurring defects and implement permanent preventive fixes.
* ITSM Governance: Efficiently manage incidents, problem records, and service requests within ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Period-End Operations: Monitor, validate, and support period-end settlement runs and corresponding financial postings.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance**

* Integration Alignment: Collaborate with SD and FI teams to resolve complex, cross-module integration issues and ensure seamless Order-to-Cash (O2C) processing.
* Change Management: Adhere strictly to change management, transport release, and governance protocols for all system enhancements.
* Knowledge Management: Maintain detailed functional documentation, conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions, and promote standard SAP best practices.

**Required Candidate Profile**

* Experience: 8–10 years of SAP hands-on experience covering both Application Support (AMS) and Enhancements/Implementations in SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Core Functional Expertise: Deep domain expertise in SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)—rebates, accruals, settlements, and contract maintenance.
* Domain Knowledge: Solid expertise in SAP SD (Order-to-Cash) and advanced SAP Pricing Procedure configurations.
* Technical Interface Skills: Proven track record of designing functional specs for custom RICEF objects and working with ABAP teams.
* Support Proficiency: Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow) and standard ITIL support processes.

We are seeking an experienced Applications L2/L3 Support & Maintenance Engineer with expertise in OpenText RightFax to provide operational support, administration, maintenance, troubleshooting, and minor enhancements for enterprise faxing solutions. * IIS

title: Senior D365 Finance & Operations Application Lead
description:
About the Role:
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on Senior D365 Finance & Operations Application Lead to own the functional operation, development roadmap, and continuous improvement of our Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations environment.
  
  
You will be the primary IT partner for Finance, Procurement, Logistics, and Operations, combining business process expertise with technical capabilities, application governance, and delivery coordination.
  
  
Working closely with our Senior D365 Engineer in India, who leads technical architecture and development, you will drive the transition from external vendors to sustainable internal engineering and support capabilities.
  
  
This is a senior individual contributor role with end-to-end application ownership, without direct line management.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Application Ownership & Business Partnership:
  
  
  

* Own D365 Finance & Operations and its business-critical integrations, including connected expense, reporting, and integration services.
* Translate Finance, Procurement, and Logistics requirements into functional solutions, roadmaps, and prioritized backlogs.
* Provide expertise across GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Inventory, Tax, and related workflows.
* Ensure application reliability, business continuity, and readiness for financial closing periods.
* Define service expectations, escalation paths, and SLAs/OLAs with business and IT stakeholders.

Functional Engineering & Delivery:
  
  
  

* Perform hands-on D365 configuration, troubleshooting, and selected enhancements.
* Read, debug, and review X++ code, contributing to development where appropriate.
* Define functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with the Senior D365 Engineer on solution design, technical feasibility, and delivery planning.
* Coordinate testing, UAT, releases, deployments, business acceptance, and documentation.

Internalization & Vendor Management:
  
  
  

* Lead the transition of agreed development and support activities from external partners to internal teams.
* Coordinate knowledge transfer, source code, technical assets, documentation, and operational handovers.
* Establish clear responsibilities, support processes, and delivery capabilities across Switzerland and India.
* Manage vendor performance, service agreements, transition milestones, risks, and dependencies.
* Reduce external dependencies while maintaining service continuity and quality.

Operations, Governance & Budget:
  
  
  

* Own application service quality, incident coordination, problem resolution, and continuous improvement.
* Oversee integrations, application security roles, access reviews, segregation of duties, and audit compliance.
* Ensure alignment with ITSM, security, change, and release management processes.
* Coordinate distributed engineering resources, delivery commitments, and stakeholder communication.
* Act as Cost Center Owner, managing application budgets, licensing, contracts, and external service costs.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and improved reliability.

What You Bring:
  
  
  

* 8+ years in ERP, enterprise applications, consulting, or application management, ideally including 5+ years with D365 Finance & Operations.
* Strong functional knowledge of Finance, Procurement, and operational ERP processes.
* Hands-on D365 configuration, troubleshooting, and practical X++ development experience, including code analysis and debugging.
* Experience managing application roadmaps, requirements, delivery, integrations, testing, and production support.
* Proven ability to manage external ERP partners, knowledge transfer, and transitions to internal engineering teams.
* Experience collaborating with distributed teams and coordinating technical delivery without direct line authority.
* Understanding of application security, financial controls, audit requirements, and ITSM practices.
* Strong business partnering, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.
* Excellent English communication skills.

Additional advantages: Advanced X++ development, Azure, Power Platform, Logic Apps, REST APIs, Power BI, Linux, automation, Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, ITIL, German language skills, and relevant Microsoft certifications.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
Within your first 12 months, you will have:
  
  
  

* Established trusted functional ownership and a transparent D365 roadmap.
* Built an effective delivery partnership with our India-based engineering team.
* Transitioned agreed vendor activities into sustainable internal capabilities.
* Improved application reliability, support processes, and financial closing readiness.
* Delivered hands-on improvements while strengthening governance, documentation, and audit readiness.
* Reduced vendor dependency and improved budget transparency.

Your Mindset
  
  
You combine business understanding, technical expertise, and strong ownership. You are equally comfortable working with Finance stakeholders and engineers, translating complex requirements into practical solutions.
  
  
You communicate clearly, challenge existing processes constructively, and focus on reliable, maintainable solutions that deliver measurable business value.
  
  
*As our Global IT application portfolio evolves, additional business application responsibilities may be assigned.*

* Experience with antivirus/endpoint security, hardware and software troubleshooting, mobile/tablet configuration, system synchronization, and biometric devices.
* Ability to independently diagnose technical issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, documentation, and user-support skills.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

A proactive, technically strong IT professional who can take ownership of the organization's IT environment, manage day-to-day infrastructure, and resolve complex technical issues independently. Practical troubleshooting ability is essential; ticket management alone is not sufficient.

IT Help Desk, IT Support, IT Infrastructure, Network Administration, Server Management, Domain Server, Active Directory, LDAP, Windows Troubleshooting, macOS Support, Mail Server, DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, Antivirus, Endpoint Security, Hardware Troubleshooting, Software Installation, Mobile Device Configuration, System Synchronization, Biometric Systems, IT Asset Management, Backup, IT Security, Technical Support.

Job Description: IT Infra Service Delivery Manager

Location- Ahmedabad

Reporting To: Delivery Head / Account Delivery Head (ADH)
  
Role Purpose
  
Lead end-to-end IT Service Delivery for enterprise customers, owning service outcomes across towers (End User Services, Infrastructure, Applications, Network, Cloud). Ensure predictable delivery against SLAs/OLAs/Underpinning Contracts, drive continual improvement using ITIL® 4 practices, and orchestrate multi-vendor delivery to achieve contractual, financial, and customer experience goals. (Terminology aligned with ITIL 4 key concepts, guiding principles, governance, and continual improvement.)

Key Responsibilities
  
1) Run & Govern
  
•    Own service performance—publish MSR/QSR, executive summaries, risks, actions, and trend insights (ServiceNow Performance Analytics / Power BI).
  
•    Lead Operational/Service/Executive Reviews, aligning delivery towers, vendors, and customer stakeholders.
  
•    Ensure contractual compliance to SOW/MSA including service credits, waivers, and governance records—audit ready at all times. 
  
2) Stabilize & Improve
  
•    Drive MIM posture (readiness, drills, on call, comms), backlog hygiene, and automation/shift left to boost CSAT and reduce TCO.
  
•    Run RCA/CAPA programs; track benefits (repeat incident reduction, MTTR, change failure rate).
  
•    Lead CSI initiatives across process, tooling, and org—aligned to ITIL 4 guiding principles. 
  
3) Transition & Transformation
  
•    For new/changed services, define interim vs. steady state SLAs, baselines, staffing, and tooling readiness; execute cutover criteria and hypercare.
  
•    Align Service Delivery Plan with Wipro QMS (Veloci Q) requirements and customer specifics; maintain evidence of communications and approvals. 
  
4) Stakeholder Leadership
  
•    Act as single point of accountability for service outcomes; manage escalations through resolution; influence CXO/Director level stakeholders with data driven narratives.
  
•    Mentor leads/SMEs; build a high performing, ITIL mature delivery culture.
  
Must Have Skills & Experience
  
•    12–15 years in IT services with 6–8 years leading enterprise IT service delivery across multi tower and multi vendor environments.
  
•    Proven governance of SLAs/OLAs/UCs, penalty/earnback mechanisms, and audit expectations (ISO/ISMS/SOC). 
  
•    Strong command of ITIL 4 practices and value stream thinking; hands on with ServiceNow ITSM (SLA policies, business calendars, PA dashboards, reports).
  
•    Expertise in Major Incident, Problem/RCA, Change/CAB, Availability/Capacity, Knowledge, ITAM/CMDB, Service Catalog.
  
•    Advanced analytics & storytelling (Power BI/Excel), prioritization, and stakeholder management.
  
•    Excellent communication and customer facing leadership; experience in managed services contracts.
  
Preferred / Good to Have:
  
•    ITIL® 4 Strategist: Direct, Plan & Improve (DPI) or Leader: Digital & IT Strategy (DITS)
  
•    PMP® / PRINCE2® Practitioner, PSM I/II (or SAFe Agilist)
  
•    Cloud Associate/Architect (e.g., Microsoft Azure AZ 104 / AZ 305, AWS SysOps/Architect Associate)
  
•    DevOps/SRE Foundation, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer

title: Technical Support Coach
description:
The Tech Coach plays a pivotal role in elevating the skill set, confidence, and service delivery of our customer-facing support teams. Working within the Learning & Development (L&D) organization, the Tech Coach balances real-time technical guidance in internal support channels with structured quality checks, performance coaching, and documentation maintenance. This role acts as a strategic bridge between support technicians, supervisors, and training staff to ensure standard-setting customer experiences.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Provide real-time technical guidance and troubleshooting support in internal help channels.
* Guide technicians through complex or urgent customer issues by breaking down technical concepts and fostering problem-solving skills rather than simply providing direct answers.
* Instill confidence in frontline staff and set a high standard for customer interaction quality.
* Communicate with Operations and Engineering teams when new issues/bugs arise.
* Evaluate technician ticket, chat, and phone interactions against established QA/QC grading rubrics and automated grading checks.
* Perform monthly human verification audits on sample cases to maintain grading accuracy and calibrate evaluation systems.
* Conduct targeted manual case reviews for agents to isolate root causes and build remediation plans.
* Provide clear and useful feedback for administrators to improve customer service.
* Partner directly with leaders to deliver structured feedback, actionable performance insights, and trend analysis.
* Communicate both performance deficiencies and team accolades to leaders to aid in employee development and recognition.
* Participate in leadership syncs to align coaching priorities with team performance metrics.
* Draft, update, and maintain internal documentation articles to maintain brand consistency and availability of information.
* Identify missing or outdated documentation standard operating procedures during ticket reviews and update relevant sources.
* Assist with training, onboarding, and mentoring new technical hires as they transition onto active shifts.
* Serve as an approachable point of contact for new technicians during their early tenure to accelerate time-to-productivity.
* Drive technical advancement initiatives (e.g., Level 1 to Level 2/3 progression) by designing targeted coaching plans.
* Conduct 1-on-1 coaching sessions to address skill gaps, refine soft skills, and improve technical execution.
* Track recurring technical issues, error patterns, and support trends across shifts.
* Provide feedback and data insights to Trainers regarding widespread knowledge gaps to inform future training modules, team PSAs, and curriculum updates.

#### **Requirements**

* Strong proficiency in Web Hosting environments, Linux system administration, and command-line interfaces (CLI).
* Mastery of soft skills, with a demonstrated ability to explain complex technical topics in clear, approachable language.
* Friendly, positive, and energetic approach to mentoring peers and helping others succeed.
* Ability to review support cases, analyze performance data using rubric criteria, and draw objective conclusions.
* High comfort level working in fast-paced text and chat environments while balancing accuracy with responsiveness.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in technical coaching, mentoring, training, or QA role.
* Experience with specialized web hosting management tools.
* Familiarity with Salesforce CRM and QA evaluation tools.

At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed. 
  
 
  
 We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. title: Manager, Travel Experience Consultant
description:
As a Manager, Travel Experience Consultant, you will lead a dedicated team of Travel Consultants. This role requires a unique blend of people leadership, operational management, and relationship cultivation. You will be responsible for the day-to-day oversight of your team, ensuring they provide exceptional service, while also managing the strategic service relationship with the dedicated customer's Travel Manager and Specialists.
  
  
Your leadership will be key to developing a high-performing team, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring the success of the offline travel program for our most valued customers.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* People Leadership & Development: Serve as the frontline manager for a team of Business Travel Consultants. You will be responsible for coaching, training, and upskilling team members to deliver a best-in-class customer experience.
* Performance Management: Conduct regular 1:1 meetings and quarterly reviews to monitor progress, set clear expectations, and track career development using career maps. Provide continuous performance feedback to encourage desired behaviors and ensure alignment with corporate goals.
* Operational Management: Oversee the team's operational performance, monitoring call queues (ACD) and SLAs to ensure goals are met. You will perform root cause analysis on common service issues to develop and implement permanent corrective actions and process improvements.
* Customer Relationship Management: Act as the primary point of contact for the dedicated customer's Travel Manager. You will conduct regular check-ins, present performance statistics, and collaborate on improvement plans and service enhancements.
* Issue & Escalation Resolution:Take ownership of customer escalations, managing and resolving issues from start to finish. You will coach your team to proactively address traveler inquiries and aim for first-contact resolution. As Manager, you may also need to step in and directly handle escalated chats and calls to ensure prompt and effective resolution.
* Collaboration & Communication: Collaborate with the wider support team to meet performance and behavior metrics. You will work with your manager to prioritize and address customer requests for product and service enhancements. You will also communicate transparently with the dedicated customer about service improvements and corrective actions.
* Talent Acquisition & Onboarding: Screen and interview new hires as the organization scales. You will provide input for the New Hire Training Program and ensure its effective execution for modules delivered by the support team.
* Administrative Oversight: Manage approvals for employee travel bookings and handle Resignation Conversations with departing employees. You will lead these discussions with respect and curiosity, documenting insights to help improve the company.
* Engagement & Culture: Organize team engagement activities, both in-person and remote, to foster a positive, collaborative, and high-performing team culture.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Experience: A minimum of 5 years of progressive leadership experience in a contact center or support environment, with at least 5 years of experience at the manager level.
* Industry Expertise: A minimum of 5 years of experience in the travel industry, with deep knowledge of GDS platforms (Sabre and/or Amadeus).
* Customer Focus: A proven ability to live and breathe customer support, with a commitment to high customer engagement and a passion for resolving complex customer issues.
* Leadership Skills: A track record of building relationships, motivating teams, and acting as a proven mentor. You should have a clear understanding of the challenges facing a fast-growing company.
* Analytical Abilities: The ability to use a data-driven approach to identify operational challenges and inform strategic decisions.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, along with strong presentation and facilitation skills.
* Technical Acumen: Familiarity with CRM applications (e.g., Salesforce, Twilio) and contact center applications (e.g., Calabrio, WorkDay).
* Personal Attributes: Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills. You should be able to work independently and as part of a team, and be flexible to work non-traditional shifts as needed.
* Education: Bachelor's degree preferred.

**What Sets You Apart**

* A reputation as a resolution-focused leader who champions change and consistently exceeds expectations.
* A proven ability to proactively identify and implement process improvements.
* A passion for developing others and fostering a solutions-oriented team culture.

title: Duty Manager
description:
Holiday Inn Express Bangalore Bommasandra is part of IHG Hotels & Resorts, one of the world’s leading hotel companies. Holiday Inn Express is IHG’s largest and fastest-growing brand, with more than 3,000 hotels in 75 countries, focused on simple, smart, and engaging guest experiences. Guests enjoy affordable stays with high-speed internet access, free breakfast, and comfortable rooms designed to help them relax and recharge. IHG supports a global workforce of approximately 350,000 people across hotels and corporate offices, offering strong brand recognition and career development opportunities.
  
Applicants can benefit from IHG’s global standards, training programs, and the IHG One Rewards loyalty ecosystem.
  
Role Description
  
The Duty Manager at Holiday Inn Express Bangalore Bommasandra is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru, responsible for overseeing day-to-day hotel operations during assigned shifts. This role manages the front office team, ensures smooth check-in and check-out processes, and addresses guest requests, concerns, and feedback promptly and professionally. The Duty Manager coordinates with housekeeping, maintenance, and food and beverage teams to maintain brand standards, cleanliness, safety, and service quality. The role includes monitoring occupancy, handling reservations and room allocations, managing cash and billing procedures, and supporting compliance with IHG policies and local regulations. The Duty Manager also helps train and guide team members, supports service recovery efforts, and contributes to guest satisfaction and operational efficiency.
  
Qualifications
  
  
Candidates should possess strong hotel operations and front office skills, including experience with guest services, check-in/check-out procedures, and reservation management.
  
Candidates should possess leadership and people management skills, including team supervision, delegation, coaching, and performance feedback.
  
Candidates should possess customer service and communication skills, including handling guest inquiries, resolving issues, and maintaining a professional and welcoming demeanor.
  
Candidates should possess organizational and problem-solving skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, manage time effectively, and respond calmly to operational challenges.
  
Candidates should possess basic financial and administrative skills, including cash handling, billing oversight, and familiarity with hotel management systems or PMS software.
  
Relevant qualifications such as a diploma or degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality, Business, or a related field are beneficial.
  
Prior experience in a hotel supervisory or Duty Manager role, preferably within an international brand, is highly desirable.
  
Working knowledge of safety, security, and compliance standards in hospitality, along with flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and holidays, is expected.

title: Manager Business Optimization
description:
**About Us**

As a leading provider of high-quality food and beverage ingredients, we work with farming communities across the globe to grow, source and produce ingredients that are good for consumers, farmers, and the world around us. We supply household food brands and manufacturers worldwide with cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts and spices ingredients which are often grown on our own farms and estates and sourced from hundreds of thousands of farmers across ~50 countries. Along with our diverse manufacturing and innovation capabilities, this means we can provide ingredients for a range of products, from a plant-based latte mix to an almond based snack bar or a dairy-free ice cream. Making a positive impact on people and planet is a core component of our Purpose, to be the change for good food and a healthy future. With a deep-rooted presence in the countries where our ingredients are grown, we are closer to farmers, enabling better quality, and more reliable, traceable, and transparent supply. And whoever we’re with, whatever we’re doing, we always make it real.

**Overview of the role**

Work with Procurement and planning teams to optimize the economic and operational performance of the plan-to-produce and source-to-pay processes across multiple food-ingredient manufacturing sites. The role combines demand and production planning, procurement analytics, cost analytics, and the digitalization of both functions — including applied AI and automation. It exists to close the value leakage that sits between planning, buying, and finance, and to engineer it out of the process permanently.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Demand & production planning**
  — work alongside the demand and production planners who own the plan: strengthen the statistical forecast baseline for a multi-thousand-SKU portfolio, introduce forecast variance and FVA discipline, improve line-level scheduling logic across blending and packaging capacity, and sharpen MRP shortage, scenario and S&OP analytics.
* **Procurement analytics**
  — equip category buyers with the analysis behind their decisions: vendor pricing and spend visibility, category planning and coverage tooling, BOM-based demand attribution to suppliers, supplier risk classification, and should-cost and make-vs-buy support.
* **Cost & financial analytics**
  — give Finance and Operations a common, trusted view of where value leaks: standard cost roll-up through multi-level BOMs, manufacturing variance analysis (PPV, yield, absorption), margin and working-capital impact of planning policy, SLOB/E&O exposure, and inventory and DIO reporting.
* **Service performance**
  — measure OTIF and fill rate on the customer's own methodology and attribute every miss to a planning, supply or capacity root cause, so the accountable function can act on evidence rather than opinion.
* **Digitalisation & AI**
  — the accountability owned outright: replace manual spreadsheet processes with auditable automated systems, build the planning and procurement decision tools the functions run on, and apply AI to analysis, extraction and workflow automation with defined validation and governance.
* **ERP & planning systems**
  — support the functional process owners through ERP and planning-platform implementation and migration: requirements definition, master data governance, data migration, UAT, cutover and hypercare.
* **Influence & team leadership**
  — direct and quality-assure an offshore analytics team, and earn adoption without direct authority by working through the incumbents in Commercial, Procurement, Manufacturing, IT and Finance who own the processes being improved.

**Experience and Qualification**

* Degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Statistics, Accounting or a related quantitative field.
* Cost or management accounting qualification (CMA / CIMA / ICMAI or equivalent) held alongside operational supply chain accountability.
* 10+ years spanning all three of demand planning, production planning, and procurement analytics — depth in one or two is not sufficient.
* 3+ years in food, beverage, spice or food-ingredient manufacturing (allergen controls, lot traceability, shelf life).
* Administrator-level configuration experience on an advanced planning system (DemandCaster strongly preferred), plus hands-on ERP data-level SQL in more than one dialect (Plex and Snowflake strongly preferred).
* Full-lifecycle ERP or planning-platform implementation as business process owner, through cutover and hypercare.
* Applied intermittent-demand forecasting (Croston, SBA, TSB, ADI/CV² classification, Forecast Value Add).
* Proven ability to build and deploy production-grade planning and procurement tools independently — advanced Excel engineering plus browser-based analytics applications. No dedicated developer support in this role.
* Demonstrated AI-enabled automation in production use, with a stated efficiency or accuracy result and a described validation and governance approach.
* Multi-site accountability and experience directing an offshore analytics team.
* Preferred: CPIM / CSCP / CPSM; Python or R; SAP IBP / S4 or Blue Yonder exposure; agricultural commodity or packaging category experience.

**First Year Success Measures**

Success in year one is evidenced by working systems in daily use and a quantified benefit, not by analysis delivered:

* Planning — corrected end-to-end capacity model in live use by the planners, and FVA reporting running in the monthly S&OP cycle.
* Procurement — buyer category console deployed and adopted by the buying team, with coverage and supplier risk visible in one place.
* Cost & working capital — quantified PPV and working-capital benefit agreed with Finance, and reduced aged SLOB exposure.
* Service — measurable OTIF and fill-rate improvement on the customer's own methodology, with every miss attributed to a root cause and owner.
* Digitalisation — phase one of the roadmap delivered, with the manual spreadsheet routines it replaced retired rather than run in parallel.

description:
**About the Role:**

Manager Breakdown Maintenance & Preventive Maintenance is to ensure that equipment and machinery in a Café set up are maintained and repaired efficiently when they break down or experience unexpected failures. The role involves a combination of technical, managerial, and organizational tasks. Here are the key responsibilities.

**Roles and Responsibility:**

* Break down maintenance: Responsible for 450 cafes and 200 CDX(Xpress) outlets across the country .
* Repair & maintenance: Responsible for 450 cafes and 200 CDX(Xpress) outlets across the country .
* Supervision: Building program of all heating and A/C and Refrigeration based on daily schedules
* Equipment Inspection and Assessment: Conduct regular inspections of supplies, tools, machinery and equipment to identify potential issues.
* Emergency Response: Quickly respond to breakdowns or unexpected equipment failures, ensuring that downtime is minimized to maintain
* Diagnosis: Identify the root causes of equipment failures and breakdowns by working with maintenance teams and using diagnostic tools.
* Coordination: Coordinate with maintenance technicians, mechanics, and engineers to ensure prompt repair and maintenance activities
* Resource Allocation: Allocate resources, such as personnel, tools, and spare parts, to address breakdowns efficiently.
* Scheduling: Develop and maintain a maintenance schedule to prevent future breakdowns by conducting routine maintenance activities and predictive maintenance.
* Cost Management: Monitor and manage the budget allocated for breakdown maintenance, making sure it is used effectively and efficiently.
* Vendor Management: Work with external vendors and suppliers to source replacement parts and services as needed for repairs.
* Documentation: Maintain detailed records of equipment breakdowns, repairs, and maintenance activities for future reference and analysis.
* Reporting: Provide regular reports to higher management on breakdown statistics, downtime, and measures taken to address them.
* Safety Compliance: Ensure that all maintenance activities comply with safety regulations and standards to protect the well-being of maintenance staff and other employees.
* Training: Develop and implement training programs for maintenance personnel to enhance their skills in diagnosing and repairing equipment.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process and equipment improvement to reduce the frequency of breakdowns.
* Inventory Management: Oversee the inventory of spare parts and supplies required for breakdown maintenance to ensure an adequate supply.
* Root Cause Analysis: Conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurring breakdowns by addressing underlying issues.
* Quality Control: Ensure that equipment repairs and maintenance are done to high standards to prevent frequent breakdowns and maximize equipment lifespan.
* Collaboration: Work closely with other departments, such as production and engineering, to understand their needs and coordinate maintenance activities accordingly.
* Overall, the breakdown maintenance manager plays a crucial role in minimizing equipment downtime, ensuring the reliability and efficiency of production processes, and reducing maintenance-related costs QSR (Quick Service restaurant) environment.

**Experience & Qualification:**

1. Any bachelor's degree (mechanical, electrical, industrial, etc.) is preferable.
2. 10+ years of experience. 5+ Years - experience in Retail chains.
3. Good Arithmetical & Reasoning Ability
4. Effective communication skills to convey technical information to team members, other departments, and stakeholders.
5. Clear communication during breakdown situations to coordinate activities and provide updates.
6. Extensive Experience in A/C and Refrigeration for Repair and maintenance of equipment in Cafés
7. Capability to assess the technical skills of the maintenance team.
8. Knowledge In Troubleshoot
9. Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) for tracking and managing maintenance activities.
10. Ability to leverage technology for planning, scheduling, and analyzing breakdown maintenance data.

**Language Fluency: English, Hindi and Kannada. Open to travel PAN India**

**Job Description:**
The Manager, Evidence Generation Operations Enablement (non-site based) provides non-site-based study operations support across intake and triage, study progress documentation, close-out tracking, fair market value support, cross-functional coordination, investigator-initiated and collaborative research contracting support, evidence package upload, and vendor artifact storage. The role delivers consistent, high-quality, and traceable operational execution across repeatable evidence generation workflows, enabling Global Evidence Generation teams to focus on scientific strategy, study prioritization, final decisions, and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
**About the Role:**
The Manager, Evidence Generation Operations Enablement (non-site based) coordinates study operations activities across multiple non-site-based study types. The role manages intake completeness, review logistics, study documentation, close-out packages, FMV records, contracting materials, vendor artifacts, and evidence package archival. The role works with Global Evidence Generation, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Procurement, local operating companies, vendors, and study teams, escalating strategic, scientific, budget, legal, compliance, or non-standard documentation questions to the appropriate owner.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute:**

* Receive and log evidence generation, collaborative research, study support, and contracting requests, including requester, asset, indication, region, timing, request type, and completeness status.
* Conduct first-pass completeness checks and route requests to the appropriate Global Evidence Generation, portfolio, study, or functional owner.
* Coordinate cross-functional synopsis and protocol review logistics, including reviewer lists, timelines, meeting scheduling, comment collation, version control, and action tracking.
* Escalate conflicting scientific, strategic, legal, or compliance comments to Global Evidence Generation for resolution.
* Maintain study documentation checklists, status trackers, milestone updates, open-action logs, and repository records for assigned non-site-based studies.
* Prepare study status summaries for study leads or governance review, including progress updates, risks, dependencies, and missing documentation.
* Apply standard close-out procedures, collect final study documents, track vendor, budget, and contract close-out actions, and store final close-out packages.
* Flag missing documents, unresolved payments, pending approvals, open risks, or study-specific exceptions to the appropriate owner.
* Support first-pass FMV documentation, rate-table checks, assumption capture, and archival of FMV outcomes with contract packages.
* Prepare internal contracting initiation packages for investigator-initiated research, collaborative research, and other non-site-based agreements, including study overview, intellectual property terms, publication rights, budget inputs, and required approvals.
* Coordinate Legal or shared contracting review and track amendments, renewal triggers, negotiation points, and contracting lifecycle milestones.
* Store vendor artifacts, statements of work, scorecards, correspondence, contract records, and performance documentation with correct metadata, access controls, retention category, and study linkage.
* Maintain traceable logs for intake, review, contracting, close-out, vendor artifacts, and evidence package archival.
* Identify recurring process gaps and support improvements to templates, trackers, checklists, and handoff materials aligned with quality and compliance requirements.
* Use approved digital, automation, and AI-enabled tools, where appropriate, to support intake, documentation tracking, review coordination, issue identification, and operational reporting while maintaining accuracy, traceability, privacy, and human oversight.

* Familiarity with investigator-initiated research, collaborative research, contracting workflows, FMV documentation, Legal review routing, and vendor artifact management.
* Experience maintaining audit-ready repositories, trackers, version histories, and documentation packages.
* Strong coordination skills across Global Evidence Generation, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Procurement, local operating companies, vendors, and study teams.
