title: Global Treasury Operations, Manager
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
An experienced individual for our Markets Operations who demonstrates subject matter expertise in one or more responsibilities of the operation that includes the execution of Global Treasury investment portfolio and/or liability management related workflows, supports Funding and Collateral Transformation products in line with market deadlines and internal SLAs. The individual works independently with regard to accomplishing responsibilities, strives to provide excellent client service and supports Risk Excellence culture of State Street. The individual should possess extensive knowledge and experience on securities, settlements, rates, treasury products, and related financial attributes. Will require to work closely with Business teams, Functional teams, Business Risk, Compliance and Technology teams on day-to-day basis to ensure seamless BAU. A large element of the role is transformation of the function, from operating model changes to a new technology infrastructure to reduce risk, create efficiency and improve service delivery. The role will be needed to drive the transformation whilst remaining focused on BAU so as to not compromise on service.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of State Street. As a leading provider of trading and lending solutions to the world’s institutional investors, we deliver the industry’s most innovative platforms, financing and portfolio solutions. Our capabilities are backed by proprietary, high-value research, insights and indicators that power clients’ investment decisions, accelerate performance and help investors stay ahead of shifting markets. Across our comprehensive set of solutions – data-driven macro market intelligence that give an information advantage; client-first platforms and tools that redefine trading; financing solutions that streamline liquidity access; and portfolio solutions designed to help achieve peak performance – we deliver a breakthrough edge to drive business success.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As an Officer you will
  
  

* Liaise with front office, compliance, finance, claims, and IT teams to support the full trade lifecycle.
* Responsible for Markets participation in programs such as ISO 20022, TD+1, and other bank wide initiatives.
* Provide Trade Support for Asset Management and Liability Management teams of Global Treasury
* Actively participate in the Peer Repo project and implementation
* Monitor exception reporting and provide necessary insight on resolution
* Monitor derivative and investment portfolio valuations and report on exceptions
* Investigate recon variances and provide root cause analysis
* Provide trade support and static data set up for Funding and Collateral Transformation team
* Monitor and perform collateral management functions in accordance with approved policies and procedures
* Oversee daily activities and help junior team members with subject matter expertise, trainings and understanding the core business operations
* Proposes and works to implement workflow changes, leading to improved productivity
* Work directly with the business and other Global Treasury stakeholders to provide information and/or operational solutions as needed
* Work proactively on updating job aids and procedures, making sure that team is adhering to the newly adopted processes
* Support the “Risk Excellence” culture within the business
* Work well with all GTO members and GT/GM stakeholders as demonstrated by being responsive to requests, striving for excellent client service
* Execute Funds & Securities Transfers for Repo/Reverse Repo activities.
* Perform or approve cash/GL processing.
* Take a leadership role in broader based projects as a subject matter expert.
* Responsible for KRI/Operating Metrics reporting and other overarching team related responsibilities.
* Focus on the control environment to drive a strong risk & control culture across the global teams to ensure processes are robust & compliant.
* Partner with Technology and partake in Markets Operations to deliver a best-in-class E2E workflow solution, removing manual touchpoints and increasing STP
* Support applicable Change the Bank and Run the Bank Projects impacting the team, from inception; providing SME support, testing and monitoring into Production.
* Ensure vendor oversight and hold them accountable to high standards of delivery. Stay abreast of all regulatory and market changes and ensure adherence and no impact to service standards as a result of these changes.
* Partner with ERM and compliance colleagues globally to ensure Markets Operations remains disciplined with respect to adherence to resiliency strategy, control assurance etc.
* Support audits and ensure adherence to operational risk and compliance policies.
* High level of personal commitment to each task, can-do attitude, and a drive to deliver.
* Proactive approach to problem solving, delivering results and finding better ways.

**What We Value**
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Strong risk mitigation, problem solving, and decision making skills
* Ability to think critically and resolve complex problems
* Drive automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency
* Stay updated on industry regulations and best practices related to FX Confirmation, Settlement operations.

**What You'll Bring To The Role**

* Front-to-back knowledge of the Treasury product related Confirmation, Settlement, systems, markets and instruments
* Hands-on experience in managing FICC, NSCC, Repo, reverse repo, DTC and FED settlements
* Working knowledge in Settlement/Payment department & understanding payment life cycle
* Familiarity with systems such as Markitwire, Summit, In-trader, MCH, Hogan , IBS, Bloomberg, FXALL, SWIFT

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Graduate and above preferably in Finance
* B.COM, BBM/BBA. MBA (Finance), M.COM or any degree related to Finance or Commerce
* Good knowledge in Back-office confirmations and settlement
* Knowledge of Global Markets, custody, cash management and payment systems
* Good Communication Skills both written and oral
* 10+ years of experience in Treasury/Investment operations/Financial Services industry

**Additional Requirements**

* Knowledge of Macros, Artificial intelligence, Automation tool etc
* Shift Timings: NAM - 6pm to 3am IST
* Persona: 4 days' work from office
* Location: Mumbai / Bangalore

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: R&D Operations and Communication Manager
description:
**At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!**
**As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.**
**At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.**
**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.**
**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**
**Your Role:**
R&D Operations and Communication Manager
  
  
**Location:**
Elanco IAC, Bangalore
  
  
**Reports to:**
R&D Site Lead
  
  
**Role Summary**
This role is a strategic partner and force multiplier to the R&D Site Lead & Lead Team, operating at the center of site leadership rather than in support of it.
  
  
This role is responsible for translating global & site strategy into tangible action, culture & communication at Elanco Innovation & Alliance Center (IAC).
  
  
This role is responsible for serving as the chief of operations and communications for the local site. The person in this role serves as a trusted extension of the R&D Lead Team, representing the office in forums where sound judgment, discretion, and credibility are essential.
  
  
The Site Operations role not only provides administrative and coordination support but also helps advance key site priorities through a focus on leadership effectiveness, strategic alignment, and organizational health advancing global initiatives and translating them at the ground level in consultation with the local R&D Lead Team.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities: -**
**Strategic Partnership & Site Leadership**

* Serve as strategic advisor and thought partner to the R&D Site Lead & Lead Team shaping how strategic initiatives translate into concrete site-level action
* Partner with the leadership team and enable the site's strategic planning and prioritization efforts by facilitating discussions, tracking key initiatives, and helping ensure leadership attention is directed toward critical priorities
* Facilitate stakeholder discussions and support business case development for strategic site capabilities, including opportunities to enhance IAC’s role as an AI hub within the R&D, partnering on the AI COP
* Build and sustain direct working partnerships with R&D executive and functional lead team members, acting as a trusted point of contact on their behalf for site-level priorities, cross-functional dependencies, and follow-through

**Executive Communications & Organizational Narrative**

* Provide support and enable successful delivery of flagship site events such as R&D Connect Week —from theme and content architecture through post-event communications to the larger audiences (internal & external)
* Facilitate and support senior leadership engagement initiatives including townhalls, and speaker preparation
* Provide communications support for the Site Lead by helping craft executive briefings, leader emails, and broader site communications that are impactful, engaging, and people-centric
* Build and protect a consistent communications narrative that ties site activity back to a central R&D theme across the year

**Organizational Health**

* Work closely with the HSE Lead and team, providing coordination and operational support while acting as an integral member of the team.
* Champion site culture enhancement ideas that include employee engagement initiatives, cross-functional team building activities, and serving as the R&D ERG Liaison in partnership with the EBS ERG Leadership.
* Lead organizational change management (OCM) on site, through major transitions, pairing structured process with communication that helps people make sense of what's changing and why
* Partner with R&D Lead Team to collate talent advancement and the STA (short-term assignment) pipeline for talent across the site

**Governance, Project & Team Leadership**

* Project manage operational initiatives to delivery representing the local R&D Lead Team and global functional leaders
* Schedule and facilitate R&D Lead Team meetings, floor initiatives and cross-functional governance forums, capture minutes, key decisions + action points
* Own the site's project portfolio dashboard and reporting cadence for leadership and global stakeholders
* Maintain oversight of site operations (logistics, visitor and delegate management, calendar and travel support for visiting leaders), ensuring consistent quality and timeliness
* Potentially own and execute site-based projects

**What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):**

* Minimum 10+ Years of relevant experience working in a global environment or supporting a global environment, specifically in animal/human health R&D

**What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):**

* Proven experience operating as a strategic partner to leaders in a global, matrixed organization
* Executive presence and the discretion to handle highly confidential, sensitive matters
* Exceptional written communication — able to write convincingly and authentically
* Track record of driving execution across functions without formal authority
* Comfort leading through ambiguity and building structure or governance where none previously existed

**Additional Information:**

* Based in Bangalore, India, at the IAC site, expected to complete 30 days/Quarter of in-office presence.
* Frequent partnership with global, cross-time-zone stakeholders across the US and Europe
* Proficiency across the MS Office suite; comfortable adopting AI and new-age content tools

title: Key Account Manager (Technical) | Facilities Management | Bangalore
description:
**Company Description**
**Colliers (NASDAQ, TSX: CIGI) is a global diversified professional services and investment management company operating through three industry-leading businesses: Commercial Real Estate, Engineering and Investment Management. With greater than a 30-year track record of consistent growth and strong recurring cash flows, we scale complementary, high-value businesses that provide essential services across the full asset lifecycle. Our unique partnership philosophy empowers exceptional leaders, preserves our entrepreneurial culture, and ensures meaningful insider ownership, driving strong alignment and sustained value creation for our shareholders. With $6 billion in annual revenues, 28,000 professionals, and $110 billion in assets under management, Colliers is committed to accelerating the success of our clients, investors, and people worldwide. Learn more at**
**corporate.colliers.com**
**.**
**Job Description**
We are looking for an experienced Key Account Manager – Technical to oversee technical facility management operations across multiple client sites. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring smooth operations, maintenance, compliance, client satisfaction, and financial performance across all assigned locations.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess strong technical knowledge of building management systems, HVAC, electrical systems, DG sets, UPS, plumbing, fire and life safety systems, and preventive maintenance. The candidate must have proven experience in managing multiple sites, leading technical teams, coordinating with clients, and ensuring adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Multi-Site Technical Operations
* Manage and oversee technical facility management operations across multiple client locations.
* Conduct regular site visits and technical audits to ensure operational efficiency and service quality.
* Monitor the performance of site engineers, facility managers, supervisors, and technical teams.
* Ensure uninterrupted operation of critical equipment and building infrastructure across all sites.
* Review site-level operational reports, maintenance schedules, breakdowns, and pending work orders.
* Implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and ensure consistent service delivery across locations.
* Technical Maintenance and Engineering
* Oversee preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance of HVAC systems, chillers, electrical panels, transformers, DG sets, UPS, pumps, plumbing, and building management systems (BMS).
* Monitor equipment performance and ensure timely resolution of technical breakdowns.
* Review maintenance plans, equipment logs, energy consumption, and asset registers.
* Coordinate with OEMs, contractors, and specialized service providers for major repairs and maintenance.
* Ensure proper maintenance of fire alarm systems, firefighting equipment, emergency lighting, and other life safety systems.
* Identify recurring technical issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Client Relationship and Account Management
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients across assigned sites.
* Conduct regular client review meetings and provide updates on operational performance.
* Understand client requirements and ensure timely resolution of complaints and escalations.
* Maintain strong client relationships and improve customer satisfaction.
* Review SLAs, KPIs, scope of work, and contractual obligations to ensure compliance.
* Identify opportunities for service improvement, account growth, and additional business.
* Team and Vendor Management
* Lead, mentor, and monitor site engineering teams across multiple locations.
* Ensure adequate technical manpower deployment, attendance, training, and productivity.
* Manage vendors, contractors, and service partners to ensure quality and timely delivery.
* Conduct performance reviews and provide technical guidance to site teams.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, safety procedures, and operational standards.
* Compliance, Safety and Risk Management
* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory requirements, electrical safety standards, fire and life safety requirements, and client-specific policies.
* Coordinate statutory inspections, equipment certifications, and compliance documentation.
* Conduct regular safety inspections and technical risk assessments.
* Monitor closure of audit observations and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions.
* Develop and review emergency response plans and business continuity procedures.
* Budgeting and Financial Management
* Prepare and monitor annual maintenance budgets and site-level operating expenses.
* Control maintenance costs, manpower expenses, utility consumption, and vendor costs.
* Review quotations, purchase requests, work orders, and vendor invoices.
* Monitor account profitability, cost optimization, and resource utilization.
* Identify energy-saving initiatives and opportunities to improve operational efficiency.
* Reporting and Performance Monitoring
* Prepare and submit monthly operational and technical performance reports.
* Track preventive maintenance compliance, equipment uptime, breakdowns, complaints, and closure timelines.
* Monitor site-wise KPIs, SLA performance, client feedback, and audit scores.
* Conduct periodic operational reviews and implement improvement plans.
* Escalate critical technical risks and operational issues to senior management.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Electrical, Mechanical, or relevant Engineering discipline.

Additional Information
  
  

* 10–15 years of experience in technical facility management or integrated facility management.
* Proven experience handling multiple client sites simultaneously.
* Strong technical knowledge of HVAC, electrical systems, DG sets, UPS, BMS, plumbing, pumps, and fire and life safety systems.
* Experience in managing site engineers, facility managers, vendors, and technical service teams.
* Strong client management, stakeholder coordination, and escalation-handling skills.
* Experience in budgeting, cost control, SLA/KPI monitoring, and operational reporting.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and facility management systems.
* Willingness to travel regularly across assigned sites.
* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
* Technical uptime and equipment reliability across all sites.
* Preventive maintenance completion and breakdown reduction.
* Client satisfaction and complaint closure turnaround time.
* SLA/KPI compliance and audit performance.
* Budget adherence and account profitability.
* Statutory and safety compliance.
* Vendor performance and manpower productivity.
* Timely submission of operational and financial reports.

title: Area Road Logistics Manager
description:
**It's more than a job**
As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.
  
  
‎
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Branch Manager – Road Logistics to lead our Hyderabad business, with end-to-end responsibility for operational performance, customer management, people leadership and P&L. This is a predominantly operations-focused leadership role (70% Operations / 30% Strategic), with a strong mandate to ensure operational excellence while driving sustainable and profitable business growth. The role will manage an established team and work closely with internal and external stakeholders to deliver seamless customer service, strengthen relationships and identify opportunities to expand the business.
  
  
**How you create impact**

* Own the overall P&L and business performance of the Hyderabad branch.
* Lead day-to-day trucking and transportation operations, ensuring service quality, operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
* Manage vendor and transportation partners to ensure consistent service delivery and operational performance.
* Own key customer relationships, proactively managing feedback, service issues and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Lead and develop the branch team, ensuring clear objectives, accountability and strong engagement.
* Drive commercial performance by identifying opportunities for business growth, customer acquisition and expansion.
* Work closely with the national organization and key stakeholders to deliver agreed financial, operational and strategic objectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, implement best practices and strengthen operational excellence.
* Support commercial activities including business opportunities, solution development, pricing and customer proposals.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across customers, vendors and internal stakeholders.

* 10+ years of relevant experience in Road Transportation / Contract Logistics.
* Strong and proven experience in Trucking / Road Transportation Operations Management.
* Prior experience managing teams and leading people.
* Strong understanding of P&L management, commercial performance and business growth.
* Ability to balance operational execution with a broader strategic and commercial perspective.
* Strong customer and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Experience managing vendors, transportation partners and service delivery.
* Proven ability to drive operational excellence while maintaining customer satisfaction and profitability.

**What's in it for you**
At Kuehne+Nagel, you’ll be part of a global logistics leader that believes in creating real impact—on business, on customers, and on careers. Here’s what you can look forward to:
  
  

* Global Exposure: Step into a world of international opportunities with a presence in 100+ countries.
* People-Centric Culture: Join a team where your voice matters and people genuinely care.
* Learning & Development: Grow with us—personally and professionally—through world-class training and career pathways.
* Innovation & Sustainability: Be part of a future-focused company driving real change in logistics and the planet.
* Rewards & Recognition: Get rewarded for your passion, performance, and potential.
* Stability with Agility: Enjoy the best of both worlds—a trusted global brand with a startup spirit.

**Who we are**
Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
  
  
As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

title: Cluster Head- Last Mile
description:
**About The Team**
Being part of Meesho's Fulfilment and Experience (F&E) team as Cluster Head LM,
  
  
will zip you to the cockpit of our ever-burgeoning rocketship, where you get to
  
  
directly shape the experience of the country's next billion e-commerce users.

running operations/support, supply chain know-how, analytics and the holy grail,

* Own and drive critical operational metrics end to end and achieve performance
* targets

**About Us**
Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.
  
  
**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**

Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.
  
  
We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.
  
  
Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.
  
  
****Culture and Total Rewards****
Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.
  
  
Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.
  
  
We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness-related perks.
  
  
To support work-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.
  
  
At Meesho, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where every individual can thrive. In compliance with the
**Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016**
, we uphold the following principles:
  
  

* Equal Opportunity: We ensure that employment opportunities are never denied on the grounds of disability if the candidate is otherwise competent to perform the job.
* Accessible Workplace: Our facilities are designed to be fully accessible, with amenities and assistive devices provided to support differently abled individuals in their work.
* Inclusive Hiring Process: We adopt a transparent and non-discriminatory selection process, including providing application forms in alternate formats and offering reasonable accommodations during interviews upon request.
* Career Growth: We provide adequate training post-recruitment and pre-promotion, with training materials available in accessible formats to enable equal career progression.
* Support & Confidentiality: A dedicated liaison officer/committee addresses concerns and grievances, while maintaining strict confidentiality of disability-related information.
* Awareness & Inclusion: We conduct awareness programs to promote a culture of inclusivity across the organization.

Meesho welcomes applicants and employees of all abilities and is dedicated to fostering an environment where differently abled persons can achieve their full potential.

title: Lab Manager - Hardware Engineering
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we are tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing — an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that understand the world. Doing what has never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent.
  
  
NVIDIA’s Silicon Co-Design Group is the team that gets every GPU, SoC, and CPU silicon program from first power-on to high-volume production. We are hiring a Lab Manager to own hardware engineering lab operations across our Bangalore, Hyderabad and Pune Design Center.Your labs are where silicon meets reality — where every bring-up, validation experiment, and rework cycle happens, and where a day lost hits the program directly. You own the section: multiple labs, varied product classes, and a team of rework, reflow, and logistics technicians delivering daily for engineering. Your decisions show up in lab uptime, bring-up readiness, capital plan accuracy, and audit outcomes on safety and physical IP. You are the leader the program turns to when a new product class needs a lab spun up fast, when an EHS or security gap surfaces, or when capacity for the next roadmap year hasn’t been planned.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Own and Run multiple labs across varied product classes — silicon bring-up, validation, and engineering experiments. Lead rework, reflow, and logistics technicians (including outsourced workers); develop them to self-manage opex procurement, planning, and day-to-day execution.
* Plan ahead of the roadmap. Forecast long-term lab needs — space, power, cooling, thermal, reflow capability, equipment — and own the capital and expense plan that supports it. Drive growth, reconfiguration, and ramp-down as programs evolve.
* Engage Bring-up early. Partner with Bring-up managers to scope incoming silicon programs — requirements, procurement, budget, staffing — so infrastructure and personnel land ahead of priority milestones, on cost.
* Hold the safety and security bar. Drive lab EHS compliance and security control. Be the recognized safety champion and physical IP asset expert — set guidelines, run reviews, operate with audit-ready discipline.
* Run equipment cradle-to-grave. Own capital and expense planning, purchasing, warranty, calibration, and inventory — shipment, import, EC components, bonding — with a clear, auditable process across all labs.
* Standardize across sites. Coordinate with global lab managers to learn and propagate best practices and standardize lab operations where it adds leverage.
* Role may involve travel across our Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Pune Design Centers

**What We Need To See**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience), with overall 8+ years of experience in silicon/HW lab setup, management, and maintenance.
* At least 3+ years managing a technical lab environment and leading teams across sites, with a track record of owning a multi-lab section — including capital and expense equipment planning, vendor and outsourced-worker management, and inventory/logistics tracking.
* Hands-on experience operating lab equipment (oscilloscope, DAQ, and other common equipment) and consumer hardware assembly/teardown, solder/rework — with familiarity in HW bring-ups, computer systems, and debugging.
* Experience working with multi-functional teams — SW, validation, ASIC, and other hardware/software functions — with excellent communication abilities across sites.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience with CPU/SOC chip bring-up and validation process.
* Multi-site or global lab coordination experience — shared standards, vendor frameworks, or capacity planning across regions.
* Comfortable using AI productivity tools (Claude, Copilot, or equivalent) to compress reporting, analysis, and operational workflows — with judgment about where AI helps and where it doesn’t.

title: Production Planning & Control (PPC) Manager
description:

People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG. In Mobility, we help our customers meet the need for hard-working mobility solutions. We’re making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!
  
  
**We are looking for Production Planning & Control (PPC) Manager**
The Production Planning & Control (PPC) Manager is responsible for planning, scheduling, coordinating, and controlling manufacturing activities to ensure timely delivery of products while optimizing resources, inventory, capacity utilization, and production efficiency. The role involves close coordination with Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, Stores, and Production teams to achieve customer delivery commitments and business objectives for railway signaling and automation products.
  
  
**You’ll make a difference by**
**Production Planning & Scheduling**

* Develop and maintain master production schedules based on customer demand, project requirements, and capacity constraints.
* Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly production plans.
* Monitor production progress and ensure adherence to planned schedules.
* Balance production loads across work centers to maximize productivity.
* Ensure on-time delivery of products in line with customer and project commitments.

**Material Planning & Inventory Control**

* Coordinate with Procurement and Stores teams to ensure material availability for production.
* Monitor inventory levels and optimize stock without affecting production continuity.
* Identify material shortages, excess inventory, and slow-moving materials.
* Drive inventory reduction initiatives while maintaining service levels.
* Review material requirements through SAP, ERP/MRP systems.

**Production Control**

* Track Work Orders (WO) and Production Orders from release to completion.
* Monitor production performance against plan and take corrective actions where necessary.
* Control WIP (Work-in-Progress) inventory to improve production flow.
* Ensure production bottlenecks are identified and mitigated proactively.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Collaborate with Engineering, Quality, Procurement, Project Management, and Manufacturing
* teams.
* Coordinate changes in production priorities based on customer requirements.
* Support New Product Introduction (NPI) and engineering change implementation.
* Facilitate communication between departments to ensure seamless execution of production
* plans.

**Capacity, Resource Planning & Quality**

* Analyze manpower, machine capacity, and infrastructure utilization.
* Forecast future capacity requirements based on business demand.
* Recommend actions to address capacity constraints.
* Optimize resource allocation to meet production targets.
* Maintain planning and production records in accordance with company procedures.
* Ensure compliance with Siemens processes, quality standards (ISO & IRIS), and EHS requirements.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and process improvement initiatives.
* Improve planning accuracy and production efficiency.
* Lead productivity improvement and cost reduction projects.
* Support digitalization and ERP enhancement initiatives, AI implémentations etc.

**Technical Skills**

* Production Planning & Scheduling
* Material Requirement Planning (MRP)
* SAP / ERP Systems
* Capacity Planning
* Inventory Management
* Demand Forecasting
* Supply Chain Coordination
* Lean Manufacturing
* Root Cause Analysis
* Production KPI Management
* Microsoft Excel and Power BI

**Performance Monitoring & Reporting**

* Prepare and present production KPI reports to management.


+ On-Time Delivery (OTD)
+ Production Adherence
+ Inventory Turnover
+ Capacity Utilization
+ WIP Levels
+ Schedule Compliance
+ Production Efficiency

* Conduct root cause analysis for schedule deviations and delivery delays.

**Desired Skills**

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
* Production Control.
* Minimum 3 years in a managerial role.
* Experience in Railway Signalling, Electronics Manufacturing, Industrial Automation, or related industries preferred.
* Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP.

**Join us and be yourself!**
We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

In return, you'll get the chance to work with teams impacting - and the shape of things to come. We're Siemens. title: AVP-Technology. Technology Operations
description:
We are 24 x 7 technology service management operation unit of the Bank. We are focused on Service availability and ensure uninterrupted Technology Services to our Staffs and Customers through ITIL process governance, leading service improvements and driving automation with an aim to provide world class customer and employee experience.
  
We support several business groups and operation units with varied applications usage patterns that are built on multiple technology stacks. These services/applications are created via traditional, scrum and agile development methodologies, hosted and managed on private, public & hybrid cloud and on-prem data centers across our operational geographies in US, Europe, Middle East & Asia region.
  
As a Senior Manager in Service Management, in our fast-paced leadership team, you will be responsible for managing Incident and Problem ITIL processes. Take actions to identify opportunities to improve process controls and simplify process. You will track the technology incidents across the organization and drive reduction in incident counts by adopting reactive and proactive approaches. You will ensure right severity classification of incidents, appropriate comms to technology and business stakeholders and will drive the faster resolution of the incidents. You will work with CXCG- Customer Experience, Command center and Service desk to identify the customers’ and employees’ issues proactively and drive improvements.
  
You will define process KPIs and develop MIS dashboards working with MIS team and will drive thematic service improvements based on the KPIs trends. You will drive effective problem management practices to address root cause and contributory causes of the incidents.
  
As a leader, coach, and mentor, you will provide your team with the objectives of department’s goals aligned to company’s strategic direction. You will also be providing necessary support to your team in achieving the targets and meeting their learning & development needs. This critical leadership role will directly report to Head of Incident Management
  
Key result Areas- Incident Management: Effective management of 24X7 incident management. Continuous improvement of process controls and comms protocols of Incident
  
Management, including Technology and Business updates. Take complete ownership of the Incidents from Start to End in recording, prioritizing, categorizing, Communicating, escalating, and driving the incident towards resolution. Take complete charge of the Major incident call and manage it skillfully. Take actions to proactively identify issues working with Command Center including the improvement of the monitoring. Improve Customer and Employee experience by proactively detecting service issues through CRM dashboards and Service tickets analysis, take prompt actions with relevant teams.
  
- Stakeholders Engagement / Management: Educate the Incident process and Problem Management to stakeholders. Establish feedback system to gather opportunities for improvement.
  
- Risks, Audit and Control Compliance: Process Risks are proactively managed without any delays. Any observations of Internal and External audit to be addressed within the stipulated time.
  
- Service Reporting: Define KPIs and work with MIS team to produce interactive
  
dashboards and presentations for different stakeholders including senior executives. Drive improvements based on KPIs.
  
- Team Management: Provide team clarity about their deliverables, identify their
  
development needs, and do regular check-ins. Ensure compliance of mandatory
  
learning and annual leave.
  
- Coordinating and prioritizing work as per the business criticality and completing
  
assigned tasks within the timelines.
  
- Perform analysis to proactively identify the issues and take necessary actions to fix it.
  
- Identify the Gaps, prepare Service Improvement plans with measurable outcomes and work with SMEs to close it and to improve the overall experience.
  
- Identify the areas of redundant manual effort and work towards automating it. Support the team’s objectives and prepare periodical management reports
  
Knowledge, Skills and Experience- The incumbent should be self-driven with 12+ experience in service management designing, defining, and driving ITIL processes, preferably from Banking Industry.
  
- Understanding relevant industry standards and practices is desirable.
  
- Significant experience in leading support for large, complex, multi-functional environments.
  
- Prior meaningful technology and business/industry work experience including experience in Incident and Problem management. Experience in driving service improvements based on incident trends and themes.
  
- Knowledge & experience in Proactive incident management will be desirable.
  
- Demonstrable experience attracting, hiring, retaining, and leading top process and engineering talent.

* Strong understanding of operational controls, compliance, and risk management.

title: Manager Program Management VCA X, Visa Consulting & Analytics
description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Visa is a world leader in payments and technology, with over 259 billion payments transactions flowing safely between consumers, merchants, financial institutions, and government entities in more than 200 countries and territories each year. Our mission is to connect the world through the most innovative, convenient, reliable, and secure payments network, enabling individuals, businesses, and economies to thrive while driven by a common purpose – to uplift everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
Make an impact with a purpose-driven industry leader. Join us today and experience Life at Visa.
  
  
**Team Summary**
Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. VCA's core client segments include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.
  
  
VCA-X is VCA's global delivery capability, designed to scale high-value solutions across Regions through multidisciplinary teams, common delivery standards, AI-enabled assets, and continuous learning from delivery. Working in partnership with Regional teams and Practice Areas, VCA-X enables consistent, efficient, and scalable delivery while maintaining client and market relevance.
  
  
Program Management is a core pillar of the VCA-X operating model. It provides the integrated planning, orchestration, and delivery management required to scale delivery across multiple use cases, teams, and geographies.
  
  
The role operates as one of three core delivery leadership pillars within VCA-X, alongside Specialist & Consulting Delivery and Data & Analytics Delivery. It will form part of the VCA-X Leadership Team, and report directly to the Head of VCA-X.
  
  
**What a Manager, Program Management, VCA-X Does At Visa**
The Manager will coordinate the day-to-day operating processes that turn VCA-X priorities into disciplined execution, timely decisions, and consistent delivery across markets. The role will maintain plans and metrics, run governance cadences, administer demand intake, support quality and compliance controls, track automation and efficiency initiatives, and provide executive-assistant and administrative support to VCA-X leadership.
  
  
**Planning, Metrics & Execution Tracking**

* Support strategy and annual planning by translating priorities into detailed plans, milestones, owners, dependencies, and timelines.
* Maintain scorecards and dashboards; track performance against agreed metrics and follow up on variances and actions.
* Produce accurate operating updates and decision-ready materials for management reviews.

**Governance, Quality & Compliance**

* Set up and run governance meetings and operating cadences, including agendas, pre-reads, minutes, action logs, and escalation tracking.
* Implement quality frameworks, checklists, review gates, documentation standards, and delivery controls.
* Monitor adherence to relevant policies and processes, maintain evidence, and coordinate remediation of identified gaps.

**Demand Intake & Delivery Coordination**

* Administer the demand intake pipeline, validate required information, coordinate assessments, and maintain status visibility.
* Support prioritization, resource planning, mobilization, and handoffs across multidisciplinary teams.
* Track delivery health, risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions; escalate blockers and drive actions to closure.

**Market & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate with Regional and market leaders to progress the VCA-X agenda, confirm demand, and align on next steps and commitments.
* Maintain stakeholder communications, action trackers, and decision records across a highly matrixed global environment.
* Support issue resolution by bringing together the right stakeholders and ensuring timely follow-through.

**Executive & Administrative Support**

* Provide executive-assistant support to VCA-X leadership, like calendar management, meeting scheduling, travel coordination, expense administration, coordination for site level initiatives, etc.
* Coordinate leadership meetings and events, prepare agendas and materials, manage logistics, and ensure actions and follow-ups are completed.
* Handle sensitive information with discretion and serve as a reliable coordination point for internal and external stakeholders.

**Automation & Efficiency Delivery**

* Maintain the pipeline of automation and process-improvement opportunities and coordinate prioritization and implementation.
* Track baseline performance, adoption, benefits, and delivery against agreed efficiency targets.
* Document and standardize improved processes, tools, templates, and ways of working.

**Why this is important to Visa**
VCA-X depends on strong operating discipline to manage demand, coordinate delivery, maintain quality, and scale consistently. This role provides the execution backbone and management information needed to keep priorities moving and commitments on track.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Operations Research, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 7+ years of experience in program management, business operations, PMO, consulting operations, transformation, or professional-services delivery.
* Hands-on experience managing plans, milestones, scorecards, governance routines, risks, issues, and action tracking.
* Experience supporting demand intake, portfolio reporting, quality controls, compliance processes, and cross-functional delivery.
* Strong organization, analytical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively across functions and geographies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in shared services, centers of excellence, consulting, managed services, or global delivery operations.
* Exposure to automation, AI-enabled workflows, process improvement, or operational-efficiency programs.
* Knowledge of payments, financial services, or adjacent industries.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Operations Manager
description:

Moto365 is a next-generation automotive technology company building a seamless ecosystem of vehicle care, intelligent diagnostics, and connected services. We combine AI-powered inspection systems, smart workshop platforms, and predictive maintenance tools with real-world automotive expertise — transforming how modern drivers maintain and experience their vehicles.

title: Operations Manager
description:

This role is responsible for driving operational excellence across supply chain, procurement, warehousing, inventory management, order fulfillment, logistics, customer experience, and process automation.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in scaling D2C ecommerce operations, building efficient processes, managing cross-functional teams, and delivering exceptional customer experiences while optimizing operational costs. The role requires close collaboration with the founders and leadership team to support rapid business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operations & Supply Chain**

* Lead end-to-end D2C operations from procurement to customer delivery.
* Develop and implement scalable operational processes and SOPs.
* Ensure seamless inventory planning, replenishment, and stock availability.
* Drive demand forecasting to minimize stock-outs and excess inventory.
* Optimize warehouse operations for accuracy, efficiency, and productivity.
* Manage relationships with manufacturers, suppliers, and procurement partners.

**Order Fulfillment & Logistics**

* Oversee order processing, fulfillment, dispatch, and reverse logistics.
* Manage third-party logistics (3PL) partners and courier aggregators.
* Improve delivery timelines, reduce RTO (Return to Origin), and enhance fulfillment accuracy.
* Monitor logistics performance and negotiate cost-effective shipping solutions.
* Ensure SLA compliance across all fulfillment partners.

**Inventory & Warehouse Management**

* Maintain high inventory accuracy through regular audits and reconciliation.
* Monitor inventory aging, stock health, and inventory turnover.
* Improve warehouse productivity and optimize storage utilization.
* Implement warehouse best practices and inventory control systems.

**Ecommerce Operations**

* Oversee operational workflows across Shopify, marketplaces, and D2C channels.
* Ensure seamless coordination between Operations, Marketing, Customer Support, Finance, and Technology teams.
* Support new product launches and promotional campaigns from an operational standpoint.
* Monitor order flow during high-volume sales and campaign periods.

**Process Excellence & Automation**

* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement scalable solutions.
* Introduce automation tools to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
* Establish SOPs, KPIs, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across all operational functions.

**Financial & Cost Management**

* Own operational budgets and cost optimization initiatives.
* Monitor fulfillment costs, warehousing expenses, and logistics spend.
* Improve operational efficiency while maintaining customer satisfaction.
* Support business planning through operational forecasting and MIS reporting.

**Team Leadership**

* Build, mentor, and lead high-performing operations teams.
* Define KRAs, KPIs, and performance management systems.
* Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with senior leadership on strategic operational initiatives.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Order Fulfillment SLA
* Order Accuracy
* Inventory Accuracy
* Inventory Turnover
* Warehouse Productivity
* Dispatch TAT
* On-Time Delivery Rate
* Logistics Cost per Order
* RTO Percentage
* Customer Complaint Resolution Time
* Operational Cost Reduction
* Vendor Performance
* Process Automation Initiatives

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field.
* MBA is preferred.
* 8–10 years of experience in D2C Ecommerce, Retail, FMCG, Health & Wellness, or Consumer Brands.
* Proven experience leading large-scale ecommerce operations.
* Strong understanding of supply chain management, warehouse operations, inventory planning, and logistics.
* Experience managing 3PL partners, courier aggregators, and fulfillment centers.
* Hands-on experience with Shopify, OMS, WMS, ERP systems, and inventory management platforms.
* Strong analytical skills with advanced proficiency in Excel and operational reporting.
* Demonstrated experience in process improvement and operational automation.

title: Platform Solutions – Payments Operations–Vice President–Hyderabad
description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Platform Solutions, a division of Goldman Sachs, is seeking a
**Vice President**
to lead and scale our
**Payments Operations**
team in India. The Payments team is critical to safeguarding customer trust and platform integrity by governing money movement, managing complex payment remediation, and maintaining operational control across lending and credit card products.
  
  
As a Vice President, you will provide strategic direction, operational leadership, and end-to-end governance for regional and global payment functions. You will oversee the remediation of payment exceptions, drive automation and workflow modernization, and manage risk and control frameworks across multiple payment rails. In this role, you will act as a senior regional leader partnering closely with global counterparts across Engineering, Treasury, Legal, Compliance, Product Controllers, and Credit Delivery Solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and inspire a multi-tiered operations organization (including managers, associates, and analysts), establishing clear OKRs, performance benchmarks, and succession plans.
* Champion an inclusive, high-performance, and motivating team culture focused on continuous development and operational excellence.
* Represent India Payments Operations in global governance meetings, steering committees, and business reviews.

**Payment Operations & Financial Control Governance**

* Drive end-to-end operational oversight of critical payment rails, including ACH, Fedwire, Wires, Check/Lockbox, and Bill Pay, supporting consumer lending and credit card product lifecycles.
* Own the books and records integrity by establishing stringent reconciliation frameworks; govern suspense account risks, investigate systemic breaks, and enforce strict ledger-posting standards.
* Ensure strict adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs), managing critical daily settlement and cutoff deadlines with 100% operational resilience.

**Risk, Controls & Regulatory Oversight**

* Ensure operations strictly comply with US consumer banking regulations and frameworks, including Reg Z, Reg O, Reg V, Reg E, TILA, ECOA, and CFPB guidelines.
* Design, enhance, and maintain a proactive Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) framework, anticipating failure points and preventing control breakdowns.
* Lead audit preparedness and regulatory examinations; drive comprehensive root-cause analysis and remediation for audit findings and operational losses.

**Operational Transformation & Metrics**

* Drive strategic automation, digitalization, and process optimization initiatives using modern analytics tools to eliminate manual casework and enable scalable volume growth.
* Define, track, and synthesize key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) into actionable executive dashboards for senior business leadership.
* Act as the final regional escalation point for high-severity payment breaks, customer remediation casework, and complex money movement inquiries.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience: 10+ years of progressive operations experience within banking, financial services, or fintech environments.
* Leadership: Minimum 6+ years of direct people management experience, with proven capability in leading teams of managers and specialists.
* Domain Knowledge: In-depth technical and operational expertise in US payment systems (ACH/NACHA, Wires/Fedwire, Bill Pay, Checks) and credit/lending operational lifecycles.
* Regulatory Acumen: Strong working knowledge of US consumer lending regulations (e.g., Reg Z, Reg E, TILA, ECOA, CFPB).
* Stakeholder Management: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated experience influencing executive leadership globally.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree (Master’s, MBA, CA, or equivalent).
* Professional industry certifications (e.g., AAP – Accredited ACH Professional, APRP – Accredited Payments Risk Professional, or CRCM).
* Hands-on experience leading large-scale business transformation, workflow redesign, or low-code automation initiatives (e.g., SQL, Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI).
* Proven expertise managing complex general ledger (GL) reconciliations, suspense account monitoring, and accounting break resolution.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguous, high-pressure situations while sustaining high operational control and regulatory compliance.

**About Goldman Sachs**
At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
  
  
We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs.
  
  
Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.

description:

**Vulnerability Management Lead**
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced
**Vulnerability Management Lead**
with
**6–10 years of cybersecurity experience**
to lead enterprise-wide vulnerability management operations. * Lead weekly and monthly vulnerability review meetings with internal stakeholders and US-based customers.
* Mentor Vulnerability Management Engineers and review technical assessments, remediation recommendations, and reporting.
* Ensure alignment with security frameworks such as NIST, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, and PCI-DSS.

**Job Requirements**

* Experience in executive reporting, stakeholder management, and customer-facing engagements.
* Exposure to TruOps, Cyberfusion, Okta, CyberArk, CrowdStrike, and SentinelOne is highly preferred.
* Experience supporting US-based customers and working during US business hours is preferred.

**Tools & Technologies**

* Vulnerability Management: Tenable, Rapid7/InsightVM
* Patch Management: Tanium, Automox
* Risk & GRC: TruOps, Cyberfusion
* IAM/PAM: Okta, CyberArk
* Endpoint Security: CrowdStrike, SentinelOne

* Preferred certifications include CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+, CySA+, CEH, GSEC, Tenable, Rapid7, ITIL Foundation, or equivalent industry certifications.

title: Breakdown & Repair Maintenance
description:
**About the Role:**

Breakdown, Repair & maintenance is to ensure that equipment and machinery in a Café set up are maintained and repaired efficiently when they break down or experience unexpected failures. The role involves a combination of technical, managerial, and organizational tasks. Here are the key responsibilities.

**Roles and Responsibility:**

* Break down maintenance: Responsible for 450 cafes and 200 CCD outlets across the country .
* Repair & maintenance: Responsible for 450 cafes and 200 CCD outlets across the country .
* Supervision: Building program of all heating and A/C and Refrigeration based on daily schedules
* Equipment Inspection and Assessment: Conduct regular inspections of supplies, tools, machinery and equipment to identify potential issues.
* Emergency Response: Quickly respond to breakdowns or unexpected equipment failures, ensuring that downtime is minimized to maintain
* Diagnosis: Identify the root causes of equipment failures and breakdowns by working with maintenance teams and using diagnostic tools.
* Coordination: Coordinate with maintenance technicians, mechanics, and engineers to ensure prompt repair and maintenance activities
* Resource Allocation: Allocate resources, such as personnel, tools, and spare parts, to address breakdowns efficiently.
* Scheduling: Develop and maintain a maintenance schedule to prevent future breakdowns by conducting routine maintenance activities and predictive maintenance.
* Cost Management: Monitor and manage the budget allocated for breakdown maintenance, making sure it is used effectively and efficiently.
* Vendor Management: Work with external vendors and suppliers to source replacement parts and services as needed for repairs.
* Documentation: Maintain detailed records of equipment breakdowns, repairs, and maintenance activities for future reference and analysis.
* Reporting: Provide regular reports to higher management on breakdown statistics, downtime, and measures taken to address them.
* Safety Compliance: Ensure that all maintenance activities comply with safety regulations and standards to protect the well-being of maintenance staff and other employees.
* Training: Develop and implement training programs for maintenance personnel to enhance their skills in diagnosing and repairing equipment.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process and equipment improvement to reduce the frequency of breakdowns.
* Inventory Management: Oversee the inventory of spare parts and supplies required for breakdown maintenance to ensure an adequate supply.
* Root Cause Analysis: Conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurring breakdowns by addressing underlying issues.
* Quality Control: Ensure that equipment repairs and maintenance are done to high standards to prevent frequent breakdowns and maximize equipment lifespan.
* Collaboration: Work closely with other departments, such as production and engineering, to understand their needs and coordinate maintenance activities accordingly.
* Overall, the breakdown maintenance manager plays a crucial role in minimizing equipment downtime, ensuring the reliability and efficiency of production processes, and reducing maintenance-related costs QSR (Quick Service restaurant) environment.

**Experience & Qualification:**

1. Any bachelor's degree (mechanical, electrical, industrial, etc.) is preferable.
2. 4 to 6 years Overall 2+ Years - experience in Retail chains.
3. Good Arithmetical & Reasoning Ability
4. Effective communication skills to convey technical information to team members, other departments, and stakeholders.
5. Clear communication during breakdown situations to coordinate activities and provide updates.
6. Extensive Experience in A/C and Refrigeration for Repair and maintenance of equipment in Cafés
7. Capability to assess the technical skills of the maintenance team.
8. Knowledge In Troubleshoot
9. Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) for tracking and managing maintenance activities.
10. Ability to leverage technology for planning, scheduling, and analyzing breakdown maintenance data.

**Language Fluency: English, and local language. Open to travel**

title: Asset Manager - Fund Accounting - Team Lead
description:
****Job Description****
The main function of the role is: Work in conjunction with individuals on the team as well as other Shared Services/COEs, outsource partners, Client Operations, other business units as needed to ensure seamless processing according to the fund’s policies, to ensure NAV/yield accuracy and that all SLAs are met.
  
  
**Shifts: North America (Night Shifts)**
****What You Will Be Responsible For:****
As Senior Associate you will:
  
  

* Manage the day-to-day activities of a functional/oversight team by monitoring, reviewing and validating all daily activity to ensure accuracy and timeliness in calculations and processing, as well as adherence to controls, e.g. ensuring accurate g/l and/or balance for daily pricing
* Provide timely accurate management reporting and issue log maintenance, under moderate supervision
* Research and resolve exceptions and issues
* Escalate unresolved issues to management as required
* Reconcile and resolve discrepancies with other Shared Service teams, external clients and Client Operations as needed
* Ensure all inquiries are resolved in a timely and accurate manner and communicates effectively with client when necessary
* Ensure appropriate records of daily and monthly activities are kept
* Coordinate effective and timely flow of critical information to all relevant parties and follows up on administrative details within the department
* Oversee the adherence to Standard Operating Procedures
* Maintain knowledge of current alternative procedures and processes
* Assist with workflow management and technology enhancement, make suggestions to streamline operations
* Document any updates or changes to formal procedures, databases, etc.
* Participate in projects as well as prepare and verify information for those various projects/special requests as directed
* Train, develop and motivate new staff and complete performance appraisals
* Provide staffing recommendations by interviewing new personnel
* Coordinate and supervise work efforts when multiple Associates are needed to complete work
* Provide coaching and development opportunities to staff, participate in individual on-going training and development
* Has accountability and responsibility for completing and delivering PPRs on time
* Make effective recommendations to hire, discipline, control work and terminate employment
* Make effective recommendations for promotions, salary increases and bonuses.
* During the course of normal day to day operations, responsible for identifying any unusual or potentially suspicious transaction activity and must report and/or escalate in accordance with corporate policy and guidelines detailed in relevant operating procedures.
* Perform duties of Associates if required, perform other duties as assigned.

****What We Value:****
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  
****Competencies:****

* Client focus: – Act as a focal point of contact to maintain strong client relationship; actively participate in internal and client meetings. Respond to client queries.
* Leadership Focus – Leverage experience and technical expertise to support peers globally by providing guidance and training, and fully support and participate in all aspects of employee engagement.
* Operational Efficiency Focus: Actively participate in an efficient and effective global operating model, collaborating with peers globally, and using standard technology, best practices, and optimal functions.
* Performance Focus: Provide excellent service to clients through a results-oriented mindset
* Quality & Risk Focus: Understand and minimize risk through adhering to standard and client specific operating procedures and through broad participation in the global training program. Focus on qualitative work, attention to detail with a thorough understanding of business impact and ways to minimize risk

****Mandatory Skill Sets:****

* Good understanding of financial services and investment products
* Excellent Communication Skills
* Problem Solving & Analytical Skills
* Ability to work on MS Office (Excel, Word and PPT)

****Additional Skill Sets:****

* Good understanding of financial services and investment products.
* Strong attention to detail and a focus on service.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities to meet internal and industry deadlines.
* Ability to perform under pressure and manage high volumes.
* Committed to learn technical aspects of each deliverable.
* Ability to communicate with various internal teams to resolve queries and escalate accordingly.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, organizational, and time management skills.
* Demonstrates an ability to be a leader within their team, as well as be a leader amongst your peers.

****Education & Preferred Qualifications:****

* Graduate degree in Business, Accounting, Finance or equivalent experience preferred
* 6+ years of experience in related accounting or finance field preferred
* Should be comfortable working in North America Shifts

****About State Street****
What we do. State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.
  
  
**Work, Live and Grow.**
We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary in locations, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Program to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. title: Platform Solutions – Payments Operations–Vice President–Hyderabad
description:
**Job Summary**

Platform Solutions, a division of Goldman Sachs, is seeking a **Vice President** to lead and scale our **Payments Operations** team in India. The Payments team is critical to safeguarding customer trust and platform integrity by governing money movement, managing complex payment remediation, and maintaining operational control across lending and credit card products.

As a Vice President, you will provide strategic direction, operational leadership, and end-to-end governance for regional and global payment functions. You will oversee the remediation of payment exceptions, drive automation and workflow modernization, and manage risk and control frameworks across multiple payment rails. In this role, you will act as a senior regional leader partnering closely with global counterparts across Engineering, Treasury, Legal, Compliance, Product Controllers, and Credit Delivery Solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and inspire a multi-tiered operations organization (including managers, associates, and analysts), establishing clear OKRs, performance benchmarks, and succession plans.
* Champion an inclusive, high-performance, and motivating team culture focused on continuous development and operational excellence.
* Represent India Payments Operations in global governance meetings, steering committees, and business reviews.
  

**Payment Operations & Financial Control Governance**

* Drive end-to-end operational oversight of critical payment rails, including ACH, Fedwire, Wires, Check/Lockbox, and Bill Pay, supporting consumer lending and credit card product lifecycles.
* Own the books and records integrity by establishing stringent reconciliation frameworks; govern suspense account risks, investigate systemic breaks, and enforce strict ledger-posting standards.
* Ensure strict adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs), managing critical daily settlement and cutoff deadlines with 100% operational resilience.
  

**Risk, Controls & Regulatory Oversight**

* Ensure operations strictly comply with US consumer banking regulations and frameworks, including **Reg Z, Reg O, Reg V, Reg E, TILA, ECOA, and CFPB guidelines**.
* Design, enhance, and maintain a proactive Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) framework, anticipating failure points and preventing control breakdowns.
* Lead audit preparedness and regulatory examinations; drive comprehensive root-cause analysis and remediation for audit findings and operational losses.
  

**Operational Transformation & Metrics**

* Drive strategic automation, digitalization, and process optimization initiatives using modern analytics tools to eliminate manual casework and enable scalable volume growth.
* Define, track, and synthesize key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) into actionable executive dashboards for senior business leadership.
* Act as the final regional escalation point for high-severity payment breaks, customer remediation casework, and complex money movement inquiries.
  

**Basic Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* **Experience:** 10+ years of progressive operations experience within banking, financial services, or fintech environments.
* **Leadership:** Minimum 6+ years of direct people management experience, with proven capability in leading teams of managers and specialists.
* **Domain Knowledge:** In-depth technical and operational expertise in US payment systems (ACH/NACHA, Wires/Fedwire, Bill Pay, Checks) and credit/lending operational lifecycles.
* **Regulatory Acumen:** Strong working knowledge of US consumer lending regulations (e.g., Reg Z, Reg E, TILA, ECOA, CFPB).
* **Stakeholder Management:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated experience influencing executive leadership globally.
