title: OTT Event Operations Manager
description:
*For this role you must be able to work on-site in the Mumbai office in Andheri.*

This role sits within Deltatre's Live Operations function, supporting live OTT operations for global sports and entertainment events. The team operates 24/7 and is responsible for the operational reliability of video streaming during live production windows — across event scheduling, real-time supervision, and 2nd Level technical support.

Reporting to the Head of Live Operations and partnering closely with Project Managers and Service Managers, the Event Manager leads the local team of Staff Operators (LiveOps and Supervisors) and supervises Live Production operations directly when appropriate. The role combines event management and client coordination with the management of a 24/7 operational team — a multi-disciplinary operational remit.

**Responsibilities**

**Service delivery and operational excellence**

* Work with the Head of Live Operations to implement processes and workflows for Live Operations
* Deliver operational efficiencies that minimise cost of service whilst maintaining service excellence
* Implement operative processes that ensure high-quality, efficient Live service delivery
* Define and promote processes and best practices for the operations activities within the LiveOps team
* Hold accountability for KPI measurement and service quality improvement

**Team management**

* Manage the LiveOps team (Supervisors, Operators, TechOps) as a competence centre for operations on acquisition, encoding and delivery, VOD ingest and playback
* Schedule weekly rotas across Supervisors, Operators, and TechOps according to client schedules
* Provide leadership, mentoring, and coaching to the team
* Organise and oversee onboarding and training of new joiners
* Define local initiatives to ensure service continuity and limit turnover
* Ensure the team understands the operational and business needs of the client, and the capabilities of Deltatre systems
* Deputise for the Head of Live Operations in their absence

**Event management and coordination**

* Interface with Service Managers to gather requirements and details of the relevant live streaming services
* Manage the Build-to-Run phase — end-to-end platform beta-testing on Staging environment prior to launch, reporting detailed summaries of issues
* Co-operate with Service Manager and Tech Team to validate new software releases through E2E beta-testing on Staging
* Coordinate the activities required to deliver the Live operative services for assigned client(s)
* Manage event scheduling — import/entry of events upon EPG / customer request
* Keep operative documentation up to date for all services
* Take part in recurrent client production meetings; gather information and comment on issues tracked in the daily LiveOps report
* Configure the LiveOps report as the basis for quality improvements and client conversations

**Live Operations supervision**

* Orchestrate the LiveOps team during Live Production; act as the main point of contact for team members
* Hold accountability for Live Service delivery
* Act as the first point of contact and escalation for the client during Live Production
* Apply operative troubleshooting when needed to ensure Live service delivery
* Perform live checks for quality control of operational output (sync, trim, etc.) during Live production
* Ensure timely escalation of technical issues to 2nd Level shared or dedicated Support
* Maintain active, supportive communication with the client during Live Production

Requirements

You have led a live operations team in a 24/7 broadcast environment before. You know what good SLA discipline looks like during live production, how to keep a team focused through a difficult event, and how to read the patterns in incoming alerts that mean something needs to change upstream. You are comfortable both with the structural work of operational planning and with the hands-on, real-time work of supervising a live broadcast.

**Required**

* 5+ years' experience in live transmission and/or 24/7 OTT broadcast environments, including demonstrated leadership of operational teams
* Familiarity with video encoding workflows end-to-end (acquisition, encoding, delivery, VOD ingest and playback)
* Knowledge of streaming protocols and the encoders / transcoders used in live workflows
* Solid knowledge of SLA / KPI management and operational workflows
* Hands-on experience with service desk tools (JIRA, ServiceNow, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with video analytics platforms (Conviva, NPAW, or comparable) and observability tools
* Demonstrated incident management experience — triage, escalation, root cause
* Comfortable with shift-based 24/7 coverage and able to maintain protocol-driven response during live event peaks
* Clear problem-solving, organisational, and communication skills
* Fluent written and spoken English

**Valued**

* ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management qualification
* Background in sports broadcasting, OTT, or rights-holder operations
* Experience working with project teams (Project Managers, Service Managers) in handover from build to run

**Who Thrives Here**

Running a Live Operations function in a 24/7 environment is a discipline. The visible work is events going to air without issues; the work that matters is the structural — what gets documented, what gets automated, what gets escalated upstream when a pattern shows up. People who do this well combine operational steadiness with technical depth — they can supervise a shift and write a process improvement document in the same week.

A successful Event Manager at Deltatre is patient with people development (you are building a stable, capable team), protective of the team's focus during demanding events, and curious about how the systems and workflows could be better. The role rewards structural thinking and steady judgement more than heroics.

**Process and what to expect**

* Introductory conversation: a step for us to get to know each other better, and for us to answer all questions you might have around Deltatre.
* 1-hour Technical round of Interview: we will deep dive on your experience and collect examples of the responsibilities you've been dealing with in your past experience. A chance to deep dive on the role and for you to ask questions.
* 1-hour Competency Based Interview: we will ask you situational questions around how you deal with real-life scenarios at work. Easier doing it, more than explaining it.

*If any of these formats would be difficult for you, tell us — we adjust regularly and can usually accommodate.*

*Accessibility and accommodation questions are welcome at any stage. Tell us what would work for you.*

title: Lead, EV Product Stabilization
description:
Bus & Truck | Operating Depots

Reports to: Head of Contract Manufacturing

Location: Mumbai, Pune with Need based Travel

Type: Full-time

Role Summary

Own the stabilization of newly launched EV buses and trucks at operating depots. You resolve early-life vehicle problems quickly, drive permanent fixes with the manufacturer and design teams, and ensure smooth induction of each new product into daily operation, so fleets reach target uptime and the customer's confidence is built from day one.

Key Responsibilities

Depot induction and stabilization

Plan and lead induction of new vehicles at depots: commissioning checks, charging readiness, driver and maintenance team briefing, and trial runs.

Run a structured stabilization program for each new product or batch (typically the first 3-6 months): daily issue tracking, uptime monitoring and escalation.

Deploy and manage field engineers at depots; ensure round-the-clock response during the initial run-in period.

Co-ordinate with maintenance and OEM tech support team for resolution of recurring issues.

Field Issue resolution along with OEMs for various ongoing projects

Problem resolution

Diagnose and resolve early-life issues across the e-powertrain, battery/BMS, charging, HV systems, thermal management, brakes, HVAC, body and electronics.

Use telematics, fault-code and fleet data to detect patterns, find root causes (8D, 5-Why, FTA) and separate product, process, charging-infrastructure and operator-driven causes.

Drive permanent corrective actions with the CM/OEM, design and suppliers, and verify fixes on the vehicle, including software updates and retrofits.

Manage retrofit and campaign rollout across depots, with tracking to closure.

Operations and customer interface

Be the technical point of contact for depot managers, fleet operators and STUs on new product issues.

Coordinate spare parts, service support and warranty resolution so vehicles are not off-road for long.

Train drivers and depot maintenance staff on operation, charging practices, HV safety and basic troubleshooting.

Support charging infrastructure readiness and performance (CCS2/GB-T, charger-vehicle compatibility, power availability).

Feedback and governance

Feed field learnings into design, manufacturing and PDI checkpoints to prevent recurrence in new builds.

Track stabilization KPIs and issue closure; report to leadership and customers through regular reviews.

Support warranty analysis and cost recovery from the CM/suppliers.

Lead and develop a team of field engineers and depot coordinators.

Authority

Prioritize and escalate field issues across CM, design and supplier teams

Recommend vehicle withdrawal, stop-use or campaign actions on safety-critical issues

Sign off on vehicle stabilization exit and handover to regular service

Qualifications

B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Automobile or Electrical/Electronics Engineering.

10-14 years in the automotive CV industry, with at least 6-8 years in field issue resolution, product stabilization, service or fleet operations. Direct experience with electric buses or trucks preferred.

Skills

Strong knowledge of bus and truck systems and EV architecture: battery, BMS, motor, inverter, charging, HV safety

Field diagnostics using EV diagnostic tools and telematics/fleet data

8D, 5-Why, FTA, FMEA, Pareto

Warranty, spare parts and service processes

Understanding of CMVR, AIS standards (AIS-038, 039, 156, 004) and depot operations

Stakeholder management with operators, STUs, OEMs and suppliers; calm and decisive under pressure

Valid HV safety training or certification is a plus

KPIs

Fleet uptime/availability during stabilization

Time to resolve (MTTR) and open-issue ageing

Repeat and early-life failure rate (per 1,000 km or per vehicle)

Retrofit/campaign closure rate

Depot and customer satisfaction

Warranty cost and recovery

Time to stabilization exit for each product

Working Conditions

Travel across depots (indicative 50-60%); may be stationed at a depot during launch; flexibility for extended hours during induction and breakdown escalations.

title: Senior Team Lead Dispute & Credit Management
description:
**Location Country**
India

Mumbai
  
  
**Who are V?**
As a global leader in ship management and marine services, we add value to a vessel’s operations. Operating around the clock and around the world, V. gives every client the quality and efficiency they need in every sector. Covering crew management and recruitment, quality ship management and technical services, together with supporting management and commercial services, V. has an unrivalled industry knowledge with performance assured. Our values, We Care, We Collaborate, We Challenge, We are Consistent, We Commit and Deliver, are at the heart of everything we do and they support our strategy of Investing in Talent. We are always interested in making contact with talented individuals - people who will demonstrate our values and deliver great service, for internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**Overall Purpose of The Job**

* Management of the GSS based teams for Collections/Reporting and Disputes/Queries to support reduction of managed vessel of debt owed to group companies.
* Delivery of group debt reporting including values owed, funds received, pending approvals etc to relevant stakeholders and drive transition from excel spreadsheets to odp dashboards.
* Identify opportunities for automation and improved efficient data delivery.
* Providing insight on areas for improvement to decrease payment delays from managed vessel to group companies Inclusive of debt review conversations with vessel finance/accounting teams and operations teams on entity side to support effective and prompt query resolution.
* Proactive and continual process improvement to evolve the support function and add value to both purchaser and supplier and drive continual reduction of recurring queries.
* To drive improvement on managed vessel payments to group companies and reduce aged debt by delivering clear and concise reporting and following up with vessel finance and relative stakeholders to confirm status of aged invoices.
* Facilitation / support of query resolution to speed up query resolution time and then payment by extension
* Proactively work with group companies ops teams to highlight areas of concern by providing query data and drive prosess improvement to reduce repeat incidents of common queries
* Suppport both entity and vessel side with query resolution
* Represent group company interests and ensures items are escalated and queries are managed to drive prompt resolution. Ensure Group companies are aware of any issues around non-payment.
* Manage Credit Risk, Accelarate Collections and resolve disputed items efficiently to protect revenue and improve cash flow performance.

**Key Responsibilities And Tasks**
**General Task**

* Ownership of KPI’s deliver continual improvement on targets
* Manage/Support team’s day to day activities related to Reporting, Credit Control, Disputes & Queries
* Act as point of escalaton for team members
* Ensure all processes are fully documented and SOP’s are maintained as processes evolve

* Ensure all reporting issued out in compliance with reporting calendar,
* Preparation of monthly report on invoices pending approval with analysis per SM office, client, approver
* Engage with VFC's/wider business to identify continual improvement of existing reports, pick up requests for new reports or retire reports that are no longer necessary
* Maintenance of SOP's and documentation relating to team processes
* Cross trained on all other reporting that is issued by team members IE approval status, aged debt etc.
* Support month-end and year-end closing processes, viz, monthly/annual reports.
* Drive effective communication with regular reviews of what we are sending and is it the appropriate audience.
* Ensure that a targeted approach is utilized rather than scattergun

**Global Credit Control**

* Lead monthly review calls with VFC’s of key offices with focus on payments to group companies; identify aged debt reasons; trigger escalations or move to dispute or query team
* Work with Entity credit control teams and GSS Vessel accounting team to identify items that need to be escalated to VFCs
* Collate comments and work with entity credit control teams to keep them appraised of managed vessel debt status.
* Follow up with vessel finance for vessels that have left management for focused follow up
* Carry out follow up calls where necessary based on actions agreed in the call
* Keep meeting stakeholders well informed with information and expectations communicated prior to any meetings to maxmimise productivity on calls
* Send out minutes of meetings confirming payments agreed and upcoming actions
* Continual review on collection KPI’s and cash targets; engage in necessary actions to drive improvement within our process
* Continual review on KPI’s/aged debt targets and engage in necessary actions to drive improvement within our process
* Raise the flag for any potential issues and ensure escalation process is followed through to resolution.
* Drive continual improvement on collections practices adapting to the needs of the induvial offices/clients
* Any other duties which may be required in relation to collections or reporting

**Disputes & Queries**

* Strong analytical approach to data; Improve tracker functionality/usability
* Work with IT/developers to drive integration into Shipsure and automation
* Analyse data to highlight re-occurring issues and highlight/drive change in process, training or IT system
* Development and formalisation of query treatment processes; technical issues/improvements.
* Drive regular query review meetings with areas experiencing high/regular volume of queries
* Preparation of monthly reports on disputed invoices including number of invoices per group entity, reason for dispute, etc.
* Working with the invoice issuing entity to resolve disputes in a timely manner.
* Continual review of KPI’s and support/drive improvement on resolution days
* Support creation of communications with wider business on stats and common queries.
* Ensure Proper documentation and approval for credit notes / adjustments.
* Improve Turn Around Time (TAT) for dispute resolution.

**What can I expect in return?**
V. Group can offer you a market leading salary and benefits package, in addition to significant opportunities for career growth and personal development. This a great opportunity to join a true leader in the maritime sector - a company that has exciting plans for future growth.

* Strong understanding of Order-to-Cash cycle.

* ERP system knowledge
* Strong analytical and negotiation skills.
* Proactive approach to work
* Strong and effective communication skills
* Very organized
* Attention to detail
* Exposure to Financial risk assessment
* Able to demonstrate strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills
* Analytical thinker

**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
Global Business Services
  
  
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview**
Global Markets Operations &Middle Office provides operations support to the Global Markets Business of BAML. Key Business activities include back office and middle office operations related to securities, derivatives, futures, options, currencies (FX) and commodities. Key functions in the middle office include trade control, product control and balance sheet management. While in the operations groups the key functions are Trade Processing & settlement, Inventory Management, Cash Management, Asset Services, Collateral Management, Reconciliation, Client & Product Data management
**.**
**Job Description**
Derivatives Collateral Operations manages the margining for the OTC, Repo Derivatives & Foreign Exchange businesses and Repo agreements. Collateral Management is a tool to control & reduce the bank's credit exposure risk on Derivative trades.
  
  
The Collateral Operations Unit monitors daily margining for customers across various products (Rates, Commodity, Structured Credit, Equity, Foreign Exchange, and Repo, Futures & Options). The Counterparty’s net exposure is evaluated each morning in order to determine collateral requirement. Margin Calls are made and received by Collateral Analyst and collateral exchanged. Team is also responsible to perform Data quality checks, monitor feeds from upstream into collateral system, run margin calculations, onboarding/static setup of new agreements into collateral application, Security Optimization, Journal processing, liquidity and regulatory reporting.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Participate in IT initiatives and transition projects and strive to build standardized, integrated, controlled infrastructure
  
  
Lead and drive global projects from India coordinating with global stakeholders
  
  
Identify and assess risk and monitor issue reporting and remediation by applying the company’s standard Risk Framework
  
  
Design and publish appropriate Controls/metrics for operations control, using business intelligence and analytics software
  
  
Data Quality checks on the upstream feeds and coordination with tech teams in resolving issues
  
  
Coordination with onshore team in decision making on upstream feed issues with due consideration to the impact
  
  
Running swing report highlighting the day over day changes for benefit of margin teams
  
  
Staying on top of prolong DQ issues, discuss and chased for status updates with upstream and tech team over BL/ Emails & Group Chats
  
  
Verification of call details originating from internal applications and exchange margin call notices with clients
  
  
Constant updates with correct RAG status to the users of collateral applications and calculations
  
  
Follow-up on margin calls due for payment where we do not have receipt of counterparty confirmation
  
  
Verification of settlement instructions before releasing cash /securities as collateral
  
  
Month end interest settlements with clients on collateral balances
  
  
MIS, reporting of operational and trading exposures to management
  
  
Maintenance of data in relation to points of contact internal and external and additional information necessary to effectively and efficiently resolve disputes
  
  
Working closely together with Static data team, Settlements, Traders, and clients to ensure accurate information is updated within our processing database
  
  
Responsible for monitoring and clearing items on the daily breaks/exception reports, Clearing aged breaks
  
  
Generate and publish daily control reports including MTM Swings, cash/security fails, zero MTM, Stale prices, open aged calls, etc.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Education -**
UG/PG
  
  
**Experience Range**
Manager: 10+ years
  
  
**Foundational Skills**
Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written)
  
  
Flexible to work in night shifts
  
  
Strong knowledge of investment banking, capital markets & Derivatives
  
  
Methodical and organized mindset, with strong control background and attention to detail with regards to ensuring data integrity
  
  
Excellent organizational skills are required with the ability to prioritize daily workload, work accurately and efficiently under pressure
  
  
To be flexible in their attitude and approach, and be willing to work extra hours during the week with overflow of volume and to provide cover for holidays planned and unplanned.

Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.
  
  
We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.
  
  
Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.
  
  
****Culture and Total Rewards****
Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.
  
  
Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.
  
  
We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness-related perks.
  
  
To support work-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.
  
  
At Meesho, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where every individual can thrive. In compliance with the
**Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016**
, we uphold the following principles:
  
  

* Equal Opportunity: We ensure that employment opportunities are never denied on the grounds of disability if the candidate is otherwise competent to perform the job.
* Accessible Workplace: Our facilities are designed to be fully accessible, with amenities and assistive devices provided to support differently abled individuals in their work.
* Inclusive Hiring Process: We adopt a transparent and non-discriminatory selection process, including providing application forms in alternate formats and offering reasonable accommodations during interviews upon request.
* Career Growth: We provide adequate training post-recruitment and pre-promotion, with training materials available in accessible formats to enable equal career progression.
* Support & Confidentiality: A dedicated liaison officer/committee addresses concerns and grievances, while maintaining strict confidentiality of disability-related information.
* Awareness & Inclusion: We conduct awareness programs to promote a culture of inclusivity across the organization.

Meesho welcomes applicants and employees of all abilities and is dedicated to fostering an environment where differently abled persons can achieve their full potential.
  
  
Know more about Meesho here : https://www.meesho.io/

title: Manager, Revenue Recognition (Billing & Contract Setup)
description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a highly skilled and analytical Team Lead to oversee our Order-to-Cash (OTC) financial operations, specifically focusing on complex contract setup, global billing, and revenue recognition compliance. In this role, you will lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of 10 to 15 professionals, ensuring operational excellence, strict adherence to global accounting standards, and tight internal controls.
  
  
The ideal candidate possesses deep functional expertise in ASC 606, an intricate understanding of General Ledger (GL) accounting, and a proven track record of handling complex reconciliations and driving process efficiencies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Team Leadership & Performance: Manage, coach, and develop a team of 10 to 15 billing and revenue analysts. Establish performance metrics (KPIs), conduct regular reviews, and foster a collaborative, high-accountability environment.
* Contract Setup & Billing Operations: Oversee the end-to-end contract ingestion and billing setup process. Ensure complex commercial contracts are accurately translated into the financial systems for seamless invoicing.
* Revenue Recognition & Compliance: Act as the subject matter expert for ASC 606 (Revenue from Contracts with Customers). Ensure the team correctly applies revenue policies to multi-element arrangements, performance obligations, and variable considerations.
* Reconciliations & Month-End Close: Lead month-end close activities for the OTC function. Review and approve complex reconciliations between billing systems, revenue sub-ledgers, and the General Ledger (GL) to ensure zero discrepancies.
* Audit & Controls: Maintain robust internal controls (SOX compliance where applicable). Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors regarding revenue and billing workflows.
* Process Automation: Identify bottlenecks in the current billing and revenue recognition workflows and implement automation or process improvements to scale operations.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.

* Experience:

+ Minimum of 7 to 10 years of progressive experience within Corporate Finance/Accounting, specifically inside an OTC or Revenue Operations function.
+ At least 2 to 3 years of experience in a supervisory or team lead capacity, directly managing a team of 10+ employees.

- Technical Accounting Skills:

* Strong foundational understanding of General Ledger (GL) architecture and double-entry accounting fundamentals.
* Expert, practical knowledge of ASC 606 / IFRS 15 frameworks and policies.
* Proven experience executing and reviewing high-volume, complex financial reconciliations.
* Systems: Proficiency with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) and specialized billing/revenue modules (e.g., Zuora, RevPro). High proficiency in Advanced Excel is required.

**Key Competencies**

* Analytical Thinking: Ability to dissect complex commercial contracts and identify financial risks or operational impacts.
* People Management: Proven capability to motivate, balance workloads across a medium-sized team, and manage conflicting priorities under tight month-end deadlines.
* Communication: Exceptional communication skills to explain complex accounting treatments to cross-functional teams like Sales, Legal, and FP&A.

**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Director Media (Cross Channel)
description:
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
  
  
For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
  
  
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
  
  
At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
  
  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

****Role Summary And Impact****
As part of the
**Global Operations Centre (GOC)**
, the Director – Cross Channel will lead and evolve a global media execution function, working across the United States, Europe and Asia. The role combines cross-channel media expertise, operational leadership, client partnership and people development to deliver scalable, consistent and high-quality outcomes across markets.
  
  
The Director will own the operational strategy, governance, delivery standards, reporting, capacity planning and continuous-improvement agenda across multiple PODs and workstreams. The role will translate business and marketing priorities into practical activation frameworks, guide teams through ambiguity, and build a future-ready, AI-enabled delivery organisation. We are looking for a Director – Cross Channel who will:
  
  
Cross-Channel Operations and Delivery Excellence
  
  

* Lead end-to-end operations across at least two core digital media disciplines, such as Search, Social, Programmatic or Ad Operations, while maintaining a working understanding of complementary channels.
* Build and govern common delivery standards across teams, PODs and markets, covering campaign setup, quality assurance, tracking, reporting, documentation and operational controls.
* Drive measurable improvements in quality, timeliness, productivity and delivery outcomes through clear performance measures, root-cause analysis and disciplined follow-through.
* Scale and continuously improve processes, integrating workflows across media functions to enable consistent and connected cross-channel delivery.
* Champion automation, advanced measurement and AI/ML-enabled ways of working to improve efficiency, insight and scalability.
* Maintain awareness of evolving industry developments, including identity solutions, real-time analytics and server-side tagging, and translate relevant developments into the media operations roadmap.

Client, Market and Stakeholder Leadership
  
  

* Build trusted relationships with Nexus-Hub regional teams, market leaders, internal senior stakeholders and external clients.
* Confidently lead senior and CEO-level conversations, simplifying complex operational issues and translating business goals into scalable frameworks and activation plans.
* Act as a strategic partner rather than only a delivery lead, thinking beyond the immediate problem and focusing stakeholders on sustainable solutions and outcomes.
* Influence across strategy, analytics, engineering and activation teams, including situations where direct authority is limited.
* Own cross-market escalations, exercise sound stakeholder judgement and make informed decisions in ambiguous situations or where information is incomplete.
* Communicate clearly and credibly across organisational levels, both verbally and in writing.

People and Leadership
  
  

* Lead a high-performing, globally distributed organisation, with experience managing teams of approximately 30–50 people and 4–8 direct reports.
* Create clarity of direction and accountability across multiple PODs or workstreams, balancing delivery priorities, team capacity and stakeholder expectations.
* Coach and mentor leaders and team members, provide timely and actionable feedback, and build a strong succession and leadership pipeline.
* Drive training, professional growth and platform capability while reinforcing best practices, operational consistency and quality at scale.
* Foster resilience, collaboration and openness to feedback, and visibly translate feedback into action.

Planning, Risk and Commercial Discipline
  
  

* Lead or support scoping, capacity planning, staffing and resource management across markets and workstreams.
* Proactively identify delivery, capability and stakeholder risks; establish mitigations early and maintain ownership through resolution.
* Manage vendor relationships and evaluate relevant martech and adtech solutions to support platform compliance and operational innovation.
* Work independently, take ownership of outcomes and make timely decisions while balancing client needs, team sustainability and operational priorities.

****Skills And Experience****

* Minimum 10 years of relevant digital media and operations experience, with no exceptions; 12–15 years of professional experience is preferred for this Director-level scope.
* Deep expertise in at least two digital media channels among Search, Social, Programmatic and Ad Operations, with working knowledge of complementary channels.
* Hands-on experience with relevant platforms and tools, which may include Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, The Trade Desk, DV360, SA360, CM360/DCM, Microsoft Advertising, Amazon Ads, LinkedIn, AppsFlyer and tagging or analytics tools.
* Proven experience leading sizeable, multi-location media activation or operations teams and delivering centralised support to local or regional teams.
* Experience working with global and geographically distributed teams; exposure to multiple PODs or workstreams is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to manage complex client relationships, cross-functional collaboration and senior stakeholder expectations.
* Strong track record of maintaining quality standards, driving operational improvement and delivering performance at scale.
* Good understanding of scoping, capacity planning, staffing requirements and resource trade-offs.
* AI-enabled mindset, with prior experience or meaningful exposure to applying AI in work highly desirable.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in any field.
* Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

Leadership and Behavioural Traits
  
  

* Solution-oriented and strategic: looks beyond the immediate problem and focuses on scalable, sustainable solutions.
* Mature stakeholder manager: navigates complex internal and external relationships, including senior and CEO-level conversations, with confidence and judgement.
* Delivery standard-setter: creates consistency across teams and markets and holds the organisation accountable for measurable quality and delivery outcomes.
* Decisive under ambiguity: makes sound, informed choices when information is incomplete and maintains ownership of the outcome.
* Proactive risk leader: anticipates challenges, surfaces issues early and mobilises the right action before delivery is affected.
* Continuous-improvement champion: scales processes, embraces automation and raises operational maturity over time.
* Coach and talent builder: develops people, strengthens leadership capability and creates an environment in which feedback leads to action.
* Resilient and collaborative: remains constructive under pressure, works across boundaries and responds openly to feedback.
* Influential and independent: shapes outcomes without relying on hierarchy and works autonomously while staying connected to enterprise priorities.

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Data Centre Engineering Operations Cluster Manager, AWS Data Center Operations
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Amazon is expanding the Data Center management team in India. This position within Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) requires broad Data Center knowledge with Subject Matter Expertise (SME) in as many specific fields as possible. The location for this job will be in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
  
  
This position serves as the primary operational resource to support ADSIPL within its leased/ owned and operated Data Centers in India. This position will provide a leadership for a specific cluster of data center and across ADSIPL’s portfolio of Data Centers, Mumbai. This position will be responsible for the overall operation and maintenance of the critical infrastructure supporting IT operations within the Indian Data Center space. It will also include event management, incident management, problem management, change management, and cost/contract management. In addition, this will include the relationship management with the landlords, critical facility vendors, Data Center Construction team, Data Center Operations team, Technical Program Managers, Security team, and Logistics team in India. The position will require 24x7 on-call, scheduled weekend work support and rotational shift. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.
  
  
This position will also be responsible for developing the team and leading them to the every success.
  
  
The Data Center Engineering Operations Cluster Manager is responsible for the management of all aspects of the performance of the data centre infrastructure within the region. The role requires a highly driven, self-managed individual who demonstrates initiative and proactively seeks solutions to problems.
  
  
Amazon Data Centres
  
  
AWS pioneered cloud computing in 2006, creating cloud infrastructure that allows customers build securely and innovate faster. We continuously innovate the designs and systems within our Data Centres to protect them from man-made and natural risks. As a result, Amazon data centres are large-scale high-density centres where you will work on changing the face of Cloud Technology in the region.
  
  
People and Culture
  
  
To succeed in Amazon, people must be self-motivated, highly technically-minded and intent on delivering world-class results. You will put the customer first in everything you do and build trust and communicate effectively with people at all levels of the business. Our team culture is collaborative; it is designed to empower and enable to you to succeed. We take pride in the diversity that is achieved by the global talent within the company. We promote and develop a strong safety culture.
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Will Be Accountable For**

* Setting and maintaining the highest standard for safety and actively promoting a world-class safety culture
* The key performance metrics for a significant number of large scale Data Centres distributed across multiple Amazon owned and Co-location sites (hosted by 3rd party service providers) by continuously driving improvements while delivering performance against agreed metrics
* Delivering 100% uptime on all customer supporting infrastructure
* Strategic planning and execution of all corrective and preventative maintenance activities on all mission-critical infrastructure
* Managing strong technical teams with responsibility for the training and/or development of others to ensure operational excellence
* Successful delivery of a portfolio of strategic projects on critical infrastructure
* The successful delivery of build-out and retrofit of facility infrastructure in existing and new regional locations
* Managing vendor performance by consistently setting high standards, driving accountability and conducting regular performance reviews
* Risk Management: adopt and plan corporate risk strategy.
* Critical Event Response readiness (planning, escalation/incident management, customer impacting event management response and recovery.)
* Experience working and managing within complex organizational matrix, manage and grow relationships between cross-functional teams.

Key job responsibilities
  
  
This position within Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) requires broad Data Center knowledge with Subject Matter Expertise (SME) in as many specific fields as possible. The location for this job will be in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
  
  
This position will be responsible for the overall operation and maintenance of the critical infrastructure supporting IT operations within the Indian Data Center space. It will also include event management, incident management, problem management, change management, and cost/contract management. In addition, this will include the relationship management with the landlords, critical facility vendors, Data Center Construction team, Data Center Operations team, Technical Program Managers, Security team, and Logistics team in India. The position will require 24x7 on-call, scheduled weekend work support and rotational shift. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.
  
  
This position will also be responsible for developing the team and leading them to the every success.
  
  
The Data Center Engineering Operations Cluster Manager is responsible for the management of all aspects of the performance of the data centre infrastructure within the region.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 12+ years of management experience
* Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Knowledge of the electrical and mechanical systems involved in critical data center operations including systems such as feeders, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, ATS units, PDU units, chillers, pumps, air handling units, and CRAC units
* Experience with large scale mechanical and power systems
* Experience hiring, developing, and managing high-performing technical teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Head of Operation_Corporate & Marine
description:
**About Tripjack**

**TripJack: A Great Place to Work® and the trusted tech platform for over 60K+ travel agents across India!**

We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified™ workplace, reflecting the trust, pride, and sense of belonging our people feel every day. This recognition reflects our commitment to a culture where our teams grow, collaborate, and drive the future of travel technology, while consistently delivering excellent service to our agent partners.

With over 35+ years of travel experience between the founders, TripJack has always prioritized the needs of travel agent partners. TripJack’s integrated platform offers content from 750+ airlines, 2 Mn+ Hotels including services across Corporate Travel, Travel assistance and Insurance, Rail and Marine segments. With a superior tech platform, seamless agent pre- and post-booking journeys, and 24/7 customer service, we are on a mission to transform the travel booking & management experience for our agent partners.

**Role**: Head of Operations – Corporate & Marine

**Location**: Lower Parel, Mumbai

**Experience**: 15+ Years

  

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for an experienced and strategic Head of Operations – Corporate & Marine to lead and manage the end-to-end operations for TripJack’s Corporate and Marine Travel businesses. The role will be responsible for driving operational excellence, service delivery, customer satisfaction, process improvement, commercial efficiency, team productivity, and business growth across Corporate and Marine Travel operations. The incumbent will work closely with senior leadership, key corporate and marine clients, airlines, suppliers, GDS partners, and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless service delivery, operational scalability, and achievement of business and financial objectives. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Business Travel Operations, Corporate Travel, Marine Travel, strategic implementation, process improvisation, supplier management, client management, and P&L ownership, with a strong understanding of the travel and aviation ecosystem.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Lead the overall Corporate and Marine Travel Operations function and ensure smooth day-to-day service delivery.
* Develop and execute operational strategies aligned with TripJack’s business objectives and growth plans.
* Manage end-to-end travel operations covering corporate travel, marine travel, ticketing, servicing, changes, cancellations, refunds, reissues, and client support.
* Drive operational excellence through process standardization, automation, digital transformation, and continuous process improvement.
* Establish and monitor SLA, TAT, productivity, quality, service delivery, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* Ensure effective management of corporate and marine client requirements and deliver a high level of service experience.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with airlines, GDS providers, suppliers, travel partners, and strategic vendors.
* Negotiate with suppliers and partners to secure competitive commercial terms, improved service quality, and operational efficiencies.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization, revenue improvement, and margin enhancement.
* Take ownership of operational budgets and contribute towards P&L management and profitability.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing operations team across Corporate and Marine Travel.
* Establish clear performance metrics and drive team productivity through regular reviews and performance management.
* Work closely with Sales, Business Development, Finance, Technology, Product, HR, and senior management teams.
* Handle operational escalations and ensure timely resolution of critical client and business issues.
* Identify operational risks and implement appropriate controls to ensure business continuity.
* Use operational data and analytics to identify trends, improve decision-making, and enhance overall performance.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, travel industry standards, commercial agreements, and operational SOPs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and lead Corporate & Marine Travel Operations and ensure seamless and scalable end-to-end service delivery.
* Manage large corporate travel accounts and their operational requirements.
* Ensure efficient ticketing, servicing, amendments, cancellations, refunds, and reissues.
* Own operational contribution towards business profitability and P&L.
* Identify opportunities for cost reduction and margin improvement.
* Build strong relationships with key corporate and marine clients.
* Drive customer satisfaction and retention through superior service delivery.
* Identify operational gaps and implement process improvements.
* Drive automation and technology adoption across operational workflows.
* Partner with senior leadership to develop Corporate & Marine operational strategy.
* Support business expansion and onboarding of new clients and business verticals.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**
The purpose of this role is to increase revenue, maximize process efficiency & cost-effectiveness, and ensure excellent customer experience, through effective supervision of daily operations and personnel, contract compliance, resource optimization and capability development within an account.

͏
**Do**

* **Maximize process efficiency and cost effectiveness through strategic planning, contract compliance and governance mechanisms**
* Strategy Planning with Senior Stakeholders
  + Collaborate with leaders to provide strategic and operational plans associated with the account
  + Plan the strategy for the coming years by identifying new geographies for alternate revenue streams
  + Ensure a deep enough understanding of clients individual experiences to head off potential issues before they become problems
* Contract compliance & adherence
  + Ensure all SLA parameters are met in the account and maintain a green card at all times
  + Review and drive appropriate actions/ systemic changes on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non-compliances are cited
  + Monitor and review the account on various delivery parameters to ensure quality delivery as per budget and timelines

͏

* Delivery governance in the account
  + Understand customer goals and key performance metrics and ensure exceeding those goals throughout the project
  + Ensure a green card for all accounts in terms of performance and quality
  + Monitor and review delivery dashboards/ MIS across accounts to track progress and identify potential red flags
  + Participate and share account performance across operational, quality and fulfillment parameters with internal and external stakeholders
  + Lead and manage project escalations, potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to eliminate any revenue leakage
  + Ensure regular invoicing as per the contract terms and condition
  + Forecast and track key account metrics
* Invoicing
  + Timely submission of invoices to the client as defined in the SOW
  + Provide information required and resolve any invoicing issues raised by the client
* Collect and analyze statistics (costs, customer service metrics etc.)
* Assume responsibility of budgeting and tracking expenses

͏

* **Ensure outstanding performance against key metrics mentioned in the agreement**
* Regular cadence around contract compliance
  + Evaluate performance with key metrics (accuracy, customer service metrics etc.)
  + Set direction for the team, track progress against targets through regular cadence calls and course correct as require
  + Drive the focus of the team on quality and adherence to contract compliance processes
  + Drive and implement structured cadence around quality, both process and transactional
  + Cadence with delivery lead to ensure margins are met and the account numbers are at par to what is committed
  + Weekly calls with WFM to ensure resource optimization, compliance to the manpower numbers agreed in the contract, future planning in case of ramp ups etc.

͏

* Resource Allocation & Retention
  + Conduct effective resource planning to maximize the productivity of resources (people, technology etc.)
  + Review and monitor resource planning and fulfillment in line with account requirements and costs of delivery
  + Optimize manpower and minimize leakages by working closely with delivery head
  + Ensure retention by offering relevant trainings and certifications of all allocated resources
  + Lead one-on-one floor connect and other engagement activities to improve stickiness of the delivery team
* Collaborate and influence internal key stakeholders to manage and resolve issues to ensure fulfillment and flawless delivery of projects

.

With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Job title: Team Lead – Business Operations (Customer Order Management)

Job location: Pune

As Team Lead – Business Operations, you will be responsible for achieving functional excellence in Customer Order Management. This includes managing the process from Order Booking to Closure. Additionally, you will drive business productivity and Operational efficiency across the organisation. Furthermore, you will adopt technological advancements to automate processes. Manage engagement for Business in areas of Order Management & Invoicing (Contracts Delivery Operations) and work with global partner to finds areas to reduce complexity, standardise and improve the way of execution. You will report into Manager – Business Operations and will have a hybrid working. We will ask to provide strategic leadership to assigned organisation.

* Lead / manage Business operations assignments (Customer order booking), which are moderate to high in complexity, following all relevant procedures.
* Provide leadership to the assigned team to lead efficiency in execution.
* Maintain the confidentiality of sensitive and proprietary technical, financial, and commercial information.
* Manage business process transitions and find areas to reduce complexity in building the tasks and standardising the way of execution.
* Ensure that you adequately document all audits (internal/external), and deal with risk areas promptly.
* Engage with multiple partners to identify opportunities for increased engagement, seek feedback on deliverables and to improve overall engagement
* Provide deliverables of good quality on time and on budget with high levels of Internal Customer Satisfaction, ensuring the team delivers them.
* Manage use of all resources and ensure accurate capacity planning.
* Manage resources and to assign right skills to the work.
* Work with required regional & domestic partners to ensure compliance & smooth processing of the activities/processes assigned.
* Manage & use the Business ops resources throughout different Regions for required support
* Use resources to ensure the team to meet process requirements defined in Standard Processes also respects the Quality Management System processes.
* Manage team performance to develop team capability and motivate the team. Create developmental plans for any identified gaps.
* Support best practice sharing and knowledge transfer among teams to improve competency of whole team.
* Lead the teams in Operations including third-party resources to comply with RA standards.
* Assess and develop competency and capabilities among the team. Encourage multi-skilling within the team to ensure better use.

**Leadership**

* A conceptual and out of the box thinker with experience establishing processes, SOPs, streamlining workflow and creating teamwork environment to enhance the productivity.
* Maintain professional demeanour, show empathy for customers, communicate and respect.
* Create an work environment by establishing positive and respectful work relationships.
* Commitment to achieving goals and guiding issues to resolution.
* Hold self and team accountable for keeping commitments, maintaining standards, and achieving goals. Develop people & teams – Planning and supporting relevant, learning for individuals and teams
* Build Organisational Talent - Takes responsibility for individual performance and is aware of team performance goals.
* Work with all partners (in varying roles and departments); provide succinct information on time
* Experience with delivering excellent customer experience.

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor's Degree. Diploma / degree in Business Administration
* Minimum of 10+ years of relevant experience in Business Operations.
* Typically requires 5+ years of hands-on experience in the Order-to-Cash (O2C) process lifecycle (Projects / contracts delivery or fulfilment)
* Have exposure to Global Work style, engagement with clients while sitting at remote locations.
* Willing to work in flexible business shifts / global time zones including NA/LA time zone to lead partner connect
* Flexibility to travel, 10% of the time, within and outside India (if required) to meet functional, client/ stakeholder teams

**Preferred:**

* Master's in Business Administration
* Experience in technological adoption for process automation, optimization as well enhancements for increased efficiency with sustained / improved customer satisfaction.
* Lean Six Sigma Certification (Green Belt & above).

**What We Offer:**

* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On-demand digital course library for professional development

... and other local benefits!

As our MSP business continues to grow, we are expanding our operational leadership capacity to support additional customer engagements, maintain service quality, and ensure scalable 24×7 operations.

The selected candidate will work alongside the existing Operations Lead, sharing responsibility for day-to-day operations, assigned customer accounts, team management, technical escalations, and continuous service improvement.

This is a **hands-on technical leadership role** requiring strong AWS infrastructure knowledge, operational discipline, customer-facing communication, and the ability to lead engineers in a fast-paced managed services environment.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently managing MSP customer operations while actively contributing to the growth and maturity of the practice.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. MSP Operations & Service Delivery**

* Take end-to-end operational ownership of assigned MSP customer accounts and service delivery activities.
* Collaborate with the existing Operations Lead to ensure seamless 24×7 operational coverage and clearly defined responsibilities.
* Manage daily operations, including incident, service request, problem, and change management in accordance with agreed SLAs.
* Oversee shift schedules, resource allocation, handovers, and on-call escalation arrangements.
* Ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests while maintaining customer satisfaction.
* Monitor operational KPIs, including SLA compliance, MTTA, MTTR, ticket backlog, and recurring incidents.
* Lead major incident management, including technical coordination, customer communication, RCA, and preventive actions.
* Maintain operational documentation, SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge repositories.
* Drive operational efficiency through automation, process improvements, and proactive monitoring.

### **2. Customer & Service Management**

* Act as the primary operational point of contact for assigned MSP customers.
* Build strong customer relationships through proactive communication and consistent service delivery.
* Conduct regular operational reviews covering SLA performance, incidents, security findings, cost optimization, and improvement initiatives.
* Manage customer escalations independently, ensuring timely communication and resolution.
* Coordinate onboarding and transition of new customers into MSP operations, including access management, monitoring setup, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer environments in terms of availability, performance, security, and cost.
* Collaborate with account management and practice leadership on service expansion opportunities.
* Ensure operational activities remain aligned with agreed SOWs, service boundaries, and customer commitments.

### **3. Technical Leadership & Escalation Management**

* Provide hands-on technical guidance to L1/L2 engineers for troubleshooting and incident resolution.
* Act as a technical escalation point for complex AWS infrastructure and operational issues.
* Troubleshoot issues across AWS compute, storage, networking, databases, security, and monitoring services.
* Coordinate complex technical escalations with L3 engineers, AWS Support, and third-party vendors.
* Review technical solutions, operational changes, and remediation plans to ensure reliability and security.
* Support AWS infrastructure optimization, including availability, performance, security, backup, and disaster recovery.
* Identify recurring technical issues and implement permanent fixes, automation, or preventive controls.
* Ensure production changes follow established change management and approval processes.

### **4. Team Leadership & Capability Development**

* Lead, mentor, and support cloud operations engineers across L1, L2, and L3 functions.
* Ensure adequate technical guidance and leadership availability across operational shifts.
* Conduct regular team reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and technical training.
* Review ticket quality, troubleshooting approaches, documentation, and customer communication.
* Identify skill gaps and develop training and AWS certification plans.
* Support hiring, technical interviews, onboarding, and performance evaluations.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, operational discipline, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Develop team capabilities to reduce dependency on senior engineers for routine operational activities.

### **5. MSP Practice Growth & Operational Scalability**

* Support the MSP Practice Head in scaling operations as new customer accounts are onboarded.
* Contribute to resource capacity planning, shift coverage models, and operational workload distribution.
* Help standardize processes, monitoring frameworks, runbooks, and service delivery practices across customer accounts.
* Identify automation opportunities to improve operational efficiency and reduce repetitive manual activities.
* Support operational readiness assessments for new customer engagements.
* Contribute to service quality improvements, operational reporting, and governance initiatives.
* Support AWS MSP program requirements, operational best practices, and compliance readiness.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

### **Technical Skills**

* **5–8 years of experience** in IT infrastructure, cloud operations, or managed services, including at least 4 years of hands-on AWS experience.
* Strong understanding of AWS services, including:
* **Compute:** EC2, Auto Scaling, Lambda
* **Networking:** VPC, Route 53, ELB, VPN, Security Groups, NACLs
* **Storage & Databases:** S3, EBS, RDS
* **Security & Identity:** IAM, CloudTrail, AWS Config
* **Monitoring & Operations:** CloudWatch, AWS Systems Manager, AWS Backup
* Strong Linux and Windows server administration and troubleshooting experience.
* Good understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VPN, firewalls, and load balancing.
* Experience in monitoring, incident troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and production support.
* Practical knowledge of ITIL-based incident, change, problem, and service request management.
* Experience with ITSM tools such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with scripting and operational automation using Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
* Understanding of AWS security, backup, disaster recovery, and operational best practices.

### **Leadership & Customer Management**

* Minimum **2 years of experience leading or co-leading** an IT operations, cloud support, or managed services team.
* Experience managing 24×7 support operations, shift planning, and technical escalations.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage customer accounts and operational commitments.
* Strong experience in SLA management, operational reporting, and service reviews.
* Ability to coordinate major incidents and communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and prioritization skills.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication.
* Ability to manage multiple customer environments and competing operational priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate, AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate, or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.
* AWS Professional-level certification is an advantage.
* ITIL Foundation certification.
* Experience working in an AWS Managed Services Provider environment.
* Exposure to AWS MSP program requirements and operational best practices.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.
* Familiarity with container technologies such as Docker, ECS, and EKS.
* Knowledge of AWS security services, including Security Hub, GuardDuty, AWS Organizations, and Control Tower.
* Experience with AWS cost optimization using Cost Explorer, Budgets, Savings Plans, and Reserved Instances.
* Exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar compliance frameworks.
* Experience implementing operational automation, proactive monitoring, and self-healing infrastructure.

**Working Expectations**
------------------------

* Ability to work in a 24×7 managed services environment with responsibility for operational escalations.
* Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and provide occasional off-hours support for critical incidents.
* Comfortable handling multiple customer accounts and working with distributed teams.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and collaborate with peer operational leads.

title: Category Manager
description:
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a dynamic, detail-oriented
**Category Manager – Mobility, Transit & Tourism t**
o own the end-to-end performance of this unified vertical on DigiHaat. You will build and scale a comprehensive mobility and tourism marketplace covering daily/regional transit options, stays, local experiences, guided tours, and travel-linked products such as handicrafts, local produce, and curated travel kits. You will onboard and manage supply, ensure listing quality, track bookings and fulfillment, and work with product and tech teams to deliver a seamless buyer journey across transit and travel.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Category Strategy and Growth
* Define and execute the category strategy for mobility, transit, and tourism with clear goals, priorities, and KPIs in collaboration with product, marketing, and business teams.
* Identify high-potential segments across transit & mobility (first-mile/last-mile connectivity, intercity bus/rail integrators, local transit options) alongside tourism segments (homestays, rural & heritage tourism, craft and culinary experiences, pilgrimage and wellness travel).
* Build the category roadmap around seasonality, commuting patterns, regional demand, festivals, and travel trends.
* Align category operations with broader business objectives of growth, network adoption, profitability, and customer satisfaction.
* Supply Onboarding and Partner Management
* Onboard and nurture a diverse supply base: transit operators, mobility service providers, homestay owners, tour operators, local guides, experience hosts, artisans, and tourism-linked sellers.
* Build strong relationships with mobility aggregators, transport operators, travel suppliers, and logistics partners to ensure service reliability, availability, and cost efficiency.
* Set and monitor service standards, cancellation/refund policies, and compliance requirements, including transport permits, local licenses, and safety norms.
* Handhold small transit operators, experience hosts, and first-time digital sellers through onboarding, catalogue creation, and platform best practices.
* Booking, Transit & Order Lifecycle Operations
* Monitor the full lifecycle from route search, booking, ticket issuance, and service delivery to post-trip feedback to ensure a smooth end-to-end customer experience.
* Track and resolve operational issues such as schedule disruptions, cancellations, no-shows, overbooking, service quality complaints, refunds, and physical product deliveries.
* Work with operations teams to streamline fulfillment for mobility bookings and tourism-linked retail products.
* Identify and implement process improvements to reduce operational costs and maximize booking efficiency.
* Pricing, Inventory and Demand Management
* Use demand forecasting to manage inventory, seat/stay availability, and peak/off-peak capacity across daily transit and travel seasons.
* Develop dynamic pricing strategies, bundled offers, and multi-modal travel packages (e.g., Transit Pass + Stay + Experience + Local Products) to improve conversion and basket value.
* Work with marketing on customer acquisition campaigns, transit usage incentives, destination-led promotions, and seasonal travel offers.
* Data-Driven Decision Making
* Use data and analytics to track category performance: GMV, total bookings, route throughput, conversion rate, repeat rate, cancellation rate, customer ratings, and partner reliability.
* Identify commuting and travel trends, regional transit bottlenecks, and category expansion opportunities.
* Deliver regular performance reports and actionable insights to internal and external stakeholders for continuous platform optimization.
* Listing Quality and User Experience
* Ensure listings, routes, and travel options are accurate, current, and compelling - covering departure/arrival schedules, stay descriptions, itineraries, amenities, pricing, availability, and policies.
* Analyze customer reviews, ratings, and ride/trip feedback to identify pain points and collaborate with tech/product teams to address them.
* Drive product enhancements for multi-modal travel discovery, transit routing, category search filters, and trust signals for mobility and travel services.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Total Experience: 8–12 years in category management, marketplace operations, or business leadership roles.
* Mandatory Industry Experience: Direct, proven experience across Mobility / Transit, the Travel Industry, and Tourism Management.
* Track Record: Proven success in building, scaling, and monetizing digital platforms in mobility, travel, or multi-service marketplaces.

**Must-Have Attributes**

* Hands-on experience with buyer-facing apps in mobility, transit, travel, hospitality, or experience marketplaces (e.g., transit/cab apps, OTAs, activity platforms).
* Deep understanding of the Indian mobility and tourism ecosystem, including urban/rural transit networks, regional travel dynamics, and localized tourism.
* Expertise in yield management, dynamic pricing, route/inventory capacity planning, and user acquisition strategies.
* Solid grasp of agile methodologies and demonstrated skill in working with cross-functional product and tech teams.
* Exceptional negotiation, partner management, and stakeholder communication skills.

## Infrastructure & Platform Lead

Location: On-site

SecNinjaz is building sovereignty-aligned cybersecurity and IT solutions designed to empower organizations with secure, resilient, and open technologies.

Our mission is to become a one-stop cyber solutions partner — architecting and delivering secure infrastructure, cybersecurity platforms, and advanced technology solutions while prioritizing open-source, sovereignty, and operational resilience.
