title: Senior Brand Manager - Sony AATH( Kolkata)
description:
**Senior Manager - Marketing, Sony AATH**

**Location: Kolkata**

**Reports to:**
Head – Marketing, Sony AATH and Channel YAY!

**Purpose**

The position is responsible for leading marketing strategy, brand-building, and consumer-centric initiatives for Sony AATH, aiming to drive market share growth, GRP and ad-revenue targets, and strengthen audience engagement. We are looking for a strategic leader who can balance creative, consumer-centric initiatives with revenue targets and cross-channel priorities, while fostering strong collaboration across Programming, OAP, Sales, Distribution, and external partners. The ideal candidate will hold high accountability for strategic campaigns, high-profile launches, and measurable business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Brand Saliency & Consumer Engagement

* Strengthen Sony AATH's brand awareness and brand health.
* Plan and execute consumer and trade marketing campaigns across social media, email, and other channels.
* Support sales and distribution teams to improve brand perception and market presence.

2. Revenue & Sales Enablement

* Support advertising sales revenue generation.
* Collaborate with the sales team to create integrated marketing solutions for advertisers.
* Monitor revenue performance and recommend corrective actions to achieve targets.

3. Show Launches & Media Visibility

* Plan and execute marketing campaigns for new show launches.
* Drive visibility through social media, barter partnerships, PR, and strategic alliances.
* Track campaign performance and optimize for reach, engagement, and awareness.

4. Channel GRP Performance

* Align marketing activities with channel viewership objectives.
* Monitor campaign effectiveness to help achieve targeted GRPs (Gross Rating Points).

5. Operational & Financial Optimization

* Encourage innovation by ensuring each team member leads at least one initiative every quarter.
* Optimize marketing budgets and identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining campaign effectiveness.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Deliver
  **2–3 sales support initiatives**
  .
* Execute
  **5+ distribution-led initiatives**
  .
* Improve brand perception metrics.
* Achieve revenue targets.
* Increase launch-week slot reach by
  **20%**
  .
* Grow social media reach and engagement by
  **15% year over year**
  .
* Close
  **3 major barter deals**
  and
  **15+ strategic alliance partnerships**
  .
* Achieve target average channel GRPs.

Business Competencies

* Strategic thinking and commercial acumen
* Creativity and innovation
* Stakeholder management and collaboration
* Problem-solving and execution excellence
* Project management
* Strong communication and presentation skills

Technical Competencies

* Marketing strategy and campaign planning
* Consumer insights and data-driven decision-making
* Understanding of on-air promotions
* Media planning and advertising ecosystem knowledge
* Budget management and ROI measurement

**Why join us?**

Sony Pictures Networks India (SPNI) is the consumer-facing identity of Culver Max Entertainment Private Limited which is an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, Japan. A leading media and entertainment conglomerate, SPNI comprises 28 Premium Channels in both SD and HD formats, including leading Hindi General Entertainment Television Channels - Sony Entertainment Television; Sony SAB and Sony PAL; Marathi General Entertainment Channel - Sony Marathi; Bangla General Entertainment Channel - Sony AATH; Hindi Movie Channels - Sony MAX, Sony MAX 1, Sony MAX 2 and Sony WAH; renowned destination for sports fans - Sony Sports Network comprising Sony Sports Ten 1, Sony Sports Ten 2, Sony Sports Ten 3, Sony Sports Ten 4, Sony Sports Ten 5; Kids Entertainment Channel - Sony YAY!; English Movie Channel - Sony PIX; Factual Entertainment Channel - Sony BBC Earth; Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television (FAST) channel in the US and Canada – Sony KAL; Digital entertainment OTT platform - Sony LIV and the independent production venture for original content and IPs for TV and digital media - Studio NEXT. This Network reaches out to over 700 million viewers in India and is available in over 150 countries.

Recognised as an employer of choice within and outside the media industry, SPNI is a recipient of several awards, including India’s Best Companies to Work For 2021 by the Great Place to Work® Institute, India, Exemplars of Inclusion in AVTAR & Seramount’s Most Inclusive Companies Index 2024 and listed as one of the 100 Best Companies for Women in India for eight consecutive years by AVTAR & Seramount. In recognition of the company’s unique workplace culture and exceptional people practices SPNI won the ET Future Skills 2024 for Best Learning Program Supporting Change Transformation Business Strategy, and the TISS LeapVault CLO Awards 2024 for Best Employee Engagement Program and Best Games Based Learning Program.

SPNI is in its 30th year of operations in India. Besides having overseas subsidiaries, it has a subsidiary MSM-Worldwide Factual Media Private Limited, and an affiliate, Bangla Entertainment Private Limited in India.

For more information, log onto www.sonypicturesnetworks.com

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Department :**
Technology Consulting/Technology Strategy and Transformation
  
  
**Level :**
Manager
  
  
**Job Title : Strategy Manager**
**THE OPPORTUNITY**
: EY's Technology Strategy & Transformation (TST) team is at the forefront of delivering cutting-edge consulting and advisory services to some of the largest enterprises across the globe. Our technology practice is recognized by industry analysts as a leader in leveraging business and technology to drive strategic business-led, tech-enabled e2e transformation. We serve clients across all major industries and work with organizations of different sizes, helping guide them to achieve business success while delivering strategic IT value.
  
  
**Scope of engagements**
We are currently seeking experienced, seasoned IT Strategy practitioners who can be positioned at the crucial intersection of business, technology and customer to devise creative new strategies based on trends, insights and data. We are looking for folks who have experience in advising clients to …
  
  

* reset, reimagine and re-think their business and operating models with tech-enabled, cutting-edge solutions that re-energize performance across the enterprise
* set and drive enterprise tech vision and strategy in alignment with corporate / business unit strategy, customer focus and solution teams
* drive increased value from technology spend with focus on optimizing cost, agility, productivity and performance

We work with clients to address issues of importance to the Chief Information Officer (CIO) and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) in creating value and delivering world-class IT capabilities to support futuristic business needs. Working closely with our industry groups and leveraging the Ernst & Young brand as independent, trusted advisors, we provide our high-profile clients with range of services including:
  
  

* Tech Strategy & Vision
* IT Operating Model optimization
* Transformation strategy, roadmaps & blueprints
* Office of CIO functions (IT Finance, Sourcing, Project Portfolio Mgt. etc)
* Product strategy & management
* M&A due-diligence, planning and post integration/separation
* Enterprise Architecture Services

**Key responsibilities of candidate include:**

* Understanding the business strategy & vision and translating them into enterprise-wide technology vision & strategy in alignment with strategic priorities for growth, customer experience, efficiency etc.
* Analyze value chain and business capabilities to develop clear understanding of strategic objectives, KPI’s, processes and underlying systems that deliver the business outcomes
* Assess the impact of the business strategy on business capability model and business processes to identify optimization opportunities (through tech-enabled solutions) across organization, systems, data, infrastructure and applications
* Have strong experience in analysing business models, business model innovation/ incubation, and experience in one or more of the following areas preferred: Market Strategy, Pricing/ Monetization, Finance, Ecosystem Management, and/ or Product Management
* Ability to analyse client’s (IT) Operating Model including the organization structure, processes and governance while developing recommendations and/or creating actionable roadmaps
* Significant experience in: 1) developing business capability model for the enterprise; 2) analysing enterprise-wide portfolio of systems / platforms and 3) function as guardian of the transformation strategy and business architecture to make sure that new initiatives comply with strategic priorities
* Solid experience in guiding our clients through large, enterprise-wide transformation to implement their strategies and business architecture. Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the IT strategic and improvement agenda
* Be a trusted advisor on 'innovation' with ability to frame key business and technology trends within the context of the client's objectives. Ability to identify the potential implications and impacts of the associated trends.
* Leverage EY’s global network, and leverage the cross-functional expertise to develop relevant architecture insights

Within the team, your role will include the following additional responsibilities:
  
  

* Ability to lead conversations with the client stakeholders. Strong communication skills as the profile requires interactions with CIO, CEO, CFO and other senior leadership
* Build and develop trusted relationships as a strategic technology advisor with clients and work internally across EY advisory teams to bring our clients the most comprehensive, end-to-end services and effectively address their business challenges.
* Building and growing TST Strategy practice, developing and maintaining client relationships, and selling and delivering work as an engagement leader or Subject Matter Specialist.
* Develop thought leadership and define approaches to provide structured solutions to complex technology strategy problems of clients, by recombining existing methodologies and teams
* Managing engagement teams and providing leadership in the assessment, design, and management of successful Business - IT transformation engagements in collaboration with our clients. They should provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing EY leadership of engagement status, and managing staff performance
* Help recruit, develop and retain strategy professionals, coach and mentor team members, deliver architecture-related training and take on other practice management tasks as needed (e.g., development of practice offerings)
* Should be very good at using various tools (Such as Word, Excel, Powerpoint, visualization tools, MS-Project, etc.)
* Would support in developing new solution offerings, tools and knowledge repositories
* People skill has worked independently on projects or as part of small consulting teams
* Should be self-driven and organized person with ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high pressure environment
* Should have experience in pursuit teams including conceptualizing propositions and presenting solutions to client
* Create expert content for point-of-view and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C-Level discussions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Strong academic background with BE/B.tech and MBA from top Tier-1 B-schools
* A background in Strategy Consulting (in top tier consulting firms), with 10+ years of relevant experience in large-scale, enterprise-wide transformations
* Min. of 10+ years of specific industry / sector experience through completed client engagements related to business transformation. Should have experience in any one or two industry sectors such as Financial services, Retail, Healthcare/Pharma, Telecom, e-commerce, etc.
* Demonstrated experience of driving business workshops as well as conducting deep-dive technology workshops to collaboratively develop transformation vision, strategy, roadmaps and blueprints
* Experience with assessing maturity of IT operating models & organizations structure to determine optimization opportunities. Should understand IT - business alignment, IT strategy and planning, development of current and future state IT architecture, roadmaps, IT/Digital maturity assessment, etc.
* Experience with large transformation related to customer experience, process re-engineering, digital, cloud, automation, AI/ML/advanced analytics, next-gen / emerging tech (IoT, blockchain, virtual twins etc).
* Conducting research and analyses of operational effectiveness, processes, stakeholders, etc., creating end-to-end visibility into how the organization executes their operations today and identifying systemic issues impacting business performance
* Should have experience in designing and managing an effective IT governance framework across the spectrum of IT service delivery
* Should be able to analyze data and translate findings into meaningful insights, integrating relevant business knowledge
* Should have knowledge about or exposure to areas such as IT Service Management and Governance, Agile methodologies, Data visualization, Cloud technologies, emerging technologies

The following are preferred, but not required:
  
  

* Advanced business and/or technology degrees from tier-1 schools (MBA, Masters)
* Experience in presenting directly to the C-Suite and explain complex concepts to anyone from an intern to a CFO, CHRO or CMO
* Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the strategic and improvement agenda.
* Speaking at industry conferences, round tables, and other public forums
* Authoring articles and white papers
* Business / technology innovation experience with emerging tech solutions leveraging power of combinatorial technologies AI/ML, Data Automation, Blockchain, IoT, etc
* Exposure across key technology domains is preferred (application, data, DevOps, infrastructure, cloud, network. security etc)
* Demonstrated capability to drive sales and bring a network of client relationships to the firm
* Relevant industry certification (e.g., TOGAF Biz Architect, Business Process Framework (eTOM Practitioner of TMForum), AWS Cloud Certified etc.).

**Overall Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Understanding of the current IT environment and industry IT trends to identify the engagement and client service issues.
* Ability to act as day-to-day client contact on the project engagement; run client status and other client meetings and deliver executive-level presentations that drive actions and decisions.
* Proven delivery skills including the ability to scope/size a project; staff a team with the appropriate skill set; provide subject matter direction and guidance to a team; and manage the delivery of an engagement.
* Ability to identify opportunities and help generate sell-on work during client engagements by understanding a range services and offerings and coordinating with personnel in other service lines to help sell integrated solutions that meet client needs.
* Experience in creating points of view on relevant industry trends, solutions, methodologies, and analytical frameworks and tools to bring strategic perspectives to existing solutions.
* Experience in managing a portfolio of executive level clients and developing long-term trusted advisor relationships.
* Experience in building strong teams with a solid understanding of project management, industry content knowledge, and effective client communications.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior
description:
Senior Manager – Certificates & Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)

Kolkata & Hyderabad

About the Role

Inceptial Tech is looking for an experienced technology professional to lead enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) engineering and certificate lifecycle management within the Information Security function.

The role involves managing enterprise PKI platforms, cryptographic key protection, certificate automation, and security operations while leading engineering teams and ensuring reliable, secure production services.

Key Responsibilities

\* Lead PKI engineering teams and oversee technical delivery.

\* Manage enterprise Certificate Authority (CA) hierarchies, HSMs, and key management processes.

\* Oversee certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, discovery, and lifecycle automation.

\* Manage code-signing, device certificates, and user certificate services.

\* Define cryptographic standards, certificate policies, and approved algorithms.

\* Coordinate with vendors and Certificate Authority providers.

\* Ensure platform availability, audit readiness, and certificate expiry prevention.

\* Support cryptographic agility and post-quantum cryptography migration planning.

Required Skills

\* Strong expertise in PKI architecture and certificate lifecycle management.

\* Knowledge of X.509 certificates, TLS, certificate validation, revocation, and trust stores.

\* Experience with Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS).

\* Familiarity with platforms such as Venafi, Keyfactor, DigiCert, Entrust, or HashiCorp Vault.

\* Experience with ACME, certificate automation, and Hardware Security Modules (HSMs).

\* Strong knowledge of cryptographic key management and code signing.

\* Experience in technical leadership, vendor management, and security operations.

Experience & Qualifications

\* 15–18 years of experience in infrastructure or security engineering.

\* At least 3 years of team management or technical leadership experience.

\* Experience managing enterprise-scale PKI platforms and production certificate services.

\* CISSP, CISM, or relevant PKI certifications are preferred.

About Inceptial Tech

Inceptial Tech is a global technology solutions company operating across the UK, USA, Germany, and India, delivering IT consulting, software development, Testing-as-a-Service, and managed Oracle Cloud services.

Interested professionals with relevant experience are welcome to connect with us to discuss this opportunity.

title: Manager Business Consulting - IT
description:
It's about Being What's next.
**What's in it for you?**
The Manager Business Consulting will act as a business-facing IT partner by managing the application lifecycle and providing effective post-implementation support for Sales and Supply processes across the RSE region
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
  
  
Every day is an opportunity: an opportunity to learn, to grow, to share success, and to contribute to one of the world’s leading industrial gas and engineering companies. Seize the opportunity: take your next step with us and join our team.
  
  
Linde values diversity and recognizes the importance of fostering inclusion in our work environment. We believe that our success depends on the diverse perspectives of our employees, customers, and global markets. As an employer of choice, we strive to support our employees' growth, welcome new ideas, and respect our differences.
  
  
Team
  
  

Making an impact.
**What will you do?**

* In this role you will participate as a core project team member in the implementation of SAP and non-SAP applications, including system interfaces, across the RSE region
* Further you will own the application development lifecycle for assigned initiatives by working with business users to gather and document requirements, translating them into SAP process designs, developing the functional specifications, configuring SAP solutions, collaborating closely with ABAP developers for custom developments, performing system testing, supporting user acceptance test and ensuring successful deployment.
* Furthermore, you will identify process gaps and propose workarounds where required
* Moreover, you will provide end-to-end SAP application support for Sales and Supply systems across the relevant modules (e.g. SD, MM/PP/PM, Procurement, SAP authorisations, integrated FI/CO areas), including issue troubleshooting, user training, data cleansing and post go-live support
* Further you will maintain accurate and up-to-date system documentation, including business requirements, solution designs, configuration details and user/training manuals
* Moreover, you will act as a business process specialist by maintaining a strong understanding of Sales and Supply processes including OTC, PTP, R2R and master data management
* Additionally, you will collaborate with Global IT teams (including GIMS, BASIS, Release Management, TCOE, Global Business Consulting), Shared Services, regional and country IT teams, and external vendors to ensure successful project delivery and support

Winning in your role.
**Do you have what it takes?**

* For this role you will have a degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or other disciplines with strong interest in business consulting and a solid understanding of IT and business applications
* Further you have a minimum of 3 years’ experience in system implementations, particularly in SAP SD
* Furthermore, you have a strong business knowledge and understanding of Sales and Supply processes
* Additionally, you have the ability to work in a global environment and travel as required

**Why you will love working for us!**
Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company, operating in more than 100 countries worldwide. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain and protect our planet.
  
  
On the 1st of April 2020, Linde India Limited and Praxair India Private Limited successfully formed a joint venture, LSAS Services Private Limited. This company will provide Operations and Management (O&M) services to both existing organizations, which will continue to operate separately. LSAS carries forward the commitment towards sustainable development, championed by both legacy organizations. It also takes ahead the tradition of the development of processes and technologies that have revolutionized the industrial gases industry, serving a variety of end markets including chemicals & refining, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, and primary metals.
  
  
At Linde, the sky is not the limit. If you’re looking to build a career where your work reaches beyond your job description and betters the people with whom you work, the communities we serve, and the world in which we all live, at Linde, your opportunities are limitless. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
  
  
Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!
  
  
We are looking forward to receiving your complete application (motivation letter, CV, certificates) via our online job market.
  
  
Any designations used of course apply to persons of all genders. The form of speech used here is for simplicity only.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law.

Ltd. acts responsibly towards its shareholders, business partners, employees, society and the environment in every one of its business areas, regions and locations across the globe. title: Regional Manager – Operations & Business Development
description:
**1. Job Purpose**

To manage regional operations, ensure effective project execution, strengthen client relationships, oversee billing and receivables follow-up, and drive business development across Kolkata and Eastern India. The role also involves leading the team with strong leadership and managerial skills, ensuring timely compliance, and maintaining efficient execution of projects and operational activities.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Regional Operations & Project Execution**

* Oversee daily regional operations, project execution, and site activities.
* Monitor resource utilization, manpower deployment, service delivery, and project progress.
* Ensure efficient execution of projects as per contractual obligations, timelines, and quality standards.
* Identify operational challenges and implement corrective actions.
* Coordinate with site teams and zonal offices to ensure smooth operations and timely completion of deliverables.
* Ensure effective execution and proper management of projects under the assigned region.

**B. MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports.
* Monitor project progress, pending activities, deliverables, operational performance, and resource utilization.
* Maintain accurate records of project status, billing, collections, and operational activities.
* Coordinate with internal departments and zonal offices to obtain timely updates.
* Provide regular reports on regional performance, pending issues, and project-related challenges to Senior Management.

**C. Client Management, Billing & Receivables**

* Liaise with government bodies, municipal corporations, Urban Local Bodies (ULBs), clients, and site teams.
* Maintain strong client relationships and ensure effective stakeholder coordination.
* Coordinate bill submissions, invoice processing, payment approvals, and commercial documentation.
* Follow up on outstanding receivables and pending payments with clients.
* Coordinate with Accounts and Project teams to resolve billing discrepancies and payment-related issues.
* Ensure timely billing, proper documentation, and effective receivables management.

**D. Business Development**

* Identify new business opportunities, upcoming projects, and tenders across Kolkata and Eastern India.
* Develop and maintain relationships with government authorities, municipal corporations, ULBs, and potential clients.
* Track relevant tenders, project opportunities, and business prospects.
* Coordinate with the Tender team for proposal preparation, tender documentation, and timely submission of bids.
* Support business acquisition, client engagement, and achievement of regional revenue targets.
* Provide regular updates to Senior Management regarding business opportunities and potential projects.

**E. Team Leadership & Management**

* Lead and manage the regional team with strong leadership and managerial capabilities.
* Allocate responsibilities, monitor performance, and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
* Coordinate with Operations, Accounts, Tender, Purchase, and other internal departments.
* Ensure effective communication, accountability, teamwork, and resource utilization.
* Guide team members in resolving operational challenges and improving performance.
* Escalate critical operational and commercial matters to Senior Management.

**F. Compliance & Documentation**

* Ensure timely compliance with applicable statutory requirements, contractual obligations, and project-specific requirements.
* Maintain accurate project records, operational documents, billing records, and commercial documentation.
* Monitor pending compliance activities and coordinate with the concerned departments for timely completion.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, internal procedures, and reporting requirements.

**3. Educational Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering preferred.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in Management Studies preferred.
* Equivalent relevant educational qualifications may also be considered based on experience and suitability.

**4. Experience & Competencies**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in operations, project coordination, client management, or business development.
* Experience in government liaison, municipal projects, or infrastructure projects will be preferred.
* Experience in environmental engineering, water and wastewater treatment, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), EPC, or infrastructure projects is desirable.
* Strong leadership, team management, planning, negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MIS reporting, billing coordination, receivables follow-up, and commercial documentation.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and meet deadlines.
* Strong client relationship management and business development capabilities.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Efficient project execution and effective project management.
* Timely completion of operational activities and contractual deliverables.
* Timely compliance with applicable statutory, contractual, and internal requirements.
* Accuracy and timely submission of MIS reports.
* Timely billing, effective receivables follow-up, and reduction in outstanding payments.
* Client satisfaction and effective stakeholder coordination.
* Identification of new business opportunities and achievement of regional business targets.
* Effective team leadership, resource utilization, and team performance.
* Timely resolution of operational and commercial issues.

**6. Overall Accountability**

The Regional Manager will be responsible for the overall operational performance, project execution, client relationships, team management, billing and receivables coordination, compliance, and business development activities across Kolkata and Eastern India, ensuring efficient execution of projects and achievement of organizational objectives.

description:
**Manufacturing Engineering Manager - Operations Management**
**Job Description**
**Partner the Best**
As a Manufacturing Engineering Leader, you will oversee and mentor the local Manufacturing Engineering team, ensuring they support existing and future product lines effectively. You will provide valuable advice and guidance to support our manufacturing activities. You will mentor a team to achieve high levels of reliability and consistency on the production line. You will play a strategic role in developing and implementing continuous improvements to our processes to ensure we create quality products.
  
  
**As Manufacturing Engineering Leader, you will be responsible for:**

* Manage multiple projects at various stages simultaneously, from defining scope and developing concepts to build, testing, and implementation.
* Plan and lead the installation and sequencing of machines, workstations, tools, and parts to maximize production efficiency.
* Ensure continuous business improvement according to benchmarks and standards.
* Conducting frequent interactions on manager level with Engineering, Shop Floor Leader, Project Management, Quality, HSE and enabling functions about technical and organizational alignment.
* Handling complex manufacturing processes. Manufacturing department has to define approaches. Variety due to customization to client needs.
* Strong Experience as Fabrication and Welding Shop Leader is preferred with following attributes:
* Manage daily fabrication, joint fit-ups, and welding operations to meet production schedules, safety rules, and quality standards
* SMAW (Shielded Metal Arc Welding), MIG/MAG, and FCAW (Flux-Cored Arc Welding), ensuring correct parameters and approved Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS) are followed.
* Check joint preparation, fit-up alignment, distortion control, and coordinate with QC (Quality Control) inspectors for visual checks and Non-Destructive Testing (NDT).
* Relevant welding or supervisory certifications (such as AWS, CWB, or ASME-aligned qualifications) will be preferred.

* Have a bachelor’s degree in mechanical with minimum 12-15 years’ experience in a related field or demonstrate equivalent, professional work experience

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The successful candidate will lead and deliver ICT, Audio Visual (AV), Security, and Extra Low Voltage (ELV) design and consultancy services across a diverse range of projects. * ICT / Data and Network Infrastructure
* Structured Cabling and Wireless Network Systems
* CCTV / Video Surveillance Systems
* Access Control and Intrusion Detection Systems
* Intercom and Video Intercom Systems
* Audio Visual (AV) Systems
* Smart Building / IoT Systems
* Extra Low Voltage (ELV) Infrastructure
* Multidisciplinary Design Coordination
* Design Drawings, Specifications, and Equipment Schedules
* Tender Documentation and Technical Submissions
* BIM Coordination, Clash Detection, and Constructability Reviews
* Application of Relevant Standards, Regulations, and Industry Guidelines

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related discipline.
* 13–15 years of relevant experience in ICT, AV, Security, and ELV design consultancy.
* Strong technical knowledge of ICT infrastructure, structured cabling, security systems, AV systems, and integrated ELV solutions.
* Proven experience in leading engineering teams and managing design deliverables across multiple projects.
* Strong understanding of BIM workflows, multidisciplinary coordination, and clash detection processes.
* Experience in preparing design reports, technical specifications, tender documents, and detailed engineering drawings.
* Familiarity with applicable international standards, local regulations, authority requirements, and industry best practices.
* Experience working on Middle East projects is highly desirable.
* Excellent technical report-writing, communication, client management, and presentation skills.
* Strong project management, resource planning, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain high standards of technical quality.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning.
* Exposure to diverse and high-profile projects.
* A collaborative and supportive working environment.
* Opportunities to lead technical teams and contribute to the growth of the business.
* Career progression within a growing consultancy organization.

Interested candidates should submit their CV and a short cover letter outlining their relevant experience, qualifications, technical expertise, and key project portfolio to heyhr@designconfidence.me.

title: Lead Salesforce
description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
**About the Role**
We are seeking an experienced and highly capable
**Salesforce Lead**
to drive the technical delivery of our next-generation
**Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform**
powered by Salesforce, Agentforce, AI, Data Cloud, and MuleSoft.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical leadership role for professionals who can
**lead development teams, guide solution design, mentor developers and senior developers, and closely partner with architects to deliver scalable enterprise solutions**
. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce platform expertise with strong people leadership, delivery ownership, and architectural thinking.
  
  
As a Salesforce Lead, you will be responsible for translating business and platform strategy into high-quality technical solutions while ensuring adherence to architecture, governance, security, and engineering best practices. You will lead cross-functional teams building intelligent service management experiences across Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Agentforce, Enterprise Service Management (ESM), ITSM, CMDB, IT Asset Management, and enterprise integrations.
  
  
This role offers an opportunity to play a key leadership position in shaping the future of AI-powered service management and conversational enterprise platforms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead a team of Salesforce Developers and Senior Salesforce Developers across multiple workstreams.
* Provide technical leadership throughout the full software development lifecycle, from solution design to production deployment.
* Partner closely with Salesforce Architects to translate architectural vision into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
* Own technical delivery, ensuring solutions meet business, security, scalability, and performance requirements.
* Drive estimation, sprint planning, technical task allocation, and delivery execution.
* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and architecture compliance reviews.
* Establish and enforce Salesforce development standards, coding conventions, CI/CD processes, and governance frameworks.

**Solution Design & Development**

* Lead the design and development of Salesforce solutions supporting the organization's Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform.
* Design scalable solutions leveraging Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Platform, and Agentforce capabilities.
* Build intelligent service experiences utilizing Agentforce, AI-driven workflows, conversational experiences, and autonomous service capabilities.
* Design and develop complex solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, Platform Events, Integration Patterns, and Salesforce APIs.
* Guide implementation of enterprise service management processes including:

+ Incident Management
+ Service Request Management
+ Change Management
+ Problem Management
+ Knowledge Management
+ Employee Support Services
+ CMDB Management
+ IT Asset Management
+ Service Catalog Management

**Integration & Enterprise Architecture**

* Lead enterprise integration initiatives using MuleSoft and API-led connectivity patterns.
* Design reusable integration frameworks connecting Salesforce with ITSM, ERP, HR, Monitoring, Collaboration, Identity, and Business Systems.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects and integration teams to ensure platform interoperability and data consistency.
* Drive API governance, performance optimization, security controls, and integration best practices.

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**

* Mentor Salesforce Developers and Senior Developers through coaching, design guidance, and hands-on technical support.
* Support career development and capability building within the Salesforce team.
* Identify skill gaps and define technical learning and certification roadmaps.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Act as the primary technical escalation point for complex solution and production challenges.

**AI & Platform Innovation**

* Champion adoption of Agentforce, Generative AI, Data Cloud, and emerging Salesforce innovations.
* Guide implementation of conversational AI, agentic workflows, intelligent automation, and self-service experiences.
* Evaluate new platform capabilities and recommend innovative solutions that improve service delivery and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to strategic platform roadmaps and technology decision-making.

**Required Qualifications**
**Must Have**

* 7 to 10 years of Salesforce platform experience with at least 2-3 years in a technical lead role.
* Strong hands-on expertise across:

+ Service Cloud
+ Sales Cloud
+ Experience Cloud
+ Salesforce Platform

* Deep technical expertise in:

+ Apex
+ Lightning Web Components (LWC)
+ Salesforce Flows
+ SOQL/SOSL
+ Platform Events
+ Integration Patterns
+ REST/SOAP APIs
+ Salesforce Security Model

* Strong experience with large-scale Salesforce implementations and enterprise delivery programs.
* Experience leading and mentoring development teams.
* Experience working alongside solution architects and enterprise architects.
* Proven ability to drive technical decision-making and delivery governance.
* Strong understanding of:

+ Data Architecture
+ Security & Sharing Models
+ DevOps & CI/CD
+ Release Management
+ Application Lifecycle Management

* Experience in Agile, Scrum, and DevOps-driven environments.
* Strong stakeholder communication and leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing Enterprise Service Management (ESM) and IT Service Management (ITSM) solutions.
* Experience with:

+ CMDB
+ IT Asset Management (ITAM)
+ Service Catalog
+ Enterprise Operations Management

* Hands-on experience with MuleSoft and API Management.
* Experience working in global delivery models.
* Salesforce Platform Developer I & II Certifications.
* Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect Certification.
* Scrum Master, SAFe, or Agile certifications.

**Added Advantage**

* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce.
* Experience building Conversational AI and autonomous service experiences.
* Exposure to Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts.
* Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud.
* Experience delivering Digital Transformation and Enterprise Automation initiatives.
* Knowledge of Service Operations, ITIL, or Enterprise Service Management frameworks.

**What We Are Looking For**
We are seeking professionals who:
  
  

* Think like technical leaders while remaining hands-on contributors.
* Can successfully lead teams while maintaining a strong engineering mindset.
* Are comfortable partnering with architects and influencing platform strategy.
* Enjoy solving complex enterprise-scale technology challenges.
* Can balance delivery excellence, innovation, governance, and stakeholder expectations.
* Are passionate about Agentforce, AI, Conversational Platforms, and Intelligent Automation.
* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and strong decision-making capabilities.
* Thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

**Why Join Us?**

* Lead the technical delivery of a strategic Salesforce-powered Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform.
* Work with cutting-edge technologies including Agentforce, AI, Data Cloud, MuleSoft, and Enterprise Automation.
* Influence platform architecture and engineering direction.
* Lead and mentor a high-performing Salesforce engineering team.
* Collaborate with architects, integration specialists, AI engineers, and business leaders.
* Accelerate your career toward Solution Architect and Engineering Leadership pathways.
* Be part of a rapidly growing organization where innovation and impact are valued.

**Join Us ?**
If you are a seasoned Salesforce professional with a passion for technical leadership, team mentoring, enterprise-scale solution delivery, and AI-driven innovation, we invite you to join us in building the future of
**Conversational Agentic ITSM on Salesforce**
. This role offers the opportunity to combine
**technical excellence, people leadership, and architectural influence**
while shaping a transformative platform that redefines enterprise service management.
  
  
**Compensation**
Estimated Pay Range:
  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.

title: Manager - Education Loan
description:
**Location Name:**
Paravur
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Assess Education Loan applications independently and consistently, balancing customer eligibility, repayment capacity, academic and employability factors, collateral support, legal and technical acceptability, and portfolio quality.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Review applicant and co-applicant identity, relationship, academics, admission, institution, course, country, test scores and requested funding.
* Assess income, banking, bureau, obligations, repayment capacity and policy eligibility.
* Evaluate cost of education, scholarships, margin or own contribution, living expenses and the proposed loan amount.
* Assess secured and unsecured structures, including property, gold or other approved collateral, through applicable reports and controls.
* Own or review Legal and Technical Assessment requirements for secured cases and ensure satisfactory reports are available before progressing the credit decision.
* Engage and coordinate with approved third-party valuers and lawyers to facilitate timely valuation, technical and legal reports; review report validity, observations, conditions and exceptions for credit consideration.
* Review verification outcomes, fraud indicators, deviations and mitigants, and raise evidence-based queries.
* Prepare or validate credit assessment notes, recommendations, sanction conditions and deviation matrices.
* Decide, recommend, refer or decline cases within the approved credit authority matrix and ensure complete decision audit trail.
* Monitor underwriting quality, approval, rejection and deviation trends, turnaround time, productivity and portfolio feedback.
* Coordinate with Sales, Risk, Operations, RCU, Collections, Legal, Technical, collateral teams and external service providers while preserving independent credit judgement.
* Provide market and portfolio feedback for policy refinement, process improvement and new product launches.
* Own the assigned credit work queue and resolve day-to-day case queries.
* Maintain accurate system records and escalate material exceptions beyond delegated authority.

**Key Decisions / Dimensions**

* Approve, recommend, refer or decline cases strictly within the approved credit authority matrix and risk policy.
* Assess the acceptability of legal, technical, valuation and collateral observations for credit decisioning within delegated authority.
* Escalate title, valuation, technical, fraud, policy, compliance and other material exceptions to the prescribed authority.
* Numeric sanction and deviation authorities are to be defined in the approved delegation matrix.

Key interactions
  
  
Internal Sales, Product, Risk, Operations, RCU/Fraud Control, Collections, Legal, Technical, Collateral, Compliance, Finance, Technology and COE.
  
  
External Students, co-applicants, approved valuers, lawyers, legal and technical agencies, verification partners and other approved service providers.
  
  
**Major Challenges**

* Balancing growth, customer experience, turnaround time and portfolio quality.
* Managing incomplete or inconsistent academic, financial, collateral, legal and technical information.
* Coordinating internal teams and third-party agencies while maintaining independent credit judgement.
* Identifying and resolving adverse legal, technical, valuation, fraud or policy observations within defined authority.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**
Graduate or postgraduate in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Management or a related discipline. 1-3 years of relevant experience in credit appraisal, underwriting, secured/unsecured lending or financial services; Education Loan exposure preferred.
  
  
Critical skills and knowledge
  
  

* Credit appraisal and financial analysis
* Bureau, banking and income assessment
* Academic and employability assessment
* Secured and unsecured lending
* Legal and Technical report interpretation
* Property valuation, collateral and title-risk awareness
* Third-party valuer, lawyer and vendor coordination
* Fraud-risk awareness and decision writing
* Excel, presentation and business MIS capability

This role provides accounting and financial analysis support within a centralized Finance Shared Services organization, supporting a portfolio of 500+ extended stay hotels. Reporting to the Finance Shared Services Manager, the position is responsible for preparing journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, financial analyses, and reporting in accordance with U.S. GAAP, company policies, and internal controls.
  
  
The role serves as a key preparer supporting monthly close, audits, budgeting/forecasting support, and ad hoc financial analysis, while partnering closely with U.S.-based accounting, FP&A, and operations teams. * Perform monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities in a timely and accurate manner.
* Prepare BS account reconciliations, investigate variances, and resolve reconciling items.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of financial data prior to submission to corporate finance.
* Maintain supporting documentation for all journal entries and reconciliations in compliance with internal controls.

**Financial Analysis & Reporting Support**

* Prepare standard and ad hoc financial reporting, including trend analysis and variance explanations.
* Support FP&A teams with actuals analysis to inform forecasts, budgets, and long‑range planning.
* Assist in the preparation and validation of data used in management reporting and dashboards.
* Analyze financial data across systems to identify unusual trends, risks, or improvement opportunities.
* Respond to routine analytical requests from finance and operations stakeholders.

**Audit & Compliance Support**

* Prepare audit schedules and supporting documentation for external audits.
* Respond to auditor inquiries and assist in resolution of audit requests.
* Ensure compliance with accounting policies, procedures, and internal control requirements.

**Process Improvement & Systems Support**

* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and standardization within accounting processes.
* Assist with implementation of process improvements, automation initiatives, and system enhancements, including AI-enabled tools.
* Support testing and validation activities related to system upgrades or process changes.
* Ensure data integrity across ERP and reporting tools.

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Support**

* Partner effectively with U.S.-based finance, accounting, and operations teams.

**Other Duties**

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Competencies**
