title: Fixed Income Derivatives Sales Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
Support EMEA Fixed Income Derivatives Sales with pricing, structuring, analytics, and client materials; automate workflows
  
  
As a Fixed Income Derivatives Sales Analyst within the EMEA Sales team (Markets Group, CIB Research & Analytics) you will be responsible for supporting sales coverage through interest rate hedging and derivatives solutions for corporate clients. You will structure and price vanilla and bespoke derivatives using internal models, run analytics, and quantify key market and credit risks. You will work on trade ideas and client-ready strategies by synthesizing macro drivers and internal/external research and analysing payoff profiles for client objectives. You will create tailored client materials (pitchbooks, factsheets, and market analysis) and articulate product rationale in the current environment. You will support end-to-end trade execution and lifecycle processes while driving automation and process improvements using Python/VBA.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support Fixed Income Derivatives sales/marketing coverage by understanding client objectives and identifying suitable interest rate hedging and derivatives solutions for corporate clients
* Structure and price derivative solutions (vanilla and bespoke) using internal flow pricing models and by combining option strategies, and run relevant analytics to support pricing metrics and quantify market/credit risks
* Generate trade ideas and client-ready strategies by synthesizing macroeconomic drivers and external/internal research, and optimizing payoff profiles for the target client base
* Create client materials for meetings including tailored pitchbooks/factsheets and market analysis, articulate product rationale for the current environment and backtest strategy outcomes where applicable
* Manage end-to-end trade support across the lifecycle including instrument setup/creation, booking support, term sheet preparation, note issuance coordination, and responding to post-trade client queries (settlements, lifecycle calculations, reconciliations, and documentation checks)
* Drive process improvement and automation for the sales team by building tools to streamline recurring workflows and daily tasks using Python/VBA

**Required Qualifications, Skills And Capabilities**

* Strong knowledge of derivatives and greeks – indices, futures, and options
* Strong knowledge of Equities, Rates, FX, and Commodities
* Knowledge of VBA and any object-oriented programming language (specifically Python)
* Close attention to detail and ability to work at very high standards of precision
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with Strong quantitative and analytical skills
* Good communication and team skills in a multi-location set up

**Preferred Qualifications, Skills And Capabilities**

* Clear, logical thinker with strong qualitative skill set
* Strong team player that partners well with stakeholders

Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

**Job Description:**
====================

**About Russell Investments, Mumbai**

Russell Investments is a leading global investment solutions partner providing a wide range of investment capabilities to institutional investors, financial intermediaries, and individual investors around the world. Since 1936, Russell Investments has been building a legacy of continuous innovation to deliver exceptional value to clients, working every day to improve people’s financial security. Headquartered in Seattle, Washington, Russell Investments has offices in 17 cities around the world.

Joining the new Mumbai office is an incredible opportunity to work closely with global stakeholders to support the technology and infrastructure that drives the investment and trading processes of a globally recognized asset management firm. Be one of the first to join this new team based out of Goregaon (East) in Mumbai and be a part of creating the foundation and culture for the firm’s growing operations in India. The Mumbai office operates 5-days a week from Monday to Friday with varying shifts to accommodate time zones around the world.

For more information, please visit www.russellinvestments.com.

**Role Summary**

This position's primary responsibility will be for evaluating and monitoring the creditworthiness of corporations within the investment grade spectrum. Primary focus will involve assessing financial data, company filings, industry trends, and market conditions to make informed recommendations regarding credit risks and opportunities within a portfolio of investment grade companies. The Credit Analyst is also responsible for making presentations to the Rating Committee with credit opinions and internal rating recommendations. This position also identifies developing credit concerns before they negatively impact the portfolios and identifies potential additions to the Approved List.

**Years of Experience**

3 to 5 years’ experience in credit analysis within the investment, banking, or insurance industries.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance or related field. MBA or CFA designation highly preferred.

**Responsibilities**

* Fundamental credit research of investment grade corporate credits, primarily financial institutions (banks).
* Ongoing surveillance and monitoring of assigned credits which may include Asset Backed Commercial Paper (ABCP) and Asset Backed Securities (ABS).
* Timely credit research and financial analysis in response to trading and portfolio management proposals for investments in new-issue and secondary investment opportunities.
* Ensuring consistency of the credit research process, while seeking on going enhancements and efficiencies to the research process which meets the needs of all stakeholders.
* Exposure analysis and credit risk measurement.
* Ability to manage a significant amount of data and support database design and management for credit research, ratio and trend analyses, and management reporting.
* Ad hoc credit risk projects as required.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Keen eye for detail, a deep understanding of financial markets, and the ability to interpret complex data to make informed credit decisions.
* Excellent qualitative and quantitative financial analysis skills.
* Critical thinker.
* Ability to leverage tools such as Excel, Bloomberg, to drive efficient, credit monitoring.
* Experience with risk management principals and techniques such as VaR and Stress Testing.
* Proven database skills.
* Outstanding people skills with the ability to convey credit opinions and concerns effectively and efficiently.
* A strong individual contributor with the ability to work independently with minimal supervision, but also be able to work and collaborate as part of a team.
* Strong work ethic with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities.
* Work proactively with portfolio managers and other key stakeholders.

**Core Values**

* Strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication and collaboration skills with all levels of management
* Strong organizational skills including the ability to adapt to shifting priorities and meet frequent deadlines,
* Demonstrated proactive approach to problem-solving with strong judgment and decision-making capability.
* Highly resourceful and collaborative team-player, with the ability to also be independently effective and exude initiative and a sense of urgency.
* Exemplifies our customer-focused, action-oriented, results-driven culture.
* Forward looking thinker, who actively seeks opportunities, has a desire for continuous learning, and proposes solutions.
* Ability to act with discretion and maintain complete confidentiality.
* Dedicated to the firm’s values of non-negotiable integrity, valuing our people, exceeding client expectations, and embracing intellectual curiosity and rigor.

You're the person who turns numbers into decisions. A patient pays an advance in USD, a partner hospital in Turkey needs a payout, and the founders ask, “Are we actually making money on this case?” You're the one with the answer.

As Business Finance Manager, you will own budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance across CureMeAbroad. You will partner with sales, operations, and the founding team to plan expenditure, protect margins across our 350+ partner network, and maintain predictable cash flow.

Your core mission is to turn financial data into clear, actionable business plans.

**# KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Budgeting & Forecasting**

Own the annual budgeting cycle and develop rolling financial forecasts.

Conduct monthly budget-versus-actual reviews and drive corrective actions based on variances.

**2. Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)**

Build financial models for new markets, partnerships, and pricing strategies.

Analyse unit economics across individual patient cases, countries, and partner hospitals.

**3. Business Partnering**

Partner with sales, operations, and marketing teams on financial planning and decision-making.

Evaluate business cases, track Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and channel ROI, and support negotiations with hospitals and vendors.

**4. Cash Flow & Treasury Management**

Manage cash flow, working capital, and financial liquidity.

Monitor foreign exchange (FX) exposure and oversee the reconciliation of patient payments, refunds, and partner payouts.

**5. Reporting, Controls & Compliance**

Ensure accurate monthly financial closes and management information system (MIS) reporting.

Strengthen financial controls, approval workflows, and internal processes.

Support GST, TDS, FEMA/RBI compliance, audits, and investor reporting.

**6. Team Management & Systems**

Mentor and guide finance executives.

Improve financial reporting tools, automation, and processes to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

Requirements & Qualifications

**# Experience:**

2–6 years of experience in FP&A, business finance, or financial controllership.

**# Education:**

CA, CMA, MBA (Finance), or an equivalent qualification.

**# Financial Expertise:**

Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling, and translating financial analysis into actionable business decisions.

**# International Finance:**

Hands-on experience with multi-currency transactions, cross-border payment flows, foreign exchange, and relevant regulatory requirements.

**# Tools & Technology:**

Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills, experience with Tally, Zoho Books, QuickBooks, SAP, or similar accounting systems, and familiarity with BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau.

**# Accounting & Compliance:**

Working knowledge of Indian accounting standards, GST, TDS, and FEMA/RBI requirements.

**# Communication & Ownership:**

Strong communication and analytical skills, with the ability to explain financial insights to non-finance stakeholders. High ownership, integrity, and discretion in handling sensitive financial data are essential.

**# Preferred Experience:**

Experience in a startup, healthcare, travel, or marketplace business. Exposure to fundraising and investor reporting will be an added advantage.

**# Why Join CureMeAbroad?
﻿**

**Global Impact:**
Be part of a global medical tourism technology and discovery platform connecting patients from high-cost markets such as the US, UK, Germany, and Australia with verified hospitals and surgeons across India, Turkey, Thailand, Mexico, and Spain.

**Fast-Paced Growth:**
Join a fast-scaling global medical tourism brand.

**High Ownership:**
Take ownership of financial planning and performance, with a direct influence on business decisions and growth.

**Leadership Exposure:**
Work directly with the founding team on live deals, international markets, and real business growth targets.

title: Senior Executive – Finance & Business Operations
description:
**About E42.ai**

E42.ai is a VC-backed AI company building a no-code enterprise Cognitive Process Automation (CPA) platform. Our AI coworkers automate processes across Finance, HR, Marketing, Customer Care and other enterprise functions. We work with 50+ enterprise customers globally, including Fortune 500 companies, and are a NASSCOM Deep Tech member. Our platform has been featured in IDC and Gartner reports and recognized by partners such as Microsoft, Oracle, SAP and NVIDIA.
 

**We are growing fast, and our internal teams are expected to work the way our customers will: efficiently, with automation, and with strong controls.**

 

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a detail-oriented, hands-on finance professional to run our day-to-day accounting and compliance, and to act as a dependable support partner to our HR and Admin teams. You will own the accuracy of our books, keep us compliant with Indian statutory requirements, and help leadership with timely financial insight. You will be comfortable with AI tools and eager to use them to cut manual effort in routine work.

* **Title:**
  Senior Executive – Finance & Business Operations
* **Department:**
  Finance & Accounts (with cross-functional support to HR and Admin)
* **Location:**
  Pune
* **Employment type:**
  Permanent, full-time
* **Experience:**
  3–5 years

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Accounting and Reporting (core)**

* Maintain accurate books of accounts and ensure complete documentation for all transactions.
* Manage the general ledger, journal entries, month-end and year-end closing.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements and management reports.
* Perform bank reconciliations and manage accounts payable and receivable, including vendor payments, invoicing and collections follow-up.
* Monitor company expenses and review reimbursements against policy.
* Maintain financial databases, trackers, spreadsheets and reporting tools.

**2. Taxation and Statutory Compliance**

* Prepare and file GST returns, and handle TDS computation, deduction, deposit and return filing.
* Support income tax filings, advance tax and other statutory requirements.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax regulations and company policy.
* Maintain a compliance calendar and make sure no due dates are missed.

**3. Audit and Controls**

* Coordinate with statutory, internal and tax auditors, and respond to audit queries on time.
* Implement and maintain internal financial controls, approval workflows and documentation standards.
* Identify gaps in processes and propose practical fixes.

**4. Analysis, Budgeting and Forecasting**

* Conduct financial analysis and prepare budget vs actual variance reports.
* Assist with budgeting, cash flow monitoring and financial forecasting.
* Provide management with clear, accurate financial insights and summaries.

**5. Contracts and Commercial Support**

* Support preparation of basic contracts and agreements using approved templates.
* Read and summaries client and vendor contracts, highlighting payment terms, billing milestones, taxes and other financial obligations for management and legal review.
* Track contract renewals and billing schedules.

Note: This role supports contract preparation and review but does not replace legal counsel. Final legal vetting stays with management or external advisors.
 

**6. AI and Process Improvement**

* Use AI tools and automation to reduce manual work in reconciliations, reporting, data entry and document review.
* Suggest and help implement process improvements across finance, HR and admin
  workflows.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

**Must have**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance or a related field.
* 3–5 years of professional accounting experience, including financial reporting, account reconciliation, taxation and audit support.
* Strong grasp of accounting principles and financial processes.
* Working knowledge of Indian taxation, including GST and TDS.
* Advanced MS Excel skills (formulas, pivot tables, lookups, financial reporting).
* Proficiency in Tally, QuickBooks, Zoho Books or similar accounting software.
* Comfort with AI tools (for example ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or similar) for everyday work.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with excellent attention to detail.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.

**Good to have**

* CA Inter, CMA, MBA (Finance) or other relevant certifications.
* Exposure to payroll and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, PT).
* Experience reading or drafting commercial contracts.
* Prior experience in a technology, SaaS or startup environment.
* Experience with ERP or cloud finance tools and basic automation.
* Understanding about HR process and support whenever needed.

**Behavioral skills**

* Strong ownership and ability to work independently, with minimal supervision.
* Good time management and reliability in meeting deadlines.
* Flexibility to switch between finance, HR and admin tasks without losing accuracy.
* Collaborative and approachable when working with teams across functions.
* Discretion in handling confidential financial and employee information.

**What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)**

* Monthly books closed within an agreed timeline, with clean reconciliations.
* Zero missed statutory deadlines for GST, TDS and payroll compliances.
* Smooth, low-query audits.
* At least a few routine finance or HR/Admin processes simplified using AI or automation.
* HR and Admin teams see Finance as a reliable and responsive partner.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work at the centre of a fast-growing AI company.
* Exposure across finance, HR, admin and commercial functions, with room to grow into a broader business operations or finance leadership role.
* Compensation: Market Standards.

description:
The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) works for a world where everyone has access to affordable, reliable, clean electricity and the means to use it to improve their lives. Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. With work in more than 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, our Alliance aims to reach 1 billion people with clean electricity, prevent 4 billion tons of carbon emissions and create or improve 150 million jobs.
  
  
**Contract type: Fulltime, Open ended**
**Reports Directly To**
Direct Reports:
  
  
**Matrix/Dual Reports**
Chief Impact Officer
  
  
None
  
  
VP, India; MD, Grids of the Future
  
  
**Overview Of The Role**
Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet’s goals are bold and audacious. We recognize that the path to a just energy transition worldwide will be complex, non-linear, and filled with successes and opportunities, alongside failures and challenges. The Manager, Impact, India and Southeast Asia will support our effort to measure our contribution to impact through evaluations, monitoring and learning. Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) is embedded within our operating model, to ensure that we have an ear to the ground so we remain responsive and opportunistic, while generating insights that support continuous improvement.
  
  
Stepping into a start-up environment, the Manager, Impact, India and Southeast Asia will lead monitoring, evaluation and learning for the India and Southeast Asia portfolio, guided by the organization’s Impact framework. They will also lead impact measurement for the Grids of the Future pillar across all regions, and provide monitoring and analytics support across the global portfolio. They will be responsible for independently establishing the routine and long-term work component of these workstreams, ensuring that they are efficiently managed and executed.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
  
  

+ Monitoring: Providing backend impact data quality assurance for all India and Southeast Asia transactions. Provide technical advice on target setting, indicators, theory of change mechanisms, causality links for the India and Southeast Asia portfolio. Onboard and train program teams on results monitoring sheets – ensuring compliance. They will also support the monitoring function across the global portfolio, including data compilation, quality checks and analytics for quarterly impact reporting, working alongside the Alliance’s external monitoring and learning partner.
+ Grids of the Future impact: Leading impact measurement for the Grids of the Future pillar across all regions. Developing and maintaining expected-impact estimates for utility partnerships, grid digitalization, battery energy storage and distributed energy resource programs, working with program teams and external modelling partners. Tracking realized impact against expected impact as programs move through the pipeline, and designing evaluations of utility-level outcomes such as reliability, losses and effects on consumers.
+ Evaluation: Sourcing and managing independent evaluation partners working closely with the Director of Evaluation. Establishing the pulse on what needs evaluation and when by closely working with the India and Southeast Asia and Grids of the Future teams in sourcing evaluation questions. Selecting fit for purpose evaluation approaches and tools and sense checking their design and functionality.
+ Learning: Support the team in designing and managing ongoing reflection, sense-making, and learning from the work to inform potential shifts in strategy when necessary, using data and evidence to rationalize change.
+ Capacity building: Onboarding, training and operationalizing Impact functions in country teams, solution teams and hiring monitoring evaluation and learning consultants. description:

o own the end-to-end performance of this unified vertical on DigiHaat. The type of transactions we currently work on range from multifamily apartment complexes to large office towers in the United States and European markets and range in value sizes from $10 million USD - $200 million+ USD.
  
  
**About The Role**
A hands-on role owning the resident revenue cycle from move-in through move-out for an assigned group of US properties. You will set up new leases in Yardi, apply daily cash, keep tenant ledgers accurate, manage delinquency and deposit accounting, and complete the monthly GPR, accrual and AR reconciliation work that supports the financial statements — partnering daily with US site teams and property management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* 1. Move-Ins & New Resident Setup — Audit every new move-in in Yardi against the executed lease. Post prorated rent, deposits, admin, pet, parking and utility charges, and set up concessions and recurring charge schedules correctly the first time.
* 2. Cash Application & Tenant Ledgers — Apply lockbox, ACH, portal, check and money order receipts daily. Clear unapplied and suspense items, and correct misapplied payments, duplicate charges and open credits with documented adjustments.
* 3. Delinquency & Collections — Review aging by property, assess late fees per lease and local ordinance, track payment plans and rental assistance, support notices and legal referrals, and recommend approved write-offs.
* 4. Move-Outs & Deposit Accounting (SODA) — Finalize move-out ledgers and issue SODA statements within the statutory deadline. Research disputes, issue corrections, and manage former-resident balances and the collections handoff.
* 5. GPR & Accruals — Review GPR daily for market rent, lease rent, loss-to-lease, vacancy and concession accuracy. Post and review monthly GPR accruals including vacancy loss, concessions and bad debt.
* 6. Month-End Close & Reconciliations — Reconcile the AR subledger to the GL, along with prepaid rent and deposit liability. Deliver the AR close package and revenue variance commentary per the close calendar.
* 7. Reporting & Stakeholder Support — Distribute delinquency, move-in/move-out and receivable reporting with exceptions flagged, and support audit, owner and lender requests with ledgers and documentation.
* 8. Process & Team Support — Keep AR, move-in and SODA procedures documented, drive down rework, and train and review junior AR staff on setup, cash application and corrections.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* Semi-Qualified CA / CA Qualified; CPA preferred
* 1-2 years of accounts receivable experience, with US real estate property management accounting
* Hands-on Yardi Voyager — resident ledgers, charge codes, receipts, move-in/move-out functions and AR reporting
* Proficient in Excel — pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS and reconciliations on large ledger exports
* Comfortable working in the US accounting night shift (5.30 PM to 2.30 AM)
* Good English communication, written and verbal
* Working knowledge of lease terms, prorations, concessions and security deposit rules

**Core Skills**

* Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline
* Ability to manage deadlines in a high-volume, multi-property environment
* Problem-solving on ledger exceptions and reconciling items
* Clear communication with US site teams, property managers and residents

title: Analyst
description:
**The Role**
As our Analyst, you'll be the analytical engine behind our online sales and paid acquisition. You'll track how every channel performs, find where we're winning or wasting spend, and give marketing, merchandising, and leadership clear recommendations. The role suits someone equally comfortable in a spreadsheet, a SQL editor, and a conversation with a media buyer.
  
  
**Compensation**
: Indian Rupee $70,000 - $100,000 montly
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own reporting on ecommerce performance (traffic, conversion rate, AOV, revenue, margin) and paid media (ROAS, CAC, CPA, CTR, CPM) across Google, Meta, TikTok, Amazon Ads, affiliates, and other channels.
* Build and maintain dashboards in [Looker Studio / Tableau / Power BI] that give teams a single source of truth.
* Analyze campaign and channel performance, and recommend budget allocation and bid, audience, and creative optimizations.
* Design, run, and read A/B tests on landing pages, site experience, promotions, and ad creative.
* Evaluate attribution across channels using platform data, GA4, and incrementality or MMM approaches where available.
* Analyze customer behavior, including cohorts, retention, lifetime value (LTV), repeat purchase rates, and LTV:CAC by channel.
* Support merchandising and promotional planning with product, category, pricing, and discount performance analysis.
* Forecast revenue and marketing spend for weekly, monthly, and seasonal peaks such as Black Friday/Cyber Monday and holidays.
* Audit tracking and data quality (pixels, UTMs, conversion APIs, GA4 events) with marketing and engineering.
* Present findings to non-technical stakeholders with clear, actionable recommendations.

**What You Bring**

* 2-4 years of experience in ecommerce, digital marketing, or retail analytics.
* Strong SQL skills and advanced Excel/Google Sheets.
* Hands-on experience with GA4 and at least two major ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, Amazon Advertising).
* Experience building dashboards in a BI tool.
* Solid grasp of performance marketing metrics, funnel analysis, and attribution concepts.
* Working knowledge of A/B testing and basic statistics (significance, sample size).
* The ability to explain complex data simply and turn analysis into a clear "here's what we should do."
* Attention to detail and a healthy skepticism about data quality.

**Nice to Have**

* Python or R for analysis or automation.
* Experience with Shopify, Magento/Adobe Commerce, or Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
* Familiarity with marketing mix modeling, incrementality testing, or tools like Northbeam, Triple Whale, or Rockerbox.
* Experience with CRM and email/SMS platforms (Klaviyo, Braze, Attentive).
* Experience with data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake) and dbt.

title: Impact Manager (Full-time / Remote)
description:
**About Generation:**

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have an 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

**JOB OBJECTIVES:**

The Impact Manager will strengthen Generation’s ability to measure, evaluate, and communicate durable impact across the global network. Reporting to the Lead, Impact Evaluation & Data Advocacy, this role will lead durability measurement and evaluation workstreams, deliver instruction and content for the Durability Academy, and serve as global D&I’s day-to-day counterpart on APAC and SAMEA.

This role combines research rigor, structured problem-solving, and the ability to teach and coach. The Impact Manager will independently own defined evaluation, research, and insight workstreams, manage vendor and research partner relationships, coach Durability Academy partner organizations, and produce high-quality materials for Generation leadership, country CEOs, and funders.

This is a remote position, based in the SAMEA region (India preferred).

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Durability & Impact Evaluation**

* Lead defined cross-country durability analyses (employment, earnings, job quality, financial health, and related metrics), from framing through final outputs
* Shape evaluation framing, research design, and methodological comparability across countries and program models
* Manage evaluations and research partnerships end to end, including scoping, vendor procurement, contracting support, data-sharing processes, and quality of deliverables
* Own evaluation briefs, synthesis memos, and funder-ready materials
* Ensure durability insights are grounded in consistent and reliable underlying data

**Durability Academy Instruction & Content**

* Co-facilitate cohort-wide Durability Academy sessions, taking ownership of selected modules over time
* Serve as a 1:1 coach for a portfolio of cohort partner organizations, guiding them through their theory of change, durability logframe, and measurement plans
* Maintain and improve Academy content between cohorts, including module materials, milestone documents, logframe templates, and facilitation guides
* Turn cohort work into reusable examples, case material, and practical guidance for future cohorts and the wider Durability Collective

**APAC & India Impact Priorities**

* Act as global D&I's day-to-day counterpart to Generation India and other APAC teams on evaluation, data, and impact priorities
* Coordinate regional evaluations and research partnerships, ensuring alignment with global methodology and standards
* Support regional teams on outcomes data, cost-per-learner and ROI inputs, and funder reporting
* Support onboarding and alignment of regional impact leads with global D&I tools and ways of working
* Surface regional insights and needs to D&I leadership to inform priorities and planning

**Structured Analysis & Insight Communication**

* Translate ambiguous leadership and funder questions into structured analytical approaches, and lead the resulting analyses
* Develop high-quality slide decks, workshop materials, and written summaries for Generation leadership, country CEOs, and funders
* Shape coherent impact narratives across decks, reports, and external-facing materials
* Contribute evidence, data, and methodology inputs to grant proposals and funder engagement

**Cross-Functional Delivery & Team Support**

* Manage timelines, deliverables, and dependencies across D&I workstreams, proactively flagging risks and reporting progress
* Partner with Impact Operations and Analytics colleagues to improve the clarity and consistency of core metrics (e.g., placement, durability indicators, income, living wage, ROI)
* Provide guidance and quality review for analyst-level work as needed
* Support D&I team operations such as recruitment and onboarding

**ATTRIBUTES (e.g. qualifications, knowledge, skills, and experience):**

***Required experience and skills:***

* 5+ years of experience in impact evaluation, monitoring & evaluation, research, analytics, consulting, policy, or related fields
* Track record of independently owning evaluation, research, or analytical workstreams from framing to delivery
* Experience managing external vendors, research partners, or academic collaborators
* Experience facilitating workshops, training, or coaching for professional audiences
* Strong structured thinking and the ability to synthesize complex information into clear insights
* Strong written communication and slide development skills, including materials for senior leadership or funders
* Comfort working with data (Excel required; SQL preferred)
* Ability to operate independently with significant ambiguity and manage multiple workstreams

***Preferred experience and skills:***

* Experience in workforce development, economic mobility, education, or related social sector work
* Experience working with teams in India or the wider SAMEA/APAC region
* Hands-on experience with survey design, research design, and impact evaluation methodologies, including quasi-experimental approaches
* Familiarity with adult learning principles or curriculum development
* Experience working with dashboards (e.g., Power BI) and interpreting metrics
* Fluency in additional languages beyond English

***Mindset:***

* Structured thinker who breaks down ambiguous questions into clear components and approaches, and helps others do the same
* Intellectually curious and motivated to understand the “why” behind outcomes, not just produce analysis
* Rigorous and practical, holding a high bar on evidence while keeping measurement useful for partners and programs
* Takes ownership, proactively flagging risks and proposing solutions
* Collaborative and low-ego, able to work across technical and non-technical stakeholders, cultures, and time zones
* Self-reflective and open to giving and receiving frequent feedback

***\*\*\*Please apply with your English CV/resume, thank you\*\*\****

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Company Description**
BillCut is a mission-driven fintech company focused on changing how India handles personal debt and credit. The team is made up of creators, problem-solvers, and curious minds who design simple, people-first solutions that reduce financial stress. Through seamless technology and partnerships with leading financial institutions, BillCut helps customers shift high-interest credit to lower-interest EMI plans. The company is committed to ending financial traps and empowering individuals from all walks of life to take control of their money. Team members join a culture that prioritizes asking “why,” challenging the status quo, and building a smarter financial future for millions of Indians.
  
**Role Description**
The Data Analyst role at BillCut is a full-time, on-site position based in New Delhi. This role is responsible for collecting, cleaning, and analyzing customer and product data to generate actionable insights that support product development, risk assessment, and business strategy. The Data Analyst will build and maintain dashboards and reports to track key performance metrics, identify trends, and support decision-making across teams such as product, marketing, and operations. Day-to-day tasks include working with multiple data sources, performing statistical analysis, validating data quality, and presenting findings in clear, accessible formats. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business questions into analytical problems and recommending data-driven improvements to customer experience and financial outcomes.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and hands-on experience in Data Analytics.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of Statistics and the ability to apply statistical methods to real-world business problems.
* Candidates should possess experience with Data Modeling, including organizing data structures for reporting and analysis.
* Candidates should possess solid Communication skills, with the ability to explain complex findings to non-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in tools such as Excel, SQL, and one or more analytics or BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker) is beneficial.
* Experience with programming languages used in data analysis (e.g., Python or R) is an advantage.
* A bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Prior experience in fintech, banking, or financial services, and familiarity with credit or lending products, is a plus.

### **A****BOUT TIDE**

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

**Tide facts:**

* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members across UK and India
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* Over 2,800 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India's Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

As a Senior Analyst - Credit Products you'll work closely with Tide's credit product teams to shape credit product and risk decision making. This role will suit an individual that can operate with a high degree of independence and has hands-on experience of proactively taking initiative to uncover insights from data.

As a key member of our team, your role will go beyond merely generating reports; you will be expected to extract meaningful insights from data, enabling informed decision-making that drives our lending strategy. If you have a keen ability to decipher complex credit focused data sets and transform them into actionable insights that guide our decision making, we encourage you to apply for this position and help shape the future of SME lending.

**Some of the things you'll be doing:**

* Data Analysis & Insight Generation: Utilise advanced analytics to derive meaningful insights from complex data sets. Focus on analysing lending product performance, identifying trends, and providing actionable recommendations.
* Credit Risk Management: Monitor and optimise key performance indicators (KPIs) related to credit risk. Develop strategies to mitigate risk while supporting business growth.
* Collaboration with Credit Product Teams: Work closely with product managers and developers to inform and guide the development of new credit products. Use data-driven insights to influence product strategy and design.
* Reporting & Communication: Prepare comprehensive reports and presentations for senior management and stakeholders. Clearly communicate findings and recommendations.
* Continuous Learning & Improvement: Stay abreast of industry trends and advancements in data analytics tools and methodologies. Continuously seek ways to improve our data analysis processes and credit product offerings.

### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

* 4+ years of experience working as a credit focused analyst or data scientist at a fintech or bank.
* You have expert SQL proficiency and can navigate complex data warehouse relationships
* You are a self starter who takes initiative and can operate with a high degree of independence.
* You have the ability to deal with ambiguity and competing objectives in a fast paced environment.

### **WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN:**

Make work, work for you! We are embracing new ways of working and support flexible working arrangements. With our new Hybrid working model & Working Out of Office (WOO) policy our colleagues can work remotely from home or anywhere in their home country. Additionally, you can work from a different country for 90 days of the year. Plus, you'll get:

* Competitive salary
* Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing
* Employee Assistance Programme
* 12 casual & 15 Privilege leaves
* We invest in your development with professional L&D budget per year
* Spacious office in Hitechcity with all day snacks
* 24 hours paid volunteering time off per year
* Hybrid working
* Sabbatical leave

### **TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING**

At Tide, we champion a **flexible workplace** model thatsupports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

### **TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE**

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard.

  

*At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard.*

**Disclaimer**

*It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:*

* *Tide does* ***not*** *charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.*
* *All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our* ***Careers Page*** *and applications should be submitted through this channel.*
* *Communication from Tide will only come from an official* ***@tide******.co*** *email address.*
* *Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.*

*If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at* *talent@tide.co*  
*Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.*

  

*Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our* *AI Policy**.*

*Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with* *Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

title: Financial Analyst
description:
**We are looking for a Financial Analyst to join our Finance-FP&A team in Noida. This is an exciting opportunity to work on financial planning and analysis profile with great experience on budgeting/forecasting/revenue reporting and reconciliation/customer revenue analysis.**
  
  
**About You**
  
  

* BCOM or Finance Graduate / relevant Post Graduate degree is required. (CA/MBA Finance is added advantage)
* Strong analytical, forecasting methods skills, and problem-solving skills.
* Working knowledge of financial and general accounting principles, practices, and procedures
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize complex tasks under tight deadlines.
* Clear, concise communication skills
* Proven experience in use and application of Excel, PowerPoint and/or other reporting tools.

  
  
**What will you be doing in this role?**
  
  

* Member of Corporate Functions FP&A team, which provides partnership and financial support for Chief People Officer, CFO, SVP Of Revenue Operations, and General Counsel. Role will report into Director of FP&A.

* Regular partnership with central FP&A team for corporate deadlines, forecast and budget submissions, and variance analysis.
* Regular partnership with Controllership / Accounting to review journal entries, understand anomalies in data, and ensure clean financials.

* Provide suggestions for further improvements on processes involving data outputs.
* Prepare and perform format checks of all Finance presentation materials in MS PowerPoint/ Power BI/Excel.
* Ensure proper transfer of information into presentations and standardize formatting.
* Pro-actively perform version checks to ensure slide decks that are submitted always contain the latest data.

  
  

* Support team in ad-hoc analysis and tasks as required.

  
  
  
  
**About The Team**
  
  
The team in all consists of 5 people and this role will be reporting to Senior Manager Finance.
  
  
  
  
**Hours of Work –**
  
  

* Shift timing-12 to 9 PM
* Ready to be flexible to work on extra hours as per business/process requirement.
* This is a full-time role requiring 40 working hours (excluding breaks) per week. Work Mode-Hybrid (subject to change)

title: Deputy Manager, Financial Operations
description:
The Advanced Specialist, Financial Operations is a senior individual contributor within Global Rights & Royalties. The role owns complex royalty data analysis, supplier and royalty reconciliations, database integrity, advance and earnings payments, and the accurate application of agreement and product structures across multiple geographies.

  
  

Working with a high degree of autonomy, you will lead payout-based projects, make standard and non-standard operational recommendations, and provide trusted advice on royalty processing, product structures and payment setups. You will partner with business and technology stakeholders to resolve complex issues, strengthen data quality and ensure that royalty outcomes align with contractual requirements and business objectives.

  
  

You will also work closely with the Manager to monitor critical deliverables, maintain transparent progress reporting, lead quality and validation activities, prepare preliminary transaction reporting, and improve the capability of the wider team through mentoring and technical guidance.

  
  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES**

  
  

**1. Royalty Data Integrity and Calculation Assurance**

  

  
* Analyse complex royalty data and validate the integrity of the royalty calculations database and connected operational records.
  
  
* Ensure royalty calculations, statement outputs, advances and earnings payments reflect approved agreement terms, product structures and payment setups.
  
  
* Conduct routine and risk-based quality checks, control reviews and data validation exercises across high-value or complex royalty activity.
  
  
* Identify data gaps, anomalous results and processing risks; assess root causes and coordinate corrective action before release or payment.
  
  
* Maintain clear, audit-ready evidence of analysis, validation, decisions, approvals and adjustments.
  

  

**2. Reconciliations, Supplier Accounts and Payments**

  

  
* Lead the reconciliation of royalty supplier accounts, statements, advances, earnings and related balances, identifying and resolving discrepancies promptly.
  
  
* Maintain supplier and payment-related records and ensure accurate, authorised and complete system entries.
  
  
* Oversee complex royalty statement and payment processing, ensuring compliance with contractual terms, operating procedures and relevant controls.
  
  
* Review unusual, high-value or non-standard payment scenarios and make recommendations within delegated authority.
  
  
* Escalate legal interpretation, tax, policy or commercial decisions to the accountable specialist or business owner with a clear statement of facts and impact.
  

  

**3. Global Payout Projects and Operational Delivery**

  

  
* Lead or provide senior specialist support for payout-based projects across multiple geographies, from analysis and planning through validation and controlled delivery.
  
  
* Define operational requirements, dependencies, risks, control points and acceptance criteria in partnership with the Manager and project stakeholders.
  
  
* Monitor milestones, exceptions and actions, communicating progress and decision requirements clearly and early.
  
  
* Coordinate cross-functional inputs to ensure project outcomes align with business objectives, contractual requirements and operational readiness.
  
  
* Conduct post-implementation review and translate lessons learned into stronger processes, controls and documentation.
  

  

**4. Advisory Support on Agreements and Product Structures**

  

  
* Provide expert operational advice on royalty payouts, product structures, agreement terms and payment setups to support accurate processing and informed business decisions.
  
  
* Assess the operational impact of proposed or existing structures and highlight dependencies, limitations, risks and downstream consequences.
  
  
* Partner with Portfolio, Editorial, Rights, Royalties, Finance, Legal and other owners to clarify requirements and support correct system treatment.
  
  
* Distinguish operational application from formal legal or commercial interpretation and route decisions to the appropriate accountable owner when required.
  
  
* Promote consistent application of approved standards across markets, products and royalty processes.
  

  

**5. Stakeholder, Author and**
**OneCRM**
**Escalation Management**

  

  
* Provide timely, clear and evidence-based responses to complex stakeholder, author and agent inquiries.
  
  
* Ensure prompt and high-quality action on OneCRM tickets, prioritising material, aged or recurring escalations and driving them to resolution.
  
  
* Analyse escalation trends to identify systemic issues, control weaknesses and opportunities to improve author experience.
  
  
* Build trusted relationships across internal and external stakeholder groups and influence resolution of complex operational matters.
  
  
* Communicate risks, trade-offs and recommendations in a way that enables timely decisions.
  

  

**6. Technology Partnership and Sustainable Issue Resolution**

  

  
* Partner with technical teams and business stakeholders to investigate data inquiries, system defects, interface issues and processing anomalies.
  
  
* Translate operational and contractual requirements into clear business scenarios, expected outcomes and validation criteria.
  
  
* Support root-cause analysis, solution design, testing and implementation validation to ensure issues are resolved sustainably.
  
  
* Challenge temporary workarounds where they introduce control or scalability risk and recommend practical long-term solutions.
  
  
* Contribute to automation, reporting-tool development, data governance and process standardisation initiatives.
  

  

**7. Reporting, Controls and Audit Readiness**

  

  
* Prepare preliminary reports, summaries and analysis of royalty transactions, reconciliations, exceptions and payout activity for team and management review.
  
  
* Work with the Manager to monitor key tasks, service levels, risks, backlogs and project progress, ensuring accurate and transparent reporting.
  
  
* Maintain adherence to policies, procedures, approvals, contractual requirements, data privacy obligations and regulatory standards.
  
  
* Prepare complete documentation and work papers for author audits, internal reviews, external audits and control testing.
  
  
* Identify and communicate emerging risks or unusual circumstances, supported by impact analysis and recommended actions.
  

  

**8. Technical Leadership and Team Capability**

  

  
* Provide day-to-day technical guidance, mentoring and constructive quality feedback to junior colleagues and peers.
  
  
* Help ensure the quality of tasks, analysis and advice provided by self and others without formal line-management accountability.
  
  
* Share specialised knowledge through coaching, process documentation, case reviews and learning sessions.
  
  
* Promote strong ownership, customer focus, control discipline and continuous improvement across the team.
  
  
* Support the Manager in prioritising complex work and building resilient operational capability.
  

  

**Essential Qualifications and Experience**

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  
  
* Substantial relevant experience in royalty operations, financial operations, publishing, rights administration or a comparable complex transaction environment. Experience in publishing, rights or royalties is strongly preferred.
  
  
* Demonstrated expertise in royalty or financial data analysis, reconciliations, payment processing, database validation and complex discrepancy resolution.
  
  
* Experience leading projects, workstreamsor material operational deliverables across multiple stakeholders or geographies.
  
  
* Experience providing technical guidance or mentoring to colleagues and improving the quality of team outputs.
  
  
* Strong experience managing internal and external stakeholders and communicating complex information, risks and recommendations.
  

  

**Preferred Experience**

  

  
* Knowledge of royalty calculations, author agreements, product structures, advances, earnings payments and intellectual property management tools.
  
  
* Experience with supplier account maintenance, OneCRM or comparable case-management workflows, author inquiries and escalations.
  
  
* Experience supporting audits, control testing, system implementation, data migration, automation or reporting-tool development.
  
  
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience with royalty, ERP, workflow, database or business intelligence tools.
  
  
* **KEY WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**
  
  
* GRR Management and Royalty Operations | Portfolio and Editorial | Rights and Intellectual Property Management | Finance and Controllership | Tax and Accounts Payable | Technology and Transformation | Legal and Compliance | Internal and External Audit | Authors, Agents and Other Approved Stakeholders

title: Lead – Finance Controller
description:
**Responsibilities**
Financial Control & Governance
  
  

* Lead financial control and governance framework across projects and business units.
* Establish and monitor financial policies, controls, procedures, and accounting standards.
* Ensure adherence to internal control mechanisms and corporate governance requirements.
* Drive financial discipline and safeguard organizational assets through effective control processes.
* Monitor financial risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures.

Financial Planning & Business Finance
  
  

* Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes.
* Review project-wise profitability, cash flow forecasts, and business performance metrics.
* Support strategic planning, investment decisions, and business growth initiatives.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to leadership for informed decision-making.
* Evaluate business performance against approved targets and budgets.

Financial Reporting & MIS
  
  

* Oversee preparation and review of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.
* Ensure accuracy and timeliness of management reports, dashboards, and business performance reviews.
* Analyze financial statements, project profitability, revenue trends, and cost structures.
* Present financial performance updates and key business insights to senior management.
* Develop advanced MIS frameworks for real-time financial monitoring.

Project Finance & Commercial Oversight
  
  

* Monitor project financial health, fund utilization, and cost management.
* Review project CAPEX, project costs, revenue recognition, and profitability analysis.
* Partner with Project, Procurement, Sales, CRM, and Business Development teams to drive financial efficiency.
* Ensure financial viability assessments for new projects, investments, and land acquisitions.
* Support commercial negotiations from a financial risk and profitability perspective.

Cash Flow & Working Capital Management
  
  

* Oversee cash flow planning and liquidity management across projects and business operations.
* Monitor fund inflows, outflows, receivables, payables, and working capital requirements.
* Ensure efficient utilization of financial resources and availability of adequate funds.
* Coordinate with treasury teams on funding requirements and cash management strategies.
* Drive initiatives for optimizing working capital and cash conversion cycles.

Compliance, Audit & Risk Management
  
  

* Ensure compliance with accounting standards, taxation regulations, statutory requirements, and corporate policies.
* Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors, tax consultants, and regulatory authorities.
* Lead audit closure activities and ensure timely resolution of audit observations.
* Monitor compliance risks and strengthen internal control frameworks.
* Support implementation of risk management and compliance initiatives.

Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Collaborate with Business Heads, Project Teams, Procurement, Sales, CRM, Legal, Commercial, and Treasury functions.
* Act as a strategic finance partner to business leadership.
* Present financial reviews, business cases, and performance reports to senior stakeholders.
* Support management committees, board reviews, and business planning discussions.

Team Leadership & Process Excellence
  
  

* Lead and mentor finance teams across projects and business functions.
* Drive process improvements, financial automation, and digital reporting initiatives.
* Promote a culture of accountability, compliance, and operational excellence.
* Build team capabilities through coaching, training, and performance management.
* Establish best practices in financial reporting, controls, and business partnering.

**Qualifications**
Educational Qualification
  
  

* Chartered Accountant (CA) is mandatory.
* MBA (Finance), CMA, or equivalent qualification will be an added advantage.
* Bachelor's Degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, or related discipline.

Experience
  
  

* 12–18 years of experience in Finance Controllership, Business Finance, FP&A, Project Finance, Corporate Finance, or Financial Management.
* Strong experience within Real Estate, Infrastructure, Construction, EPC, Manufacturing, or Project-based organizations.
* Experience in handling large project portfolios, financial governance, statutory compliance, and leadership reporting.
* Proven track record in budgeting, profitability management, business partnering, and internal controls.

title: Finance Executive
company: India's Future Investors - Money Entertainment Reality Show
description:
**Company Description**
India’s Future Investors (IFI) is India’s Money Entertainment Reality Show, where real-world financial decisions are made under intense time and pressure. Through immersive challenges and practical money scenarios, IFI explores how people think, prioritize, and act when stakes are high. The show combines money intelligence, human behavior, competition, and entertainment to discover “India’s Money Rockstar.” IFI invites viewers not only to watch, but also to participate, compete, and follow the journey as contestants prove their financial acumen. The platform offers a unique opportunity for finance professionals and enthusiasts to be part of an innovative concept at the intersection of media, entertainment, and financial literacy.
  
**Role Description**
The Finance Executive role is a full-time, on-site position based in Noida. This role is responsible for managing day-to-day finance operations, including preparation and review of financial statements, monitoring cash flows, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities. The Finance Executive will handle financial reporting, ensure timely and accurate compliance with Goods and Services Tax (GST) and other regulatory requirements, and coordinate with internal teams and external advisors as needed. The role includes analyzing financial data to support decision-making for production, marketing, and operational teams, as well as maintaining organized financial records and documentation. The Finance Executive will also contribute to process improvements, internal controls, and financial best practices to support the growth and sustainability of the show.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong knowledge of Finance and Financial Statements, including preparation, review, and interpretation.
* Candidates should possess experience in Financial Reporting, with the ability to produce accurate, timely reports for management and regulatory purposes.
* Candidates should possess Goods and Services Tax (GST) expertise, including filing, reconciliation, and compliance with current regulations.
* Candidates should possess robust Analytical Skills, with the capacity to evaluate financial data, identify trends, and support strategic decisions.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in accounting software and MS Excel, along with attention to detail and strong numerical skills.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and collaboration abilities to work with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Relevant academic background such as a bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CA, CMA, MBA in Finance) are an advantage.
* Prior experience in media, entertainment, or production finance is beneficial but not mandatory; willingness to learn and adapt is essential.

description:

**Description:**

**We are seeking an experienced Assistant Manager with a strong background in month end closing and reporting. The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing the full spectrum of financial closing processes, ensuring compliance with accounting standards, managing detailed analyses, and coordinating with auditors. This role requires robust analytical skills, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex financial information to stakeholders.**

**Responsibilities:**

**·      Financial Closing & Reporting:**

**o  Oversee the accurate and timely closing of financial books at the end of each accounting period.**

**o  Ensure compliance with accounting standards and IFRS during the closing process.**

**o  Ensure proper booking of prepaid expenses and provisions.**

**o  Prepare the fixed assets register and perform regular scrutiny of the balance sheet, profit & loss account, and cash flow statements.**

**o  Coordinate the preparation of consolidated financial statements, including balance sheet, profit & loss, and cash flow analysis.**

**o  Preparation of Board packs, investor reports, and audit schedules.**

**·      Financial Analysis & Planning:**

**o  Conduct in-depth analysis of assets and liabilities, as well as profit & loss accounts.**

**o  Perform variance analysis comparing historical periods and budgeted figures.**

**o  Analyze working capital schedules, AR & AP ageing, and inventory ageing.**

**o  Assist in the preparation of business plans and financial forecasts to support strategic decision-making.**

**·      Budgeting & Forecasting:**

**o  Develop annual budgets in coordination with department heads and business units.**

**o  Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual forecasting processes.**

**o  Monitor actual performance vs. budget and provide variance analysis with actionable insights.**

**o  Ensure alignment of budgets with corporate goals and financial strategy.**

**o  Assist in long-term financial planning and scenario analysis.**

**·      Auditing & Compliance:**

**o  Liaise with internal and external auditors, coordinate with external auditors during the annual audit process.**

**o  Provide necessary documentation and clear explanations during audits and regulatory reviews.**

**o  Maintain up-to-date knowledge of IFRS and local accounting standards to ensure full compliance.**

**·      Process Improvement & Internal Controls:**

**o  Review and enhance financial processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and internal controls.**

**o  Develop and implement best practices in financial consolidation and reporting.**

**·      Stakeholder Engagement & Team Leadership:**

**o  Communicate complex financial information and strategic insights to senior management and key stakeholders.**

**o  Lead, mentor, and develop a team of finance professionals to ensure high performance and continuous professional growth.**

**o  Collaborate with cross-functional teams including tax, treasury, and operations to ensure seamless financial operations.**

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification is mandatory.
* Minimum 3-4 years post qualification experience.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good presentation skills.
* Good understanding of Accounting Standards
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Growth and target oriented.

**Preferred Attributes:**

* Experience working within dynamic, multi-entity organizations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines under pressure.
* A detail-oriented mindset with a commitment to accuracy and integrity.

title: Manager Credit, Consumer PBU

title: Industrial Trainee
description:
**About the Company**

Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high-quality, standardized, and reliable service experience. To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.

Urban Company started as UrbanClap in November 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav, and Varun, realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented, and offline. Customers found it challenging to avail quality services conveniently, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several

middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind -

**1. Customer love:**
Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services

**2. Partner empowerment**
: Build a deep, full-stack partnership with service partners,

helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood

**3. Technology first**
: Bring innovation and technology to an age-old industry

**About the Role**

We are looking for a motivated and analytically strong
**Business Finance Intern**
to join our team. The intern will work closely with the
**Associate Manager – Business Finance**
and support them across financial planning, P&L management, business analysis, forecasting, and various strategic and operational projects.

This role will provide hands-on exposure to business finance in a fast-paced environment. The intern will assist the AM in day-to-day analysis, reporting, data tracking, and stakeholder coordination, while also getting opportunities to independently work on specific projects and problem statements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. P&L Management and Business Performance**

* Assist in preparing and maintaining business P&Ls.
* Support in tracking key revenue, cost, and profitability metrics across business categories and geographies.
* Help identify key trends, deviations, and potential areas for cost or revenue optimisation.
* Assist in preparing regular business performance reports and dashboards.

**2. Forecasting and Financial Planning**

* Support in preparing annual plans, periodic forecasts, and scenario analyses.
* Track key business and financial drivers and help validate underlying assumptions.
* Assist in analysing delivery trends, revenue, costs, margins, and other operating metrics to improve forecast accuracy.

**3. Budget vs Actual Analysis**

* Assist in monthly Budget vs Actual analysis across key financial metrics.
* Identify and analyse major variances and support in preparing commentary and insights for stakeholders.
* Maintain trackers to monitor business performance against targets.

**4. Business and Pricing Analysis**

* Support analysis of pricing, take rates, margins, and other key business levers.
* Conduct data analysis to support pricing and other commercial decisions.
* Assist in benchmarking and analysing business performance across categories, cities, or other relevant dimensions.

**5. Cost Monitoring and Revenue Assurance**

* Monitor key cost heads and identify unusual movements or deviations from planned numbers.
* Support checks to identify potential revenue leakages or gaps in financial reporting.
* Assist in building trackers and processes for better cost control and financial visibility.

**6. Process Improvement and Automation**

* Assist in improving existing finance and business processes.
* Support the creation and maintenance of automated reports, dashboards, and trackers.
* Help streamline recurring analyses and reduce manual effort through better data and reporting processes.

**7. Special Projects and Ad-hoc Analysis**

* Provide analytical support for ad-hoc business and finance projects.
* Work on specific problem statements involving business performance, cost optimisation, revenue growth, or operational efficiency.
* Support in preparing analyses and presentations for discussions with business and finance stakeholders.

**8. Stakeholder Coordination**

* Assist in coordinating with cross-functional teams to gather data and resolve queries.
* Support follow-ups on financial and operational action items.
* Help ensure timely availability and accuracy of data required for business reviews.

**What We’re Looking For**

* CA Industrial Trainee
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good understanding of financial statements and basic financial concepts.
* Comfortable working with large datasets and Excel/Google Sheets.
* Knowledge of SQL, data analysis tools, or dashboarding tools will be an added advantage.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work with numbers accurately.
* Ability to structure problems and communicate insights clearly.
* Proactive mindset with a willingness to learn and take ownership.

**What You’ll Learn**

* Hands-on experience in P&L management and business finance.
* Exposure to forecasting, budgeting, financial analysis, and business planning.
* Understanding of key business and operational metrics in a consumer technology company.
* Opportunity to work closely with the Business Finance and Business teams.
* Experience working on real business problems and contributing to key decision-making processes.

**What We’d Love**

* Curiosity to understand how a business operates beyond just the numbers.
* Strong ownership and willingness to take initiative.
* Ability to learn quickly and work in a fast-paced environment.
* A structured and detail-oriented approach to problem-solving.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.

At Urban Company we are committed to providing equal and fair opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We endeavor to maintain a work environment free from harassment based on age, colour, physical ability, marital status, parental status, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

title: Associate, Office of the CFO // Controllership Transformation
description:

Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States.
  
  
The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transitions and transformations.
  
  
Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm’s platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.
  
  
The Office of the CFO (OCFO) team partners with middle market stakeholders to provide strategic finance solutions and operational, technical and transaction accounting advisory across the entire business and investment lifecycle. Leveraging backgrounds in accounting, finance, operations, audit, investment banking, investing and consulting, the OCFO team provides holistic perspectives and capabilities to deliver results that are unmatched in the industry.

As key a contributor within the OCFO and Transaction Advisory Services (TAS) practices, this Associate will leverage a background in accounting, finance, operations and consulting to support end-to-end finance transformation, design and optimization.
