title: Dy. Commercial Project Manager
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. In Mobility, we help our customers meet the need for hard-working mobility solutions. We’re making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!
  
  
**We are looking for Dy. Commercial Project Manager**
As a Dy. Commercial Project Manager, you will support the project to drive profitable project execution, manage working capital of the project, control the project’s costs and manage risk, prepare project forecast, review the project at periodic intervals and present the project progress to management on time to time basis.
  
  
**You’ll make a difference by**

* Active Customer Relationship Management. Proactively communicate with customers’ commercial representatives and manage solving of commercial issues.
* Checking that the overall project's contractual structure has been correctly created in the respective commercial tools
* Cross-Company coordination- Assurance of the correctness, consistency and transparency of the overall project's financial status
* Coordination of legal, fiscal and insurance subjects between the Siemens companies involved
* Consolidation and analysis of project figures across all company boundaries and accounting units
* Managing internal and external claims between all possible stakeholders
* Reporting- Responsible for summarizing global reporting to the relevant Management level
* Documentation in line with the mandatory internal and external requirements
* Project-internal- Managing commercial and legal subjects in the project
* Collaboration with the Project Manager in terms of the project's strategic orientation and its respective internal and external communication. Support the Project Manager to achieve the financial results according to set targets, managed with due professional care and optimize the project gross profit, cash flow and assets and financing instruments.
* Adherence to fiscal, commercial law and company-internal rules
* Commercial project coordination (e.g. application for and follow-up of bank guarantees, insurances, etc.) as well as coordination of legal, fiscal and insurance subjects
* Order entry calculation, concurrent costing and final costing. Ensure correct allocation and monitoring of costs.
* Asset and cash flow management - Optimize operating working capital throughout the project lifecycle to ensure positive free cash flow
* Preparation of invoices and follow-up of claims
* Project-internal controlling (deadlines, costs, quality)
* Regular project reporting / project status meetings / milestone reviews
* Involves in the creation of final project reports and summarization of lessons learned with feedback to the organization
* Overall handling of fiscal, currency-related aspects and insurance subjects, involving the department responsible and taking into consideration internal business models
* Steers the project's supply chain incl. procurement, delivery and ECC
* Calculation of Price Variations based on escalation formulae as per application indices and ensuring claim realization from customers and to vendors.
* Ensure the accuracy of project books and records and keeping our systems updated, e.g. SAP and ensure compliance with Financial Reporting Guidelines
* Contract management- Wording of the commercial and legal contractual conditions with customers, consortium members and subcontractors
* Involved in negotiations as well as interpretation and implementation of contracts in projects
* Analysis and assessment of complex, where applicable international contract constellations
* Drive Contract management throughout the project delivery phase including proactive opportunity and claim management strategies to maximize the project outcome.
* Risk, Claim and change order management
* Ascertain own claims from customers including Extension of Time Compensation and prevention of unjustified claims from vendors.
* Agreement on contractual amendments regarding the scope of supplies and services, prices, deadlines or other contractually stipulated conditions
* Identification and financial assessment of opportunities and risks, definition and implementation of suitable measures to reduce risks or realize opportunities, and creation of contingencies for remaining risks, active risk and opportunity management.

**Desired Skills:**

* You should have minimum experience of 3 - 5 years along with Bachelors/Post graduate degree (CA, MBA, CMA etc.) in Finance.
* Have good communication skills to deal with different stakeholders within/outside organization (domestic and international).
* A Project Manager certification along with working experience on SAP especially SD, FICO modules, would be an added advantage
* Should have a growth mindset with an edge for learning and taking up new responsibilities

**Join us and be yourself!**
We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
  
  
**Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens.**
This role is based in Bangalore. You might be required to visit other locations within India and outside. In return, you'll get the chance to work with teams impacting - and the shape of things to come. We're Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.

title: Data Privacy Specialist
description:
**Role Overview**

The Privacy Specialist is responsible for supporting and strengthening the organization’s privacy and personal data protection program, with strong working knowledge of India’s Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act and applicable rules. The role focuses on privacy compliance, data handling practices, risk assessments, documentation, individual rights requests, and coordination with business and technical teams. Experience with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

**DPDP Compliance & Privacy Governance**

* Maintain and support the organization’s privacy program in alignment with India’s DPDP Act and applicable rules and guidance
* Translate privacy obligations into practical policies, procedures, workflows, and controls for relevant business functions
* Support privacy governance activities, maintain compliance registers, and track implementation of privacy requirements
* Monitor changes in privacy laws, rules, and regulatory guidance and assess their potential impact on organizational practices

**Personal Data Lifecycle & Data Principal Rights**

* Support data mapping and records of personal data processing, including collection, use, sharing, retention, and deletion
* Help establish and maintain processes for handling data principal requests, grievances, consent withdrawal, and related communications, as applicable
* Review privacy notices, consent language, and data collection forms to help ensure transparency and appropriate purpose limitation
* Coordinate with business and technical teams to support retention schedules, deletion processes, and appropriate handling of personal data

**Privacy Risk Assessments & Incident Management**

* Conduct or coordinate privacy impact and risk assessments for new projects, products, vendors, and changes to personal data processing
* Identify privacy risks and recommend proportionate controls and remediation actions in collaboration with relevant teams
* Support the identification, assessment, escalation, and documentation of personal data breaches and privacy incidents
* Coordinate with Security, Legal, IT, and business stakeholders on incident response, required assessments, and applicable notification obligations

**Third-Party Privacy & GDPR (Added Advantage)**

* Review vendor and partner privacy practices, contractual clauses, and data-processing arrangements with relevant stakeholders
* Support privacy due diligence and track remediation of issues identified during vendor reviews or assessments
* Where applicable, assist with GDPR-related activities such as data subject rights, lawful bases, records of processing, and cross-border transfer reviews
* Help map privacy requirements across jurisdictions and identify common controls while accounting for jurisdiction-specific obligations

**Documentation, Training & Stakeholder Management**

* Maintain privacy policies, procedures, notices, assessment records, processing registers, and evidence of compliance
* Prepare privacy compliance updates, risk summaries, metrics, and reports for management and internal stakeholders
* Deliver or coordinate privacy awareness sessions and provide practical guidance to teams handling personal data

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 3–8 years of experience in data privacy, privacy compliance, information security GRC, legal compliance, or a related role
* Strong, demonstrable knowledge of India’s DPDP Act and applicable rules, including key obligations relating to notice, consent where applicable, data principal rights, safeguards, breach response, and accountability
* Experience with privacy documentation, data mapping, risk assessments, compliance reviews, and coordination with cross-functional stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Law, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field; relevant privacy or data protection experience may also be considered
* Working experience with DPDP, GDPR is an added advantage; certifications or training such as CIPP/A, CIPP/E, CIPM, or other relevant privacy qualifications are desirable
* Experience managing security incidents and crisis situations
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Cybersecurity, or related field

Certifications such as ( Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) - Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP) - Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE ), CDPO or ISO/IEC 27701.

Job Title: Executive – Statutory Compliance Department: Human Resources / Compliance

Experience: 2–4 Years

Location: Hyderabad

Reporting To: Manager – HR Payroll & Statutory Compliance

Employment Type: Full-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a detail-oriented Executive – Statutory Compliance to manage and ensure timely compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements across multiple locations. The role involves handling PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, minimum wages, contract labour compliance, statutory returns, audits, documentation, and coordination with internal teams, clients, and government authorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Ensure timely compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements across multiple locations.

· Handle monthly PF and ESIC activities, including ECR preparation, challan generation, payment tracking, employee registration, and exit updates.

· Manage Professional Tax (PT), Labour Welfare Fund (LWF), and other applicable statutory payments and returns.

· Monitor compliance with Minimum Wages, Payment of Wages, Bonus, Gratuity, Maternity Benefit, and other applicable labour legislations.

· Handle Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act compliance, including registration, licensing, renewals, and related documentation, wherever applicable.

· Manage Shops and Establishments registration, renewals, amendments, and statutory records.

· Prepare, review, and maintain statutory registers, returns, challans, acknowledgements, and supporting documents.

· Coordinate with clients, internal HR teams, payroll, finance, vendors, and statutory authorities for compliance-related activities.

· Conduct statutory compliance audits, identify non-compliances, and ensure timely closure of observations and corrective actions.

· Monitor compliance portals and client audit platforms, ensuring timely submission of documents and closure of non-compliances.

· Support inspections, notices, and other queries from statutory authorities by preparing the required documents and coordinating responses.

· Track statutory due dates, maintain compliance calendars, and ensure timely completion of monthly, quarterly, and annual filings.

· Verify employee and payroll data to ensure accuracy of statutory contributions and payments.

· Prepare compliance reports, MIS, and periodic status updates for management and clients.

· Keep updated on amendments to labour laws, minimum wages, and other applicable statutory requirements.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

· Graduate in Commerce, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related discipline.

· 2–4 years of experience in statutory compliance, labour law compliance, payroll compliance, or HR operations.

· Good knowledge of PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, Minimum Wages, CLRA, Shops and Establishments, and other applicable labour laws.

· Hands-on experience with statutory portals, compliance trackers, and audit documentation.

· Proficiency in MS Excel, including data validation, reconciliation, and MIS reporting.

· Strong coordination, documentation, analytical, and communication skills.

· Ability to manage multiple locations, meet statutory deadlines, and work with minimal supervision.

**Preferred Skills**

· Experience in managing PAN-India statutory compliance.

· Familiarity with compliance management platforms such as Comply4HR/C4HR, Lawrbit, MYND, UCS, or Simpliance.

· Experience in client compliance audits, documentation reviews, and non-compliance closure.

· Knowledge of payroll systems such as Keka and statutory reconciliation processes.

**Key Competencies**

· Attention to detail and accuracy.

· Deadline management and follow-up.

· Problem-solving and analytical skills.

· Ownership and accountability.

· Effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders.

title: Senior Regulatory Affairs Specialist
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
Supporting Design and Development Control activities with regulatory requirements, direction, tactics and strategies and working in a team environment with all organizational departments. Preparation of document packages for international regulatory submissions from all areas of company, internal audits and inspections.
  
  
**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

* Set up new process for entering new data - Regulatory Information Management System.
* Process SME to ensure appropriate coordination and advise on consistent interpretation of required data attributes.
* Keeps abreast of regulatory procedures and changes.
* Provide requested regulatory data and documents to support tenders
* Keeps abreast of regulatory procedures and changes.
* Lead in development/maintenance of regulatory files, data, records, and reporting systems of systematic retrieval of information.
* Prepare, review, file, and support premarket documents for global registrations for assigned projects.
* Collaborate with business unit and international regulatory affairs personnel to support marketing authorizations for assigned projects.
* Preparation of document packages for international regulatory submissions from all areas of company, internal audits and inspections.
* Compiles all materials required in submissions, license renewal and annual registrations.
* Recommends changes for labelling, manufacturing, marketing and clinical protocol for regulatory compliance.
* Monitors and improves tracking/control systems.
* May direct interaction with regulatory agencies on defined matters.
* Develop Regulatory Strategies for new or modified products for assigned projects.
* Monitor and provide information pertaining to impact of changes in the regulatory environment.
* Communicate with regulatory agencies and/or notify bodies on administrative and routine matters.
* Document, consolidate, and maintain oral and written communication with health authorities.
* Prepare internal documents for modifications to devices, when appropriate.
* Author and/or review regulatory procedures and update as necessary.
* Review change control documents and ascertain regulatory impact for external and internal documents through formal regulatory assessments.

**Required knowledge and experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in medical, Mechanical, Electric Life Science or other healthcare related majors.
* 7+ year’s experience for RA role in medical device and or pharmaceutical industry.
* Works independently with general supervision on larger, moderately complex projects / assignments.
* Contributes to the completion of project milestones.
* Adjusts or recommends enhancements in systems and processes to solve problems or improve effectiveness of job area.
* Ability to quickly establish credibility with all levels of customer base.
* Communicates primarily and frequently with internal contacts. Contacts others to share information, status, needs and issues to inform, gain input, and support decision making. Nice To Have Skills:
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent written, organizational, and communication skills is required, and have a flexible and team-oriented attitude.
* Self-motivated and positive.
* Ability to quickly establish credibility with all levels of customer base.

Finance fuels our lives. Banking, Insurance and Wealth management, create the foundations for growth, prosperity and peace of mind. No other Industry touches so many people or shapes so many lives.
  
  
Amid sweeping regulatory change, today’s financial services institutions are focusing on digital transformation, convergence and disruption from an array of nontraditional competitors — all while meeting greater demands for trust and transparency.
  
  
To address this delicate balance of issues, our competent team of business strategists, technologists and industry leaders bring fresh thinking and sector knowledge across banking and capital markets, insurance, and wealth and asset management. The results are seamless collaboration, innovative problem solving, breakthrough performance gains and sustainable value creation.

**CNS - Risk - Process & Controls :**

Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
  
  
We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
  
  
Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls

EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
  
  
Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.

**Experience**

* Worked on process documentation / project management tools
* Experience of working on AI tools
* Advance excel and powerpoint
* Experience of 3-5 years of experience in WAM practice

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. title: Product Counsel
description:
We are Progress (Nasdaq: PRGS) - the trusted provider of software that enables our customers to develop, deploy and manage responsible, AI-powered applications and experiences with agility and ease.  
We’re proud to have a diverse, global team where we value the individual and enrich our culture by considering varied perspectives because we believe people power progress. Join us as a **Product Counsel** and help us do what we do best: propelling business forward.

We are looking for a qualified and experienced Product Counsel to join our legal team and provide advice and support to our management and internal clients on various product related areas including product design, development and release, marketing, data protection, security and compliance. You will be working closely with our product management, engineering, design, product marketing, support, operations, compliance and business line executives. This role requires a business-minded in-house lawyer who will partner with multiple innovative product teams around the world to ensure that the company's products and services are structured to achieve the business strategy while complying with applicable regulations in multiple jurisdictions.

**In this role you will:**

* Partner closely with product management, engineering, design, product marketing, support, operations and compliance teams and provide counsel and advise on a wide variety of complex and developing legal, regulatory and compliance issues in connection with the delivery of cloud services.
* Advise on requirements affecting all stages of a product's life cycle, including design, development, marketing, public relations, product launch and distribution, and related product regulatory concerns.
* Support sales cycle, including developing and managing options for company agreements (including with customers, partners and vendors), answering questions, providing documentation, facilitating sales execution and negotiating agreements alongside commercial counsel.
* Serve as a liaison and issuer spotter for other legal team members in a matrixed organization with product teams, including in the areas of intellectual property, privacy, security and trade compliance.
* Ensure compliance with U.S. and international laws and regulations and company policy dealing with intellectual property, privacy, security, trade compliance and other applicable laws.
* Analyze, structure, draft, and negotiate technology development, licensing, and other commercial agreements and provide ongoing legal counseling in the areas of intellectual property, technology, and licensing.
* Review, draft and advise on advertising and marketing materials, including press releases, packaging, product launch collateral, sweepstakes, promotions, and other related items.
* Conduct training for the legal team as well as internal teams.

**Your background:**

* Law degree is required
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant in-house experience as a product counsel, preferably in the technology industry, with a focus on software, SaaS and cloud offerings.
* Significant experience with intellectual property, licensing, privacy and trade compliance in the technology sector.
* Ability to communicate effectively with product managers and engineers and apply legal principles based on understanding of technology architectures and principles.
* Able to multi-task, work independently in a fast-paced environment and to interface with internal departments and all levels of management.
* Maintain current understanding of best practices related to legal issues in product development and marketing for technology companies.
* Experience with HIPAA compliance is highly desired;
* Strong drafting and negotiation skills.

**Skills:**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Strong business acumen and strategic thinking skills.
* Excellent drafting, negotiation, and communication Prior product counseling experience with a technology company;
* Startup mindset – highly passionate, team player, high sense of urgency, willingness to roll up sleeves and ability to deal with ambiguity in a fast-paced business;
* Excellent attention to detail, strong communication skills, well-honed analytical skills and strong project management skills;
* Strong technical skills with a continuous learning mindset to develop a deeper understanding of the business.

**If this sounds like you and fits your experience and career goals, we’d be happy to chat.** **What we offer in return is the opportunity to experience a great**

title: Company Secretarial Counsel
description:
Posted Wednesday, October 14, 2026 at 5:00 PM

**Join the global leader in responsible marketing activation services**

At HH Global, we help the world’s most recognized brands turn their growth ideas into measurable impact through responsible marketing activation.

We are a global marketing activation partner that connects brands to their customers and delivers sustainable marketing execution at scale.

With over 4,000 colleagues across more than 55 countries, you’ll join a diverse, high-performing community, empowered to deliver sustainable, innovative solutions for our clients.

**Company Secretarial Counsel**

**Legal Team | Global Corporate Governance**

**The Opportunity**

HH Global is seeking an experienced Company Secretarial Counsel to join its Legal Team and support the governance and compliance of HH Global's portfolio of entities worldwide.

  

This is an excellent opportunity for a company secretarial professional with a minimum of 5 and up to 7 years' experience to take on a broad international role with increased responsibility. The successful candidate will act as deputy to the Company Secretarial Solicitor, support and mentor junior team members, and play a key role in the continued development of the Company's governance function.

  

You will work closely with directors, senior management and external advisers across multiple jurisdictions, supporting entities throughout Europe, the Americas, Asia-Pacific and the Middle East.

  

**Location**

The role would be based at the HH Global office in Mumbai, with hybrid working available.

  

**Full Time Permanent Role**

This is full time permanent role with a probation period of six (6) months.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage company secretarial and corporate governance activities across a global portfolio of entities, including board and shareholder matters, statutory compliance, filings and corporate records.
* Coordinate corporate actions, including director changes, registered office changes, powers of attorney and other governance matters, ensuring documentation is prepared, executed and filed in a timely manner.
* Liaise with external company secretarial providers and advisers across multiple jurisdictions.
* Maintain and enhance entity management systems, governance records and compliance processes.
* Support corporate transactions, restructurings and other strategic projects.
* Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and compliance.
* Act as deputy to the Company Secretarial Solicitor and provide guidance and support to junior members of the Company Secretarial Team.
  

**Skills and Experience**

* We are looking for candidates with:
* A law degree, Chartered Governance Institute (CGI) qualification, or an equivalent legal, governance or company secretarial qualification.
* A minimum of 5 years' experience in company secretarial, corporate governance or international corporate administration.
* Strong knowledge of company law, corporate governance and statutory compliance requirements.
* Experience supporting multinational groups and managing a portfolio of entities across multiple jurisdictions.
* Experience working with boards, directors, senior stakeholders and external advisers.
* Strong drafting, organisational and communication skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Experience mentoring or supporting junior colleagues.
* Experience using entity management software such as GEMS or similar platforms.
  

**About You**

You are a proactive, organised and commercially minded governance professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced international environment. You take ownership of your work, build strong stakeholder relationships and are comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy while supporting the wider success of the Legal Team.

You will be a trusted member of the Legal Team, capable of managing company secretarial matters independently while contributing to the continued development and success of the function.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**

HH Global is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. We are also committed to providing reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process where required.

*This job description is intended as a guide to the duties and responsibilities of the role and is not exhaustive. HH Global reserves the right to amend responsibilities in line with business requirements.*

**You belong in our global community**

Belonging is at the heart of HH Global. We don’t just talk about inclusion; our teams recognize it as a fundamental part of our culture. Join the global leader in responsible marketing activation services and bring your authentic self to a team that values you for who you are.

We welcome job applications from all suitably qualified candidates and will make reasonable adjustments to our recruitment process to accommodate you.

title: Corporate Specialist
description:
**About Us**
We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
  
  
As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
  
  
**About GSS**
As the internal support organization for DNV and DNV owned companies, we deliver shared services within Human Resources, Finance, IT and Real Estate & Procurement to DNV globally. Our mission is to enable DNV to grow, succeed with its business goals and improve competitiveness. Customer experience is at the core of everything we do. GSS is responsible for many of the tools, processes and daily routines that create the backbone of DNV.
  
  
**About The Role**
The global shared services group (GSS) within DNV provides support services and key competencies in Finance, Human resources, IT, Real Estate and Procurement. GSS strategic goals are to provide high-quality, cost-efficient support services to all business areas and to the group. GSS delivers high-quality support services, fully aligned with Group policies and in compliance with laws and regulations of the countries where we operate.
  
  
The corporate / compliance specialist is responsible for the corporate housekeeping support function for the countries India, Srilanka and Bangladesh. To succeed in this role, you should be a team player with excellent communication skills and cultural awareness. You will be responsible for maintaining corporate records of DNV entities. Must be well organized, pay attention to detail, aware of deadlines.
  
  
As a corporate/ compliance specialist in our team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Maintaining and keeping information up to date for all the Legal Entities assigned in accordance with Internal requirements in our corporate digital tool and physical archives when required by law.
* Coordinate and oversee Corporate Filings with government authorities as and when required by local law. This will be supported by DNV’s secretarial / legal advisors for that country.
* Support in interacting with Banking partners on specific need basis and ensuring critical compliances are met.
* Liaise with internal process owners to handle Reserve Bank of India related fillings / requirements like FLAIR reporting, Annual performance report etc.
* Liaising with BA stakeholders, Group Legal, GSS internal stakeholders and finance colleagues where they need specific support on conducting AGMs, POA, director signatories, company DSC, Board resolutions, Notices, Minutes, Articles of Association etc related to their roles.
* Ensure resources, capabilities and capacity to meet both existing and new business demand and support ongoing Group projects like M&A, Liquidation programme etc.

What we offer
  
  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work-life balance.
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave).
* Medical benefits (Insurance and Annual Health Check-up).
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance).
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On-The-Job Training, Training Programme).
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement).
* Company bonus/Profit share.

\*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*
  
  
DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture, and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
  
  
**About You**

* Member of Institute of Company Secretaries of India.
* More than 5 years of experience in corporate governance. Preferably in Multinational organisation.
* Ability to proactively conduct documentation processes with eye to detail.
* Manage stakeholders with excellent communication skills – both oral and written
* Ability to handle multiple regulatory compliances like FEMA, MSME, LEI, Dematerialisation etc.

*Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.*

description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream**
With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.
  
  
We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.
  
  
**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.**
We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
  
  
We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
  
  
ABOUT ICE CREAM: Life Tastes Better with Ice Cream Once separated from Unilever, the The Magnum Ice Cream Company (TMICC) will become the world’s largest global Ice Cream Company, with over 100 years’ experience delivering a diverse range of indulgent, yet responsible, craft food experiences. We have 35 brands, including 3 one billion Euro brands (Magnum, Wall’s, Ben & Jerry’s), a strong presence in over 60 countries, generating annual revenue of €8 billion. All brands are driven to transform moments into memories through indulgent yet responsibly made and marketed products. We have a well-developed strategy to deliver growth and value creation which is clear on where to play and how to win. We turn the ordinary into the extraordinary by designing unique and innovative Ice Cream experiences that make life taste better, creating joyful experiences. In our Ice Cream business, we’re crafting the future through innovation and imaginative minds, creating unique products. We spark moments of happiness for people and within the communities where we operate. We are committed to developing and nurturing talent. You will have ample options for career growth and exploration. Your career development will be a priority for us, and we are dedicated to supporting your growth journey within the new company. ABOUT GBS: Global Business Solutions:   Global Business Solutions (GBS) is TMICC’s trusted transformation partner, delivering innovative and integrated solutions from design to delivery. We develop future-fit capability, expertise and technologically advanced solutions to unlock speed, simplicity and operational agility across TMICCs operations. This is your chance for a ‘once in a lifetime’ career experience, playing a part in the creation of a fully independent, new Ice Cream company and a greenfield GBS organization supporting Europe Supply Chain Finance Processes. Employees within GBS partner with multiple teams in countries across Europe ranging from Factories, Distribution Centers, Supply Chain Planning, Customer Services, Procurement. You will become part of the delivery service engine behind TMICC’s hero brands and will have the opportunity to implement new solutions and processes alongside an innovative tech stack that is been delivered as part of the separation from Unilever program. What you'll be responsible for 1. Legal Financial Operations
  
  

* Manage finance-related processes within the Legal function, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timeliness.
* Prepare, review, submit, and track expense reports in accordance with internal policies.
* Raise Purchase Orders (POs) and support invoice processing, follow-up, and closure.
* Ensure compliance with internal financial policies, controls, billing processes, and approval requirements. 2. Matter, Invoice & Billing Management
* Create and maintain legal matter records in Legal Tracker or similar matter management / e-billing systems.
* Support invoice review processes, including validation against billing guidelines, approved rates, matter information, and supporting documentation.
* Support review of UTBMS codes, LEDES formats, billing narratives, and invoice data quality.
* Conduct timekeeper rate reviews and support resolution of discrepancies with Legal, Finance, and external law firms. 3. Budgeting, Accruals & Forecasting
* Support preparation of legal budget reports, forecasts, accruals, and spend tracking.
* Maintain forecast trackers and financial data repositories for Legal matters and vendors.
* Gather, validate, and follow up on financial information to ensure completeness, accuracy, and timely reporting.
* Identify trends, variances, and follow-up items related to legal fees, budgets, and spend. 4. Vendor, Law Firm & Stakeholder Coordination
* Collaborate with lawyers, Finance, Accounts Payable, Procurement, external law firms, and vendors to resolve legal fee, billing, payment, and budget-related issues.
* Support vendor onboarding processes and maintain accurate vendor and law firm records.
* Manage the Legal support mailbox and act as a central point of contact for legal finance queries. 5. Systems, Tools & Process Support
* Support Legal Tracker or similar finance, matter management, and e-billing platforms.
* Troubleshoot platform issues and coordinate resolution with customer support teams, vendors, IT, Finance, and relevant internal teams.
* Support integration and alignment with other Finance tools and enterprise systems.
* Maintain accurate, structured, and up-to-date records, documentation, trackers, and process references. 6. Reporting, Dashboards & Continuous Improvement
* Prepare dashboards, reports, and operational summaries covering legal spend, matters, invoices, vendors, forecasts, accruals, and process performance.
* Support continuous improvement of financial processes within Legal GBS.
* Identify opportunities to improve data quality, transparency, controls, and efficiency across legal finance operations. We're looking for someone who Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related field. 7–9 years of experience in a finance-related role, preferably AP / AR / P2P, Legal Operations, e-billing, matter management, or shared services environment. Experience working with financial systems, legal e-billing platforms, matter management systems, or enterprise workflow tools. Experience in a multinational or GBS environment is an advantage. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications including Word and PowerPoint. Experience with Legal Tracker or similar matter management / e-billing systems is preferred. Understanding of legal finance processes including purchase orders, invoices, accruals, forecasting, vendor onboarding, and legal spend tracking. Familiarity with billing guidelines, UTBMS codes, LEDES formats, timekeeper rates, and law firm invoice review processes is preferred. Ability to prepare trackers, dashboards, reports, and structured financial summaries. Comfort working with finance tools, legal technology platforms, and system integration / troubleshooting processes. What you'll get Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes Market-competitive pay and performance related rewards Flexible ways of working Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work Time off to rest and recharge Ongoing learning and development opportunities Specific benefits vary by location

**Why join us?**
This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.

title: Legal Manager - Non Litigation
description:
Job Description

Designation: Manager / Sr. Manager – Legal (Commercial & Arbitration)

Function: Legal & Compliance Reporting to: Head – Legal / CFO / CEO (as applicable) Location: [Specify Location]

-

Role Purpose

The role is responsible for legal evaluation of bid/tender documents, contract risk assessment, and end-to-end management of arbitration and dispute resolution processes with customers and vendors.

The incumbent will safeguard the organization’s legal and commercial interests while ensuring compliance, risk mitigation, and structured dispute resolution.

-

Key Responsibilities (KRAs)

1️⃣ Bid & Tender Legal Evaluation

* Review and evaluate RFPs, RFQs, tender documents, and bid submissions

* Identify legal, contractual, and commercial risks

* Highlight deviation clauses and recommend mitigation strategies

* Draft and review bid qualifications and legal clarifications

* Support Go/No-Go decisions from a legal risk perspective

* Ensure compliance with statutory, regulatory, and contractual obligations

-

2️⃣ Contract Drafting & Commercial Agreements

* Draft, review, and negotiate:

o Customer contracts

o Vendor agreements

o NDAs, MoUs, SLAs, AMC contracts

o Turnkey / project agreements

* Ensure appropriate risk allocation (indemnity, liability caps, penalties, LD clauses)

* Standardize contract templates and maintain clause repository

* Advise business and commercial teams on contractual exposure

-

3️⃣ Arbitration & Dispute Management

* Manage arbitration matters with customers and vendors

* Coordinate with external counsel and represent company interests

* Prepare legal notices, replies, claims, and counter-claims

* Compile documentation and evidence for arbitration proceedings

* Track dispute exposure, timelines, and potential financial impact

* Advise management on settlement strategies and litigation risk

* Maintain dispute MIS and legal risk registers

-

4️⃣ Legal Risk Advisory

* Provide proactive legal advice to Sales, Projects, Procurement & Commercial teams

* Assess contractual risks in large turnkey and long-term projects

* Recommend structured risk mitigation strategies

* Support internal investigations and compliance reviews where required

-

5️⃣ Governance & Compliance

* Ensure compliance with applicable laws including:

o Companies Act

o Contract Act

o Arbitration & Conciliation Act

o Industry-specific regulations

* Maintain centralized contract documentation

* Support internal and external audits

-

Key Risk Indicators (KRIs)

* Acceptance of high-risk contractual clauses without mitigation

* Escalation of disputes due to contractual gaps

* Financial exposure from arbitration awards

* Liquidated damages triggered due to contractual weaknesses

* Delays in legal response to notices or claims

* Inadequate documentation impacting dispute outcomes

-

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Turnaround time (TAT) for contract reviews

* Reduction in contractual risk exposure

* Favorable arbitration outcomes / settlements

* Reduction in dispute escalation cases

* Standardization and implementation of contract templates

-

Education & Qualification Parameters

Mandatory:

* LLB (Bachelor of Laws)

Preferred:

* LLM (Corporate / Commercial Law preferred)

* 5–10 years of experience in commercial contracts and arbitration

* Experience in telecom / infrastructure / project-driven industry

* Strong understanding of Arbitration & Conciliation Act and commercial dispute handling

-

Key Competencies

Functional:

* Contract drafting & negotiation

* Legal risk assessment

* Arbitration handling & dispute management

* Commercial awareness

* Regulatory knowledge

Behavioral:

* Strong analytical and risk-oriented mindset

* Negotiation and influencing ability

* High attention to detail

* Ability to work under pressure

* Strong stakeholder management

-

Interface Departments

* Sales & Business Development

* Projects & Operations

* Procurement & Commercial

* Finance

* External Legal Counsel

* Customers & Vendors

description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026.

**About Position:**

We are seeking an experienced Assistant Group Counsel to support and manage a wide range of commercial contracting and legal advisory activities across global business operations. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and closing commercial agreements, particularly within the technology and professional services industry. This role requires a business-oriented legal professional who can balance legal risk with commercial objectives while supporting stakeholders across multiple geographies and functions.

* **Role: Assistant Group Counsel – Commercial Contracts**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Draft, review, negotiate, and manage a variety of commercial agreements including Master Services Agreements (MSAs), Statements of Work (SOWs), Consulting Agreements, Independent Contractor Agreements, Employment Agreements, Software License Agreements, Software Reseller Agreements.
* Structure and negotiate contracts to ensure alignment with business objectives while minimizing legal and commercial risks.
* Support contract negotiations with customers, vendors, partners, and third parties across multiple jurisdictions.
* Ensure contractual terms comply with internal legal policies, governance frameworks, and company standards.
* Manage the end-to-end contract lifecycle, including drafting, revisions, approvals, execution, and archiving.
* Coordinate contract execution and ensure all agreements are properly documented and maintained within contract management systems.
* Provide legal guidance and commercial support to business, sales, delivery, procurement, finance, HR, administration, and other internal functions.
* Review contractual risks and prepare recommendations for internal stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Assess commercial disputes, claims, and contractual issues, and provide legal summaries and risk assessments to decision-makers.
* Support litigation management activities and coordinate with external counsel, insurance carriers, and other legal advisors where required.
* Provide legal support for employment-related matters and internal policy implementation.
* Assist in developing contract templates, negotiation playbooks, and legal process improvements.
* Conduct legal awareness sessions and training programs for employees and business stakeholders.
* Monitor legal and regulatory developments relevant to commercial contracting and business operations.
* Handle special projects and legal matters as assigned by leadership.

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 8-12 years of experience in commercial contracting, corporate legal affairs, or technology-focused legal functions.
* Strong expertise in commercial services contracting including MSAs, SOWs, software licensing, reseller agreements, consulting contracts, and employment agreements.
* Proven experience drafting, vetting, negotiating, and closing complex commercial agreements.
* Hands-on experience supporting contracts involving India and US jurisdictions.
* Exposure to contracts across Europe, Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific regions will be an advantage.
* Strong understanding of contract law, commercial risk management, and legal compliance requirements.
* Experience assessing contractual disputes, claims, liabilities, and legal risks.
* Ability to independently manage contract negotiations and drive agreements to closure.
* Experience working with cross-functional business teams and senior stakeholders.
* Familiarity with litigation management processes and interactions with external legal counsel.
* Strong knowledge of legal documentation, contract governance, and records management practices.
* Excellent legal drafting, communication, negotiation, and analytical skills.
* Demonstrated ability to handle multiple priorities and work effectively under pressure.
* Strong commercial acumen and business-oriented approach to legal problem-solving.
* Bachelor's Degree in Law (LLB) or equivalent legal qualification.
* Enrollment with the relevant Bar Council and legal practice credentials preferred.

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

title: Compliance Manager
description:
**About SJ Group**
Surbana Jurong Group is a diverse collective of problem solvers for the built environment, continually reimagining ways to create a smart and sustainable future.
  
  
Headquartered in Singapore, the group has a global talent pool of 16,000+ in Surbana Jurong and its member companies AETOS, Atelier Ten, B+H, CHIL, KTP, Prostruct, Robert Bird Group, SAA and SMEC, based in more than 120 offices in over 40 countries. They include architects, designers, planners, engineers, facilities managers and other specialists driven by progressive thinking and creative ideas to shape a better future.
  
  
**About The Role**
The
**Compliance Manager**
, based at our Head Office in Gurugram, India, will support the implementation of the Group Compliance Programme and promote a strong culture of ethics, integrity and compliance across the business.
  
  
The role will focus on compliance risk management, ethics and compliance processes, investigations, third-party due diligence, monitoring and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the implementation and continuous improvement of the Compliance Programme.
* Promote ethics, integrity and compliance through training, awareness and business engagement.
* Maintain compliance risk registers and support identification and mitigation of key risks.
* Manage compliance processes including Conflict of Interest, Employee Declarations, Gifts & Hospitality and Business Partner Due Diligence.
* Conduct and coordinate third-party due diligence and compliance assessments.
* Support investigations relating to whistleblower reports, fraud, misconduct, bribery and corruption.
* Provide practical compliance guidance to business stakeholders.
* Support compliance monitoring, audits, reporting and management updates.
* Support ISO 37001 readiness and other compliance assurance initiatives.
* Monitor relevant regulatory developments and support implementation of required actions.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Law, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Risk Management, Governance or a related discipline.
* Relevant professional certification in Compliance, Risk, Internal Audit, Fraud or AML would be an advantage.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in Compliance, Risk Management, Internal Audit, Governance, Investigations or related disciplines.
* Strong experience in Ethics & Compliance, ABAC, Whistleblower/Speak-Up Programmes, Third-Party Due Diligence and Compliance Risk Management.
* Experience in a multinational, consulting, engineering, infrastructure, construction or professional services environment would be highly regarded.
* Exposure to ISO 37001 would be advantageous.

**Skills & Attributes**

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Good analytical, investigative and problem-solving abilities.
* High level of integrity, professionalism and confidentiality.
* Strong attention to detail and sound judgement.

?
  
  
Join a global, multidisciplinary consultancy shaping sustainable, people-centric environments across 40+ countries. Work with world-class teams and lead impactful landscape design across the region.
  
  
All recruitment activities are handled by our internal Talent Acquisition Team, and this role currently doesn't require agency input.
  
  
Please do not forward resumes directly to SJ employees/managers; we do not accept unsolicited resumes and are not responsible for any associated fees.
  
  
\*\*Only shortlisted candidates will be notified\*\*

title: Lead Network Policy
description:
**The Role**
This role will be responsible for shaping and supporting policy and regulatory frameworks impacting digital commerce in India, while driving ONDC’s engagement with government and regulatory stakeholders.
  
  
The individual will work closely with ministries, regulators, and public institutions to enable policy alignment, support regulatory development, and strengthen ONDC’s positioning within the evolving digital commerce ecosystem.
  
  
Additionally, the role will contribute to the techno-legal framework for network governance, including the design of systems and mechanisms to monitor and ensure policy compliance across the network.
  
  
This position sits at the intersection of public policy, regulatory affairs, and government engagement, requiring both strategic thinking and execution capability.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* Government & Policy Engagement: engage with government entities and regulatory bodies on matters related to digital commerce and network-based platforms.
* Build and manage relationships with key policymakers, ministries, and regulatory stakeholders; represent ONDC in policy forums, consultations, working groups, and government discussions.
* Policy & Regulatory Development: track and interpret developments across e-commerce policy, digital trade, competition, and data governance frameworks — including the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act and related rules.
* Contribute to policy notes, consultation responses, discussion papers, and regulatory submissions; support the development of policy recommendations relevant to ONDC.
* Work on key themes such as platform neutrality, interoperability, digital inclusion, and network governance.
* Research & Policy Analysis: conduct in-depth policy research, regulatory analysis, and impact assessments; develop briefing notes, policy papers, and executive presentations for leadership and external stakeholders.
* Prepare management reports and information packs — in particular for regulator meetings, internal reviews, and committee presentations — ensuring timely and accurate reporting.
* Stakeholder & Ecosystem Management: engage with industry bodies, think tanks, research institutions, and ecosystem participants; collaborate closely with legal, operations, technology, and leadership.
* Capability Building: deliver training sessions and regulatory updates to product teams and the wider business, and build scalable processes, templates, and documentation for the team as it grows.

**What Success Looks Like**
You become ONDC’s trusted voice on policy — tracking regulatory change before it lands, translating it into practical guidance for the business, and representing ONDC credibly with ministries, regulators, and institutions.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**

* 8+ years in public policy, regulatory affairs, or government engagement — preferably in digital, technology, or e-commerce sectors.
* Strong understanding of India’s regulatory landscape, policy-making processes, and frameworks including the DPDP Act.
* Excellent research, writing, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with the ability to translate policy into actionable frameworks.
* Comfortable working in a cross-functional, high-impact environment, with strong interpersonal skills for internal and external stakeholder collaboration.

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our General Counsel Shared Services Team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
  
  
**General Counsel Shared Services**
General Counsel (GC) is a trusted advisor to all parts of Fidelity International Limited (“FIL”), providing high-value independent advisory and assurance expertise through our specialist teams. GC comprises Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, and Public Policy & Strategic Relationship Management. The GC Shared Services function is a global centre of expertise currently located in Dalian and India, providing operational support and services to the General Counsel function.
  
  
**Global Investment Compliance:**
The Global Investment Compliance (GIC) function provides advice, support, oversight and challenge to teams across Fidelity’s Asset Management Platforms. Stakeholders include portfolio managers, research analysts, trading desks, corporate finance, institutional teams and their respective support groups.
  
  
**Investment Compliance Monitoring:**
The Investment Compliance Monitoring team forms a crucial component of the Global Investment Compliance department, with teams located in Japan, Hong Kong, London, and Gurgaon. The team supports the implementation and continuous execution of trading, communication, and other regulatory surveillance processes. This involves examining alerts, identifying potential market abuse or misconduct, escalating issues, supporting investigations, and strengthening surveillance controls. The team works closely with global stakeholders, supports system testing and optimisation, and plays a key role in enhancing processes and maintaining thorough documentation.
  
  
**About Your Role**
The role supports monitoring trading activity in stocks listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and other relevant market conduct surveillance activities. You will be responsible for monitoring trading in accordance with market regulations and guidelines to detect suspicious transactions that might constitute market abuse. In addition, there will be opportunities to perform other activities undertaken by the firm’s Investment Compliance function.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Using proprietary and market-leading tools to perform recurring exception monitoring of FIL’s trading and other investment activities and investigates exceptions and incidents which include, but not limited to, best execution, fair allocation, market conduct, and conflicts of interest;
* Respond to requests and inquiries from regulators, exchanges and industry bodies, including the SESC, KLFB, JSDA, JPX, and IMAJ..
* Assisting with thematic reviews, desktop reviews and projects;
* Coordinate and collaborate with internal teams in relation to periodic regulatory supervisory inspections.
* Supporting the monitoring and analysis of regulatory trends and changes to the various rules and regulations impacting FIL’s investment functions and working closely with and advising internal stakeholders on the impact of such trends and changes.
* Supporting the development, review and implementation of changes to policies and procedures related to FIL’s investment functions.
* Develop effective working relationships with other functional areas to support the timely receipt of information required to complete monitoring and review activities.
* Provide a high-quality and timely service to internal stakeholders.

**Experience And Qualifications Required**

* Strong analytical capabilities and excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Native Japanese speaker or highly fluent in Japanese, demonstrated by successful completion of JLPT N1. Fluency in English is also required.
* 7+ years of experience in the financial services industry in an oversight, compliance monitoring, surveillance, or securities operations capacity, with a firm understanding of concepts and practices relating to equities trading.
* Good understanding of Japanese regulations and market practices, including but not limited to the Financial Instruments Exchange Law, JSDA Rules and Guidelines, and the Tokyo Stock Exchange Regulations.
* Experience responding to regulator or exchange enquiries, supporting regulatory inspections, or assisting with investigations would be advantageous.
* Strong ability to analyse trading activity, identify unusual patterns, document investigation outcomes and escalate issues appropriately.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Japanese and English.
* Practical knowledge and skilled in using MS Office applications, especially PowerPoint, Excel and Word.
* Professional certification such as JSDA Internal Control Supervisor (Naibu Kanri Sekininsha) qualification or CAMS, CISI, CFA, FRM, or CPA is desirable but not essential.
* A global perspective and cultural awareness, with the ability to work effectively across regions and time zones.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and investigative discipline, with professional scepticism and sound judgement.
* High degree of integrity, discretion, and ability to handle confidential or sensitive matters.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders, clearly articulate issues to senior management, and challenge constructively where required.
* Strong self-motivation, organisation, prioritisation, and time management skills. Positive team player with the ability to work independently and take initiative.

**Feel rewarded**
For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

title: Manager, Resposible AI, GESS - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.
  
  
**The Team**
You will be joining a newly formed Global AI & Knowledge Organization (GAIKO) led by a Chief AI & Knowledge Officer who is moving fast. The team is global, still being staffed, and operating with urgency. The broader team includes a product & tech pillar, change management, KM services, operations and value & governance.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**

* AI Governance & Policy
* Working in partnership with the GAIKO + IT+ Risk + InfoSec and with support of the AI Operating Committee (AIOC), help design and operationalize the firm's global Responsible AI framework, including policies, standards, intake processes, use case approvals, and risk escalation procedures.
* Define the firm’s end-to-end pathway for creating and deploying AI — who may build, in which environments (including sandbox standards for prototyping and experimentation), what data controls apply at each stage, and the gates, criteria, and approval forums required to move work from internal experimentation to client-facing deployment — integrating with, rather than duplicating, existing technology risk review forums.[C1.1]
* Provide RAI assessments of proposed AI tools and partnerships, evaluating data residency, confidentiality, bias, and compliance risk. This includes independently supporting the evaluation of vendors’ technical architecture and data-handling claims, in partnership with Information Security.
* Co-own and maintain, with GSO and other designated stakeholders, [JB2.1][C2.2]the firm's AI Responsible Use guidelines, updating them as the regulatory landscape evolves across key jurisdictions (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, GDPR, India DPDP Act, and others).
* Define the RAI function's charter, roadmap, and KPIs in collaboration with the other relevant stakeholders; build the operating model for how RAI integrates with risk, delivery, legal, compliance, and IT security teams globally.
* Serve as a firm-wide subject matter expert on AI governance, policy, and responsible use strategy.
* Ethics & Bias Review
* Design and lead a repeatable pre-deployment ethics review process for AI models and tools, including fairness audits, bias testing, impact assessments, documentation standards, escalation paths, and sign-off criteria.
* Build and strengthen client AI case review processes ensuring that AI used in client engagements meets appropriate standards for transparency, bias, accuracy, and data handling before delivery.
* Build playbooks and toolkits that embed responsible AI principles into project delivery lifecycles across all practice areas and geographies.
* Partner closely with the Change Management function to weave RAI messaging into the firm's broader AI adoption and culture change agenda, making responsible use a visible, positive part of the firm's AI transformation, not a compliance afterthought.
* AI Risk & Audit
* Define and manage a global AI risk taxonomy and register; assess risk across the full AI lifecycle (data sourcing, model development, deployment, monitoring, and decommissioning).
* Establish audit and monitoring mechanisms for production AI systems, including tracking for model drift, performance degradation, data handling violations, and regulatory compliance gaps.
* Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, and IT Security to ensure all AI deployments meet applicable data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements across jurisdictions.
* Serve as the RAI technical counterpart to Information Security across all AI work including vendor tools, internally built solutions, agentic workflows, and engagement-team prototypes, and jointly evaluating data handling, controls, security architecture, and residency.
* Prepare and deliver executive-level risk reporting on the firm's AI risk posture for the AIOC and, where required, for escalation to the AI Board or client audiences.

**Qualifications**

* 8–12 years of total experience, with at least 2 years focused on AI governance, responsible AI, technology risk, or a closely related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience building a governance framework, risk program, or compliance function. Prior experience standing up a new function or practice is strongly preferred.
* Hands-on technical experience assessing AI/ML systems: data flows and pipelines, model development lifecycles, API and integration architecture (including agentic patterns and MCP-style integrations), cloud data residency and security controls, and common bias and fairness methodologies.
* Ability to independently evaluate a vendor’s technical and data-handling claims and partner credibly with information security teams on assessments — challenging technical evidence, not only summarizing it.
* Career background in ML engineering, data engineering, security/GRC engineering, or technology risk with demonstrable technical depth. Candidates whose experience is exclusively policy or legal are unlikely to meet the technical bar for this role.
* Solid command of key regulatory and standards frameworks relevant to a global consulting firm: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, GDPR, and India's DPDP Act.
* Ability to operate effectively across geographies and time zones; comfortable collaborating with a primarily USbased leadership team from an India-based position.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to translate complex risk and governance concepts for both technical practitioners and C-suite audiences.
* Proven ability to influence without authority in a matrixed, fast-paced professional services environment.
